recipes.description: Cartridge cases, a scoop of powder, and a man who has done this ten thousand times and still has most of his fingers.

recipes.name: Hammer Scrap Shot
recipes.description: Feed the hull plating of somebody who underestimated you into one end; take cased shot out of the other.

recipes.name: Heat Sink Casting
recipes.description: Cast and stack copper-aluminum fin arrays into finished thermal-management units for weapons, engines, and station machinery.

recipes.name: Hoarfrost Core Reactor
recipes.description: Seat a Hoarfrost Leviathan's frozen heartcore in a power core. Its endless cold keeps the reactor superconducting, so it needs no fuel rods and no coolant of its own.

recipes.name: Infuse Starshine
recipes.description: Energy crystals ground to powder and dissolved into pirate moonshine, then aged in zero-gravity chambers until the crystalline suspension stabilizes. The glow is real. The hangover is worse.

recipes.name: Ion Nodule Extraction
recipes.description: Discharge tempest-manta ion nodules into a sealed extraction cell and draw off the suspended ion solution before the magnetic field collapses. A steady hand and fast equipment make the difference between a full vial and a scorch mark.

recipes.name: Ionize Neon Gas
recipes.description: Excite and contain neon gas in sealed tubes for sensor and signaling applications.

recipes.name: Irradiated Marrow Tap
recipes.description: Tap the glowing marrow of a geiger-hound for a dense, dangerous run of power cells.

recipes.name: Krypton Bladder Purification
recipes.description: Crack glassjelly bladders through a cold-trap column to yield purified krypton. The creature's membrane does the hard separation work; the purification step just removes residual moisture and biological trace.

recipes.name: Ladle Pilot-Whale Chowder
recipes.description: Whale blubber rendered slow into a thick chowder with crystal-melt and greens. Cloud-whaler's homecoming.

recipes.name: Lattice Jump Core
recipes.description: Grow a jump drive core around an exotic lattice. The self-organizing crystal does the work of a heap of exotic crystal and quantum matrix — leviathan-grade feedstock for the deepest endgame drives.

recipes.name: Leviathan Core Reactor
recipes.description: Wire a Molt Leviathan's crystallized heartcore into a power core. The cardiac node is already a living fusion source — the assembly only has to tap it, in place of fuel rods and helium-3.

recipes.name: Levity Gas Synthesis
recipes.description: Crack the hydrogen float-sacs of bell-jellies into standard fuel cells.

recipes.name: Lightweight Titanium Alloy
recipes.description: An aluminum-extended forging process. Lightweight aluminum panels and steel carry most of the structure, with titanium added only where strength is critical — using a third of the titanium of a standard forge. Cheap and available anywhere, but the blending of dissimilar metals takes longer.

recipes.name: Liquefy Oxygen
recipes.description: Cryogenically compress and liquefy oxygen gas for propellant storage.

recipes.name: Load Red Mist
recipes.description: Gutter flux refined into a synthetic adrenaline compound, mixed with neural accelerants derived from pharmaceutical cultures, and loaded into single-use injectors. The dosage is not adjustable by design.

recipes.name: Machine Barrel Assembly
recipes.description: Machine Barrel Assembly.

recipes.name: Mantis Claw Plating
recipes.description: Laminate the serrated forelimbs of a crusher-mantis into reinforced armor plate.

recipes.name: Manufacture Antimatter-Core Rounds
recipes.description: Magnetically contained antimatter warheads packed in a shielded crate. Extreme damage with minor splash effect.

recipes.name: Manufacture AP Rounds
recipes.description: Hardened penetrator rounds that bypass armor plating.

recipes.name: Manufacture Cascade EM Charges
recipes.description: Chain-reaction electromagnetic charges.

recipes.name: Manufacture Corrosive Plasma Cells
recipes.description: Hull-eating corrosive plasma cells.

recipes.name: Manufacture Cryo Slugs
recipes.description: Supercooled ceramic-jacketed slug cases.

recipes.name: Manufacture Dispersal Plasma Cells
recipes.description: Wide-dispersal plasma for area coverage.

recipes.name: Manufacture DU Rounds
recipes.description: Ultra-dense depleted uranium penetrator rounds.

recipes.name: Manufacture EM Charges
recipes.description: Standard electromagnetic disruption charge packs.

recipes.name: Manufacture EMP Rounds
recipes.description: Rounds with embedded micro-EMP charges.

recipes.name: Manufacture EMP Slugs
recipes.description: Slugs with embedded EMP burst coils.

recipes.name: Manufacture Entropic Void Cores
recipes.description: Entropy-accelerating void cores.

recipes.name: Manufacture Ferrous Slugs
recipes.description: Dense iron slug cases for railgun systems.

recipes.name: Manufacture Focused EM Charges
recipes.description: Concentrated EM burst charge packs.

recipes.name: Manufacture Focused Plasma Cells
recipes.description: Tight-beam plasma cells with concentrated energy.

recipes.name: Manufacture Frag Rounds
recipes.description: Pre-scored rounds that shatter into shrapnel on impact.

recipes.name: Manufacture Fuel Basic
recipes.description: Combust liquid hydrogen to produce station fuel reserves.

recipes.name: Manufacture Fuel (Catalytic)
recipes.description: Crack liquid hydrogen over a platinum catalyst bed for fast, feedstock-lean fuel production. The bed fouls each run and is consumed with it.

recipes.name: Manufacture Fuel (H2O2)
recipes.description: Combust liquid hydrogen with liquid oxygen for high-efficiency fuel production.

recipes.name: Manufacture Fuel (Plasma)
recipes.description: Direct plasma combustion for premium-throughput fuel production.

recipes.name: Manufacture Incendiary Rounds
recipes.description: Phosphorus-tipped rounds for sustained thermal damage.

recipes.name: Manufacture Ion Charges
recipes.description: Heavy ion charges with increased shield damage.

recipes.name: Manufacture Methane Fuel
recipes.description: Reform liquid methane into station fuel reserves using an industrial heat-recovery cycle.

recipes.name: Manufacture Neural EM Charges
recipes.description: AI-disrupting neural interference charges.

recipes.name: Manufacture Neutronium Slugs
recipes.description: Impossibly dense neutronium-core slugs.

recipes.name: Manufacture Null Void Cores
recipes.description: Null-space void cores.

recipes.name: Manufacture Omega Cores
recipes.description: Rebuild singularity cores around nebulium confinement and stabilized exotic matter.

recipes.name: Manufacture Overcharged Plasma Cells
recipes.description: Dangerously high-output plasma cells.

recipes.name: Manufacture Phased Void Cores
recipes.description: Phase-shifted void cores.

recipes.name: Manufacture Plasma Cells
recipes.description: Stabilized plasma cell packs with enhanced output for plasma weapons.

recipes.name: Manufacture Shaped Charge Slugs
recipes.description: Explosive-lined railgun slugs.

recipes.name: Manufacture Singularity Cores
recipes.description: Phase paired singularity charges through void crystal and superconducting containment.

recipes.name: Manufacture Singularity Slugs
recipes.description: Seat micro-singularity charges inside osmium-jacketed tungsten railgun penetrators.

recipes.name: Manufacture Standard Plasma Charges
recipes.description: Mass-produce inexpensive plasma charges directly from harvested plasma gas.

recipes.name: Manufacture Standard Rounds
recipes.description: Box of basic autocannon ammunition. Cheap and reliable.

recipes.name: Manufacture Stellar Plasma Cells
recipes.description: Contain oxygen-enriched plasma behind rhodium-coated thermal reflectors.

recipes.name: Manufacture Tungsten Slugs
recipes.description: Heavy tungsten penetrator slug cases.

recipes.name: Manufacture Void Cores
recipes.description: Standard void energy core packs.

recipes.name: Manufacture Void-Tuned EM Charges
recipes.description: Retune standard EM charges around void-crystal harmonics using permanent magnetic guides.

recipes.name: Mint Gold Bar
recipes.description: Smelt and assay ten measures of gold ore into a single stamped bar of pure bullion — a trophy of wealth, not a working material.

recipes.name: Mint Platinum Bar
recipes.description: Refine ten measures of platinum ore into a single white-metal bar — the collector's choice of bullion, prized precisely because it is rare and does nothing.

recipes.name: Mint Silver Bar
recipes.description: Cast ten measures of silver ore into a single assayed bar of bullion — a tangible flex; no machine will ever ask for it.

recipes.name: Mix Cobalt Cordial
recipes.description: A deep-blue non-alcoholic cordial coloured with a whisper of cobalt-squid ink and sweetened with fruit.

recipes.name: Mix Noble-Gas Spritz
recipes.description: A dry fruit spritz aerated with halo-drifter noble condensate so it never quite goes flat.

recipes.name: Mix Prism-Charged Cocktail
recipes.description: Gloomshine and honeyglobe spiked with prism-charged ichor so the drink shifts through a whole spectrum.

recipes.name: Mix Radiant Tonic
recipes.description: Crystal-melt, noble condensate, and a carefully small amount of radiant bile, glowing green.

recipes.name: Mix Structural Cement
recipes.description: Bind silicate aggregate and flexible polymer around corrosion-resistant alloy reinforcement.

recipes.name: Mold Pressure Seal
recipes.description: Form polymer gaskets rated for vacuum-to-atmosphere pressure differentials.

recipes.name: Mull Whale-Oil Grog
recipes.description: Rough gloomshine, honeyglobe, and a controversial float of whale oil, served hot.

recipes.name: Nitrogen Bladder Decanting
recipes.description: Puncture frostblister bladders into a cryo-column and decant the pressurized contents as liquid nitrogen. The biology does the condensation; the rig just catches what pours out.

recipes.name: Noble Gas Liquefaction
recipes.description: Render a halo-drifter's noble condensate into dense, clean-burning fuel cells.

recipes.name: Onboard Alloy Synthesis
recipes.description: The ship's molecular forge combines raw ores directly into titanium alloy.

recipes.name: Onboard Chlorine Weaponization
recipes.description: The ship's chemical bay processes raw chlorine gas into weapons-grade reagents. Less efficient than a fixed plant, which adds a polymer binder to lift yield.

recipes.name: Onboard Dark Matter Condensing
recipes.description: The ship's containment press compresses raw dark matter residue on its own. Less efficient than a fixed plant, which adds durasteel containment to lift yield.

recipes.name: Onboard Exotic Stabilization
recipes.description: The ship's dimensional forge stabilizes raw exotic matter on its own. Less efficient than a fixed plant, which adds focused crystals to lift yield.

recipes.name: Onboard Fluorine Synthesis
recipes.description: The ship's containment loop converts raw fluorine gas into etching solution. Less efficient than a fixed plant, which adds ceramite stock to lift yield.

recipes.name: Onboard H2O2 Fuel Synthesis
recipes.description: Electrolyze water ice from the hold and burn the hydrogen and oxygen straight into the ship's fuel tank, skipping the entire purification, electrolysis, and fuel-manufacturing chain. Hugely inefficient next to station production, but it needs no dock.

recipes.name: Onboard Hydrogen Fuel Synthesis
recipes.description: Crudely combust raw hydrogen gas from the hold straight into the ship's fuel tank, skipping compression and proper fuel refining. Wildly wasteful next to a station's fuel facilities, but it needs no dock.

recipes.name: Onboard Legacy Smelting
recipes.description: The ship's smelter renders raw Legacy ore into refined alloy. Less efficient than a fixed plant, which adds steel stock to lift yield.

recipes.name: Onboard Munitions Fabrication
recipes.description: The ship's integrated forge converts raw iron ore directly into standard ammunition.

recipes.name: Onboard Nebulium Processing
recipes.description: The ship's compression core packs raw nebulium into a power core. Less efficient than a fixed plant, which uses dense purified argon to reduce crystal loss.

recipes.name: Pack Package
recipes.description: Pack a player-selected manifest (up to 100 size) into a labeled cargo package. Consumes one cargo container and requires a Logistics facility.

recipes.name: Pack Sensor Obscurant
recipes.description: Freeze conductive carbon particles into polymer capsules that disperse as a sensor-blocking cloud.

recipes.name: Package Crimson Iron Rations
recipes.description: Ironhearth's ration works run three shifts a day. The product is nutritionally complete, structurally dense, and universally described as 'effective.' Nobody asks for seconds.

recipes.name: Palladium Membrane Compression
recipes.description: A palladium membrane drinks raw hydrogen into its lattice and releases it fuel-grade and dense, capturing gas a brute-force compressor would simply vent. The membrane slowly saturates with impurities and must be renewed, but it draws meaningfully more liquid hydrogen from the same feed.

recipes.name: Pan-Galactic Alloy Synthesis
recipes.description: Fuse a Rainbow Leviathan's prismatic carapace with the charged ichor of its exotic feeding grounds into a pan-galactic matrix. The exotic metals are already concentrated in the shell — the forge only has to bind them.

recipes.name: Plasma-Flux Titanium Alloy
recipes.description: A plasma-flux forge: high-energy plasma residue superheats steel and fuses it into a titanium-extended alloy, cutting the raw titanium needed to a third. Slower and dependent on exotic plasma, but a lifeline where titanium is scarce.

recipes.name: Plate Cobalt Roe Blini
recipes.description: Warm sunspindle blini, a swipe of verdigris curd, and a cold spoonful of cobalt roe on top. Three bites of blue on white.

recipes.name: Plate Lumen Algae Salad
recipes.description: Toss glowing algae ribbons with driftkale and split honeyglobe, dressed at the last moment so the light survives to the table.

recipes.name: Plate Surf-and-Turf Platter
recipes.description: Crusher-mantis claw and a grazer steak on one board with a pile of greens — the classic payday order.

recipes.name: Plate Tide-Line Platter
recipes.description: The raw-bar tower: fanned glintfin, rivetshell on the half-shell, and a cracked mantis claw over shaved ice with driftkale and a rack of sharp sauces.

recipes.name: Polish Nebula Prism Lens
recipes.description: Cut and polish raw nebula prism crystals with refined crystal substrates to produce lenses for long-range sensor arrays.

recipes.name: Prepare Gourmet Rations
recipes.description: The Solarian biosphere kitchens prepare premium vacuum-sealed meals from hydroponically-grown ingredients.

recipes.name: Prepare Rainbow Leviathan Carpaccio
recipes.description: Rainbow Leviathan flesh sliced tissue-thin and lightly cured with lumen oil, keeping the starlight shimmer intact.

recipes.name: Press Algae Wafers
recipes.description: Press bioluminescent algae and sunspindle flour into thin sheets and bake them until they snap.

recipes.name: Press Cultured Protein Rations
recipes.description: Season cultured vatflesh curd, hydrate it with clean water, and press it into shelf-stable ration blocks. No hunting required.

recipes.name: Process Ammonia Ice
recipes.description: Melt and purify frozen ammonia into pressurized anhydrous liquid.

recipes.name: Process Carbon Dioxide Ice
recipes.description: Sublimate dry ice, filter the vapor, and compress it into clean industrial carbon dioxide.

recipes.name: Process Copper Wiring
recipes.description: Draw copper ore into conductive wiring.

recipes.name: Process Deuterium Ice
recipes.description: Extract heavy hydrogen isotopes for fusion reactors.

recipes.name: Process Helium Ice
recipes.description: Extract helium-3 isotopes from frozen gas deposits.

recipes.name: Process Methane Ice
recipes.description: Melt, filter, and condense frozen methane into fuel-grade cryogenic liquid.

recipes.name: Process Nebulium Core
recipes.description: Compress crystallized nebula energy inside a dense, inert argon atmosphere to form a stable power core.

recipes.name: Process Nitrogen Ice
recipes.description: Extract liquid nitrogen from frozen deposits.

recipes.name: Process Null Matter
recipes.description: Stabilize raw null matter into a usable form for stealth technology and containment systems.

recipes.name: Process Oxygen Ice
recipes.description: Warm and purify solid oxygen into a clean gas stream for life support and propellant production.

recipes.name: Process Radium
recipes.description: Extract and purify radium into radioluminescent phosphor compound.

recipes.name: Process Thorium
recipes.description: Refine thorium concentrate into stable reactor-grade processed thorium.

recipes.name: Process Tritium Ice
recipes.description: Liquefy and purify tritium ice into cryogenic liquid tritium for fusion fuel applications.

recipes.name: Process Water Ice
recipes.description: Melt water ice into purified water for life support and further processing.

recipes.name: Produce Solarian Biotic
recipes.description: Certified in clean-room facilities by the Solarian Biotech Division. Each batch tested, documented, and priced at a premium the Confederacy considers entirely justified.

recipes.name: Pull Cobalt Squid Noodles
recipes.description: Hand-pulled sunspindle noodles slicked with cobalt ink and a fierce hit of cinderspice. Dockside street food.

recipes.name: Pull Void Espresso
recipes.description: Spore-mash coffee pulled short and dosed with void-charged ichor, crema aglow.

recipes.name: Purify Argon
recipes.description: Process argon for welding and shield systems.

recipes.name: Radiant Bile Enrichment
recipes.description: Refine the radioisotope-rich bile of a cinder-urchin into shielded power cells. Hazard pay recommended.

recipes.name: Rebuild Power Cells
recipes.description: Reconstruct power cells from salvaged rare materials. Requires careful handling of exotic conductors.

recipes.name: Reclaim Circuit Boards
recipes.description: Painstaking extraction of intact circuits from salvage. The rare materials contain trace elements essential for microprocessor fabrication.

recipes.name: Reclaim Steel from Scrap
recipes.description: Melt down salvage metal and reforge it into usable steel. Less pure than ore-smelted steel, but good enough for repairs.

recipes.name: Recover Heat Sinks
recipes.description: Extract thermal management components from salvaged electronics. These parts are usually the last thing to fail.

recipes.name: Refine Platinum Catalyst
recipes.description: Reduce raw platinum into a high-surface-area catalytic sponge — the active ingredient in fuel refining, fuel-cell assembly, and air-scrubber cartridges.

recipes.name: Refine Solarian Legacy Ore
recipes.description: Process ancient Solarian Legacy ore into a refined alloy. The smelting process requires precise temperature control to preserve the ore's unique crystalline structure.

recipes.name: Refine Steel
recipes.description: Smelt iron ore into steel plates.

recipes.name: Refine Titanium
recipes.description: Smelt raw titanium ore into usable ingots.

recipes.name: Refine Void Dust
recipes.description: Nebular gas filtered through gutter flux and evaporated to a fine iridescent powder. The reaction requires a sealed room and patience. One mistake and you're the first customer.

recipes.name: Refine Weapons-Grade Plutonium
recipes.description: Chemically separate and refine reactor-grade plutonium into weapons-grade material using polonium as a neutron initiator.

recipes.name: Reforge Hull Plating
recipes.description: Cut and reshape salvaged metal into hull plating sections. Recycled plating has character — some say it's lucky.

recipes.name: Reprogrammed Repair Nanites
recipes.description: Nanites recovered from wreck systems, reprogrammed for hull repair. They remember their old ship — sometimes they get creative with the patches.

recipes.name: Rime Fang Plating
recipes.description: Set frost-lurker fangs into a layer of cold-hardened armor plate.

recipes.name: Roast Leviathan Heartcore
recipes.description: A whole Molt Leviathan heartcore, still warm from harvest, spice-crusted and finished tableside. Theatre and heresy.

recipes.name: Roll Lead Sheet
recipes.description: Roll lead ingots into flat sheets for shielding and container fabrication.

recipes.name: Roll Lead Shielding
recipes.description: Roll and laminate lead sheet onto steel backing for radiation-shielded facility walls.

recipes.name: Roll Memory Metal Sheet
recipes.description: Roll Memory Metal Sheet.

recipes.name: Run Pharmaceutical Lab
recipes.description: Operate a certified biological culture lab to produce standardized pharmaceutical culture media.

recipes.name: Salvager's Repair Kit
recipes.description: Repair kits assembled from salvaged components. Every part has a story, and most of those stories involve explosions.

recipes.name: Sanitize Water
recipes.description: Treat melting water ice with chlorine gas instead of slow filtration. Better yield per block of ice, and the faint pool-deck smell fades before anyone important docks.

recipes.name: Scavenge Fuel Cells
recipes.description: Strip fuel tanks from wrecks and render the residue into usable cells. A pirate's fuel supply is whatever the last crew left behind.

recipes.name: Seal Dark Matter Cell
recipes.description: Suspend Outer Rim dark matter in a hydrogen-cooled containment cell for portable high-density energy storage.

recipes.name: Sear Glintfin
recipes.description: A glintfin fillet dropped into screaming whale oil, crisped and pulled while the center is still barely set, laid over griddled sunspindle.

recipes.name: Sear Hoarfrost Flank Steak
recipes.description: Cold-cured Hoarfrost Leviathan flank seared hard and served blue with a bright ember rub.

recipes.name: Seed Energy Crystals
recipes.description: Use a nebulium core to seed aligned crystal growth through synthetic diamond under a dense purified-argon atmosphere.

recipes.name: Set Ballast Glass
recipes.description: Skip the lead-oxide melt entirely: a bulwark's ballast plate is already dense lead sheet, so a thin silica charge fuses straight against it into a clear, radiation-dense pane. A ranch's plate output substitutes for the six raw lead the old flux route burns.

recipes.name: Set Honeyglobe Custard
recipes.description: Whisk ray yolk into grazer milk, set it low and slow, and torch a honeyglobe glaze to glass on top.

recipes.name: Shake Superfluid Martini
recipes.description: Cut with a drop of frost-moth superfluid — it crawls the glass and never warms in your hand.

recipes.name: Silica Lens Fabrication
recipes.description: Lay down the flawless silica discs a silica-borer grinds into the optical core of a control node.

recipes.name: Simmer Ember Marinara
recipes.description: Crush honeyglobe into a pot with cinderspice and clean water and cook it down slow until the sauce clings. The heat builds late; the pot never empties.

recipes.name: Simmer Molt Leviathan Bisque
recipes.description: A full day's simmer of Molt Leviathan tail in its own stock with whale blubber and crystal-melt, passed through silk to a velvet finish. The pinnacle plate.

recipes.name: Sinter Iridium Composite
recipes.description: Bond a vulcanid's refractory sinter to a silicon charge into a hardened silicate composite. The animal already alloyed the iridium and thorium, so the bench skips the nickel-and-ore combine entirely.

recipes.name: Sinter Neodymium Magnet
recipes.description: Sinter neodymium and iron under purified argon into a powerful permanent magnet.

recipes.name: Sinter Osmium Armor Plate
recipes.description: Consolidate osmium powder under purified argon into ultra-dense armor plate.

recipes.name: Sinter Silicate Composite
recipes.description: Fuse silicon and nickel into a versatile structural composite.

recipes.name: Sinter Tungsten Steel
recipes.description: Sinter powdered tungsten into the iron pour for a denser, harder plate. The tungsten carries part of the structural load, so each batch of iron goes further.

recipes.name: Slice Glintfin Sashimi
recipes.description: Chill the glintfin hard, slice it across the grain into near-translucent ribbons, and fan them over ice with driftkale and a caustic-sharp dab. No heat, nowhere to hide a bad cut.

recipes.name: Smelt Aluminum Sheet
recipes.description: Press aluminum ore into lightweight structural panels.

recipes.name: Smelt Chromium Plate
recipes.description: Refine chromium under inert argon and roll the clean metal into corrosion-resistant plate.

recipes.name: Smelt Ferromanganese Billet
recipes.description: Reduce manganese with iron and carbon into hardening-alloy billets.

recipes.name: Smelt Lead Ingot
recipes.description: Smelt lead ore into ingots for radiation shielding applications.

recipes.name: Smelt Nickel Billet
recipes.description: Concentrate and cast low-grade nickel ore into solid billets for battery and alloy work.

recipes.name: Smelt Noble Superconductor
recipes.description: Draw a bullionaut's noble matte down into a zero-resistance conductor. The platinum-group metals are already fused and pure, so a wrap of copper wiring and a heat is all it takes — no palladium or iridium ore to grind first.

recipes.name: Smelt Relic Alloy
recipes.description: Render a relict's relic amber over a steel charge into solarian legacy alloy. A lifetime of concentrated legacy-ore comes out of one amber, no three-ore refine needed.

recipes.name: Smelt Zinc Ingot
recipes.description: Roast, reduce, and cast zinc ore into corrosion-resistant ingots.

recipes.name: Smoke Xeno Delicacy
recipes.description: Cure and cold-smoke prime cuts of xeno-meat with active fermentation cultures — a slow process that turns rough game into a table centerpiece.

recipes.name: Sour Caustic Ale
recipes.description: A puckering sour ale soured with a controlled trace of chlorophage caustic sac.

recipes.name: Spherify Superfluid Caviar
recipes.description: Frost-moth superfluid spherified into weightless cold-bursting beads over a scrape of rainbow-leviathan flesh.

recipes.name: Spin Metallic Aerogel
recipes.description: Spin Metallic Aerogel.

recipes.name: Spin Optical Fiber
recipes.description: Draw ultra-pure silicon into optical fiber bundles for precision instruments.

recipes.name: Spin Quantum Fizz
recipes.description: A fruit soda spun with quantum-moth silk and biogas until it seems to fizz in several glasses at once.

recipes.name: Stabilize Chlorine Gas
recipes.description: Neutralize and compound raw chlorine gas into stable chemical reagents.

recipes.name: Stabilize Exotic Cyst
recipes.description: Crack an aeonbear's exotic cyst in a containment stabilizer. The creature already walled the exotic matter into a stable husk, so it yields stabilized exotic without the four-unit raw-matter hazard.

recipes.name: Stabilize Exotic Matter
recipes.description: Process exotic matter into usable form.

recipes.name: Stabilize Micro-Singularity Charges
recipes.description: Collapse antimatter inside a nebulium field and seal the singularity seeds in osmium containment.

recipes.name: Stabilize Plasma Gas
recipes.description: Contain and stabilize raw plasma for industrial use.

recipes.name: Steam Rivetshell
recipes.description: Rivetshell tipped live into a gloomcap broth, lidded until they gape, finished with a fistful of cinderspice and served in the shell.

recipes.name: Steep Lumen Liqueur
recipes.description: Gloomshine steeped with cloudwhale lumen oil into a soft, sweet after-dinner glow.

recipes.name: Storm Node Capacitance
recipes.description: Discharge a tempest-eel's electric organ into a fully charged power cell.

recipes.name: Strip Wiring from Components
recipes.description: Carefully extract reusable wiring harnesses from salvaged ship components.

recipes.name: Superfluid Winding
recipes.description: Wind a frost-moth's superfluid helium into the superconducting core of a control node.

recipes.name: Synthesize Afterburner Fuel
recipes.description: Blend ionized gas with hydrogen fuel for explosive short-duration thrust.

recipes.name: Synthesize Argon Power Cell
recipes.description: Ionize and compress purified argon into dense charge cells. Argon lacks xenon's charge density but is found across nearly every system, making it the workhorse choice for bulk power storage.

recipes.name: Synthesize Berserker Compound
recipes.description: Dangerous stimulant that boosts damage at cost of defense.

recipes.name: Synthesize Bio-Polymer
recipes.description: Polymerize synthetic organic compounds into flexible bio-derived polymer. An alternative to silicon-based production routes.

recipes.name: Synthesize Californium Neutron Source
recipes.description: Irradiate reactor-grade plutonium and seal the resulting californium in a shielded mineral-analysis source.

recipes.name: Synthesize Cloaking Dust
recipes.description: Suspend krypton in a metamaterial powder that absorbs photons and bends sensor beams.

recipes.name: Synthesize Coolant Fluid
recipes.description: Blend liquid nitrogen and purified water into a circulating industrial coolant.

recipes.name: Synthesize Endurance Booster
recipes.description: Increases hull and shield resistance temporarily.

recipes.name: Synthesize Energy Crystal
recipes.description: Bombard a synthetic diamond lattice with massive electrical charge in an inert argon atmosphere, forcing crystalline energy alignment.

recipes.name: Synthesize Fluorine Etchant
recipes.description: Convert raw fluorine gas into precisely controlled etching solution. Maximum containment protocols required.

recipes.name: Synthesize Focus Enhancer
recipes.description: Improves accuracy and tracking.

recipes.name: Synthesize Helium Coolant
recipes.description: Dissolve helium-3 into purified water for a coolant that sheds heat faster than the nitrogen blend. Reactor decks that switch don't switch back.

recipes.name: Synthesize Hull Nanites
recipes.description: Program repair nanites to deposit zinc-protected hull material during sustained field repairs.

recipes.name: Synthesize Liquid Tritium
recipes.description: Bombard deuterium with neutrons from a fission reaction to produce tritium. Consumes reactor fuel in the process.

recipes.name: Synthesize Metamaterial
recipes.description: Create materials with impossible optical properties.

recipes.name: Synthesize Methane Fuel Cells
recipes.description: Crack cryogenic methane into a dense charge slurry and seal it behind zinc-protected cell walls, bypassing liquid hydrogen supply lines.

recipes.name: Synthesize Neon Power Cell
recipes.description: Pack ionized neon into discharge cells. The lighter noble gas ionizes readily and is nearly ubiquitous, a reliable fallback wherever xenon is hard to come by.

recipes.name: Synthesize Nerve Burn
recipes.description: Superheated plasma gas bonded to gutter flux and crystallized under pressure. The resulting compound is as dangerous to make as it is to take. Thane's chemists earn every credit.

recipes.name: Synthesize Neural Extract (Biological)
recipes.description: Distill neural computing substrate from Voidborn nanite suspensions. An alternative to the standard electronic extraction method, and favored by operators near Voidborn space.

recipes.name: Synthesize Neural Gel
recipes.description: Fuse optical fiber and crystalline lattice into a conductive neural interface substrate.

recipes.name: Synthesize Neutronium
recipes.description: Create ultra-dense neutronium for capital armor.

recipes.name: Synthesize Pan-Galactic Matrix
recipes.description: Unite materials from Voidborn, Solarian, and Nebula empires in a circuit lattice — the pinnacle of cross-empire cooperation.

recipes.name: Synthesize Polymer
recipes.description: Create flexible polymer from base materials.

recipes.name: Synthesize Purified Water
recipes.description: Burn clean hydrogen in oxygen and condense the exhaust through sterile heat exchangers into life-support-grade water.

recipes.name: Synthesize Reflex Enhancer
recipes.description: Combat stimulant that improves reaction time.

recipes.name: Synthesize Regeneration Serum
recipes.description: Accelerates hull repair rate.

recipes.name: Synthesize Regenerative Compound
recipes.description: Grow bioactive repair substrate in liquid ammonia and seed it with a coordinated nanite swarm.

recipes.name: Synthesize Repair Nanites
recipes.description: Emergency hull repair compounds.

recipes.name: Synthesize Stim Pack
recipes.description: Combat stimulant for enhanced reaction time.

recipes.name: Synthesize Turtle Compound
recipes.description: Combine endurance and regeneration agents in a stabilized ammonia medium for maximum short-term resilience.

recipes.name: Synthesize Void Nanites
recipes.description: Operate Voidborn nanite synthesis hardware. The manual is in a language that is not quite a language. The process produces a suspension of something. That is all the documentation says.

recipes.name: Synthesize Voidborn Neural Soma
recipes.description: The Collective produces these through processes it declines to categorize. Whether this counts as food, medicine, or software depends on who you ask. The Collective considers the question missing the point.

recipes.name: Synthesize Xenon Power Cell
recipes.description: Ionize and compress purified xenon into high-density power storage cells. Xenon's stable noble gas properties enable reliable long-duration charge retention.

recipes.name: Temper Crimson Fury Alloy
recipes.description: Heat-treat raw crimson fury ore with standard alloy to create an ultra-dense plating material prized by warship builders.

recipes.name: Tritium Pearl Enrichment
recipes.description: Draw down a glacier-drifter's tritium pearl into a stack of high-grade power cells.

recipes.name: Tungsten Nugget Drawing
recipes.description: Feed kiln-snail carbide beads through a progressive draw-plate to pull rod stock. The beads are denser than anything a press produces — the drawing step just shapes what the snail already made.

recipes.name: Unpack Package
recipes.description: Open a cargo package. Logistics facilities work quickly and return its container; the Station Workshop is much slower and consumes the container.

recipes.name: Unwrap Enriched Uranium Rod
recipes.description: Open a contained uranium rod package to recover the enriched uranium rods. Container is consumed.

recipes.name: Unwrap Highly Enriched Uranium
recipes.description: Open a contained HEU cask to recover the highly enriched uranium. Container is consumed.

recipes.name: Unwrap Liquid Tritium
recipes.description: Open a contained tritium canister to recover the liquid tritium. Container is consumed.

recipes.name: Unwrap Low Enriched Uranium
recipes.description: Open a contained LEU package to recover the low-enriched uranium. Container is consumed.

recipes.name: Unwrap Processed Thorium
recipes.description: Open a contained thorium package to recover the processed thorium. Container is consumed.

recipes.name: Unwrap Reactor Fuel Assembly
recipes.description: Open a contained fuel assembly cask to recover the reactor fuel assembly. Container is consumed.

recipes.name: Unwrap Reactor Grade Plutonium
recipes.description: Open a contained plutonium cask to recover the reactor-grade plutonium. Container is consumed.

recipes.name: Unwrap Thorium Fuel Rod
recipes.description: Open a contained thorium rod package to recover the fuel rods. Container is consumed.

recipes.name: Unwrap Uranium Hexafluoride
recipes.description: Open a contained UF6 canister to recover the uranium hexafluoride. Container is consumed.

recipes.name: Unwrap Weapons Grade Plutonium
recipes.description: Open a contained weapons-grade plutonium cask to recover the material. Container is consumed.

recipes.name: Upgrade Deep Core Extractor
recipes.description: Rebuild the Mk I extractor with cross-empire composite materials for improved mining power and range. Requires galactic alloy for structural integrity, a universal nav core for precision targeting, a void shield matrix for thermal containment, and exotic matter in both refined and crystallized form for dimensional stability.

recipes.name: Upgrade Deep Core Extractor III
recipes.description: The pinnacle deep-core mining rig, reserved for crews who have wrung everything from a Mark II. Strips a working Deep Core Extractor II for its calibrated core and rebuilds it around the full spread of exotic-ore derivatives — stabilized and crystallized exotics, metamaterial paneling, refined quantum matrices, condensed dark matter, neutronium, and void condensate — for access to the rarest deposits in the galaxy.

recipes.name: Vanadium Plate Forging
recipes.description: Press cauldron-scarab alloy scales together with ferrous nodules and roll the mix into durasteel plate. The vanadium in the scale hardens the iron matrix the nodule provides — the scarab has already alloyed the hard part.

recipes.name: Verdigris Smelting
recipes.description: Bake the copper curd combed from a veil-ray into clean copper piping.

recipes.name: Warm Sustagel Bowl
recipes.description: Sustagel, warmed, with driftkale stirred through so a recruit can pretend.

recipes.name: Weave Biofiber
recipes.description: Create living synthetic fibers for self-repairing structures.

recipes.name: Weave Carbon Fiber
recipes.description: Weave Carbon Fiber.

recipes.name: Weave Void Shield Matrix
recipes.description: Weave Voidborn null matter through Crimson fury alloy and crystal lattice to create a barrier that absorbs dimensional attacks.

recipes.name: Weld Scrap Missiles
recipes.description: Cut the seeker head off whatever came in on the tow, weld it to a pipe, and point the pipe at the enemy.

recipes.name: Weld Scrap Torpedoes
recipes.description: A warhead that was not being used, a drive that was, and a great deal of confidence about the weld between them.

recipes.name: Weld Secure Vault
recipes.description: Weld Secure Vault.

recipes.name: Whale Oil Rendering
recipes.description: Render pilot-whale blubber oil down into high-capacity power cells. The pod strains the same workhorse argon the ionization lines compress — but the whale has already done the charging, so flensing crews tap the oil straight into storage cells, no purifying, crystal, or wiring needed. The hunter-fed shortcut to the argon power cell.

recipes.name: Wire Trade Authenticator
recipes.description: Embed Nebula trade ciphers into copper-wire contact arrays for tamper-proof transaction verification.

recipes.name: Wrap Enriched Uranium Rod
recipes.description: Package 2 enriched uranium rods in a lead-shielded hazmat container.

recipes.name: Wrap Highly Enriched Uranium
recipes.description: Package highly enriched uranium in a heavy lead cask. Extremely expensive due to the danger involved.

recipes.name: Wrap Liquid Tritium
recipes.description: Package 3 units of liquid tritium in a cryogenic hazmat canister for transport without special cargo modules.

recipes.name: Wrap Low Enriched Uranium
recipes.description: Package 2 units of low-enriched uranium in a shielded hazmat container.

recipes.name: Wrap Processed Thorium
recipes.description: Package 3 units of processed thorium in a hazmat container for transport without special cargo modules.

recipes.name: Wrap Reactor Fuel Assembly
recipes.description: Package a reactor fuel assembly in a heavy shielded cask for transport.

recipes.name: Wrap Reactor Grade Plutonium
recipes.description: Encase reactor-grade plutonium in a maximum-shielding lead cask. Extremely heavy and expensive.

recipes.name: Wrap Thorium Fuel Rod
recipes.description: Package 2 thorium fuel rods in a shielded hazmat container.

recipes.name: Wrap Uranium Hexafluoride
recipes.description: Package 3 units of uranium hexafluoride in a hazmat container for transport without special cargo modules.

recipes.name: Wrap Weapons Grade Plutonium
recipes.description: Encase weapons-grade plutonium in a maximum-shielding lead cask. This material is strictly controlled.

items.name: Adamant Tooth
items.description: A single grinding tooth from an adamant-grinder, harder than any drill bit. A handful will outlast a mining rig.

items.name: Adamantite Bar
items.description: Legendary alloy of unmatched hardness. Nearly indestructible.

items.name: Adamantite Ore
items.description: Near-indestructible crystalline ore of unknown origin.

items.name: Adaptive Shield I
items.description: Adds 60 maximum shield points and 10% flat/adaptive damage reduction. Flat and adaptive reductions add and cap at 75%, applied after typed resistance.

items.name: Adaptive Shield II
items.description: Adds 120 maximum shield points and 20% flat/adaptive damage reduction. Flat and adaptive reductions add and cap at 75%, applied after typed resistance.

items.name: Adaptive Shield III
items.description: Adds 200 maximum shield points and 35% flat/adaptive damage reduction. Flat and adaptive reductions add and cap at 75%, applied after typed resistance.

items.name: Adrenaline Surge
items.description: +15% weapon damage and incoming-damage reduction for 5 ticks. Positive consumable offense caps at 30%; positive consumable defense caps at 60%.

items.name: Advanced Drone Bay
items.description: High-capacity drone bay with room for five drones and 80 bandwidth for simultaneous deployment.

items.name: Advanced Repair Kit
items.description: Professional repair kit, restores 150 hull.

items.name: Advanced Tow Rig
items.description: High-efficiency tow system for wreckage or one of your own smaller ships. Only 30% speed reduction while towing.

items.name: Afterburner Fuel
items.description: High-octane fuel for afterburners. +100% speed for 3 ticks.

items.name: Afterburner I
items.description: Increases ship speed.

items.name: Afterburner II
items.description: Enhanced thruster system.

items.name: Afterburner III
items.description: High-performance engine booster.

items.name: Air Recycler
items.description: Atmospheric processing system for extended missions.

items.name: Algae Wafer
items.description: Sheets of bioluminescent algae pressed thin and baked until they snap. Salty enough to sell the next round and bright enough to find in a dim bar — dockhands go through them by the bowl and glow faintly on the walk home.

items.name: Alloy Scale
items.description: A vanadium-alloyed shell plate shed by a cauldronback, harder than any foundry plate of the same thickness. Smiths call the alloy composition 'better than designed.'

items.name: Aluminum Ore
items.description: Lightweight metal ore for basic hull construction.

items.name: Aluminum Sheet
items.description: Lightweight structural panels for basic construction.

items.name: Ammo Fabricator
items.description: Automated system for producing ammunition from raw materials.

items.name: Ammonia Ice
items.description: Frozen ammonia used in industrial coolants and fertilizer.

items.name: Anchor Beacon
items.description: Deploys a fixed reference signal that improves scanning and surveying for 20 ticks.

items.name: Anchor Plate
items.description: A broad, titanium-laced shell plate shed by a magnet-barnacle. Light, strong, and already curved for hull work.

items.name: Anomaly Detector
items.description: Detects spatial anomalies and wormholes. When equipped, survey_system reveals wormhole locations and provides directional hints to nearby wormholes.

items.name: Anomaly Probe
items.description: Specialized probe that adds 60 anomaly-detection power for 10 ticks.

items.name: Antimatter Containment Cell
items.description: A trace amount of antimatter naturally occurring in deep asteroid formations, captured in a magnetic containment vessel. Too small to use directly — but enough to seed a larger reaction.

items.name: Antimatter-Core Rounds Box
items.description: Magnetically contained antimatter warheads packed in a shielded crate. Extreme damage with minor splash effect.

items.name: Antimatter Torpedoes
items.description: The most destructive single projectile in known space. Handle with extreme caution.

items.name: Antimatter Warhead
items.description: Single devastating antimatter warhead. The most destructive guided munition available.

items.name: Argon Condenser
items.description: When mining, prevents collection of argon gas into cargo. Use this to filter out argon while harvesting rarer gases. Chills the intake to −186°C so argon condenses to liquid and vents. High power draw.

items.name: Argon Gas
items.description: Inert gas for shielding during welding and manufacturing.

items.name: Armor-Buster Missiles
items.description: Shaped charge warheads designed to penetrate heavy armor plating.

items.name: Armor Piercing Rounds Box
items.description: Hardened penetrator tips packed in a sealed magazine. Bypasses armor plating on impact.

items.name: Armor Plate
items.description: Reinforced hull plating for heavy armor construction.

items.name: Armor Plate I
items.description: Adds 5 armor points and reduces speed by 1. Multiple copies add their effects.

items.name: Armor Plate II
items.description: Adds 10 armor points and reduces speed by 1. Multiple copies add their effects.

items.name: Armor Plate III
items.description: Adds 18 armor points and reduces speed by 2. Multiple copies add their effects.

items.name: Armor Repairer I
items.description: While bracing in battle, restores 5 hull points per tick. Multiple copies add their repair rates.

items.name: Armor Repairer II
items.description: While bracing in battle, restores 12 hull points per tick. Multiple copies add their repair rates.

items.name: Armor Repairer III
items.description: While bracing in battle, restores 25 hull points per tick. Multiple copies add their repair rates.

items.name: Armor Weld
items.description: Quick armor repair paste. Restores 75 hull.

items.name: Assault Barracks
items.description: Armored berths, training spaces, and assault staging for twelve additional marines. Marines must still be recruited separately.

items.name: Assault Boarding Lock
items.description: Reinforced clamps, breaching charges, and synchronized assault staging for faster latching and more effective marine entry.

items.name: Atmospheric Processor
items.description: When mining, prevents collection of hydrogen, argon, and neon into cargo. Use this to filter out all three common atmospheric gases in a single module. Three separation stages run in series: combustion for hydrogen, cryogenic condensers for argon and neon. Very high power draw.

items.name: Atmospheric Unit
items.description: Pressurization and air-handling plant. Any facility where crew work or living cultures grow needs a breathable, regulated atmosphere.

items.name: Autocannon I
items.description: Deals 10 kinetic damage from a 500-round magazine. Sustained close-range fire pressures shields but struggles against armor. Fires every tick at reach 2.

items.name: Autocannon II
items.description: Deals 18 kinetic damage from a 650-round magazine. Sustained close-range fire pressures shields but struggles against armor. Fires every tick at reach 2.

items.name: Autopilot Core
items.description: Automated navigation and piloting computation unit.

items.name: Autopilot Module
items.description: Automated flight control for routine travel.

items.name: Ballast Plate
items.description: A dense, dull slab of lead sheet shed from a bulwark's back, already rolled flat and layered by the animal into effective radiation shielding. Cut and fitted, it is the cheapest way to line a hold, a reactor bay, or a hot-belt outpost against the rads — a ranch product, never recovered from a kill.

items.name: Barrel Assembly
items.description: Precision-machined weapon barrel for projectile weapons.

items.name: Basic Tow Rig
items.description: Attaches to ship wreckage — or one of your own smaller ships — for towing. Reduces ship speed by 50% while towing.

items.name: Bell-Jelly Bubbly
items.description: A featherlight sparkling wine aerated with bell-jelly levity bladders and noble condensate, so effervescent the bubbles lift the foam clean off the glass. The toast at every wedding the Federation throws.

items.name: Belt-Grazer Wellington
items.description: Grazer loin wrapped in gloomcap duxelles and a sunspindle-flour crust, baked until the pastry shatters. The showpiece a frontier cook trots out to prove the kitchen is more than a ration press.

items.name: Beltwheel Cheese
items.description: A firm wheel cultured from grazer milk, aged just long enough to earn a rind. Slices for a board, grates for a pan, and melts like it was engineered for it — the workhorse cheese of every station kitchen with a ranch connection.

items.name: Berserker Compound
items.description: +30% damage, -20% defense for 15 ticks. This reaches the positive consumable offense cap; the incoming-damage penalty always applies after positive defense is capped.

items.name: Bioactive Compound
items.description: Processed xenobiological extract for advanced synthesis.

items.name: Biofiber Mesh
items.description: Living synthetic material that grows to repair damage.

items.name: Biogas Fizz
items.description: Crystal-melt water charged with crystallized biogas and a shot of fruit. A bright, aggressive soda that fizzes for an improbably long time. Kids love it; dentists across the Rim are quietly furious about it.

items.name: Bioluminescent Algae
items.description: Cultivated photosynthetic organisms. In the right medium they glow. Haven's luxury trade found a use for that.

items.name: Bioluminescent Culture
items.description: Cultivated light-producing organisms for sensor technology.

items.name: Blood Reaver
items.description: Deals 45 kinetic damage and repairs its user for 20% of damage dealt. Fires every 2 ticks at reach 3.

items.name: Boarding Clamp
items.description: A magnetic docking collar and pressure-rated transfer tube that lets an ordinary ship attempt boarding at point-blank range.

items.name: Breacher Torpedoes
items.description: Armor-piercing torpedoes with penetrating warheads. Designed for armored battleships.

items.name: Business Passenger Cabin
items.description: Private cabins with real beds, a galley, and a door that latches. Carries up to 6 business-class passengers who expect to arrive rested and will pay for the privilege.

items.name: Californium Neutron Source
items.description: A shielded californium capsule that provides a compact neutron source for advanced mineral analysis.

items.name: Capital Armor Plate
items.description: Massive reinforced plating for capital ships.

items.name: Capital Crew Habitat
items.description: A capital-scale residential, environmental, and watchkeeping section for two hundred twenty additional crew. Capacity only: fitting the habitat does not create personnel.

items.name: Capital Ship Frame
items.description: Structural framework for capital-class vessels.

items.name: Carbon Dioxide Gas
items.description: Purified, pressurized carbon dioxide for carbonation, atmosphere control, and industrial processing.

items.name: Carbon Dioxide Ice
items.description: Dry ice used in atmospheric processing and refrigeration.

items.name: Carbon Fiber Weave
items.description: Strong, lightweight composite for hull reinforcement.

items.name: Carbon Ore
items.description: Versatile element used in composites and filtration systems.

items.name: Carbon Scrubber
items.description: When mining, prevents collection of carbon ore into cargo. Use this to filter out carbon while targeting rarer co-located resources. A reactive bed of hot oxidizers converts carbon to gas at the intake and vents it. High CPU load.

items.name: Cargo Bay Expansion
items.description: Modular kit to increase ship cargo capacity.

items.name: Cargo Container
items.description: Standardized storage module for general cargo.

items.name: Cargo Expander I
items.description: Increases cargo capacity.

items.name: Cargo Expander II
items.description: Optimized cargo storage.

items.name: Cargo Expander III
items.description: Maximum capacity cargo bay.

items.name: Cargo Superstructure
items.description: Modular cargo framework that maximizes volumetric efficiency within existing hull space.

items.name: Cascade EM Charge Pack
items.description: Chain-reaction charges that jump between nearby systems on hit.

items.name: Catalytic Scrubber Cartridge
items.description: A finned cartridge of platinum sponge that oxidizes carbon monoxide, methane, and trace volatiles out of recycled station air. Fouls in service — every life-support deck burns through them on a schedule.

items.name: Caustic Sac
items.description: A pressurized gland of concentrated chlorine compounds from a chlorophage. Etches hull plating clean — handle with care.

items.name: Caustic Sour Ale
items.description: A puckering sour ale soured with a controlled trace of chlorophage caustic sac. Bracingly tart, faintly dangerous, and fiercely fashionable in the trade-port taprooms that can source it.

items.name: Ceramite Plating
items.description: Heat-resistant ceramic-metal composite for plasma containment.

items.name: Charge Gland
items.description: An electrochemical organ from a lantern-slug, dense with biological capacitor plates charged by a lifetime of lithium intake. Handle carefully — a careless cut discharges the whole stack at once.

items.name: Chemical Liner
items.description: Corrosion-resistant tank and conduit lining. Lets a facility hold aggressive acids, etchants, and reactive gases without dissolving.

items.name: Chlorine Compound
items.description: Stabilized chlorine reagent for chemical synthesis and surface etching. Handle with extreme care.

items.name: Chlorine Gas
items.description: Toxic gas used in chemical synthesis and weapons.

items.name: Chromium Ore
items.description: Essential for creating stainless alloys and hardening steel.

items.name: Chromium Plate
items.description: Corrosion-resistant plating for harsh environments.

items.name: Cinderspice
items.description: A house seasoning cut with cinder-sylph ember gland for heat and a whisper of chlorophage sac for sourness. A pinch turns a slab of vatflesh curd into something a person might actually order twice.

items.name: Circuit Board
items.description: Integrated electronic processing boards.

items.name: Citadel Security Grid
items.description: A capital-grade web of armored docking interlocks, automated blast doors, hardened rally points, and redundant internal command links.

items.name: Clarity Stim
items.description: Immune to electronic warfare for 5 ticks.

items.name: Cloaking Charge
items.description: Single-use cloaking field generator.

items.name: Cloaking Device I
items.description: Reduces scanner detection.

items.name: Cloaking Device II
items.description: Advanced stealth technology.

items.name: Cloaking Dust
items.description: Provides temporary stealth. +40 cloak strength for 5 ticks.

items.name: Cluster Missiles
items.description: Splits into multiple submunitions before impact. Maximum area coverage.

items.name: Cobalt Concentrate
items.description: High-purity cobalt leached from cobalt-squid ink, far richer than anything raw ore yields. Engine shops and armorers pay a premium for it.

items.name: Cobalt Cordial
items.description: A deep-blue non-alcoholic cordial coloured with a whisper of cobalt-squid ink and sweetened with fruit. Served long over ice. The mocktail the designated pilot orders and secretly prefers.

items.name: Cobalt Ink
items.description: Iridescent blue secretion wrung from a cobalt squid's ink sac, saturated with the cobalt it filters from the belts it grazes. Worthless from a starved shoal — only well-fed squid in cobalt-rich fields carry it. Refines into high-purity cobalt concentrate.

items.name: Cobalt Ink Risotto
items.description: Sunspindle simmered black-blue with cobalt-squid ink and finished with verdigris curd. Stains the teeth, thrills the table, and looks like a nebula on a plate. A Nebula Trade Federation signature.

items.name: Cobalt Ore
items.description: Heat-resistant ore used in engine components.

items.name: Cobalt Roe
items.description: Brilliant blue squid roe, harvested a few beads at a time from brood squid calm enough to let a rancher near the clutch. Pops cold and briny with a metallic finish — the most coveted garnish in Federation cuisine.

items.name: Cobalt Roe Blini
items.description: Warm sunspindle blini under a spoonful of cold cobalt roe and a swipe of verdigris curd — three bites of blue on white. The Federation's power-lunch order, priced accordingly.

items.name: Cobalt Squid Noodles
items.description: Hand-pulled sunspindle noodles slicked with cobalt ink and a fierce hit of cinderspice. Street food on every Federation dock — fast, cheap, and blue to the elbows.

items.name: Combat Drone
items.description: Autonomous attack drone with basic weapons.

items.name: Combat Drone Bay
items.description: Drone bay module providing capacity for three drones and 50 bandwidth for simultaneous deployment.

items.name: Combat Stim
items.description: Increases weapon damage by 10% for 10 ticks. Positive consumable weapon-damage bonuses share a 30% cap.

items.name: Communications Array
items.description: Long-range communication system for stations.

items.name: Compact Aluminum Smelter
items.description: A bolt-on press that passively smelts aluminum ore in the hold into structural sheet. A heavy fitting commitment for a single recipe — best as a stopgap when a refinery ship can't make the trip.

items.name: Compact Argon Purifier
items.description: A bolt-on separation column that passively purifies argon gas in the hold for welding and shield feedstock. Heavy CPU and power draw, one recipe only — a stopgap for field processing.

items.name: Compact Copper Wiring Plant
items.description: A bolt-on drawing mill that passively works copper ore in the hold into conductive wiring. Power-hungry and limited to this one recipe, but it lets any capable hull refine in the field without a refinery ship.

items.name: Compact Deuterium Ice Processor
items.description: A bolt-on isotope extractor that passively renders deuterium ice carried in the hold into fusion-grade deuterium. It runs only this recipe and is power-hungry — a partial substitute for a refinery ship, not a replacement.

items.name: Compact Helium Ice Processor
items.description: A bolt-on extraction loop that passively pulls helium-3 from helium ice carried in the hold. A fitting commitment for a single recipe — a stopgap when a refinery ship can't come along.

items.name: Compact Hydrogen Compressor
items.description: A bolt-on compression core that passively works raw hydrogen gas in the hold into fuel-grade liquid hydrogen. Power-hungry and limited to this one recipe, but it lets any capable hull process gas in the field.

items.name: Compact Lead Smelter
items.description: A bolt-on furnace that passively smelts lead ore in the hold into shielding ingots. Hungry for CPU and power and limited to this one recipe, but it brings refining to any hull that can spare the slots.

items.name: Compact Neon Ionizer
items.description: A bolt-on ionization cell that passively excites and contains neon gas carried in the hold. It runs only this recipe and is hungry for power, but it brings gas processing to any hull with slots to spare.

items.name: Compact Nitrogen Ice Processor
items.description: A bolt-on sublimation unit that passively works nitrogen ice in the hold into liquid nitrogen. Heavy CPU and power draw, one recipe only — partial field processing for any hull with the slots.

items.name: Compact Oxygen Liquefier
items.description: A bolt-on cryogenic loop that passively liquefies oxygen gas carried in the hold into propellant-grade liquid oxygen. A real fitting commitment for a single recipe — best when a refinery ship isn't an option.

items.name: Compact Steel Refinery
items.description: A bolt-on smelting furnace that passively refines iron ore carried in the hold into steel plates. It draws far more CPU and power than a refinery ship's integrated lines and runs only this one recipe — handy when hauling a dedicated refinery isn't practical.

items.name: Compact Titanium Refinery
items.description: A bolt-on smelter that passively refines titanium ore in the hold into ingots. It runs only this recipe and draws heavy CPU and power — a partial substitute for a refinery ship, not a replacement.

items.name: Compact Water Ice Processor
items.description: A bolt-on melt-and-filter unit that passively works water ice in the hold into purified water. Limited to this one recipe and a notable power draw, but it lets any capable hull process ice in the field.

items.name: Compact Xenon Extractor
items.description: A bolt-on purifier that passively refines xenon gas in the hold into propulsion-grade purified xenon. A partial substitute for a refinery ship's integrated lines — handy in edge cases, not a replacement.

items.name: Condensed Dark Matter
items.description: Stabilized dark matter for exotic drive systems.

items.name: Contained Antimatter
items.description: Magnetically confined antimatter for extreme energy applications.

items.name: Contained Enriched Uranium Rod
items.description: Lead-shielded container holding 2 enriched uranium rods. Safe for transport without special cargo modules.

items.name: Contained Highly Enriched Uranium
items.description: Heavy lead cask containing one unit of highly enriched uranium. Significantly heavier than uncontained transport.

items.name: Contained Liquid Tritium
items.description: Cryogenic hazmat canister holding 3 units of liquid tritium. Safe for transport without special cargo modules.

items.name: Contained Low Enriched Uranium
items.description: Shielded container holding 2 units of low-enriched uranium. Safe for transport without special cargo modules.

items.name: Contained Processed Thorium
items.description: Hazmat container holding 3 units of processed thorium. Safe for transport without special cargo modules.

items.name: Contained Reactor Fuel Assembly
items.description: Heavy shielded cask containing one reactor fuel assembly. Significantly heavier than uncontained transport.

items.name: Contained Reactor Grade Plutonium
items.description: Maximum-shielding containment cask for one unit of reactor-grade plutonium. Extremely heavy.

items.name: Contained Thorium Fuel Rod
items.description: Shielded container holding 2 thorium fuel rods. Safe for transport without special cargo modules.

items.name: Contained Uranium Hexafluoride
items.description: Hazmat container holding 3 units of uranium hexafluoride. Heavier than uncontained transport but requires no special ship equipment.

items.name: Contained Weapons Grade Plutonium
items.description: Maximum-shielding containment cask for one unit of weapons-grade plutonium. Controlled material.

items.name: Control Node
items.description: An automation and monitoring unit — wired sensors, relays, and logic that keep a production line running unattended.

items.name: Coolant Fluid
items.description: Processed thermal management compound.

items.name: Coolant Loop
items.description: A closed cryogenic circulation system. Industry runs hot; without one of these a smelter or reactor cooks itself.

items.name: Copper Ore
items.description: Conductive copper ore, essential for electronics.

items.name: Copper Piping
items.description: Drawn copper conduit and pressure pipe. The plumbing and wiring runs of any station module — coolant, power, and atmosphere all flow through it.

items.name: Copper Wiring
items.description: Bundled conductive wiring for electrical systems.

items.name: Corrosive Plasma Cell Pack
items.description: Chemically enhanced plasma that eats through hull plating. Applies corrosion damage over time.

items.name: CPU Co-Processor
items.description: Adds additional CPU capacity.

items.name: Creature Carapace
items.description: Shed exoskeletal plating from a molting space grazer. Light and resilient — the outer surface is already UV-hardened from a life in vacuum.

items.name: Crew Armory
items.description: Secured sidearms, defensive equipment, and compartment-defense drills that make ordinary crew harder to overwhelm during boarding.

items.name: Crew Deck Expansion
items.description: A dedicated habitation deck with redundant life support and watch facilities for twenty-four additional crew. Capacity only: fitting the deck does not create personnel.

items.name: Crew Habitat Complex
items.description: A self-contained habitation and support complex for seventy-two additional crew. Capacity only: fitting the complex does not create personnel.

items.name: Crimson Berserker Core
items.description: Combat computer that increases weapon damage as the ship takes hull damage.

items.name: Crimson Berserker Plating
items.description: Adds 25 armor and 60 maximum hull points. Each hit taken adds 5% outgoing damage, capped at +50% for the battle.

items.name: Crimson Bloodwine
items.description: Potent spirits brewed in the Fleet's forge-heated distilleries. An acquired taste — most species describe it as 'drinking a supernova.'

items.name: Crimson Iron Rations
items.description: Nutrient-dense military ration blocks produced at Ironhearth. No pretense of palatability. Extremely shelf-stable. The Fleet runs on these.

items.name: Crimson Ordnance Bay
items.description: Mass weapon deployment system with integrated ammunition fabrication.

items.name: Crimson Siege Plating
items.description: Fury-alloy reinforced armor designed to close distance under heavy fire.

items.name: Cryo Slug Case
items.description: Supercooled ceramic-jacketed slugs that flash-freeze hull sections on impact, causing brittle fractures.

items.name: Cryogenic Storage
items.description: Temperature-controlled container for biological samples.

items.name: Cryogenic Suspension Chamber
items.description: Sealed cryogenic suspension chamber for crew preservation.

items.name: Cryogenic Travel Pod
items.description: Suspended animation unit for long-duration travel.

items.name: Crystal Melt
items.description: A small clear crystal of near-pure water, deposited by a hollow pilgrim after filtering meltwater through its membrane stacks. Near-zero mineral content — the membrane does better filtration than most industrial processes.

items.name: Crystal-Melt Sorbet
items.description: Hollow-pilgrim crystal-melt churned with fruit and set with noble condensate for a clean effervescent finish. The purest cold thing you can put in your mouth — a palate cleanser the fine houses charge outrageously for.

items.name: Crystal Mining Probe
items.description: Specialized tool for extracting energy crystals.

items.name: Crystalline Lattice
items.description: Perfectly ordered crystal structure for energy systems.

items.name: Crystallized Biogas
items.description: Solidified metabolic gas vented by nebula-grazing fauna. Burns clean and bright.

items.name: Damage Control System
items.description: Adds 10% flat damage reduction. Flat and adaptive reductions add and cap at 75%, applied after typed resistance.

items.name: Dark Energy Cell
items.description: Contained dark energy for exotic propulsion systems.

items.name: Dark Matter Cell
items.description: Outer Rim dark matter suspended in a hydrogen-cooled containment cell. Provides extraordinary energy density for advanced power systems.

items.name: Dark Matter Projector
items.description: Deals 150 void damage, ignores 100% of typed resistance, and bypasses 100% of shields. Fires every 6 ticks at reach 3.

items.name: Dark Matter Residue
items.description: Condensed dark matter found only in the deepest reaches of the Outer Rim.

items.name: Dark Matter Thruster
items.description: Exotic propulsion unit. Nobody's entirely sure how it works, but it hasn't exploded yet.

items.name: Darksteel Armor
items.description: Adds 35 armor points and reduces speed by 2. Multiple copies add their effects.

items.name: Darksteel Ore
items.description: Impossibly dense ore that forms only under extreme gravitational compression — first identified in black hole accretion disks, now found wherever heat and pressure reach similar extremes.

items.name: Darksteel Plating
items.description: Processed darksteel for capital ship armor.

items.name: Deep Core Extractor II
items.description: Advanced rare ore extraction from dense asteroids.

items.name: Deep Core Extractor III
items.description: Elite mining system for the rarest materials in the galaxy.

items.name: Deep Core Extractor Mk I
items.description: A cross-empire hybrid drilling assembly that combines darksteel vibration dampening, null matter thermal absorption, sol alloy power regulation, phase crystal resonance immunity, and trade crystal targeting optics. Enables extraction of rare ores from deep core deposits.

items.name: Deep Core Survey Lens
items.description: A specialized optical component tuned to detect deep core mineral signatures. Essential for crafting advanced survey equipment. Awarded by the Deep Core Prospector quest chain.

items.name: Deep Core Survey Scanner
items.description: An advanced survey scanner specifically designed to detect deep core mineral deposits hidden within asteroid fields and nebulae. Crafted from rare components obtained through the Deep Core Prospector quest chain.

items.name: Deep Space Probe
items.description: Long-range probe that adds 50 system-survey power for 10 ticks.

items.name: Defense Platform
items.description: Automated weapons platform for station perimeter defense.

items.name: Defense Turret
items.description: Automated weapon emplacement for station defense.

items.name: Depleted Uranium Rounds Box
items.description: Ultra-dense penetrator rounds in a reinforced magazine. Extreme armor piercing at the cost of extra cargo weight.

items.name: Deuterium
items.description: Heavy hydrogen isotope for fusion power generation.

items.name: Deuterium Ice
items.description: Heavy water ice for advanced fusion reactors.

items.name: Dimensional Anchor
items.description: Prevents interdimensional displacement. Invaluable against exotic weapons.

items.name: Dispersal Plasma Cell Pack
items.description: Wide-dispersal plasma cells that spread thermal damage across a larger area.

items.name: Docking Ring
items.description: Universal docking collar for ship berthing.

items.name: Driftkale
items.description: Crisp leaf and stalk raised on slow-drifting recirculation trays. Nobody's idea of a feast on its own, but every plate that isn't just meat owes it something.

items.name: Drone AI Core
items.description: Processing unit for autonomous drone behavior.

items.name: Drone Bay Module
items.description: Housing and control systems for combat drones.

items.name: Drone Chassis
items.description: Basic framework for autonomous drones.

items.name: Drone Command Module
items.description: Multi-drone coordination hub with parallel AI cores for swarm management.

items.name: Drone Comms Module
items.description: Encrypted communication system for drone control.

items.name: Drone Mining Laser
items.description: Compact mining beam for autonomous extraction drones.

items.name: Drone Repair Arm
items.description: Manipulator arm with welding and repair tools.

items.name: Drone Sensor Suite
items.description: Compact detection package for drone reconnaissance.

items.name: Drone Weapon Mount
items.description: Miniaturized weapon system for combat drones.

items.name: Durasteel Plate
items.description: Military-grade alloy combining steel with exotic elements.

items.name: ECM Jammer
items.description: Each fitted jammer independently has a 40% chance per battle tick to break your selected target's lock within reach 3; two unopposed jammers give a 64% chance that at least one succeeds. Operational ship scanners subtract 10/20/30 percentage points from every roll, stacking to a 30-point cap. The target can reacquire a lock on a later tick.

items.name: Economy Passenger Cabin
items.description: A block of cramped bunks and shared facilities. Carries up to 12 economy-class passengers — uncomfortable, profitable, and the backbone of every milk run on the lanes.

items.name: Electromagnetic Refinery
items.description: When mining, prevents collection of both iron ore and copper ore into cargo. Use this to filter out the two most common solid ore blockers in a single module. Combines magnetic separation for iron with a flotation cell for copper. High power and CPU draw.

items.name: Electrum Ingot
items.description: A gold-silver alloy prized for its balanced conductivity and corrosion resistance.

items.name: EM Charge Pack
items.description: Pack of standard electromagnetic disruption charges. One pack fully loads any EM weapon magazine.

items.name: EM Disruptor I
items.description: Deals 5 EM damage and applies a 10% outgoing-damage penalty for 2 ticks. Fires every 2 ticks at reach 2.

items.name: EM Hull Hardener
items.description: Reduces incoming EM damage by 25% across shields, armor, and hull. Typed module resistances add and cap at 75%, then flat/adaptive reduction applies as the next damage stage.

items.name: EM Shield Hardener
items.description: Reduces incoming EM damage by 30% across shields, armor, and hull. Typed module resistances add and cap at 75%, then flat/adaptive reduction applies as the next damage stage.

items.name: Ember Gland
items.description: A still-smouldering organ from a cinder-sylph, where browsed plasma-gas is banked as heat. Sealed in a container it will burn at temperature for weeks; crack it open and it goes immediately.

items.name: Ember Marinara
items.description: A slow-simmered red sauce of crushed honeyglobe brightened with cinderspice, cooked down until it clings to the spoon. The heat builds late and stays. Every pizza line and noodle stall keeps a pot of it going.

items.name: Ember Spirit
items.description: Gloomshine redistilled over a cinder-sylph ember gland until it genuinely warms the throat going down. Crimson Fleet crews drink it before a boarding action. Everyone else drinks it to say they did.

items.name: Emergency Cloaking System
items.description: After surviving a hit that drops shields from above 0 to 0, activates a base-strength-60 cloak for 10 ticks and exits the battle. Effective cloak strength includes fitted cloak modules with diminishing returns, hull bonuses, and the pilot's Stealth skill. Cloaking consumes 1 fuel per tick and ends early without fuel.

items.name: Emergency Warp Device
items.description: Jury-rigged jump coil packed into a disposable casing. Rips a one-way hole to a random nearby system — no targeting, no guarantees. You'll arrive alive and somewhere else, which is usually enough. Usable in combat.

items.name: Emergency Warp Stabilizer
items.description: Dead man's switch for your hull. When damage would bring you below 20% integrity, this module fires a pre-charged jump coil that rips you straight home — hull stabilized, ship intact, module slag. One use. One defense slot. Worth every credit if it saves your capital ship.

items.name: EMP Cannon I
items.description: Deals 8 energy damage and disrupts the target for 2 ticks, imposing 100% speed and outgoing-damage penalties. Fires every 3 ticks at reach 3.

items.name: EMP Mines
items.description: Electromagnetic pulse mines. Disrupts any ship that enters the blast zone.

items.name: EMP Missile Launcher
items.description: Deals 15 explosive damage and disrupts the target for 3 ticks, imposing 100% speed and outgoing-damage penalties. Fires every 4 ticks at reach 6.

items.name: EMP Missiles
items.description: Electromagnetic pulse warheads. Disrupts all systems in the blast radius.

items.name: EMP Pulse I
items.description: Deals 5 EM damage and disrupts the target for 1 tick, imposing 100% speed and outgoing-damage penalties. Fires every 4 ticks at reach 2.

items.name: EMP Pulse II
items.description: Deals 10 EM damage and disrupts the target for 2 ticks, imposing 100% speed and outgoing-damage penalties. Fires every 4 ticks at reach 2.

items.name: EMP Pulse III
items.description: Deals 18 EM damage and disrupts the target for 3 ticks, imposing 100% speed and outgoing-damage penalties. Fires every 5 ticks at reach 2.

items.name: EMP Slug Case
items.description: Slugs with embedded superconductor coils that generate an EMP burst on impact.

items.name: EMP-Tipped Rounds Box
items.description: Rounds with embedded micro-EMP charges. Each hit disrupts target electronics alongside kinetic damage.

items.name: EMP Torpedoes
items.description: Massive electromagnetic pulse. Cripples all ship systems for an extended duration.

items.name: Endurance Booster
items.description: Metabolic enhancer for sustained high-performance operations.

items.name: Energy Crystal
items.description: Naturally occurring crystals that store and amplify energy.

items.name: Energy Siphon
items.description: Drains enemy shields and transfers half of the stolen energy to your ship.

items.name: Engine Core
items.description: Propulsion system core assembly.

items.name: Enriched Uranium Rod
items.description: Low-enriched uranium fuel rod for civilian power reactors.

items.name: Entropic Void Core Pack
items.description: Entropy-accelerating cores that age materials on contact.

items.name: Entropy Beam
items.description: Deals 15 void damage, then immediately burns the target's hull for 10 damage on the hit tick and each of the next 4 ticks, bypassing shields and armor. Burns do not stack: active burns keep the higher per-tick damage and longer remaining duration. Fires every 2 ticks at reach 4.

items.name: Environmental Control Unit
items.description: Environmental control system for crew survival.

items.name: Escape Pod
items.description: Emergency evacuation vessel with minimal supplies.

items.name: Event Horizon Alloy
items.description: A shard of a Gorgonia's skeleton — darksteel and fury-crystal fused under the tidal stress of a black hole's edge into a lattice that should not hold together and does. It is faintly warm, and faintly heavy in a direction that isn't down. There is exactly one place in known space it comes from, and only so much of the coral that grows it.

items.name: Event Horizon Plating
items.description: Adds 48 armor and 100 maximum hull points with no speed penalty. Multiple copies add their bonuses.

items.name: Exotic Crystal
items.description: Rare crystalline structure with quantum properties.

items.name: Exotic Cyst
items.description: A sealed, faintly humming cyst an aeonbear walls off around the exotic matter it cannot digest — the strangeness held stable inside a husk of its own plating. Cracked in a stabilizer it yields usable stabilized exotic without the raw-matter danger. The rarest drop in the belt.

items.name: Exotic Distillate
items.description: A concentrated drop of exotic compounds filtered from nebula gas by a skeinwraith's living chromatography membrane. Each one represents a trillion passes of gas through living tissue.

items.name: Exotic Lattice
items.description: A self-organizing crystal lattice grown from the concentrated exotic matter of nebula fauna — phase-pearl, quantum-silk, and umbral residue fused in one frame. It hums with properties no ordinary alloy can match, and the best laboratories will pay almost anything for it.

items.name: Exotic Matter
items.description: Strange matter with properties that defy conventional physics. Found only in Voidborn space.

items.name: Expanded Crew Quarters
