items.description: Compact bunks, life-support extensions, and watch facilities for eight additional crew. Capacity only: fitting quarters does not create personnel.

items.name: Expanded Fuel Tank
items.description: Additional pressurized fuel bladders bolted into previously empty hull space. Significantly increases fuel capacity, but the structural modifications reduce hull integrity.

items.name: Explosive Hull Hardener
items.description: Reduces incoming explosive damage by 25% across shields, armor, and hull. Typed module resistances add and cap at 75%, then flat/adaptive reduction applies as the next damage stage.

items.name: Explosive Shield Hardener
items.description: Reduces incoming explosive damage by 30% across shields, armor, and hull. Typed module resistances add and cap at 75%, then flat/adaptive reduction applies as the next damage stage.

items.name: Fermentation Culture
items.description: Active biological cultures from continuous-feed vats. What exactly is fermenting is a matter of philosophical debate in the Outer Rim.

items.name: Ferromanganese Billet
items.description: A carbon-reduced iron and manganese alloy used to harden structural metals.

items.name: Ferrous Nodule
items.description: A dense, magnetic pellet regurgitated by a slag-tortoise after a meal of iron-rich rock. The magnetism is biological — each one holds its field without any external charge.

items.name: Ferrous Slug Case
items.description: Case of standard dense iron slugs for railguns. One case fully loads any railgun magazine.

items.name: Field Hospital
items.description: A deployable trauma ward that treats allied ships at the same location while out of combat and coordinates fleet triage during battle.

items.name: First-Class Passenger Suite
items.description: A handful of lavish staterooms with panoramic ports and absurd fare margins. Carries up to 3 first-class passengers — the kind whose safe arrival the empires actually notice.

items.name: Flak Cannon I
items.description: Deals 15 kinetic damage with +100% damage to drones. Provides 25 points of anti-missile defense; fitted ratings add but incoming missile damage reduction caps at 75%. Fires every tick at reach 3.

items.name: Flak Cannon II
items.description: Deals 28 kinetic damage with +150% damage to drones. Provides 45 points of anti-missile defense; fitted ratings add but incoming missile damage reduction caps at 75%. Fires every tick at reach 3.

items.name: Flak Cannon III
items.description: Deals 40 kinetic damage with +200% damage to drones. Provides 65 points of anti-missile defense; fitted ratings add but incoming missile damage reduction caps at 75%. Fires every tick at reach 3.

items.name: Fleet Hospital
items.description: A full trauma complex able to treat allied ships at the same location and improve fleet-wide triage during battle.

items.name: Flex Polymer
items.description: Flexible synthetic material for seals and cables.

items.name: Flotation Cell
items.description: When mining, prevents collection of copper ore into cargo. Use this to filter out copper while targeting rarer co-located resources. Reagents injected into the ore slurry cause copper minerals to bind to bubbles and vent. High CPU load.

items.name: Fluorine Etchant
items.description: Precisely concentrated hydrofluoric solution for nanoscale circuit etching and advanced material processing.

items.name: Fluorine Gas
items.description: Highly reactive gas for chemical etching and processing.

items.name: Focus Stim
items.description: Increases weapon accuracy by 20% for 10 ticks.

items.name: Focused Beam I
items.description: Deals 15 energy damage; 25% bypasses shields. Fires every 2 ticks at reach 4.

items.name: Focused Beam II
items.description: Deals 25 energy damage; 40% bypasses shields. Fires every 2 ticks at reach 4.

items.name: Focused Beam III
items.description: Deals 40 energy damage; 60% bypasses shields. Fires every 2 ticks at reach 4.

items.name: Focused Crystal
items.description: Precision-cut energy crystals for weapon systems.

items.name: Focused EM Charge Pack
items.description: Concentrated EM bursts that overwhelm a single target system. Higher damage per charge.

items.name: Focused Plasma Cell Pack
items.description: Tight-beam plasma cells with higher energy density. Superior single-target damage.

items.name: Foil Scale
items.description: A bright shed scale from a mirror-skate's back, thin as foil and nearly pure aluminum. The purity is biological — the skate pre-refines the metal as it deposits each scale.

items.name: Fragmentation Mines
items.description: Wider blast radius with shrapnel dispersal. Less direct damage.

items.name: Fragmentation Rounds Box
items.description: Pre-scored casings that shatter into lethal shrapnel. Devastating against drones and small targets.

items.name: Frontier Hash
items.description: Grazer meat, gloomcap mash, and driftkale all fried together on one griddle. The miner's breakfast, the salvager's dinner, and the only thing open at 0300 on most Outer Rim docks.

items.name: Frontier Rotgut
items.description: Rough spirits distilled at the edge of nowhere. The recipe varies by batch, but the hangover is consistent. Inexplicably popular at Haven.

items.name: Frontier Spore Spirits
items.description: Distilled from fungal cultures that may or may not be earth-origin. The Frontier Council has declined to investigate.

items.name: Frontier Survival Kit
items.description: Self-repair and life support package cobbled from whatever was on hand. Surprisingly effective.

items.name: Frostmoth Frappe
items.description: Crystal-melt and fruit blended with a lick of whale blubber into a thick, ice-cold frappe. A dessert pretending to be a drink, and not fooling anyone who orders a second.

items.name: Fuel
items.description: Station fuel. Not carried in cargo — sold directly from your ship's fuel tank via the 'sell' command. Stations post buy orders for fuel they need; factions can also post buy orders to fill their private fuel reserves.

items.name: Fuel Cell
items.description: Standard fuel cell, restores 20 fuel.

items.name: Fuel Optimizer
items.description: Reduces fuel consumption by 15%.

items.name: Fuel Tank
items.description: Standard fuel storage container.

items.name: Fury Alloy
items.description: Heat-storing alloy that enhances thermal weapons.

items.name: Fury Cannon
items.description: Deals 70 kinetic damage, increased by the user's missing-hull percentage. At 40% hull it deals +60%. Fires every 3 ticks at reach 5.

items.name: Fury Crystal
items.description: Superheated crystals from Crimson volcanic worlds, pulsing with thermal energy.

items.name: Fury-Tempered Plating
items.description: Crimson fury alloy layered with steel under extreme heat. The resulting armor plate resists both kinetic and energy weapons.

items.name: Fusion Fuel Rod
items.description: Processed deuterium-tritium fuel for reactor cores.

items.name: Fusion Pearl
items.description: A glassy bead of compacted deuterium, layered like a pearl in a deuteron-slug's mantle. A clean, ready-made fusion charge.

items.name: Galactic Standard Alloy
items.description: Solarian composite fused with Crimson fury alloy and steel. The resulting material meets universal shipbuilding standards across all five empires.

items.name: Galvanic Hull Grid
items.description: A network of high-energy conductors embedded beneath the outer plating. A hostile boarding contact closes the circuit and electrifies the hull around the docking point.

items.name: Gas Harvester I
items.description: Collects valuable gases from nebulae and gas clouds.

items.name: Gas Harvester II
items.description: Improved gas collection with better containment.

items.name: Gas Harvester III
items.description: Industrial gas collection system.

items.name: Gas Harvester IV
items.description: Capital-grade gas collection and compression system.

items.name: Ghost Rounds
items.description: Ammunition manufactured without serial markings, energy signatures, or any identifiable trace. Built from bootleg power cells and titanium ingots in unlicensed armories. When forensics pulls these from a hull, the report just says 'unknown ordnance.' That's the point.

items.name: Gilded Chitin
items.description: Shed shell from a glitterback crab, so threaded with the gold it browses that it is worth melting down on its own.

items.name: Glintfin Fillet
items.description: Translucent, faintly metallic fillets cut from farmed glintfin, firm and clean-tasting with a mineral brightness on the finish. The galaxy's first real fish — cooks who trained on nothing but xeno-meat and crab treat a crate of it like contraband. Harvested from a ranch, never a kill.

items.name: Glintfin Sashimi
items.description: Raw glintfin sliced paper-thin across the grain and fanned over crushed ice with a caustic-sharp condiment and ribboned driftkale. Eating something raw that isn't a dare barely exists out here — which is exactly why the raw bars charge what they do for it.

items.name: Gloomcap Mash
items.description: Dense gloomcap fungus cultured in the dark on nitrogen and damp, then mashed to a thick pulp. Meaty, earthy, and faintly alarming to watch grow — but it fries up like the best mushroom a planet ever produced, and it never stops.

items.name: Gloomshine
items.description: Gloomcap mash run through a station still until it comes off clear. Every backwater station has a batch working somewhere in the dark. Cheap, potent, and — when the good stuff runs out — the only thing on the bar.

items.name: Gold Bar
items.description: A mirror-bright ingot of refined gold, stamped and assayed. It powers nothing and builds nothing — it simply is worth a great deal, and always will be.

items.name: Gold Ore
items.description: Highly conductive precious metal for advanced electronics.

items.name: Gold Wiring
items.description: Premium conductive material for sensitive electronics.

items.name: Grand Dining Hall
items.description: A full sit-down restaurant with a working kitchen brigade and a wine list, the centerpiece of any serious liner. High covers per seating and a bar besides — but it eats provisions fast, so keep the hold stocked with dishes and drink.

items.name: Graphene Sheet
items.description: Single-atom carbon layer with incredible strength.

items.name: Graphene Thread
items.description: A spool of natural graphene thread extruded by an inkwyrm from digested carbon ore. Each strand is a single-atom carbon sheet drawn impossibly long — the worm does in a day what a laboratory does in a year.

items.name: Graviton Beam I
items.description: Deals 32 kinetic damage and deals 25% more while the target's shields are down. Fires every 3 ticks at reach 4.

items.name: Graviton Beam II
items.description: Deals 50 kinetic damage and deals 50% more while the target's shields are down. Within reach 4, reduces its selected target's combat speed by 30%, affecting hit chance, maneuvering, escape, and boarding pursuit; web penalties add and cap at 75%. Fires every 3 ticks.

items.name: Gravity Generator
items.description: Artificial gravity system for stations and large ships.

items.name: Grazer Milk
items.description: Pale, mineral-rich milk drawn from a tended belt-grazer herd. Faintly metallic on the tongue and dense with iron-fed fats — it sets into curd almost eagerly. No wild grazer has ever surrendered a drop of it.

items.name: Grazer Milkshake
items.description: Grazer milk blended thick over crystal-melt ice with a heavy pour of honeyglobe syrup, served in a tall cup with a spoon-straw that mostly loses the fight. The official drink of ordering a pizza and not thinking about your next haul.

items.name: Grazer Steak Frites
items.description: A slab of grazer steak, greens fried crisp in whale oil, and no pretension whatsoever. The plate a spacer orders when they're tired of deciding — it's never once been a mistake.

items.name: Gutter Flux
items.description: A viscous chemical paste synthesized from industrial solvents and chlorine compounds. The name comes from the drainage channels where the first batches were cooked. Serves as a precursor for most illicit pharmaceuticals in the outer systems.

items.name: Habitation Module
items.description: Living quarters unit for station crew.

items.name: Hangar Bay Module
items.description: Enclosed bay for ship storage and maintenance.

items.name: Hazmat Container
items.description: Shielded container for radioactive or dangerous materials.

items.name: Heat Sink
items.description: Thermal management component for weapons and engines.

items.name: Heavy Mass Driver
items.description: Deals 150 kinetic damage from a 10-slug magazine; 80% bypasses armor and damage gains 50% while the target has no shields. Fires every 5 ticks at reach 6.

items.name: Heavy Pulse Laser
items.description: Capital-class energy weapon with devastating output.

items.name: Heavy Torpedo
items.description: Deals 80 explosive damage from a 4-torpedo magazine. Fires every 5 ticks at reach 6.

items.name: Helium-3
items.description: Rare helium isotope for aneutronic fusion reactors.

items.name: Helium Ice
items.description: Frozen helium-3 from gas giant atmospheres. Premium fusion fuel.

items.name: Highly Enriched Uranium
items.description: Uranium enriched above 90% U-235. Weapons-grade fissile material. Handle with extreme caution.

items.name: Hoarfrost Flank
items.description: Flank cut from a Hoarfrost Leviathan, flash-frozen the instant it leaves the body by the cold that pours off the beast. It arrives already cured — dark, firm, and needing nothing but a warm knife. Ice-field hunters prize it above the heartcore bounty.

items.name: Hoarfrost Flank Steak
items.description: Hoarfrost Leviathan flank, already cured by the cold it was cut from, seared hard and served blue with a bright ember rub. Ice-field hunters swear it's the only cut worth the frostbite — and the hoarfrost bounty barely covers the bar tab.

items.name: Hoarfrost Heartcore
items.description: The frozen cardiac node of a Hoarfrost Leviathan. Cold radiates from it for days after harvest — whatever process sustained the animal's temperature differential keeps running without the animal. Handle with insulated cargo.

items.name: Honeyglobe
items.description: A round, thin-skinned fruit engineered for pure sugar and shelf life over any resemblance to an ancestral species. The base of every dessert, cordial, and honest bottle of wine.

items.name: Honeyglobe Custard
items.description: Sift-ray yolk and grazer milk set into a trembling custard under a honeyglobe glaze torched to glass. The dessert a ranch station puts on the table to prove the whole dairy chain works.

items.name: Hot Cell
items.description: Jury-rigged power cells assembled from scavenged plasma conduits and stripped copper wiring. They run hot, they run unstable, and they're half the price of the legal alternative. Don't drop them.

items.name: Hull Integrity Field
items.description: Adds 10 armor and 80 maximum hull points. Multiple copies add their bonuses.

items.name: Hull Nanites
items.description: Nanobots that repair hull over time. Restores 20 hull/tick for 5 ticks.

items.name: Hull Patch
items.description: Emergency hull sealant. Restores 25 hull instantly.

items.name: Hull Plating
items.description: Reinforced armor section for ship construction.

items.name: Hull Reinforcement I
items.description: Adds 25 maximum hull points and reduces cargo capacity by 5. Multiple copies add their effects.

items.name: Hull Reinforcement II
items.description: Adds 60 maximum hull points and reduces cargo capacity by 10. Multiple copies add their effects.

items.name: Hull Reinforcement III
items.description: Adds 120 maximum hull points and reduces cargo capacity by 20. Multiple copies add their effects.

items.name: Hydrogen Combustor
items.description: When mining, prevents collection of hydrogen gas into cargo. Use this to filter out hydrogen while harvesting rarer gases. A plasma torch at the intake ignites and expels it on contact. High power draw.

items.name: Hydrogen Gas
items.description: Basic fuel source harvested from gas giants and nebulae.

items.name: Hyper Mining Laser III
items.description: Industrial-grade mining laser with extreme extraction power.

items.name: Ice Harvester I
items.description: Extracts valuable ice from asteroid fields and comets.

items.name: Ice Harvester II
items.description: Enhanced ice mining with thermal extraction.

items.name: Ice Harvester III
items.description: Industrial-grade ice mining equipment.

items.name: Ice Harvester IV
items.description: Capital-grade cryo-extraction and processing system.

items.name: Incendiary Missiles
items.description: Thermite warheads that burn through hull after detonation. Less explosive force, more sustained damage.

items.name: Incendiary Rounds Box
items.description: Phosphorus-tipped rounds that ignite on impact. Causes sustained thermal damage to hull systems.

items.name: Inertial Gyroscope
items.description: Attitude stabilization system for precise maneuvering.

items.name: Ion Beam Array
items.description: Deals 30 energy damage. Fires every 2 ticks at reach 3.

items.name: Ion Blaster I
items.description: Deals 8 EM damage, +50% while shields remain. Fires every tick at reach 2.

items.name: Ion Blaster II
items.description: Deals 14 EM damage, +75% while shields remain. Fires every tick at reach 2.

items.name: Ion Blaster III
items.description: Deals 22 EM damage, +100% while shields remain. Fires every tick at reach 2.

items.name: Ion Cannon I
items.description: Deals 12 energy damage. Fires every 2 ticks at reach 5.

items.name: Ion Cannon II
items.description: Deals 20 energy damage. Fires every 2 ticks at reach 5.

items.name: Ion Charge Pack
items.description: Heavy ion charges that deal 50% more shield damage.

items.name: Ion Emitter
items.description: Ionized particle projector for energy weapon systems.

items.name: Ion Gas
items.description: Highly charged gas for ion propulsion systems.

items.name: Ion Nodule
items.description: A dense magnetic organ from a voltmanta, packed with ionized particle suspension. Removing it wrong discharges the whole thing. Done right, it is a ready vial of concentrated ion solution.

items.name: Ion Solution
items.description: Dense suspension of charged particles in magnetic containment. Essential for ion propulsion and directed energy systems.

items.name: Ion Sparkling Water
items.description: Crystal-melt water charged over a voltmanta ion nodule and noble condensate — a crisp electrolyte fizz that tastes faintly of a storm about to break. What the sober and the hungover both reach for.

items.name: Ionized Neon
items.description: Excited neon gas sealed in containment tubes. Emits characteristic orange-red glow used in sensor calibration and signal amplification.

items.name: Iridium Ore
items.description: Dense, corrosion-proof metal for high-stress components.

items.name: Iron Ore
items.description: Common ferrous ore, the backbone of basic construction.

items.name: Irradiated Marrow
items.description: Glowing marrow drawn from a geiger-hound's bones, saturated with the isotopes of its irradiated prey. A dense, dangerous power source.

items.name: Isotope Separator
items.description: When mining, prevents collection of water ice and nitrogen ice into cargo. Use this to filter out both common ice types and target only rare isotope ices. A dual-gradient thermal stack handles both in series.

items.name: Judgment Beam
items.description: Deals 100 energy damage with a 50% energy-damage bonus; 50% bypasses shields. Fires every 4 ticks at reach 4.

items.name: Jump Calculator
items.description: Advanced computation unit for jump drive calibration.

items.name: Jump Coil
items.description: Hyperspace transition mechanism.

items.name: Jump Drive Core
items.description: Essential component for hyperspace travel.

items.name: Jury-Rigged Cannon
items.description: Deals 60 kinetic damage with ±30% random variance and reduced CPU requirements. Fires every 2 ticks at reach 3.

items.name: Kinetic Hull Hardener
items.description: Reduces incoming kinetic damage by 25% across shields, armor, and hull. Typed module resistances add and cap at 75%, then flat/adaptive reduction applies as the next damage stage.

items.name: Kinetic Shield Hardener
items.description: Reduces incoming kinetic damage by 30% across shields, armor, and hull. Typed module resistances add and cap at 75%, then flat/adaptive reduction applies as the next damage stage.

items.name: Krypton Bladder
items.description: A bio-sealed chamber from a nullbubble, filled with pure krypton and stoppered by a biological membrane of near-optical quality. The membrane filters better than most industrial separators — what comes out is purer than what went in.

items.name: Krypton Gas
items.description: Rare noble gas for high-efficiency lighting systems.

items.name: Krypton Kvass
items.description: A lightly fermented sunspindle drink given an inert-gas lift from a nullbubble krypton bladder — barely alcoholic, weirdly refreshing, and vanishingly clear. The thing dockworkers drink by the litre in the heat of a reactor bay.

items.name: Laser Focus Array
items.description: Precision laser focusing assembly for mining equipment.

items.name: Laser Focusing Lens
items.description: Crystal optics for focusing energy weapons.

items.name: Lead Ingot
items.description: Smelted lead for radiation shielding applications.

items.name: Lead Lined Cargo I
items.description: A shielded cargo expansion that allows safe transport of refined radioactive materials.

items.name: Lead Lined Cargo II
items.description: Heavy-duty titanium-reinforced lead cargo bay for large volumes of radioactive freight.

items.name: Lead Ore
items.description: Dense metal used for radiation shielding and ballast.

items.name: Lead Sheet
items.description: Rolled lead plate. Primary material for radiation shielding equipment and hazmat containers.

items.name: Lead Shielding
items.description: Dense lead-lined plating. Bolted into the walls of any facility that handles fissile material or hard radiation — if you see it in the build, something hot is happening inside.

items.name: Legacy Ore
items.description: Pre-spacefaring Earth artifacts fused with asteroid material over millennia.

items.name: Legion Barracks
items.description: A capital-scale troop complex supporting one hundred ten additional marines with armored quarters, equipment magazines, and assault marshalling decks. Marines must still be recruited separately.

items.name: Leviathan Heartcore
items.description: The crystallized cardiac node of a Molt Leviathan. Still warm years after harvest — whatever metabolic process formed it continues without the animal.

items.name: Leviathan Heartcore Roast
items.description: A whole Molt Leviathan heartcore, still warm years after harvest, spice-crusted and set on the pass to finish cooking itself in front of the guests. Theatre and heresy in equal measure — served exactly once at the opening of a station worth opening. Ruinously extravagant.

items.name: Leviathan Meat
items.description: Sweet, pearl-white tail meat cut from a Molt Leviathan — the ship-sized space lobster of the deep belts. A single kill yields tonnes of it, enough to keep the galactic elite in bisque and tail thermidor for months. The rarest luxury protein there is, purely because the beast that carries it so rarely dies.

items.name: Leviathan Tail Thermidor
items.description: Molt Leviathan tail meat grilled in the shell, folded through a spiced curd gratin and finished under a flame. Richer and less fussy than the bisque — the dish a leviathan hunter orders to celebrate the kill that paid for their ship.

items.name: Levity Bladder
items.description: The hydrogen float-sac of a bell-jelly, still buoyant after harvest. Used to raise everything from balloons to ballast tanks.

items.name: Life Support Array
items.description: Extended environmental control system for long-duration missions.

items.name: Life Support Unit
items.description: Integrated air and water recycling system for habitation.

items.name: Light Drone Bay
items.description: Compact drone bay for carrier ships. Holds two drones with 25 deployment bandwidth. Designed for smaller hulls.

items.name: Liquid Ammonia
items.description: Pressurized anhydrous ammonia for fertilizer, industrial cooling, and chemical synthesis.

items.name: Liquid Hydrogen
items.description: Compressed hydrogen fuel for fusion reactors.

items.name: Liquid Methane
items.description: Purified cryogenic methane for fuel and chemical production.

items.name: Liquid Nitrogen
items.description: Cryogenic nitrogen for cooling systems and chemical synthesis.

items.name: Liquid Oxygen
items.description: Cryogenically liquefied oxygen for propellant use. Pairs with liquid hydrogen for high-efficiency combustion.

items.name: Liquid Tritium
items.description: Cryogenically liquefied tritium for fusion fuel applications. Radioactive and volatile.

items.name: Lithium Ore
items.description: Essential for energy storage systems and batteries.

items.name: Low-Enriched Uranium
items.description: Uranium enriched to 3-5% U-235. Suitable for reactor fuel assemblies.

items.name: Lumen Algae Salad
items.description: Ribbons of raw bioluminescent algae over driftkale, dressed tableside with split honeyglobe so the glow survives the trip from the galley. Order it on a dim promenade and the first course lights the second.

items.name: Lumen Honey Cake
items.description: A fruited sunspindle cake soaked in cloudwhale lumen oil so the whole thing glows softly from within. Served with the lights down; children and admirals are equally powerless against it.

items.name: Lumen Liqueur
items.description: Gloomshine steeped with cloudwhale lumen oil into a soft, sweet after-dinner glow — literally. Poured over crystal-melt ice at the good tables, where the lights come down to show it off.

items.name: Lumen Oil
items.description: Glowing oil rendered from a Cloudwhale's gas-straining glands, still lit with the neon it fed on. A drop of it shines for weeks. Refiners use it as a binder that sets baleen plate without cracking it.

items.name: Magnetic Ore Separator
items.description: When mining, prevents collection of iron ore into cargo. Use this to filter out iron while targeting rarer co-located resources. A high-powered electromagnet pulls ferrous material aside and vents it. High power draw.

items.name: Manganese Ore
items.description: Strengthening agent for steel and aluminum alloys.

items.name: Mantis Claw
items.description: The serrated forelimb of a crusher-mantis, strong enough to peel a grazer's shell like fruit. The serrations are biological — grown, not cut — and remain sharp without maintenance.

items.name: Mantis Claw Thermidor
items.description: Sweet crusher-mantis claw meat baked back into the shell with whale-blubber butter and a copper-tang verdigris curd. The Solarian admiralty's standing wardroom order, and the reason mantis-hunters never want for buyers.

items.name: Marine Barracks
items.description: Armored berths, equipment lockers, and staging space for four additional marines. Marines must still be recruited separately.

items.name: Marine Garrison Deck
items.description: A hardened troop deck with independent life support, armories, and deployment facilities for thirty-six additional marines. Marines must still be recruited separately.

items.name: Mass Driver
items.description: Deals 130 kinetic damage from a 10-slug magazine; 75% bypasses armor. Fires every 4 ticks at reach 6.

items.name: Medical Bay Module
items.description: A sealed treatment cell combining sterile airflow, patient monitoring, and bioactive support equipment.

items.name: Medical Supplies
items.description: Sealed trauma packs containing sterile dressings, surgical consumables, and bioactive stabilizers. Medical modules consume one pack per five patients treated.

items.name: Memory Metal Sheet
items.description: Shape-memory alloy that returns to its original form after deformation.

items.name: Metallic Aerogel
items.description: Ultra-light solid with exceptional insulation properties.

items.name: Metamaterial Panel
items.description: Artificially structured material with impossible optical properties.

items.name: Methane Ice
items.description: Frozen methane for chemical processing and fuel synthesis.

items.name: Micro-Singularity Charge
items.description: A disposable, magnetically contained singularity seed for advanced void ammunition.

items.name: Micro-Thruster Array
items.description: Miniaturized propulsion system for drones and missiles.

items.name: Military Fuel Cell
items.description: Maximum density fuel, restores 100 fuel.

items.name: Mine Launcher I
items.description: Deals 50 explosive damage from a 5-mine magazine. On hit, also burns hull through shields and armor for 60 ticks at max(1, final hit damage / 60) per tick. Fires every 5 ticks at reach 3.

items.name: Mine Launcher II
items.description: Deals 80 explosive damage from a 10-mine magazine. On hit, also burns hull through shields and armor for 120 ticks at max(1, final hit damage / 120) per tick. Fires every 4 ticks at reach 3.

items.name: Mining Drone
items.description: Autonomous mining drone for ore extraction.

items.name: Mining Enhancer
items.description: +50% mining yield for 20 ticks.

items.name: Mining Laser I
items.description: Basic mining laser for ore extraction.

items.name: Mining Laser II
items.description: Improved mining laser with better yield.

items.name: Mining Laser III
items.description: Industrial mining laser.

items.name: Mining Laser IV
items.description: Industrial-grade mining system for maximum extraction.

items.name: Mining Laser V
items.description: Capital-grade mining system. Peak extraction performance.

items.name: Mining Survey Probe
items.description: Mineral detection probe that adds 30 system-survey power for 10 ticks.

items.name: Missile Guidance Unit
items.description: Smart targeting system for guided munitions.

items.name: Missile Launcher I
items.description: Deals 20 explosive damage from an 8-missile magazine. Fires every 3 ticks at reach 6.

items.name: Missile Launcher II
items.description: Deals 35 explosive damage from a 12-missile magazine. Fires every 3 ticks at reach 6.

items.name: Missile Warhead
items.description: Explosive payload for missile systems.

items.name: Modulated Mining Laser
items.description: Precision mining laser whose fine-control emitters can work thin, depleted deposits that standard lasers disperse.

items.name: Molt Leviathan Bisque
items.description: The dish the whole trade exists to serve. Molt Leviathan tail simmered for a day in its own stock with whale blubber and crystal-melt, passed through silk until it's pure velvet. A single beast makes it for a season; the aristocracy of five empires books the table a year out. The undisputed benchmark of galactic fine dining.

items.name: Nanite Hull Coating
items.description: Adds 100 current and maximum hull points and repairs 10 hull points each tick. Multiple copies add their bonuses and repair.

items.name: Nanite Swarm
items.description: Advanced repair nanobots. Restores 50 hull/tick for 5 ticks.

items.name: Nanocarbon Hull Lattice
items.description: Adds 250 maximum hull points and reduces cargo capacity by 30. Multiple copies add their effects.

items.name: Nanoplastic Composite
items.description: Self-healing plastic infused with nanomachines.

items.name: Navigation Array
items.description: Advanced astrogation system combining stellar cartography with predictive jump calculations.

items.name: Navigation Core
items.description: Astrogation computer for hyperspace calculations.

items.name: Nebula Bio-Regenerator
items.description: Adds 40 current and maximum hull points and repairs 8 hull points each tick. Multiple copies add their bonuses and repair.

items.name: Nebula Cargo Matrix
items.description: Prism-lens enhanced storage system that optimizes packing efficiency through light-guided sorting.

items.name: Nebula Essence
items.description: Concentrated nebular gases with exotic chemical properties.

items.name: Nebula Fungus Tart
items.description: A savoury-sweet tart of gloomcap mash and honeyglobe over a verdigris-curd base. Sounds wrong, eats wonderfully — the pastry that made a Federation baker's name and started three imitators.

items.name: Nebula Gas
items.description: Complex mixture of exotic compounds found only in nebulae.

items.name: Nebula Prism Computer
items.description: Photonic processing unit using light refraction for massively parallel computation.

items.name: Nebula Stellar Vintage
items.description: A sparkling suspension grown in zero-g from luminescent algae cultures, filtered through trade crystal. Served on every gold-plated Nebula merchant ship.

items.name: Nebula Storm Barrier
items.description: Adds 80 maximum shield points and returns 15 EM damage after every hit. Multiple barriers add their retaliation damage.

items.name: Nebulium
items.description: Crystallized energy from the heart of nebulae in Nebula Federation territory.

items.name: Nebulium Core
items.description: Processed nebulium for advanced energy systems.

items.name: Neodymium Magnet
items.description: Powerful permanent magnet for electromagnetic systems.

items.name: Neodymium Ore
items.description: Rare earth element for creating powerful magnets.

items.name: Neon Gas
items.description: Bright noble gas for signage and laser medium.

items.name: Neon Signaling Array
items.description: Gas-discharge tube array for high-bandwidth sensor calibration and signal processing.

items.name: Neon Vent
items.description: When mining, prevents collection of neon gas into cargo. Use this to filter out neon while harvesting rarer gases. A differential pressure separator tuned to neon's condensation point liquefies it and vents it away.

items.name: Nerve Burn
items.description: A crystalline stimulant that hits the nervous system like a plasma arc. Users report a burning sensation that starts at the spine and spreads outward, followed by hyper-acute reflexes and a complete inability to feel pain. The crash is legendary.

items.name: Neural Accelerator
items.description: Reduces weapon cooldown by 20% for 10 ticks.

items.name: Neural Disruption Charge Pack
items.description: Charges tuned to interfere with AI processing cores. Extended effect duration.

items.name: Neural Disruptor
items.description: Deals 12 EM damage and applies a 25% outgoing-damage penalty for 2 ticks. Fires every 2 ticks at reach 3.

items.name: Neural Extract
items.description: Concentrated neural compounds for AI cores and stimulant production.

items.name: Neural Interface Gel
items.description: Biocompatible medium for brain-computer interfaces.

items.name: Neutronium Ingot
items.description: Stabilized neutron-degenerate matter. Impossibly dense.

items.name: Neutronium Slug Case
items.description: Impossibly dense neutronium-core slugs. The ultimate kinetic penetrator.

items.name: Nickel Billet
items.description: Smelted and cast nickel, the workhorse metal of battery electrodes and stainless alloys. Low-grade ore is concentrated heavily, so each billet represents a sizeable pile of raw nickel.

items.name: Nickel Ore
items.description: Corrosion-resistant ore used in alloy production.

items.name: Nitro Cold Brew
items.description: Cold-steeped gloomcap coffee charged from a pressblister nitrogen bladder into a cascading, velvet-headed pour. What keeps the night shift on the docks vertical. Do not have four.

items.name: Nitrogen Bladder
items.description: A pressurized biological sac from a pressblister, still sealed with cryogenic liquid nitrogen inside. Harvest it live and it stays sealed; crack it and you have your cryo feedstock.

items.name: Nitrogen Ice
items.description: Frozen nitrogen used in cooling systems and life support.

items.name: Nitrogen Vent
items.description: When mining, prevents collection of nitrogen ice into cargo. Use this to filter out nitrogen ice while targeting rarer isotope ices. A thermal gradient set between nitrogen's and water's sublimation points vaporizes nitrogen while leaving other ices frozen.

items.name: Noble Condensate
items.description: Liquefied noble gas, exhaled and concentrated by a halo-drifter feeding in xenon clouds. Burns an unearthly blue in thruster tests.

items.name: Noble-Gas Spritz
items.description: A dry fruit spritz aerated with halo-drifter noble condensate, so it prickles like champagne and never quite goes flat. The drink held at every dockside launch party that's pretending to be classier than it is.

items.name: Noble Matte
items.description: A dense, softly gleaming sponge of fused platinum-group metal prised from the chambers of a tended bullionaut, where the animal has already done the concentrating a refinery would otherwise sweat over. Drawn straight into superconductor without ever touching raw palladium. Ranch-harvested — a killed bullionaut keeps its matte.

items.name: Nuclear Mines
items.description: Tactical nuclear devices. Enormous blast radius. Indiscriminate.

items.name: Nuclear Reactor I
items.description: A compact fission reactor that dramatically increases ship power capacity.

items.name: Nuclear Reactor II
items.description: Industrial-scale fission reactor. Provides enormous power output for the most demanding module loadouts.

items.name: Null Cannon
items.description: Deals 110 void damage, bypassing shields, armor, and defensive reductions. AOE radius 2 sends that full post-defense damage as a new hit to every other enemy within 2 battle bands of the target; each applies its own defenses.

items.name: Null Curd
items.description: A cold, dense paste of curdled null-matter drawn from a riftbloom's core, already condensed past what a processor would coax from raw ore. Heavy in the hand and strangely dark. Recovered from a hunted bloom.

items.name: Null Matter
items.description: Material that seems to absorb energy and light. Unique to Voidborn anomaly zones.

items.name: Null Void Core Pack
items.description: Cores that create localized null-space pockets. Devastating but difficult to manufacture.

items.name: Omega Core Pack
items.description: Mythical void cores of unknown origin. Their destructive mechanism defies conventional physics.

items.name: Onboard Galley
items.description: A compact ship's kitchen and mess that turns cargo provisions into hot meals on the move. Modest revenue, but it keeps a milk run's passengers fed and a little more patient about the trip. Consumes dishes (or drinks) from the hold while underway.

items.name: Onboard H2O2 Refinery
items.description: A self-contained electrolysis-and-combustion unit that passively converts water ice in the hold directly into tank fuel. It skips the entire station refining chain and wastes most of the ice — a lifeline for long-range explorers, but far too inefficient for industrial fuel production.

items.name: Onboard Hydrogen Refinery
items.description: A self-contained burner that passively converts hydrogen gas in the hold directly into tank fuel. It skips every refining intermediate and wastes most of the gas — invaluable for a deep-space explorer far from any fuel depot, but never worth it where a station is in reach.

items.name: Optical Fiber Bundle
items.description: Ultra-pure glass fibers for high-bandwidth data transfer.

items.name: Orchard Wine
items.description: Honest fruit wine, fermented from honeyglobe and bottled young. No pretensions, no pedigree, just a decent glass a station can make itself. The house pour from here to the Rim.

items.name: Ore Hopper
items.description: Specialized container for raw ore transport.

items.name: Osmium Armor Plate
items.description: Ultra-dense armor plating for maximum protection.

items.name: Osmium Ore
items.description: The densest naturally occurring element, used in specialized armor.

items.name: Outer Rim Salvage Array
items.description: Jury-rigged salvage system that extracts more from wrecks and debris.

items.name: Outer Rim Scrap Armor
items.description: Adds 15 armor and 50 maximum hull points and reduces speed by 1. While bracing below maximum hull, consumes 1 salvage item per tick to restore 10 hull.

items.name: Outpost Kit
items.description: A flat-packed deep-space outpost: a hardened lockbox, a fuel bladder, and the mooring spars to anchor them beside a landmark. Deploying one in lawless space plants a members-only faction outpost — a shared storage vault and fuel reserve, nothing more. Far less than a station, and far cheaper to field.

items.name: Overcharge Cell
items.description: Increases weapon damage by 25% for 3 ticks. Positive consumable weapon-damage bonuses share a 30% cap.

items.name: Overcharged Plasma Cell Pack
items.description: Dangerously overcharged cells delivering massive thermal output. Handle with care.

items.name: Overclock Chip
items.description: Overclocks weapon-control processors, reducing weapon cooldowns by 10% for 10 ticks.

items.name: Oxygen Gas
items.description: Pure oxygen gas produced by electrolyzing water or processing oxygen ice. Combines with liquid hydrogen as a high-efficiency propellant.

items.name: Oxygen Ice
items.description: Solid oxygen for emergency life support reserves.

items.name: Palladium Ore
items.description: Rare earth element crucial for shield emitter arrays.

items.name: Pan-Galactic Matrix
items.description: Voidborn null matter, Solarian composite, and Nebula trade ciphers unified in a circuit lattice. The pinnacle of cross-empire cooperation, these matrices power the most advanced technology in known space.

items.name: Pathfinder Drive
items.description: An experimental long-range drive that abandons the jump-lane network entirely. With one installed you can plot a numeric compass bearing on the jump command instead of a system name, and the drive will push your ship across open space along that heading using raw galactic coordinates. It is agonizingly slow — far slower than a lane jump — and unforgiving: miss your mark and you keep drifting. Plot a new bearing mid-drift (each replot costs another 5x jump's fuel) to correct course; a 180-degree reversal heads back the way you came. If you run dry of fuel out there, self-destruct is your last way home.

items.name: PD Burst
items.description: Activates emergency point defense, reducing missile hit chance by 80% for 3 ticks. It shares an 80% avoidance cap with Smoke Screen.

items.name: Perception Enhancer
items.description: Increases scanner power by 50% for 10 ticks.

items.name: Pharmaceutical Culture
items.description: Standardized biological culture media from certified biotech labs. Used in consumer wellness products and industrial synthesis.

items.name: Phase Array
items.description: Phased optics for cloaking technology.

items.name: Phase Cloaking Device
items.description: Top-tier stealth system using phase technology.

items.name: Phase Crystal
items.description: Exists partially out of phase with normal space-time. Found only in Outer Rim exploration zones.

items.name: Phase Disruptor
items.description: Deals 48 void damage and ignores 30% of typed resistance. Fires every 2 ticks at reach 3.

items.name: Phase Drive
items.description: Allows ships to partially phase out of normal space.

items.name: Phase Matrix
items.description: Stabilized phase crystal for reality manipulation.

items.name: Phase Pearl
items.description: A half-real bead grown by a phase-lurker, flickering in and out of sight as the phase-crystal it ate keeps trying to leave this universe.

items.name: Phased Void Core Pack
items.description: Phase-shifted cores that partially bypass shields and armor.

items.name: Piercing Railgun I
items.description: Deals 60 kinetic damage from a 7-slug magazine; 70% bypasses armor. Fires every 3 ticks at reach 5.

items.name: Piercing Railgun II
items.description: Deals 90 kinetic damage from a 10-slug magazine; 85% bypasses armor. Fires every 3 ticks at reach 5.

items.name: Pilot-Whale Chowder
items.description: Whale blubber rendered slow into a thick chowder with crystal-melt and greens. What cloud-whaling crews eat coming off a long haul, ladled by the potful and argued over for years after.

items.name: Pirate Moonshine
items.description: Distilled from water ice and pharmaceutical cultures in conditions that would make a health inspector weep. Every stronghold swears theirs is the best. They all share the same property: you won't remember what happened, and you won't want to.

items.name: Pirate Radio Scanner
items.description: A salvaged broadband receiver tuned to known pirate communication frequencies. Passively intercepts unencrypted pirate radio traffic within a few jumps. Having it installed is enough — no active use required.

items.name: Plasma Afterburner
items.description: Maximum speed enhancement.

items.name: Plasma Cannon I
items.description: Deals 22 thermal damage, increased by 50% while the target's shields are down. Fires every 2 ticks at reach 3.

items.name: Plasma Cannon II
items.description: Deals 38 thermal damage, increased by 50% while the target's shields are down. Fires every 2 ticks at reach 3.

items.name: Plasma Cannon III
items.description: Deals 58 thermal damage and reduces armor effectiveness by 15% for 3 ticks on hit. Fires every 2 ticks at reach 3.

items.name: Plasma Cannon IV
items.description: Deals 85 thermal damage and reduces armor effectiveness by 30% for 3 ticks on hit. Fires every 2 ticks at reach 3.

items.name: Plasma Cell
items.description: Magnetically contained plasma for high-energy applications.

items.name: Plasma Cell Pack
items.description: Stabilized plasma cells that increase weapon damage by 15%. One pack fully loads any plasma weapon magazine.

items.name: Plasma Gas
items.description: Superheated ionized gas captured from stellar coronas.

items.name: Plasma Injector
items.description: Fuel injection system for plasma weapons.

items.name: Plasma Mines
items.description: Thermal detonation mines. Superheated blast melts armor in the vicinity.

items.name: Plasma Repeater I
items.description: Deals 12 thermal damage, increased by 50% while the target's shields are down. Fires every tick at reach 3.

items.name: Plasma Repeater II
items.description: Deals 20 thermal damage, increased by 50% while the target's shields are down. Fires every tick at reach 3.

items.name: Plasma Residue
items.description: High-energy plasma condensate harvested from Crimson weapons testing ranges.

items.name: Plasma Sinter
items.description: A still-warm brick of plasma residue re-fired in a fluxipede's gut segments into a stable, workable flux. Dropped into a titanium melt it does the plasma-flux step on its own, no raw residue or extra steel required. A ranch product.

items.name: Plasma Torpedo Launcher
items.description: Deals 60 thermal damage and reduces armor effectiveness by 20% for 3 ticks on hit. Fires every 5 ticks at reach 6.

items.name: Plasma Torpedoes
items.description: Superheated plasma warhead. Melts armor on impact and continues burning.

items.name: Platinum Bar
items.description: A dense, white-metal bar worth a small ship apiece. The serious collector's bullion — rarer than gold, useful for nothing, and a quiet way to say one has more credits than one knows what to do with.

items.name: Platinum Catalyst
items.description: Platinum refined into a high-surface-area catalytic sponge. A little of it makes a chemical reaction go where it otherwise would not — but industrial beds foul in service and demand steady replacement. The heart of catalytic fuel refining, fuel-cell assembly, polymer cracking, and air-scrubber cartridges.

items.name: Platinum Ore
items.description: Precious metal with excellent catalytic properties.

items.name: Platinum Wiring
items.description: Fine wire drawn from stubborn white metal. It conducts worse than gold and fights the die every gauge of the way, but the contacts and electrodes made from it never pit, tarnish, or erode.

items.name: Polonium Ore
items.description: Extremely radioactive element for compact power sources.

items.name: Power Battery
items.description: High-density lithium energy storage unit.

items.name: Power Cell
items.description: High-capacity energy storage unit.

items.name: Power Core
items.description: High-capacity energy cell for ship systems.

items.name: Power Distribution Grid
items.description: Ship-wide power routing network with redundant pathways and load balancing.

items.name: Power Reactor Upgrade
items.description: Adds additional power capacity.

items.name: Power Surge Cell
items.description: Discharges stored power through every fitted weapon, immediately resetting their cooldowns.

items.name: Precision Optic
items.description: Solarian composite ground into optical-grade lenses and mounted in glass housings. Essential for advanced targeting and sensor systems.

items.name: Premium Fuel Cell
items.description: High-density fuel cell, restores 50 fuel.

items.name: Pressure Seal
items.description: Airtight seal for hull penetrations and hatches.

items.name: Prism-Charged Cocktail
items.description: Gloomshine and honeyglobe spiked with prism-charged ichor, so the drink shifts through a whole spectrum as you tilt the glass. Ordered for the show, finished for the kick. A deep-galaxy status symbol.

items.name: Prism-Charged Ichor
items.description: Iridescent hemolymph wrung from a prism-drifter's mantle, dense with refracting nebulite motes the grazer concentrates from the clouds it strains. Only well-fed drifters in nebulite-rich clouds carry it. A key feedstock for pan-galactic alloy.

items.name: Prismatic Carapace
items.description: The spectacular molted shell of a Rainbow Leviathan, fracturing light into shifting bands of colour. Its lattice is laced with exotic metals concentrated across a lifetime of hunting exotic-fed fauna — the raw material for pan-galactic alloy.

items.name: Prismatic Lens
items.description: Light-refracting material for advanced targeting systems.

items.name: Prismatic Nebulite
items.description: Multicolored crystalline ore that refracts energy in unusual ways.

items.name: Processed Null Matter
items.description: Stabilized null matter for stealth technology.

items.name: Processed Thorium
items.description: Refined thorium for molten salt reactors and radiation sources.

items.name: Processing Core
items.description: Central computing unit for ship systems.

items.name: Promenade Lounge
items.description: A proper bar with a view — soft lighting, a stocked back-shelf, and enough room to make a long haul feel like part of the holiday. Serves drinks and spirits from cargo and keeps passengers relaxed enough to forgive a leisurely course.

items.name: Protein Rations
items.description: Cooked protein pressed and vacuum-sealed into dense ration blocks, made from either butchered xeno-meat or cultivated vatflesh curd. Not fancy, but it keeps — the backbone of any frontier galley that can't source empire supply.

items.name: Proximity Mine Launcher
items.description: Deals 65 explosive damage from an 8-mine magazine; detection adds 10 hit-chance points, capped at 95% total. On hit, also burns hull through shields and armor for 90 ticks at max(1, final hit damage / 90) per tick.

items.name: Pulse Laser I
items.description: Entry-level energy weapon. Reliable but weak.

items.name: Pulse Laser II
items.description: Improved energy weapon with better focusing optics.

items.name: Pulse Laser III
items.description: Military-grade pulse laser with rapid fire capability.

items.name: Purified Argon
items.description: Inert gas for welding, shielding, and controlled atmospheres.

items.name: Purified Krypton
items.description: Ultra-pure krypton gas for precision optical systems and photon absorption cloaking technology.

items.name: Purified Water
items.description: Purified water for life support and chemical processing.

items.name: Purified Xenon
items.description: Dense noble gas for ion propulsion and high-intensity lighting.

items.name: Quantum Computer Core
items.description: Adds massive CPU capacity through quantum processing.

items.name: Quantum Control Core
items.description: A high-bandwidth coordination core for advanced fabrication — quantum-precise scheduling for the most demanding production work.

items.name: Quantum Dot Matrix
items.description: Nanoscale semiconductors for quantum computing.

items.name: Quantum Entanglement Shield
items.description: Adds 250 maximum shield points and 6 shield points to each regeneration tick. Multiple copies add their bonuses.

items.name: Quantum Entangler
items.description: Quantum-linked communication device for instantaneous data transfer.

items.name: Quantum Fizz
items.description: A fruit soda spun with quantum-moth silk and biogas until it seems to fizz in several glasses at once. Tastes different to everyone, allegedly. Physicists hate the marketing; the bar doesn't care.

items.name: Quantum Fragments
items.description: Unstable particles that exist in multiple states simultaneously. Found only in Outer Rim frontier space.

items.name: Quantum Processor
items.description: Reality-defying computing unit for exotic ships.

items.name: Quantum Shield IV
items.description: Adds 250 maximum shield points and 35% flat/adaptive damage reduction. Flat and adaptive reductions add and cap at 75%, applied after typed resistance.

items.name: Quantum Silk
items.description: Thread spun by a quantum-moth from quantum fragments, each strand existing in several places at once. A spool of it is never quite where you put it.

items.name: Quantum Stabilizer
items.description: Voidborn null matter bonded to a circuit substrate. Stabilizes quantum states in sensitive equipment across the galaxy.

items.name: Rad Harvester I
items.description: A lead-lined mining module that allows safe extraction of radioactive ores.

items.name: Rad Harvester II
items.description: Enhanced rad harvester with improved shielding and isotope capture systems.

items.name: Rad Harvester III
items.description: Industrial-grade hot-isotope extraction with titanium shielding and superconducting beam emitters.

items.name: Rad Harvester IV
items.description: Capital-grade radiation mining system with full hot-cell containment and maximum yield.

items.name: Radiant Bile
items.description: Luminous, faintly warm fluid wrung from a cinder-urchin's gut. The radioisotopes it concentrates from uranium make it a potent — and hazardous — reactor primer.

items.name: Radiant-Glazed Ribs
items.description: Grazer ribs lacquered in a cinder-urchin radiant-bile glaze that genuinely, faintly glows. Perfectly safe. Almost certainly perfectly safe. The Outer Rim's favourite dare, and its favourite hangover cure.

items.name: Radiant Tonic
items.description: Crystal-melt, noble condensate, and a carefully small amount of cinder-urchin radiant bile, glowing an unwholesome green. Marketed as an energy tonic. Consumed as a dare. Regulated in three empires and beloved in the fourth.

items.name: Radiation-Hardened Circuit
items.description: Circuit board hardened with radium phosphor. Resistant to radiation damage and electromagnetic interference.

items.name: Radium Ore
items.description: Glowing radioactive element used in specialized equipment.

items.name: Radium Phosphor
items.description: Radioluminescent compound derived from radium ore. Used in specialized sensor and circuit applications.

items.name: Railgun Capacitor
items.description: High-energy capacitor bank for electromagnetic weapons.

items.name: Railgun I
items.description: Deals 45 kinetic damage from a 5-slug magazine. Fires every 2 ticks at reach 5.

items.name: Railgun II
items.description: Deals 90 kinetic damage from a 7-slug magazine; 50% bypasses armor. Fires every 3 ticks at reach 5.

items.name: Rainbow Leviathan Carpaccio
items.description: Rainbow Leviathan flesh sliced tissue-thin and cured just enough to keep the starlight shimmer, dressed with lumen oil and a sour ember-cure. The single rarest plate in the galaxy — most chefs will go a whole career without the chance to ruin it once.

items.name: Rainbow Leviathan Flesh
items.description: Flesh from the grandest of the void-leviathans, shot through with the same starlight-fracturing pigment as its shell — it shifts colour as you turn the cut. Impossibly rare, faintly sweet, and served raw so the shimmer survives to the plate. Chefs who have worked it can be counted on one hand.

items.name: Rancher's Breakfast
items.description: Two ray eggs fried in whale oil over a pile of grilled xeno-meat and gloomcap hash. What the corral crew eats before the first feed run of the shift — big, hot, and unapologetic.

items.name: Rare Salvage
items.description: Exotic materials and advanced components from high-value wrecks.

items.name: Raw Focusing Crystal
items.description: A cloudy, self-grown crystal lattice cut from the gut-geode of a tended druse, seeded by the crystal it filters and left to accrete in the calm of a ranch. Rough and unfocused, but already halfway to a weapon core — a bench cuts it straight down to a focused crystal, skipping the raw-crystal grind. Ranch-only: a hunted druse shatters its geode to gravel.

items.name: Raw Xeno-Meat
items.description: Butchered muscle from a space grazer — dense, dark, faintly iridescent. Edible once cooked, and a galley kitchen can turn it into ration blocks or a proper smoked delicacy. Won't keep long unrefrigerated.

items.name: Ray Eggs
items.description: Leathery, palm-sized egg cases collected from a tended ranch-ray shoal, each holding a rich amber yolk. Rays only lay in the calm of a ranch — a hunted ray takes its clutch with it.

items.name: Reactive Armor Hardener
items.description: Adds 25% resistance to every incoming damage type. Typed and reactive module resistances add and cap at 75%; resistance bypass reduces that total.

items.name: Reactor Fuel Assembly
items.description: Sealed fuel rod assembly for nuclear fission reactors. Primary input for plutonium breeding.

items.name: Reactor-Grade Plutonium
items.description: Plutonium bred in a fission reactor. Requires further refinement for weapons applications.

items.name: Reconnaissance Probe
items.description: Standard probe that increases scanner power by 20% for 10 ticks.

items.name: Red Mist
items.description: A pre-loaded injector of synthetic adrenaline and neural accelerants. Popular with boarding parties. Everything goes red, everything slows down, and you stop caring about the odds. Side effects include nosebleeds, short-term memory gaps, and an overwhelming urge to do it again.

items.name: Refined Plasma Core
items.description: Stabilized high-energy plasma for weapon systems.

items.name: Refined Quantum Matrix
items.description: Processed quantum-entangled material for advanced tech.

items.name: Reflex Enhancer
items.description: Reduces incoming damage by 15% for 10 ticks. Positive temporary damage reductions share a 60% cap.

items.name: Refractory Sinter
items.description: A knuckle of iridium and thorium fused in a vulcanid's gut into a nugget that laughs at a foundry — already alloyed, already dense, needing only silicon to bond it into a composite. Recovered from a hunted vulcanid; the belt has no other source.

items.name: Refueling Pump
items.description: A high-pressure fuel transfer system that allows you to pump fuel from your own tank to another ship at the same location. Essential equipment for tankers and rescue operations.

items.name: Regeneration Serum
items.description: Bio-nanite serum that accelerates hull self-repair.

items.name: Regenerative Armor I
items.description: Adds 20 armor and 40 current and maximum hull points, and repairs 2 hull points each tick. Multiple copies add their bonuses and repair.

items.name: Regenerative Armor II
items.description: Adds 40 armor and 80 current and maximum hull points, and repairs 5 hull points each tick. Multiple copies add their bonuses and repair.

items.name: Regenerative Compound
items.description: Bio-synthetic repair material. Restores 30 hull/tick for 10 ticks.

items.name: Reinforced Bulkhead
items.description: Heavy structural framing that distributes stress across multiple hull sections. Standard in warships and heavy haulers.

items.name: Reinforced Frame
items.description: A heavy durasteel-and-composite skeleton braced for high-stress industry — capital shipbuilding, heavy weapons fabrication, and the largest production lines.

items.name: Reinforced Glass
items.description: Transparent armor for viewports and sensors.

items.name: Relic Amber
items.description: A clear amber secreted over a relict's ancient shell, dense with legacy-ore laid down grain by grain across a lifetime nobody has measured. Smelts straight to legacy alloy. Recovered from a hunted specimen — the xenobiologists weep.

items.name: Remote Armor Repairer I
items.description: Repairs the most-damaged allied ship within 2 radial bands.

items.name: Remote Armor Repairer II
items.description: Enhanced remote repair reaching allied ships within 4 radial bands.

items.name: Remote Armor Repairer III
items.description: Capital-class fleet repair reaching allied ships within 6 radial bands.

items.name: Repair Arm
items.description: A remote hull repair system that allows you to patch another ship's hull using repair kits from your cargo. Essential equipment for fleet support ships.

items.name: Repair Drone
items.description: Autonomous repair drone for field repairs.

items.name: Repair Kit
items.description: Emergency repair kit. Restores 50 hull when used as a consumable.

items.name: Repair Nanite Container
items.description: Contained micro-robots for hull repair.

items.name: Repair Nanites
items.description: Self-replicating nanobots for automated hull repair.

items.name: Rhodium Coating
items.description: An ultra-reflective, heat-resistant rhodium finish for precision optics and electrical contacts.

items.name: Rhodium Optic Array
items.description: Focused crystal optics with a heat-resistant rhodium mirror coating for precision sensors and beam control.

items.name: Rhodium Ore
items.description: Ultra-reflective metal for advanced optical systems.

items.name: Rime Fang
items.description: A frost-sheathed fang from a frost-lurker, cold enough to burn. Cutters mount them as blades that never need sharpening.

items.name: Rime Milk
items.description: Thick, near-frozen milk from ranched rime-grazers, loaded with the antifreeze fats that keep the animal alive on the ice. It pours slow, keeps forever, and cultures into a blue cheese people cross systems for.

items.name: Rimeblue Cheese
items.description: A veined blue cheese set from rime milk and cellared with gloomcap culture until the cold-blue mold runs through it. Sharp, creamy, and faintly frosted even at room temperature. The pride of the ice-field ranches.

items.name: Rivetshell Meat
items.description: The sweet, briny muscle pried from a farmed rivetshell, sold live in the shell or shucked by the crate. Cooks fast, soaks up whatever it's cooked in, and turns a belt outpost's galley into somewhere worth docking for. A ranch product — wild reefs keep their meat.

items.name: Salvage Components
items.description: Partially intact ship systems recovered from wrecks.

items.name: Salvage Drone
items.description: Automated salvage drone for wreck processing.

items.name: Salvage Enhancer
items.description: +50% salvage yield for 20 ticks.

items.name: Salvage Metal
items.description: Reclaimed metal from ship hulls. Used in manufacturing and repairs.

items.name: Salvage Module
items.description: Extracts valuable components from wrecks.

items.name: Scout Drone
items.description: Long-range reconnaissance drone with enhanced sensors.

items.name: Scrap Harpoon
items.description: Deals 44 kinetic damage; 30% bypasses armor. Uses no ammunition and fires every 3 ticks at reach 2.

items.name: Scrap Missiles
items.description: A salvaged seeker head, a length of pipe, and as much of somebody else's fuel as would fit. The guidance is enthusiastic rather than accurate. Fired in enough quantity this stops mattering, which is the entire pirate theory of ordnance.

items.name: Scrap Rounds
items.description: Hand-loaded cartridges of indifferent quality, filled from a barrel of powder somebody swears is the right powder. They will feed through an autocannon, mostly, and the ones that do not are cleared with a hammer.

items.name: Scrap Shot
items.description: Whatever was lying about, cut to something near the right diameter and packed into a case by hand. It fouls the barrel, it scatters, and roughly one round in twenty is a rock. It is also free, it is made out of the wreck of the last people who came calling, and there is a very great deal of it.

items.name: Scrap Torpedoes
items.description: A warhead cut out of something that did not need it any more, welded to a drive taken off something that did. Slow, ugly, and carrying a great deal of explosive toward a station that cannot dodge. Against anything that can, they are a waste of a good warhead.

items.name: Scrapgun
items.description: Deals 30 kinetic damage. Reloading consumes any 1 cargo item to fill its 500-round magazine; omitting the item selects low-value cargo. Fires every tick at reach 2.

items.name: Seared Glintfin
items.description: A whole glintfin fillet hit hard in a screaming pan of whale oil, crisped at the edges and barely set through, laid over griddled sunspindle. Simple, fast, and the first thing every belt cook learns to do with a fish once they've finally got one.

items.name: Secure Vault
items.description: Reinforced storage for valuable cargo.

items.name: Security Bulkheads
items.description: Reinforced docking collars, isolated pressure doors, and local security stations that frustrate hostile clamps and strengthen compartment defense.

items.name: Sensor Array
items.description: Multi-spectrum detection equipment.

items.name: Sensor Booster
items.description: Increases scanner power by 50% for 5 ticks.

items.name: Sensor Cluster
items.description: Multi-spectrum sensor package with cross-referencing analysis cores.

items.name: Sensor Dampener
items.description: Reduces enemy weapon reach by 30% and scanner power by 30 points. Only the strongest fitted dampener affects reach; scanner reduction has strongest-first diminishing returns and caps at 60. Operational ship scanners counter up to 30 points of the reach reduction.

items.name: Sensor Package
items.description: Integrated sensor and diagnostic array for hull scanning and system analysis.

items.name: Shaped Charge Slug Case
items.description: Explosive-lined slugs that focus blast energy through the target hull on impact.

items.name: Shield Array
items.description: Linked bank of shield emitters that shares load across overlapping fields.

items.name: Shield Booster I
items.description: Adds 25 maximum shield points. Multiple copies add their bonuses.

items.name: Shield Booster II
items.description: Adds 50 maximum shield points. Multiple copies add their bonuses.

items.name: Shield Booster III
items.description: Adds 100 maximum shield points. Multiple copies add their bonuses.

items.name: Shield Booster IV
items.description: Adds 200 maximum shield points. Multiple copies add their bonuses.

items.name: Shield Booster MK2
items.description: Advanced shield restoration. Restores 200 shields.

items.name: Shield Charge
items.description: Instant shield restoration, restores 100 shields.

items.name: Shield Emitter
items.description: Projector unit for defensive shields.

items.name: Shield Generator
items.description: Large-scale shield projector for stations and capitals.

items.name: Shield Hardener
items.description: Increases shield resistance by 25% for 10 ticks. While shields hold, positive temporary damage reductions share a 60% cap.

items.name: Shield Matrix
items.description: Energy distribution matrix for advanced shield systems.

items.name: Shield Overcharge
items.description: Overcharges shields to 150% capacity for 10 ticks.

items.name: Shield Recharger I
items.description: Adds 2 shield points to each regeneration tick. Multiple copies add their bonuses.

items.name: Shield Recharger II
items.description: Adds 5 shield points to each regeneration tick. Multiple copies add their bonuses.

items.name: Shield Regenerator
items.description: Boosts shield recharge rate by 50% for 10 ticks.

items.name: Ship Maintenance Bay
items.description: Allows refitting and repairs in space.

items.name: Ship Scanner I
items.description: Scans other ships for information and provides 10 points of targeting and ECM resistance. Fitted scanner resistance stacks up to 30 points.

items.name: Ship Scanner II
items.description: Enhanced scanning resolution with 20 points of targeting and ECM resistance. Fitted scanner resistance stacks up to 30 points.

items.name: Ship Scanner III
items.description: Military-grade intelligence gathering with 30 points of targeting and ECM resistance, the fitted resistance cap.

items.name: Shipboard Sickbay
items.description: A compact surgical ward that treats injured crew and marines aboard this ship while out of combat. Consumes medical supplies.

items.name: Siege Railgun
items.description: Deals 200 kinetic damage from a 3-slug magazine; 90% bypasses armor. Fires every 5 ticks at reach 6.

items.name: Siege Torpedoes
items.description: Maximum hull damage payload. Designed for breaking stations and capital ships.

items.name: Silica Lens
items.description: A flawless disc of fused silica, ground smooth in the gizzard of a silica-borer. The surface uniformity is biological — no grinding machine produces the same result.

items.name: Silicate Composite
items.description: Advanced semiconductor substrate for computing systems.

items.name: Silicon Ore
items.description: Semiconductor base material for computing components.

items.name: Silver Bar
items.description: A heavy bar of pure silver, cool and faintly luminous. It does no work and fits no machine — wealth worn on the sleeve, for pilots who would rather see their fortune than read it off a balance.

items.name: Silver Ore
items.description: Reflective metal with antimicrobial properties.

items.name: Silver Wiring
items.description: High-conductivity silver wiring for precision electronics and shield systems.

items.name: Singularity Core
items.description: Micro black hole power source. Extremely dangerous.

items.name: Singularity Core Pack
items.description: Contains stabilized micro-singularity charges. The most destructive ammunition in known space.

items.name: Singularity Plate
items.description: Event-horizon alloy beaten flat over a darksteel-and-fury backing into a finished plate — impossibly dense, and lighter to carry than it has any right to be. The core of the toughest hull armor ever fielded. There is no ore route to it: it begins as something a black hole grew a coral to make.

items.name: Singularity Slug Case
items.description: Experimental slugs containing stabilized micro-singularities. Warps space around the impact point.

items.name: Smart Cluster Missiles
items.description: Guided carrier missiles that split before impact and assign submunitions across nearby hostile ships. Seeker deconfliction saturates each secondary target after two matching payloads per volley. Their distributed payload is inefficient against a lone target but punishes tightly packed formations.

items.name: Smoke Screen
items.description: A conductive particulate cloud that reduces enemy accuracy by 40% for 3 ticks. It shares an 80% avoidance cap with missile-specific point defense.

items.name: Smoked Xeno Delicacy
items.description: Xeno-meat cured and cold-smoked with fermentation cultures over a long aging cycle. Rich, complex, and prized on tasting menus — the kind of centerpiece that makes a dining room's reputation.

items.name: Sol Alloy Ore
items.description: Ancient alloy deposits from Sol's asteroid belt, prized for their purity.

items.name: Sol Nacre
items.description: Sheets of gold-throwing nacre peeled from a coronid's carapace, sol-alloy laid down in an organic lattice the Confederacy prizes for its composite. Skips the ore-and-steel forge. Taken from a hunted crab.

items.name: Solar Collector Array
items.description: Photonic energy harvesting system calibrated to multiple stellar classifications.

items.name: Solar Lance
items.description: Deals 65 energy damage with a 25% energy-damage bonus. Fires every 3 ticks at reach 4.

items.name: Solar Panel Array
items.description: Photovoltaic power generation for stations.

items.name: Solarian Aegis
items.description: Adds 100 maximum shield points and returns 20% of final incoming energy damage as EM damage. Reflection percentages add and cap at 75%.

items.name: Solarian Biotic
items.description: Solarian Biotech Division certified wellness supplement. Whether they work better than alternatives is hotly debated. They cost more. That is the point.

items.name: Solarian Composite
items.description: Advanced material developed in Sol system research labs.

items.name: Solarian Gourmet Rations
items.description: Vacuum-sealed meals prepared in Sol Central's hydroponic biosphere. Real food is a luxury in space, and nobody does it better than the Confederacy.

items.name: Solarian Legacy Alloy
items.description: A refined alloy made from ancient Solarian Legacy ore. Its unique crystalline structure makes it exceptionally resistant to energy weapons.

items.name: Solarian Logic Matrix
items.description: Quantum-coherent processor array. Three peer review committees certified its clock speed.

items.name: Space Pizza
items.description: A hand-stretched sunspindle crust under ember marinara, molten beltwheel cheese, and a scatter of seared xeno-meat, fired hot and cut into slices you can eat one-handed on a moving deck. The galaxy argued about toppings for about a week and then just kept ordering it.

items.name: Speed Stim
items.description: Increases ship speed by 25% for 10 ticks.

items.name: Spore Ragout
items.description: Gloomcap mash braised down with driftkale and a spoon of whale oil into something deep and savoury. The best argument the frontier has that you don't need meat to eat well — not that anyone asked.

items.name: Stabilized Exotic
items.description: Exotic matter processed into usable form.

items.name: Stainless Alloy Plate
items.description: Chromium-rich structural steel hardened with ferromanganese for corrosion-resistant hull and shield assemblies.

items.name: Standard Guided Missiles
items.description: Heat-seeking guided missiles. Reliable all-purpose ordnance.

items.name: Standard Mines
items.description: Basic proximity-detonated explosives for area denial.

items.name: Standard Plasma Charge Pack
items.description: Mass-produced plasma charges filled directly from harvested plasma gas. Inexpensive and reliable, but without the enhanced output of stabilized plasma cells.

items.name: Standard Rounds Box
items.description: Crate of basic kinetic autocannon ammunition. One box fully loads any autocannon magazine.

items.name: Standard Torpedoes
items.description: Heavy anti-capital torpedoes. Slow but devastating on impact.

items.name: Starshine
items.description: Pirate moonshine filtered through crushed energy crystals. The crystalline infusion gives it an otherworldly glow and a taste that's been described as 'the aurora borealis in a glass.' The only pirate product that some empire citizens will quietly admit to seeking out.

items.name: Stasis Webifier I
items.description: Reduces the selected target's effective combat speed by 30% within reach 3, affecting hit chance, maneuvering, escape, and boarding pursuit. Webifier strengths add and cap at 75%.

items.name: Stasis Webifier II
items.description: Reduces the selected target's effective combat speed by 50% within reach 4, affecting hit chance, maneuvering, escape, and boarding pursuit. Webifier strengths add and cap at 75%.

items.name: Station Core
items.description: The structural and command heart of a deep-space station: pressurized habitat ring, docking spine, command deck, and the integrated reactor that anchors everything else. Deploying one in lawless space founds a faction station that the owning faction must then build out and keep supplied.

items.name: Station Lager
items.description: A clean, cold sunspindle lager brewed in-station and drunk by the crate. Not one bottle has ever changed a life, and that is exactly the point. The most-poured drink in the galaxy, bar none.

items.name: Station Reactor
items.description: High-output fusion reactor core for station power generation.

items.name: Station Reactor Core
items.description: Large-scale power generation system for stations.

items.name: Station Seltzer
items.description: Purified water and carbon dioxide, canned cold and sold everywhere from polished core promenades to battered refinery docks. Clean, sharp, cheap, and refreshingly free of anything with tentacles.

items.name: Steamed Rivetshell
items.description: A heaped pot of rivetshell steamed open over gloomcap broth and finished with a fistful of cinderspice, served with the shells still clacking. Communal, messy, and gone in minutes — the standard order for a whole dock crew coming off shift.

items.name: Steel Plate
items.description: Processed steel alloy for structural components.

items.name: Stellar Observation Deck
items.description: A domed leisure deck built around a panoramic viewport — cocktail bar, lounge seating, and the galaxy drifting past outside. The reason certain passengers book the slow ship on purpose. Serves alcohol and drink from cargo and makes even a multi-week crossing something to savor.

items.name: Stellar Plasma Cell Pack
items.description: Cells containing plasma harvested from stellar coronas. Burns hotter than any synthetic alternative.

items.name: Storm Lance
items.description: Deals 40 EM damage, then repeats its full final damage against up to 2 other enemies in the target's zone. Fires every 2 ticks at reach 3.

items.name: Storm Node
items.description: The crackling electric organ of a tempest-eel, still arcing faintly after harvest. A natural capacitor of frightening capacity.

items.name: Strip Miner I
items.description: Massive mining system that extracts entire asteroid chunks. Maximizes yield on common ore deposits but cannot selectively extract rarer veins. Coarse beam — needs dense deposits and cannot get a lock on heavily depleted ones.

items.name: Strip Miner II
items.description: Industrial mega-miner for maximum ore extraction. Maximizes yield on common ore deposits but cannot selectively extract rarer veins. Coarse beam — needs dense deposits and cannot get a lock on heavily depleted ones.

items.name: Structural Cement
items.description: Heavy-duty hull repair compound. Restores 200 hull.

items.name: Structural Frame
items.description: A prefabricated girder skeleton with integrated plumbing runs. The basic load-bearing shell every facility is built around.

items.name: Sunspindle
items.description: Spindly cereal grown in tall lamp-lit stalks and fed on nitrogen mist. Mills to flour, boils to mash, or steams as a side — the flour, noodle, and bread of half the galaxy starts here.

items.name: Superconductor
items.description: Zero-resistance conductor for shield systems.

items.name: Superfluid Caviar
