items.description: Frost-moth superfluid spherified into weightless beads that burst cold on the tongue, crowning a scrape of rainbow-leviathan flesh. Molecular theatre for people who've eaten everything else — and can prove it.

items.name: Superfluid Martini
items.description: Cut with a drop of frost-moth superfluid, it crawls up the sides of the glass and never once warms in your hand. Insufferable people order it to explain the physics. It is, admittedly, a very good martini.

items.name: Superfluid Vial
items.description: A self-sealing bladder of frictionless helium superfluid, secreted by a frost-moth. Creeps up the walls of any container — cryo-labs cannot get enough.

items.name: Surf-and-Turf Platter
items.description: Crusher-mantis claw and a grazer steak on one board with a pile of greens. The classic 'I finally made some credits' order — equal parts hunter's brag and comfort food.

items.name: Survey Scanner I
items.description: Analyzes asteroids to find the richest ore deposits.

items.name: Survey Scanner II
items.description: Advanced geological analysis for optimal mining.

items.name: Sustagel
items.description: Grey, complete, and utterly joyless. Extruded from water and nitrogen feedstock into a shelf-stable ration gel that keeps a crew alive and asks only that they never look forward to a meal again. Every cadet knows the tube by heart.

items.name: Sustagel Bowl
items.description: Sustagel, warmed, with some driftkale stirred through it so a recruit can pretend. It is food in the strictest technical sense. Every spacer has a story about the day they finally stopped having to eat it.

items.name: Swarm Controller
items.description: Master control unit for coordinating drone swarms.

items.name: Swarm Missiles
items.description: Pod of micro-missiles that saturate the target area. Harder to evade but less damage per warhead.

items.name: Synthetic Compound
items.description: Synthetic organic base material for biological processing.

items.name: Synthetic Diamond
items.description: Lab-grown diamond for cutting tools and heat sinks.

items.name: System Disabler
items.description: Deals 2 EM damage and automatically disables the target's fitted weapon with the highest base damage for 1 tick. Fires every 3 ticks at reach 3.

items.name: Tactical Probe
items.description: Tactical probe that increases scanner power by 40% for 10 ticks.

items.name: Target Painter I
items.description: Marks your selected hostile target within reach 3, increasing allied weapon accuracy against it by 10 percentage points. The strongest allied target painter applies.

items.name: Target Painter II
items.description: Marks your selected hostile target within reach 5, increasing allied weapon accuracy against it by 20 percentage points. The strongest allied target painter applies.

items.name: Targeting Computer
items.description: Advanced fire control system for improved weapon accuracy.

items.name: Temporal Stabilizer
items.description: Prevents time dilation effects during high-speed travel.

items.name: Thermal Ceramic
items.description: Heat-resistant material for engine and weapon components.

items.name: Thermal Hull Hardener
items.description: Reduces incoming thermal damage by 25% across shields, armor, and hull. Typed module resistances add and cap at 75%, then flat/adaptive reduction applies as the next damage stage.

items.name: Thermal Shield Hardener
items.description: Reduces incoming thermal damage by 30% across shields, armor, and hull. Typed module resistances add and cap at 75%, then flat/adaptive reduction applies as the next damage stage.

items.name: Thermal Sublimator
items.description: When mining, prevents collection of water ice into cargo. Use this to filter out water ice while targeting rarer isotope ices. Heats the intake to just above water's sublimation point — water flashes to vapor and vents; deuterium and helium ices pass through.

items.name: Thorium Concentrate
items.description: Refined thorium oxide extracted from raw ore. First step in thorium fuel processing.

items.name: Thorium Fuel Rod
items.description: Processed thorium fuel for molten-salt reactors and breeder blankets.

items.name: Thorium Ore
items.description: Fertile radioactive material for breeder reactors.

items.name: Threat Analyzer
items.description: Combat computer that prioritizes hostile targets.

items.name: Thruster Assembly
items.description: Integrated propulsion unit combining multiple nozzles with a coordinated burn controller.

items.name: Thruster Nozzle
items.description: Exhaust component for sublight propulsion.

items.name: Tide-Line Platter
items.description: The raw-bar showpiece: fanned glintfin, chilled rivetshell on the half-shell, and a cracked mantis claw over shaved ice with driftkale and three sharp sauces. Half surf, half spectacle — ordered for the table and photographed before anyone touches it.

items.name: Titanium Alloy
items.description: Advanced hull plating material.

items.name: Titanium Foam
items.description: Lightweight titanium structure with internal voids. Excellent strength-to-weight.

items.name: Titanium Ingot
items.description: Purified titanium for advanced structural applications.

items.name: Titanium Ore
items.description: Lightweight and incredibly strong, prized for ship hulls.

items.name: Trace Exotic Element
items.description: Rare element distilled from nebula gases. Used in stimulant synthesis.

items.name: Tracking Computer I
items.description: Adds 10 points of weapon accuracy and offsets up to 15 points of accuracy penalty when the target's effective combat speed exceeds yours.

items.name: Tracking Computer II
items.description: Adds 20 points of weapon accuracy and offsets up to 30 points of accuracy penalty when the target's effective combat speed exceeds yours.

items.name: Tracking Computer III
items.description: Adds 35 points of weapon accuracy and offsets up to 50 points of accuracy penalty when the target's effective combat speed exceeds yours.

items.name: Tracking Mine Launcher
items.description: Deals 100 explosive damage from a 5-mine magazine; tracking adds 3 hit-chance points, capped at 95% total. On hit, also burns hull through shields and armor for 60 ticks at max(1, final hit damage / 60) per tick.

items.name: Tracking System
items.description: Target acquisition and tracking hardware.

items.name: Tractor Beam
items.description: Short-range tackle and towing beam that slows a target, disrupts warp, and stabilizes towed ships.

items.name: Trade Authenticator
items.description: Nebula trade ciphers embedded in copper-wire contact arrays. Provides tamper-proof transaction verification for high-value exchanges, and trades at the Grand Exchange as a bearer instrument pegged by the Federation Treasury.

items.name: Trade Cipher
items.description: Cryptographic verification chip refined from Haven trade crystals. Every exchange in the galaxy depends on these to authenticate transactions and set prices.

items.name: Trade Crystal
items.description: Rare crystalline formation used as currency backing in Nebula Federation space.

items.name: Tritium Ice
items.description: Radioactive hydrogen isotope ice for high-yield fusion.

items.name: Tritium Pearl
items.description: The rarest pearl a glacier-drifter grows — supercooled tritium locked in a frozen shell grown over years of slow accumulation. One per animal. One animal per decade of patient hunting.

items.name: Tungsten Nugget
items.description: A dense carbide bead precipitated inside a kiln-snail's gland, harder than the rock it came from. Already worked harder than any industrial press achieves — needs only to be drawn into rod stock.

items.name: Tungsten Ore
items.description: Extremely hard metal with the highest melting point of any element.

items.name: Tungsten Rod
items.description: Dense penetrator material for kinetic weapons.

items.name: Tungsten Slug Case
items.description: Heavy tungsten penetrators in a reinforced case. Punches through heavy armor plating.

items.name: Turtle Compound
items.description: +40% defense, -25% speed for 15 ticks. Positive temporary damage reductions share a 60% cap; the speed penalty still applies.

items.name: Umbral Residue
items.description: A blot of cold darkness left where an umbral-leech digested dark-matter residue. It drinks light, and laboratories drink it down just as fast.

items.name: Umbral Stout
items.description: A stout so dark with umbral-leech residue it seems to drink the light off the bar. Thick, roasty, and faintly unsettling to look at head-on. Nebula deep-runners age it in the hold for the long hauls.

items.name: Universal Nav Core
items.description: Nebula trade ciphers and Outer Rim dark matter integrated with circuit boards. Enables navigation across all known space without empire-specific transponder locks.

items.name: Uranium Concentrate
items.description: Yellowcake: crude uranium oxide extracted from ore. First step in the enrichment process.

items.name: Uranium Hexafluoride
items.description: UF6 gas: volatile uranium compound used in gaseous diffusion enrichment. Extremely hazardous.

items.name: Uranium Ore
items.description: Radioactive heavy metal for fission reactors and weapons.

items.name: Vanadium Ejector
items.description: When mining, prevents collection of vanadium ore into cargo. Use this to filter out vanadium while targeting rarer co-located resources. A tuned eddy-current separator catches the dense paramagnetic ore mid-stream and flings it clear of the intake. High power draw.

items.name: Vanadium Ore
items.description: Hard transition metal used in high-strength steel alloys.

items.name: Vat Protein Loaf
items.description: Vatflesh curd bound with sunspindle flour, spiced, and baked into a sliceable loaf. The honest workhorse of frontier canteens — cheap, filling, and genuinely decent once someone who cares gets hold of the cinderspice.

items.name: Vatflesh Curd
items.description: Cultured protein set into a firm pale curd. The frontier's answer to a butcher it doesn't have — bland alone, but it takes a marinade and a hot pan like nothing else, and no animal was inconvenienced.

items.name: Verdigris Curd
items.description: Blue-green copper paste scraped from a veil-ray's filtering combs. A ready feedstock for wiring and pigment.

items.name: Verdigris Kefir
items.description: A tangy cultured drink set from veil-ray verdigris curd, a faint copper-blue and sharper than it looks. Frontier medics push it on anyone whose gut has been living on ration blocks too long.

items.name: Void Cannon
items.description: Deals 75 void damage and ignores 50% of typed resistance. Fires every 3 ticks at reach 3.

items.name: Void Capacitor
items.description: Stores energy from void space dimensions.

items.name: Void-Charged Ichor
items.description: Black, faintly humming hemolymph drawn from a void-browser, saturated with the void-essence it chews from the deep fields. Only well-fed browsers in void-essence belts carry it. A key feedstock for pan-galactic alloy.

items.name: Void Condensate
items.description: Processed void essence in stable form.

items.name: Void Core Pack
items.description: Pack of standard void energy cores. One pack fully loads any void weapon magazine.

items.name: Void Crystal
items.description: Legendary material formed in the depths of space-time anomalies.

items.name: Void Dust
items.description: A fine iridescent powder derived from nebular gas processed through gutter flux. Inhaled or dissolved in liquid, it produces vivid hallucinations of drifting through open space. Highly addictive. Banned in all empire territories.

items.name: Void Espresso
items.description: Spore-mash coffee pulled short and dosed with void-charged ichor, so the crema glows and the caffeine hits like a jump drive. Deep-galaxy prospectors run on it. Nobody sleeps well, but the ore gets mined.

items.name: Void Essence
items.description: Crystallized vacuum energy harvested from spatial anomalies. Exclusive to Voidborn territory.

items.name: Void Hull Hardener
items.description: Reduces incoming void damage by 20% across shields, armor, and hull. Typed module resistances add and cap at 75%, then flat/adaptive reduction applies as the next damage stage.

items.name: Void Ichor
items.description: Viscous, faintly luminous hemolymph drawn from large void-dwelling predators. Volatile and energy-dense — it oxidizes on exposure and must be sealed in inert canisters or it degrades within hours.

items.name: Void-Ichor Consomme
items.description: A crystal-clear broth clarified with crystal-melt and laced with a thread of void ichor, so the whole bowl holds a faint blue glow you can read a menu by. Voidborn tasting rooms serve it in the dark, on purpose.

items.name: Void-Ichor Liqueur
items.description: Gloomshine cut with a measured dose of void ichor until the glass glows and the room goes quiet. Voidborn drink it neat; everyone else drinks it once. Sealed tight — it oxidises if you dawdle.

items.name: Void Lance I
items.description: Deals 55 void damage and ignores 50% of typed resistance. Fires every 3 ticks at reach 4.

items.name: Void Lance II
items.description: Deals 85 void damage and ignores 75% of typed resistance. Fires every 3 ticks at reach 4.

items.name: Void Laser
items.description: Deals 65 energy damage; 50% bypasses shields. Fires every 2 ticks at reach 5.

items.name: Void Mine Launcher
items.description: Deals 120 void damage from a 4-mine magazine and ignores 50% of typed resistance. On hit, also burns hull through shields and armor for 90 ticks at max(1, final hit damage / 90) per tick.

items.name: Void Mines
items.description: Creates a dimensional rift on detonation. Bypasses conventional shields.

items.name: Void Nanite Suspension
items.description: The Collective produces these in facilities it declines to describe using processes it refuses to classify. The output is called a suspension. Of what is not specified.

items.name: Void Reactor
items.description: Generates power from void energy.

items.name: Void Shield Hardener
items.description: Reduces incoming void damage by 25% across shields, armor, and hull. Typed module resistances add and cap at 75%, then flat/adaptive reduction applies as the next damage stage.

items.name: Void Shield Matrix
items.description: Voidborn null matter woven through Crimson fury alloy and crystal lattice. Creates a defensive barrier that absorbs both physical and dimensional attacks.

items.name: Void Torpedo Launcher
items.description: Deals 100 void damage and ignores 75% of typed resistance. Fires every 5 ticks at reach 6.

items.name: Void-Tuned EM Charge Pack
items.description: EM charges calibrated using void crystal harmonics. Bypasses conventional EM shielding.

items.name: Voidborn Neural Matrix
items.description: Quantum computing substrate grown in null-energy fields. For the Voidborn, these are art. For everyone else, they're the most powerful processors money can buy.

items.name: Voidborn Neural Soma
items.description: Not exactly food. Not exactly software. The Collective considers the distinction an oversimplification. It is consumed. That is all they will say.

items.name: Voidborn Null Matrix
items.description: Void energy focusing lattice. The mathematics describing its operation have no solution.

items.name: Voidborn Phase Armor
items.description: Adds 30 armor and 80 maximum hull points, and reduces enemy hit chance by 25%. Phase-dodge percentages add and cap at 75%.

items.name: Voidborn Phase Drive
items.description: Propulsion system that partially shifts the hull between dimensional states to reduce inertia.

items.name: Warhead Assembly
items.description: Explosive warhead core for missile fabrication.

items.name: Warp Core
items.description: Advanced faster-than-light propulsion core.

items.name: Warp Core Stabilizer
items.description: Resists warp disruption effects.

items.name: Warp Disruptor
items.description: Long-range warp prevention module.

items.name: Warp Scrambler
items.description: Prevents target from jumping to hyperspace.

items.name: Warp Stabilizer
items.description: Prevents warp disruption for 5 ticks.

items.name: Water Ice
items.description: Frozen water extracted from comets and ice moons. Essential for life support.

items.name: Water Recycler
items.description: Closed-loop water purification system.

items.name: Weapon Battery
items.description: Hardened weapon platform housing multiple firing mechanisms with shared targeting.

items.name: Weapon Core
items.description: Central power and control unit for weapon systems.

items.name: Weapon Housing
items.description: Mounting bracket and power conduit for weapons.

items.name: Weapon Overload Capacitor
items.description: Increases weapon damage by 20% for 5 ticks. Positive consumable weapon-damage bonuses share a 30% cap.

items.name: Weapons-Grade Plutonium
items.description: Refined fissile material for warheads and advanced reactors.

items.name: Whale Baleen
items.description: A curved plate of living keratin from a Cloudwhale's filter-mouth — meters long, lighter than steel and tougher than it has any right to be. The whale grows them as armor as much as a sieve; shipwrights cut them down into capital-grade plating that no foundry can match for weight.

items.name: Whale Blubber
items.description: Thick oil-rich fat rendered from cloud-grazing whales. Cheaper cousin to the industrial whale-oil trade — but rendered slow in a galley it's the backbone of every good chowder and confit from here to the Rim.

items.name: Whale-Blubber Confit
items.description: Grazer meat cooked down slow and sealed under rendered whale blubber, spiced and left to keep. Half a preserve, half a delicacy — the flavour a dock cook builds a reputation on.

items.name: Whale Oil
items.description: Energy-dense blubber oil flensed from a pilot-whale pod — thick, slow-burning, and packed with the charge the whales strain out of the argon banks. The staple of every cloud-whaling crew: render it down and it sets straight into power cells, the living counterpart to the argon synthesis line.

items.name: Whale-Oil Grog
items.description: Rough gloomshine, honeyglobe, and a controversial float of whale oil, served hot. Cloud-whaling crews swear it keeps the cold out; landlubbers swear at it. An acquired everything.

items.name: Wiring Harness
items.description: Pre-assembled electrical wiring bundle for ship systems.

items.name: Xenon Gas
items.description: Noble gas used in advanced ion thrusters and lighting.

items.name: Zinc Ingot
items.description: Refined zinc for corrosion-resistant coatings and alloy production.

items.name: Zinc Ore
items.description: Corrosion-resistant metal for protective coatings.

facilities.name: Abyss Solidification Engine
facilities.description: State-of-the-art facility with fully distributed plasma injection arrays and redundant coolant circulation systems. Advanced control nodes coordinate precise timing across multiple crystallization chambers, achieving production rates previously impossible.

facilities.name: Acceleration Manufacturing Plant
facilities.description: A heavily automated industrial complex with quantum control cores and precision optics for optimal engine tuning, enabling rapid production of advanced afterburner systems.

facilities.name: Accelerator Assembly Plant
facilities.description: An expanded facility with dedicated superconductor-winding stations and automated barrel-assembly. Structural frames support multiple parallel production streams, each with independent targeting-computer calibration.

facilities.name: Acid Bath Vat
facilities.description: A chemical processing line with corrosion-resistant liners that concentrates fluorine gas and combines it with ceramite plating to produce etching-grade hydrofluoric solution.

facilities.name: Acid-Treated Munitions Factory
facilities.description: Heavy-duty production complex with extensive coolant circulation and reinforced frame architecture to handle sustained high-temperature corrosive chemistry. Multiple reaction chambers work in parallel to achieve industrial-scale output.

facilities.name: Acquisition Systems Plant
facilities.description: Efficient multi-stage facility with dedicated sensor-array preparation, crystal-alignment workstations, and circuit-board integration steps, followed by comprehensive targeting-accuracy validation and performance logging.

facilities.name: Adamant Tooth Furnace
facilities.description: A high-pressure furnace built to melt the hardest teeth in the galaxy into adamantite bar.

facilities.name: Adaptive Armor Production Complex
facilities.description: Cutting-edge facility featuring coolant loops for thermal management during sensor calibration, quantum control cores orchestrating dynamic resistance shifting, and fully automated layer integration. Produces responsive armor systems with maximum defensive adaptability.

facilities.name: Adaptive Defense Lab
facilities.description: An expanded assembly plant with structural reinforcement and additional shield matrix components, allowing faster integration of adaptive components. Enhanced quality control accelerates shield tuning cycles.

facilities.name: Adaptive Shield Assembly Line
facilities.description: A precision manufacturing facility that integrates shield emitters, sensors, and metamaterial panels into adaptive defense systems. Careful alignment and calibration ensure each unit learns and responds to incoming threats.

facilities.name: Adaptive Shield Factory
facilities.description: A large-scale industrial complex with cryogenic cooling loops and quantum control cores supporting rapid assembly of high-tier shield configurations at near-continuous rates.

facilities.name: Adaptive Shield Lab
facilities.description: An expanded facility with structural reinforcement and improved component staging for quantum matrix assembly. Accelerates integration of processing cores and refined quantum matrices into adaptive systems.

facilities.name: Advanced Airframe Factory
facilities.description: State-of-the-art facility featuring robotic assembly arms, in-line testing, and predictive maintenance systems that achieve near-continuous chassis output.

facilities.name: Advanced Armor Manufacturing Plant
facilities.description: Large-scale fabrication complex with dedicated cooling loops and multi-stage composite lamination. Processes fury alloys and siege plating in parallel, reducing cycle time to 13 minutes through coordinated assembly.

facilities.name: Advanced Armor Plant
facilities.description: A larger facility with multiple processing zones for nanite suspension, graphene weaving, and biofiber integration. Quantum control nodes manage the stabilization of exotic matter within the armor matrix.

facilities.name: Advanced Armor Response Plant
facilities.description: Industrial production with quantum control cores enabling real-time resistance optimization and coolant loops dissipating heat from rapid response cycles. Reinforced frames support the precision machinery needed for high-throughput adaptive armor assembly.

facilities.name: Advanced Atmospheric Systems Factory
facilities.description: State-of-the-art production facility with cascading processing cores, array of precision optics, and quantum control coordination enabling rapid, precision assembly of air recycler units.

facilities.name: Advanced Autonomous Defense Platform
facilities.description: A state-of-the-art fabrication facility where quantum cores orchestrate every micro-step of weapon core integration, barrel assembly, and fire-control calibration. Thousands of processing cores and precision optics ensure each turret meets combat readiness standards instantly upon completion.

facilities.name: Advanced Autopilot Facility
facilities.description: Heavy-duty industrial plant equipped with quantum control cores and precision optics for high-fidelity sensor integration. Reinforced frames support the increased complexity and speed of mass-producing advanced autopilot cores.

facilities.name: Advanced Barrel Manufacturing
facilities.description: Multi-spindle machining facility with sensor arrays and processing cores for rapid production of precision barrels from tungsten and titanium stock. Quantum control systems manage tool paths and surface finish quality.

facilities.name: Advanced Battery Complex
facilities.description: A state-of-the-art facility where quantum control cores manage multi-stage electrical integration, from battery alignment through final circuit board embedding and capacity certification. Thousands of processing cores and precision optics ensure every cell meets peak energy density and safety specifications.

facilities.name: Advanced Bay Integration Works
facilities.description: Precision-focused facility using quantum control cores and multi-sensor calibration to assemble high-performance cargo bay kits. Automated optical alignment and rapid modular testing reduce defects and cycle time.

facilities.name: Advanced Beam Assembly Line
facilities.description: Specialized production line for advanced beam weapons, handling dual laser focus arrays and optical fiber bundling with precision barrel machining. Complex crystal arrangement and multi-stage power cell integration require dedicated control infrastructure.

facilities.name: Advanced Biotech Production Center
facilities.description: State-of-the-art facility with extensive atmospheric and life support networks, precision environmental monitoring, and redundant systems ensuring maximum culture viability and throughput. Comprehensive containment and recycling enable continuous operation.

facilities.name: Advanced Breeder Array
facilities.description: State-of-the-art reactor facility with comprehensive lead shielding architecture, radiation-hardened control systems, hazmat container arrays, and cryogenic cooling loops. Achieves rapid isotope breeding via optimized neutron economy and thermal dissipation.

facilities.name: Advanced Capital Repair System Factory
facilities.description: Cutting-edge automated production with cryogenic cooling loops and quantum-synchronized assembly stations. Crystalline lattice integration occurs in isolated precision chambers; final units undergo automated validation before release.

facilities.name: Advanced Carbon Fabrication System
facilities.description: State-of-the-art facility featuring precision plasma injection, redundant coolant networks, and quantum-controlled feed systems for near-instantaneous composite weaving at industrial scale.

facilities.name: Advanced Cargo Matrix Production Factory
facilities.description: State-of-the-art fully automated facility with tripled hull plating throughput and extensive docking infrastructure. Delivers prism-lens enhanced storage systems at maximum speed through continuous photonic-sorting assembly.

facilities.name: Advanced Cargo Shielding Complex
facilities.description: Cutting-edge automated plant with extensive coolant loops maintaining precision during lead layering and ceramite integration. Reinforced structural systems enable rapid cycling while maintaining containment integrity.

facilities.name: Advanced Centrifuge Complex
facilities.description: Fully automated facility with redundant conversion stages, cryogenic cooling loops, and integrated hazmat containment achieving rapid, consistent output of low-enriched uranium fuel.

facilities.name: Advanced Chip Manufacturing Plant
facilities.description: Industrial-scale semiconductor fabrication with integrated coolant circulation, reinforced frames for chemical resistance, and automated gold ore refining. Produces overclock chips with enhanced speed and reliability.

facilities.name: Advanced Combat Analysis Factory
facilities.description: Industrial-scale production with parallel circuit assembly, quantum control core integration, and precision optic installation. Sensor arrays and processing cores work in tandem to deliver sophisticated threat detection and prioritization.

facilities.name: Advanced Command Module Factory
facilities.description: Fully automated production environment with robotic module assembly, AI core verification systems, and integrated testing that delivers command hubs at maximum throughput.

facilities.name: Advanced Communications Works
facilities.description: Cutting-edge facility with extensive precision optics arrays and quantum control logic ensuring signal integrity across production runs. Heavy reinforced framing and multiple processing core stations support simultaneous high-fidelity array assembly.

facilities.name: Advanced Composite Works
facilities.description: Industrial-scale manufacturing with quantum control cores managing material alignment and reinforced framing supporting heavy lamination equipment. Coolant loops prevent thermal degradation during high-speed weaving cycles.

facilities.name: Advanced Compression Array
facilities.description: Cutting-edge fully automated factory with advanced quantum control systems and precision optical alignment arrays. Delivers advanced gas harvesters with superior containment at maximum capacity.

facilities.name: Advanced Concealment Plant
facilities.description: An industrial-scale facility where quantum control cores manage the assembly of phase arrays, exotic crystals, and refined quantum matrices into cutting-edge stealth generators. Coolant loops regulate quantum field interactions, and extensive shield matrices enable superior cloaking performance.

facilities.name: Advanced Containment Complex
facilities.description: Fully automated production plant combining quantum control systems, multi-sensor inspection arrays, and optical verification for defect-free hazmat containers. Achieves maximum throughput while maintaining strict containment specifications.

facilities.name: Advanced Copper Processing Complex
facilities.description: State-of-the-art automated refinery combining intensive plasma treatment, distributed heat dissipation, and real-time control feedback to achieve near-instantaneous wire output at maximum yield.

facilities.name: Advanced Corrosion Systems
facilities.description: State-of-the-art facility with redundant coolant systems and precision control nodes managing every stage of synthesis. Reinforced construction throughout enables rapid, continuous generation of chemically enhanced plasma cells.

facilities.name: Advanced Cryo-Manufacturing Plant
facilities.description: Large-scale facility with robust structural framing and expanded ion-solution handling for complex harvester assembly. Integrated thermal management and superconductor integration enable reliable capital-module production.

facilities.name: Advanced Cryogenic Fabrication
facilities.description: A state-of-the-art facility with quantum control cores orchestrating every assembly stage, from component machining to final hermetic sealing. Thousands of precision optics and processing cores work in concert for maximum throughput and zero thermal degradation.

facilities.name: Advanced Cryogenic Hub
facilities.description: State-of-the-art facility with fully automated material handling, quantum-core logic integration, precision-optic verification, and real-time performance testing delivering maximum ice-harvester throughput.

facilities.name: Advanced Cryogenic Neon Separator
facilities.description: Cutting-edge facility with quantum control cores fine-tuning supercooled separation chambers and automated vapor routing. Precision optics and extensive sensor arrays enable continuous optimization of condensation efficiency and vent throughput.

facilities.name: Advanced Cryogenic Works
facilities.description: Cutting-edge facility with extensive reinforced construction supporting maximum-pressure helium-3 and liquid nitrogen blending. Simultaneous multi-stream copper piping integration and thermal-seal verification at peak efficiency for mission-critical cooling systems.

facilities.name: Advanced Crystal Fabrication Plant
facilities.description: Industrial-scale facility with redundant plasma injectors, precision coolant loops, and automated quality verification. Produces focused crystals with superior light transmission and minimal internal stress.

facilities.name: Advanced Culinary Module Production
facilities.description: State-of-the-art facility with quantum-controlled alignment, distributed processing cores, and precision optic inspection throughout. Reinforced infrastructure and advanced material handling achieve 33-second galley cycles.

facilities.name: Advanced Darksteel Armor Complex
facilities.description: State-of-the-art facility with quantum-precision control, advanced coolant management, and shield emitter integration for protective testing. Produces elite darksteel armor with superior structural integrity and minimal defect rates.

facilities.name: Advanced Detection Systems Works
facilities.description: Industrial production complex integrating quantum-controlled sensor calibration, precision-optic alignment, and multi-stage processing-core validation. Reinforced frames and quantum cores orchestrate six-minute assembly cycles with high dimensional accuracy.

facilities.name: Advanced Dimensional Anchor Fabrication
facilities.description: A heavy industrial complex employing reinforced frames, quantum control cores, and dedicated dark-matter processing zones. Gravity generators and shield emitters are integrated with precision timing to lock dimensional coherence.

facilities.name: Advanced Disruption Arsenal
facilities.description: Heavy-duty production complex with quantum control cores managing superconductor insertion and circuit board integration into ballistic assemblies. Targeting computer arrays calibrate each round's electrical discharge profile.

facilities.name: Advanced Drone Bay Facility
facilities.description: State-of-the-art automated plant with triple the drone-chassis throughput and parallel AI-core calibration lines. Reinforced structural systems and advanced control logic ensure flawless deployment synchronization.

facilities.name: Advanced Drone Integration Lab
facilities.description: An expanded facility with multiple assembly lines and enhanced control node integration, doubling production speed while maintaining precision in drone AI core installation.

facilities.name: Advanced Drone Module Fabrication Complex
facilities.description: Fully automated facility completing drone bay modules in 17 seconds through synchronized titanium alloy welding, chassis integration, and AI-core installation. Reinforced frames and processing cores ensure every module meets operational readiness standards.

facilities.name: Advanced Electromagnetic Refinery Production
facilities.description: State-of-the-art manufacturing system with quantum control cores managing superconductor integration, precision optics guiding durasteel assembly, and reinforced frames throughout. Optimized material flow achieves 33-second production cycles.

facilities.name: Advanced Electronics Fabrication Complex
facilities.description: Cutting-edge facility combining multi-point plasma injection, comprehensive coolant circulation, and precision heat management to achieve near-instantaneous circuit layer bonding. Produces defect-free boards at maximum industrial output.

facilities.name: Advanced EM Charge Manufacturing
facilities.description: State-of-the-art facility with precision quantum control and extensive coolant circulation for superconductor stability. Fully automated targeting computer networks and weapon housing assembly deliver consistent, high-volume EM charge production.

facilities.name: Advanced Energy Storage Facility
facilities.description: Cutting-edge production system with autonomous energy crystal verification, quantum-precision assembly, and integrated performance testing. Processes silver wiring and precision optics at industrial scale for maximum energy density.

facilities.name: Advanced Exotic Matter Fabrication
facilities.description: A cutting-edge synthesis plant where quantum cores manage femtosecond-scale dark matter stabilization and superconductor alignment, supported by massive coolant circulation arrays and distributed plasma injection. Each cell emerges fully charged and verified for exotic propulsion applications.

facilities.name: Advanced Expander Assembly Line
facilities.description: Specialized production line combining base expander units with titanium alloy reinforcement, flex polymer upgrades, and circuit board integration. Precision fixtures and staged assembly ensure proper component alignment.

facilities.name: Advanced Flak Fabrication
facilities.description: Larger facility with dedicated stations for durasteel forming, multi-sensor integration, and circuit board assembly. Structural support and increased control capacity enable faster throughput without compromising the refined targeting precision these systems demand.

facilities.name: Advanced Frame Assembly Plant
facilities.description: A larger facility with expanded bonding chambers and improved coolant management for handling the thermal stress of composite material fusion. Produces reinforced frames at higher throughput for demanding production environments.

facilities.name: Advanced Fuel Extraction Complex
facilities.description: State-of-the-art fully automated facility with redundant plasma injection systems and distributed coolant circulation. Multiple extraction chambers operate in synchronized sequence, achieving near-instantaneous fuel reserve production.

facilities.name: Advanced Graviton Assembly Line
facilities.description: A purpose-built facility for constructing advanced gravity weapons, featuring barrel assembly stations, metamaterial panel integration, and superconductor handling equipment. Precision control systems ensure stable assembly of these complex immobilization systems.

facilities.name: Advanced Heavy Reactor Complex
facilities.description: Cutting-edge manufacturing complex with extensive coolant-loop infrastructure managing heat during extended assembly, quantum-controlled fuel-stack precision, and comprehensive hazmat containment. Radiation-hardened circuits undergo full integration testing while automated systems validate the complete reactor assembly before final delivery.

facilities.name: Advanced Hospitality Module Production
facilities.description: State-of-the-art facility with quantum-controlled alignment, distributed processing cores, and precision optic inspection throughout. Reinforced infrastructure and advanced material handling achieve 33-second lounge cycles.

facilities.name: Advanced Hull Reinforcement Factory
facilities.description: State-of-the-art facility with fully automated material handling, real-time quantum-core feedback control, and redundant coolant loops managing thermal stress during high-speed bonding cycles. Produces reinforced bracing at maximum throughput.

facilities.name: Advanced Incendiary Manufacturing Line
facilities.description: Industrial-scale production system with specialized weapon housings, targeting-computer-assisted alignment, and reinforced frame construction for rapid assembly and consistent thermal performance in finished rounds.

facilities.name: Advanced Ion Factory
facilities.description: Precision industrial plant with quantum control cores, targeting-computer assembly, and dual-emitter alignment chambers operating in series for rapid, high-fidelity weapon production.

facilities.name: Advanced Isotope Complex

facilities.name: Barrier Amplification Plant
facilities.description: Industrial production center equipped with quantum control cores and coolant loops to manage the precision calibration of high-performance booster assemblies. Reinforced construction supports continuous high-speed production.

facilities.name: Barrier Manufacturing
facilities.description: Quantum-controlled assembly with active coolant circulation to maintain crystal lattice integrity during superconductor bonding, achieving microsecond-level precision at high volume.

facilities.name: Battery Bank
facilities.description: A rack of industrial capacitors and chemical cells wired across the station's power bus. Absorbs whatever the reactor is making but nobody is drawing, gives it back when production cycles all line up at once.
facilities.satisfied_description: Cell status lights show a steady green. The bus reads stable through the spikes — capacitors charging during the quiet ticks, sourcing back when the foundry and the refinery both fire on the same beat.
facilities.degraded_description: The cells are cold and the bus is reading raw plant output. Every coincident production cycle drops voltage, and the engineering log is a stream of brownout flags.

facilities.name: Battery Cell Plant
facilities.description: A heavily mechanized plant where quantum-controlled assembly arms route copper wiring with nanometer precision and laser-weld circuit connections. Precision optics verify insulation integrity and electrical isolation throughout the fabrication cycle.

facilities.name: Beacon Fabrication Plant
facilities.description: A larger facility with dedicated superconductor integration and power-cell charging stations, running coolant loops to manage thermal load from precision electronics. Output triples compared to the assembly line.

facilities.name: Beam Assembly Line
facilities.description: Dedicated weapon production line for focused beam systems, integrating crystal alignment, barrel precision machining, and circuit assembly. Control nodes orchestrate focused crystal focusing and power cell integration.

facilities.name: Beam Fabrication Plant
facilities.description: Industrial production facility with reinforced barrel-boring machinery and quantum targeting systems for enhanced precision. Focused crystals are integrated via automated positioning arms, cutting cycle time dramatically.

facilities.name: Beam Weapons Factory
facilities.description: Industrial-scale weapons production facility featuring quantum-grade targeting computers and precision-machined barrel assemblies. Automated systems assemble complex multi-emitter arrays with microsecond synchronization.

facilities.name: Bell-Jelly Bubbly Bar
facilities.description: An aeration cellar for featherlight sparkling wine.

facilities.name: Belt-Grazer Wellington Galley
facilities.description: Pastry benches and convection ovens for the frontier showpiece.

facilities.name: Beltwheel Creamery
facilities.description: Culture vats and a wheel press for setting grazer milk into rinded beltwheel cheese. Smells like a dairy the moment the doors open.

facilities.name: Berserker Fabrication Lab
facilities.description: Advanced production complex with dedicated plasma-core handling and neural-extract integration chambers. Reduced cycle time to 4 minutes through parallel preparation and assembly workflows.

facilities.name: Berserker Forge
facilities.description: Expanded plant with dedicated coolant loops and reinforced structural frames to handle the exotic material reactions. Multiple synthesis chambers run in sequence, each precisely timed to merge the neural and chemical components without losing potency.

facilities.name: Bespoke Dining Hall Production Facility
facilities.description: State-of-the-art facility with quantum-controlled alignment, distributed processing cores, and precision optic inspection throughout. Reinforced infrastructure and advanced material handling achieve 33-second dining-deck cycles.

facilities.name: Bespoke Observation Deck Production
facilities.description: State-of-the-art facility with quantum-controlled alignment, distributed processing cores, and precision optic inspection throughout. Reinforced infrastructure and advanced material handling achieve 33-second observation-deck cycles.

facilities.name: Bespoke Stateroom Production Facility
facilities.description: Cutting-edge automated plant deploying quantum systems and precision optics for real-time environmental tuning and display calibration. Full coolant circulation and maximum processing throughput ensure consistent delivery of the empires' most coveted accommodations.

facilities.name: Bio-Loom
facilities.description: A compact biological production system where bioactive compounds and nanoplastics are synthesized into living mesh. Atmospheric circulation and basic life support maintain optimal growth conditions for the synthetic material.

facilities.name: Bio-Polymer Bioreactor
facilities.description: Expanded facility with atmospheric units and air recyclers that create stable culture conditions for continuous polymer synthesis. Multiple reaction vessels cycle through hydration and linking stages to produce consistent flex polymer output.

facilities.name: Bio-Polymer Biorefinery
facilities.description: Large-scale production facility with extensive life support and atmospheric management systems maintaining optimal conditions for rapid polymerization. Reinforced frames support the bioreactor cores while air recyclers and atmospheric units cycle continuously to preserve reaction fidelity.

facilities.name: Bio-Polymer Complex
facilities.description: State-of-the-art bioreactor array with redundant life support, atmospheric, and air recycling systems ensuring near-instantaneous polymer generation. Reinforced architecture supports multiple simultaneous synthesis pathways with autonomous control over every environmental variable.

facilities.name: Bio-Polymer Synthesizer
facilities.description: Industrial bioreactor that processes synthetic compounds and purified water into flexible polymer chains. Atmospheric units maintain the controlled environment needed for proper polymerization without contamination.

facilities.name: Bio-Regeneration Laboratory
facilities.description: Mid-scale facility with expanded shield systems and structural framing to handle higher bioactive compound throughput. Coolant circulation begins at this tier to manage the metabolic demands of cultured bio-layers.

facilities.name: Biocompound Factory
facilities.description: Industrial-scale biomanufacturing plant running parallel fermentation vessels with integrated life-support systems, atmospheric management, and continuous extraction pipelines.

facilities.name: Bioculture Vat
facilities.description: A controlled biological production vessel where fermentation cultures are cultivated with purified water in sealed, temperature-regulated chambers to produce synthetic organic compounds.

facilities.name: Biofiber Assembly Plant
facilities.description: An expanded facility with parallel assembly tracks and quantum control integration. Shield emitter arrays are precision-mounted and tested in real-time before final nanite encapsulation.

facilities.name: Biofiber Culture Chamber
facilities.description: Compact production facility cultivating biofiber mesh and bioactive compounds into living hull coatings. Shield emitters and life-support integration ensure the organic cultures remain viable during assembly.

facilities.name: Biofiber Loom
facilities.description: An industrial bioreactor with multiple growth chambers and enhanced atmospheric recycling. Improved climate control and air management accelerate the weaving process while maintaining material integrity.

facilities.name: Biogas Cracker
facilities.description: A decompression rig that cracks crystallized bio-gas into standard fuel cells. Turns sift-ray harvests into the fuel every ship needs.

facilities.name: Biogas Distillation Plant
facilities.description: A staged distillation column with cryo-separation that wrings far more fuel out of each canister of crystallized bio-gas. A serious fuel supplier for a hunting frontier.

facilities.name: Biogas Fizz Bar
facilities.description: Carbonation rigs charging crystal-melt water with crystallized biogas.

facilities.name: Bioluminescent Production Greenhouse
facilities.description: Industrial-scale cultivation facility with multiple atmospheric zones, advanced life support integration, and reinforced frames to support high-density growing beds. Optimized gas exchange and temperature regulation enable rapid biomass generation.

facilities.name: Bionanite Synthesis Hub
facilities.description: State-of-the-art facility with fully automated material handling, cryogenic cooling systems, and quantum control core synchronization. Shield emitter matrices are assembled and tested in isolated chambers before integration into complete repair systems.

facilities.name: Bioreactor Array
facilities.description: An enhanced biorefinery with atmospheric control and air recycling systems to maintain sterile conditions during cell synthesis. Improved growth chambers reduce processing time significantly.

facilities.name: Bioregeneration Plant
facilities.description: An expanded facility with multiple parallel reaction vessels and enhanced coolant circulation to maintain sterile synthesis conditions. Increased throughput via redundant processing loops and improved reagent handling.

facilities.name: Biosphere Module
facilities.description: Self-sustaining environmental system with hydroponic gardens and atmospheric synthesis.
facilities.satisfied_description: Hydroponic gardens flourish under full-spectrum lighting. The air smells of green growing things — a rare luxury in space.
facilities.degraded_description: But lately, gardens wilt under failing grow-lights. Atmospheric synthesis struggles to compensate, and the air grows thin and stale.

facilities.name: Biosphere Regulation Complex
facilities.description: Industrial-scale production with quantum control cores managing precision recycling-loop calibration. Parallel processing-core and sensor-array stations work in tandem; precision optics ensure filtration accuracy.

facilities.name: Biosphere Ring
facilities.description: Comprehensive environmental management for a larger population — sensors, filtration, the works.
facilities.satisfied_description: Environmental sensors read green across every zone. Air and water purity are well past safety margins.
facilities.degraded_description: Sensor arrays flash yellow. Air quality is slipping in several zones, and filtration membranes need replacing.

facilities.name: Bipropellant Fuel Complex
facilities.description: Precision industrial plant with coolant-loop temperature management and distributed plasma conditioning, enabling faster reaction kinetics and higher-purity fuel reserve output.

facilities.name: Blood Reaver Forge
facilities.description: Industrial-scale facility running reinforced frames and quantum control cores to manage precision assembly of high-performance weapons. Targeting computers are integrated and calibrated; coolant loops ensure thermal stability during production testing.

facilities.name: Blood Reaver Foundry
facilities.description: State-of-the-art production plant with quantum control and precision optics achieving near-minute cycle times for complex Blood Reaver weapons. Coolant loop systems maintain operating temperature while automated targeting verification runs continuously.

facilities.name: Blood Reaver Workshop
facilities.description: Larger plant with structural framing that accelerates alloy processing and barrel assembly. Multiple stations work in sequence to integrate weapon cores, housings, and heat management systems.

facilities.name: Blubber Rendery
facilities.description: A flensing hall and try-pot line that renders pilot-whale oil down into power cells in bulk — the working heart of any cloud-whaling station.

facilities.name: Boarding Clamp Works
facilities.description: A pressure-rated assembly works for magnetic collars, transfer tubes, breaching seals, and synchronized docking controls.

facilities.name: Bootleg Cell Shop
facilities.description: A repackaging line that strips copper wiring and wraps it around plasma canisters to crank out hot cells. The heat sinks are the only thing standing between you and a casing rupture. Restricted to pirate strongholds.

facilities.name: Bootleg Distillery
facilities.description: Racks of copper coils feeding off climate-controlled fermentation tanks, with water recyclers reclaiming every drop of melt. Still technically a beverage operation. Technically.

facilities.name: Bootleg Powercell Foundry
facilities.description: A fully automated foundry mass-producing hot cells from salvaged plasma stock, with quantum control metering the charge and coolant networks holding the line against the heat. The casings mostly hold. Mostly is good enough at this volume.

facilities.name: Bounty Office
facilities.description: Staffed bounty office with escrow services and contractor vetting. The kind of place serious operators check first.

facilities.name: Breacher Torpedo Bay
facilities.description: A specialized weapons line that fuses durasteel plating, warhead assemblies, and tungsten into armor-piercing torpedoes. Basic weapon housing and barrel integration under automated control.

facilities.name: Breacher Torpedo Complex
facilities.description: Cutting-edge weapons facility with extensive targeting computer arrays and coolant circulation managing the thermal stress of high-speed warhead assembly. Reinforced framing supports simultaneous multi-stream production of armor-piercing warheads at maximum velocity.

facilities.name: Breacher Torpedo Plant
facilities.description: Expanded facility with dedicated weapon housing and barrel assembly stations. Quantum control cores manage precision warhead sequencing and penetrator alignment for consistent armor penetration.

facilities.name: Breacher Torpedo Works
facilities.description: Heavy-duty production complex with targeting computers guiding warhead orientation and durasteel shaping. Multiple barrel assembly lines run in parallel, each monitored by quantum control logic.

facilities.name: Breeder Reactor Core
facilities.description: A shielded fission reactor chamber where thorium and reactor fuel assemblies are bred into plutonium through controlled neutron flux. Lead-lined and isolated for safe isotope production.

facilities.name: Brine Coolant Processor
facilities.description: A gentle-heat evaporation column that distils hollow pilgrim water crystals into industrial coolant fluid. The pilgrim handles filtration; this plant handles thermal conditioning.

facilities.name: Brokerage
facilities.description: A full-service brokerage suite with dedicated exchange lines, algorithmic order routing, and fee structures that would make a station manager weep. The market moves around you.
facilities.satisfied_description: Algorithmic routing finds the best fills, dedicated lines bypass the public exchange, and your fees are a rounding error. Market dominance, quietly achieved.
facilities.degraded_description: The algorithmic routing is stale and the dedicated lines share bandwidth with cargo manifests. Still the best trading setup on the station.

facilities.name: Buffer Array
facilities.description: Expanded battery storage with load balancing — smooths out wider production spikes than a basic bank can absorb.
facilities.satisfied_description: Load balancers feed the bus in real time. Even simultaneous production cycles ride through without a flicker.
facilities.degraded_description: Load balancing is offline and the cells are out of spec. The bus sags whenever more than one facility fires at once.

facilities.name: Bulk Container Works
facilities.description: Industrial-scale hopper factory with precision optics for sensor calibration and quantum-controlled assembly stations. Advanced automation streamlines fabrication of transport containers.

facilities.name: Bulk Storage Manufacturing Hub
facilities.description: Industrial complex running multiple coordinated assembly lines with automated material feeding and precision quality gates. Advanced polymer bonding and rapid curing systems maximize production rate.

facilities.name: Bulkhead Framing Station
facilities.description: Specialized assembly facility that laminates hull plating with armor plate and titanium alloy to create heavy structural frames capable of distributing stress across multiple hull sections. Steel and copper components form the basic framework for load-bearing assembly.

facilities.name: Bulkhead Manufacturing Works
facilities.description: Industrial-grade facility featuring reinforced structural framing, docking rings for automated material staging, and precision pressure systems that bond hull sections and armor plates into integrated bulkheads at scale. Advanced control systems maintain tolerance across multiple simultaneous production lines.

facilities.name: Bullet Press
facilities.description: A compact automated system that feeds steel stock through stamping and assembly stations, forming and loading basic kinetic rounds into standard crates. Copper piping carries compressed air for actuation and ejection.

facilities.name: Bulwark Plating
facilities.description: Capital-grade belt armor, of the kind normally reserved for things that are expected to be shot at by other capital ships. Bolting it to a station is an enormous, ostentatious statement about how the next raid is expected to go.
facilities.satisfied_description: The belt is intact. Small-calibre fire is not registering as damage so much as weather.
facilities.degraded_description: The belt is holed and unpatched. Capital armor with no capital armor to repair it is just a very heavy hull.

facilities.name: Bunker-Fed Reactor
facilities.description: A fusion plant plumbed straight into the station's own fuel tank instead of running on stockpiled fuel cells. Nothing to restock — it just draws on the same reserve that fuels your ships, though it burns through that tank a bit faster than a fuel-cell plant would for the same output.
facilities.satisfied_description: The reactor draws steady and quiet straight from the tank. No fuel cells to haul in, no cells to run short of — just keep the bunker full.
facilities.degraded_description: The tank's running dry and the reactor's throttling back with it. Whatever's fueling your ships is fueling this too, and there isn't enough for both.

facilities.name: Capacitor Array
facilities.description: A high-density capacitor bank and cryogenic cell array. Carries enough charge to ride out coincident burst loads across the entire industrial deck.
facilities.satisfied_description: Cryogenics hold the array at operating temperature; charge readouts run within tolerance through the worst production beats. The grid sees the reactor as if it were producing whatever the station happens to need that tick.
facilities.degraded_description: Cryogenics have failed and the array is venting heat into the maintenance corridors. Capacity has collapsed and the bus is back to raw plant output — every coincident cycle drops voltage.

facilities.name: Capacitor Assembly Plant
facilities.description: Expanded production plant with automated weapon-housing alignment and multi-station control-node installation. Throughput increased to one cannon per 2 minutes.

facilities.name: Capacitor Bank
facilities.description: A rack of industrial capacitors wired across the power bus — absorbs surplus output and gives it back when several facilities fire on the same cycle.
facilities.satisfied_description: Cell status lights read a steady green. The bus stays stable through the spikes.
facilities.degraded_description: The cells are cold and the bus is reading raw plant output. Coincident production cycles drop voltage across the board.

facilities.name: Capacitor Charging Assembly
facilities.description: A purpose-built station that combines power cells and refined plasma cores into high-capacity energy storage units. Steel and copper construction handles the electrical loads of plasma-core integration.

facilities.name: Capacitor Weapons Forge
facilities.description: Cutting-edge facility with integrated cryogenic systems, quantum-calibrated emitter staging, and full-automation targeting-computer integration, achieving 30-second cycle times for top-tier ion cannons.

facilities.name: Capacitor Workshop
facilities.description: A specialized production line handling dual ion emitters and superconductor integration, with dedicated power-cell insertion and weapon-housing staging for improved ion weapons.

facilities.name: Capacity Enhancement Facility
facilities.description: Mid-scale facility with improved material handling, multi-stage bonding stations, and automated polymer curing ovens. Increased throughput via parallel assembly tracks and streamlined component staging.

facilities.name: Capital Booster Assembly
facilities.description: A precision production line integrating dual emitters, superconductors, crystals, power cells, and quantum matrix components into capital-grade enhancement systems. Extensive control node infrastructure ensures stability during assembly.

facilities.name: Capital Booster Manufacturing
facilities.description: Significantly expanded facility with structural frame reinforcement and substantial component capacity for handling capital-tier specifications. Multiple assembly stages process the refined quantum matrix and superconductor integration in parallel.

facilities.name: Capital Cargo Shielding Complex
facilities.description: State-of-the-art automated plant with four times the coolant-loop capacity, enabling rapid titanium bonding and multi-layer lead sealing without compromise. Reinforced structural backbone supports simultaneous processing of multiple cargo bays.

facilities.name: Capital Cryo-Fabrication Megaworks
facilities.description: Fully automated, state-of-the-art facility with redundant quantum control cores and precision optics for maximum capital-module throughput. Advanced cryo-systems and superconductor integration achieve near-continuous production cycles.

facilities.name: Capital Cryo-Processing Line
facilities.description: Heavy-duty cryogenic extraction system designed for capital-grade equipment assembly. Features enhanced coolant circulation and specialized krypton purification to handle exotic material inputs.

facilities.name: Capital Enhancement Production Complex
facilities.description: State-of-the-art manufacturing facility with advanced quantum control systems, comprehensive coolant networks, and specialized quantum matrix integration chambers. Produces capital-grade booster systems with full automated precision and maximum throughput.

facilities.name: Capital Frame Assembly Line
facilities.description: Purpose-built production line for assembling major structural components into capital-class frames. Handles hull plating, bulkheads, and durasteel integration with hydraulic press stations and precision alignment systems.

facilities.name: Capital Fuel Bunker
facilities.description: Massive underground fuel reservoir with multi-redundant containment, automated distribution rails, and real-time telemetry. Capacity to service entire fleets without interruption.
facilities.satisfied_description: All containment layers sealed. Distribution rails primed. The reservoir holds enough fuel to service a fleet — and then some.
facilities.degraded_description: Containment telemetry is showing stress fractures in two of the outer layers. Distribution is throttled to prevent cascade failure.

facilities.name: Capital Fuel Fabrication Complex
facilities.description: A fully automated, cryogenically cooled facility with redundant containment systems, coolant loops throughout, and quantum-monitored assembly lines that produce reactor fuel assemblies with unprecedented speed and safety margins.

facilities.name: Capital-Grade Laser Manufacturing Complex
facilities.description: A large-scale facility with dedicated sub-lines for exotic-material processing and superconductor installation. Laser focus arrays and crystalline lattices are mounted in parallel, reducing total build time substantially.

facilities.name: Capital-Grade Laser Production Works
facilities.description: Heavy industrial facility with precision laser-focus integration, quantum targeting systems, and reinforced frame processing. Crystalline lattices and power cells are mounted via automated precision rigs, achieving rapid cycle times.

facilities.name: Capital-Grade Repair Integrator
facilities.description: A precision assembly facility designed to combine armor repairer II units with advanced nanite containers, crystalline lattices, and power cells. Component staging ensures exact sequencing for industrial-scale armor restoration systems.

facilities.name: Capital Habitat Construction Complex
facilities.description: A major orbital works that assembles complete capital-ship residential, environmental, and watchkeeping sections.

facilities.name: Capital Laser Assembly Line
facilities.description: A specialized production line integrating completed Mining Laser III modules with crystalline lattices, focused crystals, and laser focus arrays. Power cell installation and final calibration complete each capital-grade system.

facilities.name: Capital Laser Manufacturing Plant
facilities.description: An expanded facility with dedicated integration stations for laser focus arrays and crystalline-lattice mounting. Structural frames and advanced control systems enable efficient assembly of capital-grade mining systems.

facilities.name: Capital Laser Production System
facilities.description: Fully automated manufacturing hub with integrated laser-focus alignment, crystalline-lattice processing, and advanced quantum targeting. Delivers complete capital-grade mining systems every 2 minutes with integrated coolant and power systems.

facilities.name: Capital Plating Mill
facilities.description: Larger industrial facility with structural framing that increases throughput by running multiple forming and bonding stations in sequence. Shield emitters and matrices are integrated and tested before each plate leaves the line.

facilities.name: Capital Rad Fabrication Plant
facilities.description: Heavy-scale production complex with reinforced framing and extensive coolant infrastructure for continuous manufacturing of capital-grade harvesters. Full hot-cell containment and multi-superconductor systems ensure peak extraction performance.

facilities.name: Capital Rad Manufacturing Hub
facilities.description: State-of-the-art facility with maximal coolant circulation, reinforced infrastructure, and automated superconductor integration for continuous production of industrial-grade rad harvesters. Delivers optimized titanium shielding and beam-emitter performance.

facilities.name: Capital Ship Repair Manufacturing Line
facilities.description: Industrial-scale facility with heavy reinforced framing and extensive coolant circulation to manage the thermal load of quantum control cores and high-density shield emitter arrays. Continuous flow production ensures steady output of capital-grade repair modules.

facilities.name: Capital Shipyard Complex
facilities.description: Heavy industrial complex with dedicated sections for frame fabrication, reinforcement, and modular assembly. Multi-stage conveyor integration and computer-guided positioning enable rapid frame completion.

facilities.name: Capital Weapons Assembly
facilities.description: An expanded weapons manufacturing complex with dedicated superconductor cooling loops, reinforced barrel assembly stations, and power core integration systems. Handles increased material throughput for sustained siege weapon production.

facilities.name: Captain's Estate
facilities.description: A full residential suite occupying a premium section of the station. Multiple rooms, personal galley, secure storage vault, and panoramic viewport array. People notice when you walk the corridors.
facilities.satisfied_description: Polished bulkheads, real wood trim from Sol, and a viewport array that makes visiting captains jealous. You've made it.
facilities.degraded_description: The wood trim is starting to warp and the galley's auto-chef only makes three things now. Still the best address on the station.

facilities.name: Carapace Lamination Works
facilities.description: An automated multi-press line with resin curing and stress-grading that turns bulk carapace into armor plate at scale. Absorbs the molt from a whole hunting region.

facilities.name: Carapace Press
facilities.description: A laminating press that bonds shed creature carapace into reinforced hull plating. Cheap to run and a steady outlet for grazer molt.

facilities.name: Carbon Arc Furnace
facilities.description: Crude arc chamber that floods the etch bay with carbon plasma. Wasteful with carbon but lets a thin silicon wafer carry far more circuitry.

facilities.name: Carbon Arc Quantum Etcher
facilities.description: Advanced nanofabrication platform with AI-controlled plasma delivery and real-time defect detection across parallel processing lanes. Fuel cells power the precision arc grid and repair kits maintain the atomic-level accuracy of the injection cartridges.

facilities.name: Carbon Dioxide Sublimator
facilities.description: A sealed dry-ice processor that captures sublimated carbon dioxide, filters it, and compresses it into clean industrial gas.

facilities.name: Carbon Electronics Complex
facilities.description: A distributed clean-room complex with continuous nanotube growth and automated rhodium-contact deposition.

facilities.name: Carbon-Enriched Driftkale Bay
facilities.description: Sealed drift-trays with controlled carbon dioxide injection for accelerated harvests.

facilities.name: Carbon-Enriched Honeyglobe Orchard
facilities.description: Sealed orchard cells with controlled carbon dioxide injection for accelerated fruiting.

facilities.name: Carbon-Enriched Sunspindle Bay
facilities.description: A sealed sunspindle grow-bay with controlled carbon dioxide injection for accelerated harvests.

facilities.name: Carbon Exfoliation Line
facilities.description: A thermal and mechanical exfoliation system that strips carbon ore into single-layer graphene sheets. Plasma heating and precision anvils create the atomic-scale separation.

facilities.name: Carbon Fiber Drawing Line
facilities.description: A dedicated production line that draws and weaves carbon ore into composite fiber under controlled temperature and tension. Steady throughput suitable for routine hull reinforcement orders.

facilities.name: Carbon Nano-Fabricator
facilities.description: Industrial-grade system with multi-point plasma injection, automated silicon staging, and precision arc metering. Fuel cells maintain optimal reaction temperatures while repair kits service the delicate plasma manifolds.

facilities.name: Carbon Plasma Etcher
facilities.description: Purpose-built etching cell with fuel cell-driven plasma recirculation and carbon density monitoring. Cuts waste significantly and improves board yields.

facilities.name: Carbon Press
facilities.description: A high-pressure anvil system that applies extreme force and heat to raw carbon ore, forming synthetic diamond crystals through controlled phase transition. Produces cut diamonds at measured intervals.

facilities.name: Carbon Separation Fabrication Complex
facilities.description: Quantum control cores sequence bed assembly while precision optics align the intake vanes on reinforced frames for high-throughput filtering units.

facilities.name: Carbon Weave Assembly Line
facilities.description: A dedicated production line that laminates darksteel plating with graphene sheets and carbon-fiber weave into reinforced hull lattice. Precision alignment ensures structural integrity of the composite material.

facilities.name: Carbonated Biogas Fizz Bar
facilities.description: A conventional carbonation line that substitutes pressurized carbon dioxide for crystallized biogas.

facilities.name: Carbonated Quantum Fizz Bar
facilities.description: A pressure-rated spin charger that folds quantum silk through conventionally carbonated fruit soda.

facilities.name: Carbonyl Nickel Works
facilities.description: A fully automated complex pairing flash smelting with carbonyl refining, redundant plasma injectors and cryogenic coolant networks yielding high-purity billets at maximum throughput with minimal slag loss.

facilities.name: Cargo Bay Fabrication Plant
facilities.description: Mid-tier facility integrating sensor arrays, processing cores, and structural frames into standardized expansion modules. Enhanced precision optics and control systems improve reliability and fit tolerances.

facilities.name: Cargo Container Complex
facilities.description: Fully automated ultra-high-speed facility producing containers with minimal dwell time. Robotic material handling, inline welding verification, and optimized logistics enable near-continuous output.

facilities.name: Cargo Container Fabricator
facilities.description: Basic industrial stamping and welding line for producing standardized cargo containers from steel plate and aluminum sheet. Automated press cycles and basic seam welding ensure consistent form factor.

facilities.name: Cargo Container Facility
facilities.description: Industrial-scale facility running multiple parallel stamping and welding lines with automated material feed and quality inspection. Advanced tooling and optimized workflows achieve rapid container throughput.

facilities.name: Cargo Container Plant
facilities.description: Larger stamping plant with integrated material handling and multi-stage welding stations. Improved tool design and faster cycle times increase output while maintaining structural integrity.

facilities.name: Cargo Hold
facilities.description: Organized storage facility with inventory tracking and climate zones.
facilities.satisfied_description: Climate zones maintain optimal conditions. Inventory scanners track every item, and retrieval is quick.
facilities.degraded_description: Except lately. Climate zones fluctuate unpredictably, inventory tracking drifts, and locating stored items takes longer each day.

facilities.name: Cargo Hold Workshop
facilities.description: Straightforward production line forming and bonding steel plate with flex polymer to create basic cargo expanders. Simple fixtures and manual loading stations combine with automated curing cycles.

facilities.name: Cargo Matrix Assembly Line
facilities.description: Purpose-built facility integrating cargo containers and prismatic lenses with flex polymer into optimized storage systems. Hull plating and reinforced bulkheads form the structural foundation for light-guided sorting arrays.

facilities.name: Cargo Shielding Bay
facilities.description: Larger facility with coolant-loop circulation through the lead-lamination process, preventing thermal warping during assembly. Structural frames support heavier pressing machinery.

facilities.name: Cartridge Assembly Line
facilities.description: A mid-scale production facility with dedicated stamping, case-forming, and loading sections, integrated with weapon housing and barrel assembly stations. Increased throughput via parallel processing lines and enhanced control systems.

facilities.name: Cascade EM Factory
facilities.description: Dedicated facility producing electromagnetic cascade charges through controlled circuit-board integration and superconductor bonding. Weapon housings and barrel components support rapid assembly of field-ready charge packs.

facilities.name: Cascade EM Manufactory
facilities.description: Industrial-scale facility with quantum control cores and targeting computers orchestrating circuit board layout and superconductor placement for reliable cascade initiation. Reinforced frames isolate electromagnetic interference during production.

facilities.name: Cascade EM Ordnance Complex
facilities.description: Cutting-edge facility featuring quantum-controlled circuit integration, precision targeting computers for cascade sequencing, and coolant loops maintaining superconductor stability during assembly. Fully automated systems produce maximum-efficiency chain-reaction charges.

facilities.name: Cascade EM Press
facilities.description: Specialized electronics facility that integrates circuit boards and superconductors into chain-reaction charge packs. Precision assembly ensures correct polarity and conductor spacing for cascade effect initiation.

facilities.name: Casualty Clearing Center
facilities.description: A high-throughput triage and surgical complex built to absorb the aftermath of fleet actions. It restores its private treatment pool from faction medical supplies only when care has depleted it.

facilities.name: Catalyst Reduction Furnace
facilities.description: Reduces raw platinum ore into a finely-divided catalytic sponge under controlled heat and reducing gas. The high surface area is what makes the metal catalytically active.

facilities.name: Catalytic Fuel Cell Complex
facilities.description: A fully automated fuel-cell complex with continuous catalyst regeneration and cryogenic hydrogen feed, producing cells at maximum throughput for as long as platinum stays affordable.

facilities.name: Catalytic Fuel Cell Line
facilities.description: A fuel-cell assembly line built around a platinum catalyst bed, sealing hydrogen into cells at half the feedstock of a conventional line. Economical only while platinum is cheap.

facilities.name: Catalytic Fuel Cell Plant
facilities.description: A heavy industrial plant with redundant catalyst beds and high-pressure hydrogen lines, mass-producing catalytic fuel cells while the platinum economics hold.

facilities.name: Catalytic Fuel Cell Workshop
facilities.description: An expanded catalytic line with automated hydrogen handling and pressure sealing, turning out fuel cells in larger runs while keeping the catalyst bed efficient.

facilities.name: Catalytic Fuel Complex
facilities.description: An industrial cracking complex with redundant catalyst beds, chemical-lined gas loops, and coolant networks that hold the bed at peak activity across large hydrogen batches.

facilities.name: Catalytic Fuel Hub
facilities.description: A fully automated fuel hub with continuous catalyst regeneration, cryogenic hydrogen feed, and real-time bed monitoring — maximum fuel throughput from minimum feedstock, for as long as the platinum holds out.

facilities.name: Catalytic Fuel Plant
facilities.description: An expanded cracking plant with automated catalyst-bed replacement and lined feedstock loops, keeping the hydrogen stream over fresh platinum sponge for consistent high-throughput fuel runs.

facilities.name: Catalytic Fuel Refinery
facilities.description: A compact cracking line built around a platinum catalyst bed, turning a trickle of liquid hydrogen into station fuel at a pace a bare combustor cannot match. The bed fouls every run and is consumed with it — cheap to feed only while platinum is.

facilities.name: Catalytic Polymer Reactor
facilities.description: Reactor fitted with a platinum catalyst bed that cracks organic feedstock far more completely than an open vat, drawing twice the polymer from the same synthetic compound.

facilities.name: Catalytic Refining Plant
facilities.description: An industrial plant with redundant gas loops and coolant networks that holds the precise conditions needed for maximum catalytic surface area across large platinum batches.

facilities.name: Caustic Processing Plant
facilities.description: A corrosion-lined plant that uses chlorophage caustic sacs as feedstock for flexible polymer.

facilities.name: Caustic Sour Ale Brewery
facilities.description: Souring fermenters dosing a controlled trace of chlorophage caustic sac.

facilities.name: Cell Cracking Plant
