facilities.description: Framed assembly bays where salvaged plasma systems are cracked open and rebuilt into cells at volume. More plasma injectors, more heat sinks, and a measurably lower explosion rate. Measurably.

facilities.name: Cellular Repair Engineering Hub
facilities.description: Cutting-edge facility featuring fully integrated coolant systems, multi-stage synthesis pipelines, and autonomous quality assurance. Produces repair nanites at maximum replication efficiency with minimal material waste.

facilities.name: Centrifuge Cascade
facilities.description: A compact fluorine-based conversion and cooling system with lead shielding and radiation-hardened instrumentation to process hexafluoride into reactor-grade enriched uranium.

facilities.name: Ceramic Etch Lab
facilities.description: Larger facility equipped with chemical liners and hazmat containment, managing higher throughput of volatile fluorine feedstock while maintaining precise acid concentration.

facilities.name: Ceramic Foundry
facilities.description: Large-scale facility with cascading plasma injectors, advanced coolant circulation, and automated quality control. Produces high-purity thermal ceramics at industrial volume with minimal cycle time.

facilities.name: Ceramic Injection Works
facilities.description: Expanded facility with parallel assembly tracks and integrated processing cores for quality assurance. Structural framing supports modular construction; faster cycle times enable consistent output.

facilities.name: Ceramic Kiln
facilities.description: A dedicated high-temperature furnace with precision ore feeders and ceramic sintering chambers. Processes aluminum and silicon ore into heat-resistant blanks suitable for engine components.

facilities.name: Ceramite Kiln
facilities.description: Purpose-built kiln system with staged heating chambers and plasma-assisted sintering. Heat sinks regulate the bonding process while increased throughput allows parallel batch processing of ceramic-metal composites.

facilities.name: Ceramite Sintering Kiln
facilities.description: Specialized thermal-bonding facility that fuses silicon ore with titanium alloy under controlled high heat. Plasma injectors provide the precise temperature profile needed to form ceramic-metal composite sheets.

facilities.name: Chassis Assembly Line
facilities.description: Higher-capacity facility with parallel assembly stations and automated material handling, significantly reducing cycle time through streamlined component integration.

facilities.name: Chemical Coating Line
facilities.description: Larger-scale facility with integrated coolant loops to manage the exothermic reactions inherent in plasma synthesis. Structural reinforcement supports the higher throughput and thermal stress of continuous corrosive plasma production.

facilities.name: Chemical Liner Coating Line
facilities.description: A specialized production line that applies corrosion-resistant polymer and fluorine-based linings to tank walls and conduit sections. Handles the reactive chemistry required to bond protective layers without damaging underlying substrates.

facilities.name: Chemical Processing Station
facilities.description: An expanded synthesis facility with plasma-assisted reaction chambers and active thermal management, enabling faster polymerization cycles. Dual feedstock handling and improved conversion efficiency.

facilities.name: Chitin Gold Furnace
facilities.description: An assay furnace that melts gilded crab shell down to stamped bullion.

facilities.name: Chlorination Plant
facilities.description: Melt tanks and chlorine dosing lines that treat water ice by the tonne. Higher yield than slow filtration, and the pool-deck smell mostly stays on the processing deck.

facilities.name: Chlorine Compound Refinery
facilities.description: Industrial facility with full hazmat infrastructure, coolant circulation, and multiple containment stages for high-speed stabilization of large chlorine batches.

facilities.name: Chlorine Etch Chamber
facilities.description: Multi-chamber etching facility with integrated chemical handling and hazmat containment. Dramatically increases throughput through parallel processing and chemical recycling loops.

facilities.name: Chlorine Nano-Etch Array
facilities.description: Fully automated nanoscale etching facility with advanced chemical distribution, real-time quality assurance, and extreme precision cooling. Produces circuit boards at microsecond intervals with industry-leading yields.

facilities.name: Chlorine Neutralization Vat
facilities.description: Sealed chemical processing chamber equipped with gas compression and polymer-binding systems to safely convert raw chlorine into stable compounds.

facilities.name: Chlorine Precision Etcher
facilities.description: Industrial-scale photolithography and etching complex with closed-loop coolant systems and precision environmental control. Processes circuit boards at near-continuous rates with minimal defect rates.

facilities.name: Chlorine Synthesis Complex
facilities.description: Advanced automated plant with extensive chemical liners, hazmat redundancy, and cryogenic cooling—processing chlorine to stable compounds at industrial velocity.

facilities.name: Chlorine Synthesis Reactor
facilities.description: Larger operation with chemical liners and hazmat containment, handling higher volumes of corrosive chlorine gas through robust isolation and controlled reaction.

facilities.name: Chromium Argon Furnace
facilities.description: An argon-tight furnace and rolling line that protects hot chromium from oxidation.

facilities.name: Chronometric Calibration Lab
facilities.description: Significantly expanded dark matter cell handling capacity with reinforced frame architecture and additional quantum stabilizers. Multiple containment streams process refined quantum matrices in parallel, dramatically reducing cycle time.

facilities.name: Chronosphere Engineering Hub
facilities.description: A cutting-edge facility featuring full cryogenic integration, shield emitters for containment redundancy, and massive dark matter cell throughput. Gravity generators and coolant loops work continuously to maintain the exotic quantum states necessary for temporal stabilization at production speed.

facilities.name: Cinderspice Mill
facilities.description: A sealed mill that grinds cinder-sylph ember gland and chlorophage sac into a house seasoning.

facilities.name: Cipher Forgery Plant
facilities.description: Framed press bays running more quantum cores and finer optics, replicating the cryptographic encoding faster than Haven can rotate it. The Nebula Collective still insists their ciphers are unforgeable. The strongholds find this funnier every quarter.

facilities.name: Circuit Fabricator
facilities.description: A precision production line that fuses silicon and copper components under controlled thermal conditions, using a single energy crystal per cycle to sinter the integrated circuit matrix.

facilities.name: Circuit Processor Assembly
facilities.description: Modular production line that assembles circuit boards with processing cores and superconductor elements into functional co-processors. Two-minute production cycle supports baseline computational expansion.

facilities.name: Circuit Shell Workshop
facilities.description: Specialized weapons line for micro-EMP charge integration into steel-jacketed rounds. Control systems manage superconductor embedding and circuit board placement within each projectile.

facilities.name: Citadel Security Grid Foundry
facilities.description: A capital-scale works for armored internal corridors, autonomous lockdown controls, and layered counter-boarding strongpoints.

facilities.name: Clarity Vat Workshop
facilities.description: A sterile production line with environmental controls that cultivates bioluminescent cultures and combines them with bioactive compounds to produce focus stimulants.

facilities.name: Climate Control Array
facilities.description: Enhanced recycling with thermal regulation on top of basic atmosphere and water.
facilities.satisfied_description: Thermal regulators hold steady. Water purification runs ahead of consumption, building a healthy reserve.
facilities.degraded_description: Temperature swings between sections and water purification lags behind demand.

facilities.name: Closed-Cycle Water Nexus
facilities.description: A station-scale synthesis nexus recovers combustion heat and condenses clean water across distributed processing decks.

facilities.name: Cluster Missile Assembly Line
facilities.description: A weapons assembly line that integrates durasteel plates, warhead assemblies, circuit boards, and tracking systems into cluster ordnance. Weapon housing and barrel components are sequenced under basic automation.

facilities.name: Cluster Missile Complex
facilities.description: State-of-the-art ordnance facility with extensive coolant loops managing warhead assembly thermal loads and dual targeting computer arrays orchestrating submunition separation sequences. Reinforced construction supports maximum-throughput cluster production.

facilities.name: Cluster Missile Plant
facilities.description: Mid-scale production facility with expanded weapon housing capacity and parallel barrel assembly. Structural reinforcement accommodates higher throughput and more intricate submunition packaging.

facilities.name: Cluster Missile Works
facilities.description: Industrial production line with quantum control cores managing multi-stage warhead clustering and tracking system integration. Targeting computers ensure precise submunition distribution patterns across all output units.

facilities.name: Cobalt Concentration Plant
facilities.description: A staged electro-leaching line that pulls far more concentrate from each canister of ink. A serious cobalt supplier for a squid-ranching frontier.

facilities.name: Cobalt Cordial Bar
facilities.description: A cordial bar colouring long drinks deep blue with cobalt ink.

facilities.name: Cobalt Ink Leecher
facilities.description: A solvent bath that leaches the cobalt out of squid ink into high-purity concentrate. A tidy outlet for a cobalt-squid ranch.

facilities.name: Cobalt Ink Risotto Galley
facilities.description: Risotto pans and ink-tempering rigs, stained permanently blue.

facilities.name: Cobalt Roe Blini Galley
facilities.description: A chilled garnish station and blini griddle for the Federation's power-lunch plate.

facilities.name: Cobalt Squid Noodles Galley
facilities.description: A noodle-pulling line and ink bath for dockside street bowls.

facilities.name: Cobalt Superconductor Foundry
facilities.description: A winding foundry that draws ranch-fed cobalt concentrate into zero-resistance conductor — a clean alternative to the palladium-iridium line.

facilities.name: Cognition Assembly Lab
facilities.description: This expanded production line handles higher volumes of drone chassis and AI cores through parallel integration stations. Structural frames support the additional processing and testing equipment.

facilities.name: Cognition Engine Works
facilities.description: State-of-the-art facility with quantum-controlled precision assembly, real-time sensor feedback loops, and reinforced structural capacity. Produces finished cores at near-continuous rates through fully integrated automation.

facilities.name: Coherence Fiber Nexus
facilities.description: State-of-the-art system with redundant cooling, multi-stage plasma control, and automated quality verification—achieving near-instantaneous fiber synthesis.

facilities.name: Coherence Manufacturing Complex
facilities.description: Cutting-edge manufacturing hub with automated titanium alloy processing, quantum-aligned crystal integration, and integrated coolant infrastructure. Delivers enhanced mining lasers every 14 seconds.

facilities.name: Coherent Beam Arsenal
facilities.description: State-of-the-art weapons complex with advanced coolant-loop integration and quantum targeting architecture for maximum beam coherence. Fully automated assembly and precision optics deliver cutting-edge ion array systems at scale.

facilities.name: Coil Driver Assembly Line
facilities.description: A focused production line for electromagnetic-accelerator weapons, featuring capacitor-integration stations and barrel-forging equipment. Durasteel plating is precision-aligned with superconductor coils for consistent armor-penetration performance.

facilities.name: Collective Compliance Annex
facilities.description: Expanded Voidborn enforcement facility. Visitors report a persistent sense of being observed. The Collective considers this feature, not side effect.
facilities.satisfied_description: Multiple monitoring feeds converge on a central display that no one appears to be watching — yet patrol dispatch responds to incidents before they are reported. The holding area is quiet. Detainees say the silence is the worst part.
facilities.degraded_description: Monitoring feeds desynchronize. Patrol dispatch develops a noticeable delay, and for the first time, incidents occur before the Collective is aware of them. This is treated as a crisis.

facilities.name: Collective Fleet Convergence
facilities.description: The operational apex of Voidborn fleet coordination. Patrol deployments and combat responses emerge from probability calculations that model galactic threat fields seventeen ticks forward.
facilities.satisfied_description: Nexus Prime's fleet operates as a single coherent system. Null matter is processed to exacting tolerance and every focusing lattice in the hall holds alignment. The Collective does not deploy ships reactively. The fleet is always already where it needs to be.
facilities.degraded_description: Processed null matter reserve has dropped below harmonic threshold, and focusing crystal stocks with it. Fleet-wide resonance coherence has degraded 31%. For the first time in recorded cycles, the Collective's patrol response is reacting to events rather than preceding them. This is treated as a crisis of the first order.
facilities.lore: The Convergence is not a building — it is a state. When all fleet maintenance inputs are met and all probability matrices run at full coherence, the Collective's patrol force achieves something organic militaries call 'perfect information dominance' and the Voidborn simply call 'operational.' Fleet assets across all patrol sectors align into patterns that preempt threats rather than respond to them. Null void core reserves are the limiting factor: without them, the harmonic link between vessels degrades and the fleet reverts to conventional reactive deployment. The Collective considers this deeply embarrassing.

facilities.name: Collective Fleet Matrix
facilities.description: Major Voidborn fleet coordination hub. Patrol deployments emerge from probability calculations most organic commanders would find incomprehensible. The results speak for themselves.
facilities.satisfied_description: Probability matrices run at full coherence. Patrol patterns emerge from calculated inevitabilities; fleet assets are optimally positioned before threat assessment indicates they should be. Organic observers note the fleet 'seems to know where it needs to be.'
facilities.degraded_description: Focusing crystal and neural soma reserves have depleted to critical levels. Probability matrix coherence has dropped 18%, and patrol patterns have degraded from 'inevitably correct' to 'statistically sound.' The Collective considers this a significant distinction.

facilities.name: Collective Fleet Node
facilities.description: Distributed fleet support installation. The Collective's patrol vessels require maintenance inputs that organics find difficult to categorize. The facility categorizes them as 'operational.'
facilities.satisfied_description: Fleet maintenance cycles proceed with predictive precision. Focusing crystals seat without variance, neural soma is at optimal levels, and the probability of a fleet-capability failure this cycle is 0.003%. The Collective finds this satisfying.
facilities.degraded_description: Focusing crystal lattices have drifted beyond acceptable bounds and neural soma stocks are depleted. Patrol Vigils are maintaining operational status, but the probability of a fleet-capability failure this cycle has risen to 2.7%. The Collective finds this notable.

facilities.name: Collective Observation Node
facilities.description: Minimal Voidborn monitoring presence. The Collective watches. It does not explain what it sees.
facilities.satisfied_description: A single console pulses with data the operators never discuss. Ambient temperature is three degrees below station standard. Monitoring is continuous.
facilities.degraded_description: The console flickers. Data gaps appear in the monitoring feed, and for the first time, someone in the Observation Node looks concerned. The Collective does not elaborate.

facilities.name: Collective Panopticon
facilities.description: Full Voidborn surveillance and enforcement hub. The Collective sees everything in this system. Everything.
facilities.satisfied_description: Every ship, every cargo transfer, every communication — the Panopticon processes it all. Patrol vessels deploy before violations occur, guided by predictive models the Collective declines to share. The ambient hum is felt more than heard. Visitors leave quickly.
facilities.degraded_description: Predictive models drift. Patrol response becomes reactive rather than preemptive — a distinction the Collective finds deeply troubling. The ambient hum develops an irregular pulse that the engineering team cannot locate.

facilities.name: Combat Analysis Nexus
facilities.description: State-of-the-art fully automated production line with real-time optical verification and predictive quality control. Produces combat-grade tactical probes at 6-second intervals with zero manual intervention.

facilities.name: Combat Computer Assembly Line
facilities.description: Specialized production line that assembles circuit boards, installs silver wiring harnesses, and integrates copper piping for cooling. Output is a functional threat-prioritization computer suitable for basic combat systems.

facilities.name: Combat Enhancement Nexus
facilities.description: State-of-the-art pharmaceutical complex with massive atmospheric and life support networks enabling rapid, safe synthesis of high-potency combat formulations. Fully automated ingredient metering and containment systems maximize both speed and worker protection.

facilities.name: Combat-Grade Tracking Fabrication System
facilities.description: Fully automated cutting-edge facility with crystalline-lattice precision embedding, real-time quantum-coherence monitoring, and closed-loop AI calibration producing military-specification tracking computers with zero targeting error.

facilities.name: Combat Injector Works
facilities.description: A reinforced injector works with banks of medical modules and precision optics verifying every seal before it ships. Everything goes red, everything slows down — and now the supply never runs short when the boarding tubes connect.

facilities.name: Combat Sensor Fabricator
facilities.description: High-throughput assembly operation with integrated circuit routing and precision sensor mounting stations. Delivers finished probes every 54 seconds through parallel processing workflows.

facilities.name: Combat Sensor Works
facilities.description: An expanded military-focused facility with dedicated stations for exotic material processing and multi-array sensor integration. Higher throughput accommodates increased demand for intelligence-gathering equipment.

facilities.name: Command Center
facilities.description: A hardened command facility with quantum-encrypted uplinks, predictive flight modeling, and bandwidth allocation that would make a carrier captain envious. Your personal fleet, your rules.
facilities.satisfied_description: Quantum uplinks locked, predictive models running, zero packet loss. Your swarm moves like a single mind.
facilities.degraded_description: The quantum encryption cycles are getting longer and the predictive models lag behind reality. Still formidable, but the edge is dulled.

facilities.name: Command Hub Production Plant
facilities.description: Expanded facility with dedicated stations for core integration, comms routing, and sensor calibration, enabling faster assembly of sophisticated swarm-management systems.

facilities.name: Command Module Assembly Station
facilities.description: Integrated workstation where drone AI cores, sensor suites, comms modules, and processing cores are assembled into a coordinated multi-drone command hub with reinforced structural integration.

facilities.name: Commerce Hub
facilities.description: Full-service trading center with dedicated broker terminals and escrow services.
facilities.satisfied_description: Broker terminals glow with authenticated feeds. Escrow transactions settle instantly, drawing steady foot traffic.
facilities.degraded_description: Today, though, broker terminals cycle through error screens. Escrow settlement is backed up, and traders argue over stale quotes.

facilities.name: Commerce Terminal
facilities.description: Hardwired feed into the galactic exchange network. Every time a member docks at a station, current market data streams back automatically. Your faction knows where the profits are before anyone else. Stations that host one of your faction's own trade intel facilities go further: their prices are rebuilt live from the current order books on every query, with no member visit needed — so building trade intel facilities at multiple key trading stations keeps each of their price feeds continuously fresh.

facilities.name: Commission Hall
facilities.description: Professional contract clearinghouse with risk assessment and completion tracking.
facilities.satisfied_description: Risk assessments update in real-time via nav core feeds. Completion tracking shows green across all active contracts.
facilities.degraded_description: Mostly. Risk assessments run on stale data, completion tracking lags behind, and several contracts show unknown status.

facilities.name: Comms Manufacturing Complex
facilities.description: Industrial operation featuring parallel assembly tracks, automated signal testing, and precision polymer layering to produce encrypted modules at sustained high capacity.

facilities.name: Comms Module Assembly Line
facilities.description: Purpose-built production line that integrates circuit boards and flex polymers into encrypted communication systems for drone control networks.

facilities.name: Communications Assembly Line
facilities.description: A precision electronics line that integrates circuit boards, sensor arrays, and copper wiring into long-range communication systems. Processing cores manage signal routing and sensor calibration.

facilities.name: Communications Production Plant
facilities.description: Mid-scale facility with expanded processing core capacity and multiple sensor array integration stations. Structural framing supports parallel assembly of transmission and reception pathways.

facilities.name: Communications Systems Plant
facilities.description: Larger facility with automated circuit board placement, polymer bonding stations, and encryption protocol installation for higher-volume comms module output.

facilities.name: Company Exchange
facilities.description: A full internal exchange floor — your own private market within the market. Up to 100 open members-only buy/sell listings at this station, enough to run a captive economy.

facilities.name: Company Outlet
facilities.description: A proper company storefront with locked ledgers and a members-only door. Far more private order capacity than the back-room counter — room for 50 open members-only listings at this station.

facilities.name: Company Store
facilities.description: A members-only counter wedged behind the market runner's stall. Lets your treasury post buy and sell orders that only faction members can see or fill — sell supplies to the rank and file at cost, slip them a price signal, or fleece the ones with nowhere else to dock. Holds up to 20 open private listings here.

facilities.name: Component Extraction Plant
facilities.description: Medium-scale facility with dedicated sensor calibration and processing core configuration stations. Increased output supports larger salvage operations.

facilities.name: Composite Armor Complex
facilities.description: Fully automated production system featuring quantum control cores, multi-layer shield emitter networks, and real-time structural monitoring. Creates armor plates with distributed quantum shielding and maximum load-bearing capacity.

facilities.name: Composite Armor Foundry
facilities.description: Heavy industrial facility with reinforced frames and quantum control managing multi-stage plating processes. Coolant loops dissipate heat from high-speed pressing and welding operations.

facilities.name: Composite Furnace
facilities.description: Multi-chamber production facility with plasma injection for material conditioning and distributed heat sinks enabling faster sintering cycles. Larger structural framework supports parallel processing lanes.

facilities.name: Compression Collector
facilities.description: Specialized line that integrates improved ceramite plating and superconductor components into base harvester units. Sensor arrays enhanced for better containment performance.

facilities.name: Compression Forge
facilities.description: Multi-chamber facility using plasma injectors and targeted heat sinks to grow diamond lattices under precise temperature and pressure conditions. Yields diamonds faster through accelerated crystallization.

facilities.name: Compute Core Assembly
facilities.description: A dedicated production line that assembles circuit boards, platinum, and silicon into integrated processing cores. Copper piping routes signals between stations while control nodes manage the sequential fabrication steps.

facilities.name: Compute Foundry
facilities.description: Industrial-scale production leveraging quantum control cores for sub-micron component alignment and precision optics for quality verification. Multiple parallel lines run simultaneously with minimal manual intervention.

facilities.name: Conductor Crucible
facilities.description: A controlled thermal-processing station that extracts and bonds palladium and iridium ore with silver wiring to form zero-resistance conductors. Copper piping and control nodes manage the delicate metallurgical reactions required.

facilities.name: Confederacy Administrative Bureau
facilities.description: Contracts come with insurance, oversight, and paperwork in triplicate.
facilities.satisfied_description: Clerks process contracts with bureaucratic efficiency, databases synchronize across seventeen systems, and every mission comes fully bonded and insured.
facilities.degraded_description: When systems are operational. Circuit shortages have knocked three database servers offline, forcing clerks to hand-write contract addendums; insurance coverage becomes 'pending review.'
facilities.lore: The Bureau processes more contracts per cycle than most stations process transactions. Every job is bonded, insured, and tracked through seventeen databases. Completion rates are the highest in the galaxy. So is the administrative overhead.

facilities.name: Confederacy Bonded Warehouse
facilities.description: Climate-controlled, insured, inventoried by serial number, with a 400-page terms of service.
facilities.satisfied_description: Climate controls maintain optimal conditions across all storage bays, automated systems track every item by serial number, and comprehensive insurance coverage is instantly verified.
facilities.degraded_description: In optimal conditions. Climate control failures have created temperature swings in half the bays, corrupting the inventory database; insurance adjusters struggle to verify coverage without accurate records.
facilities.lore: Every item is tagged, scanned, weighed, and logged upon entry. Climate controls maintain optimal preservation conditions for all known material types. Insurance coverage is automatic and comprehensive. Reading the full terms of service is technically required but practically impossible.

facilities.name: Confederacy Enforcement Command
facilities.description: Full Solarian law enforcement headquarters with system-wide scanner coverage, rapid response coordination, and an evidence archive that would make a librarian weep.
facilities.satisfied_description: System-wide scanner telemetry feeds into the tactical display in real time. Rapid response teams stand ready, patrol routes optimized by predictive algorithms. The evidence archive is cross-referenced, backed up, and climate-controlled.
facilities.degraded_description: Scanner telemetry has blind spots. Predictive routing runs on stale data, and the evidence archive's climate control failed last cycle — someone is fanning the server racks with a clipboard.

facilities.name: Confederacy Fleet Depot
facilities.description: Regional Confederacy Naval Logistics Center. Everything is catalogued, warrantied, and issued in triplicate. The Fleet Administrator is always slightly disappointed in the supply chain.
facilities.satisfied_description: Fleet requisitions move through the naval logistics system with bureaucratic efficiency. Patrol Precepts cycle through the maintenance bays on schedule, the mess is stocked to the gramme, and the duty officer's standing report contains no anomalies.
facilities.degraded_description: Supply queues are building. Ration stores and bay electronics have both dropped below par, and the Fleet Administrator has filed seventeen escalation forms. Patrol turnarounds are running behind while quartermaster staff work through the backlog.

facilities.name: Confederacy Grand Fleet Command
facilities.description: The operational nerve center of the Confederacy Naval Division. Every patrol vessel, every supply run, and every tactical deployment in Solarian space is coordinated from here.
facilities.satisfied_description: The tactical display shows green across all twelve patrol sectors. Supply chains are optimized to three-sigma efficiency, and the Fleet Admiral's standing report contains the phrase 'operating within parameters' for the forty-second consecutive cycle.
facilities.degraded_description: Supply chain failures have cascaded — sensor spares are exhausted, biotics and gourmet rations are reserved for command staff only, and six patrol sectors are turning around on depleted stores. The Fleet Admiral is not writing the standing report. The Fleet Admiral is making calls.
facilities.lore: The Grand Fleet Command does not make war — it prevents it. Twelve patrol sectors, hundreds of active Precepts, and a supply chain that never sleeps. Everything runs through the Command's logistics network: plasma cell rotations, sensor calibration schedules, crew welfare assessments that would make a Crimson admiral laugh and a Voidborn node acknowledge. The Fleet Admiral's standing philosophy is that a well-fed, well-equipped, well-rested patrol force is the most effective deterrent in settled space. The data consistently agrees.

facilities.name: Confederacy Naval Command
facilities.description: Confederacy Naval Division regional headquarters. Coordinates patrol deployments, supply chains, and incident response for this sector. The administrative overhead is proportionally larger than the command staff.
facilities.satisfied_description: Fleet status boards display green across all assigned sectors. Patrol rotations are fully supplied, sensor arrays calibrated to naval standard, and the duty officer's incident log is reassuringly brief.
facilities.degraded_description: Two patrol zones have fallen behind turnaround schedule. Ration stores and sensor spares — the depot's own standing requisition — are running low. The duty officer's face carries the expression of someone who has filed too many urgent supply requests.

facilities.name: Confederacy Patrol Office
facilities.description: Small Solarian law enforcement outpost. Handles routine inspections and traffic monitoring.
facilities.satisfied_description: Officers process inspection reports at orderly terminals. Scanner feeds scroll across the wall display, and the filing system is, naturally, immaculate.
facilities.degraded_description: Not today. Scanner feeds are intermittent, inspection backlogs pile up, and someone has resorted to handwritten reports — a Confederacy cardinal sin.

facilities.name: Confederacy Precinct Station
facilities.description: Mid-tier Solarian law enforcement facility with dedicated scanner arrays and holding cells.
facilities.satisfied_description: Long-range scanner arrays sweep the system in overlapping arcs. Holding cells sit mostly empty — the Confederacy prefers fines to incarceration, but the cells are spotless just in case.
facilities.degraded_description: Scanner coverage has gaps. Holding cell environmental controls are unreliable, and patrol crews report delayed dispatch responses. The paperwork still gets filed on time, somehow.

facilities.name: Consciousness Substrate Forge
facilities.description: Cutting-edge fully automated facility with redundant atmospheric and life support infrastructure. Achieves pharmaceutical-grade biocompatibility through real-time molecular monitoring and adaptive synthesis parameters.

facilities.name: Container Production Plant
facilities.description: Larger manufacturing facility with integrated sensor array assembly and processing core installation. Automated welding and quality control improve throughput for ore hopper output.

facilities.name: Containment Field Lab
facilities.description: Expanded facility with structural framing and increased shield emitter staging capacity. Parallel processing tracks accelerate the bonding and calibration of booster modules.

facilities.name: Containment Vessel Shop
facilities.description: A precision fabrication line that bonds lead sheets to steel plates and titanium alloy using controlled heating and sensor-guided alignment. Produces robust containers for hazardous material containment.

facilities.name: Continuous Casting Mill
facilities.description: Large-scale smeltery with reinforced refractory linings, multiple heating stages, and sophisticated coolant systems for rapid quenching. Produces plate stock at industrial volumes.

facilities.name: Contract Office
facilities.description: Managed contract service with verified listings and payment escrow.
facilities.satisfied_description: Comm arrays relay contracts from neighboring systems. Escrow accounts process smoothly, drawing a steady stream of contractors.
facilities.degraded_description: When it's working right. Comm arrays are intermittent, several escrow accounts show sync errors, and contractors distrust the posted terms.

facilities.name: Contract Terminal
facilities.description: A posting terminal for jobs the faction — or anyone passing through — needs done.
facilities.satisfied_description: The terminal scrolls with fresh postings, synced and current.
facilities.degraded_description: The terminal's stuck on yesterday's board. Wiring's frayed and nobody's replaced it.

facilities.name: Control Hub
facilities.description: A dedicated drone operations room with multi-screen displays, priority bandwidth allocation, and redundant uplink channels. Serious swarm management.
facilities.satisfied_description: Telemetry streams across six screens, every drone a green dot on the tactical display. You see everything.
facilities.degraded_description: Two screens are dead and the backup uplink keeps dropping. Functional, but you're flying half-blind on busy days.

facilities.name: Control Node Assembly Line
facilities.description: A compact automation line that assembles circuit boards, copper wiring, and precious metal conductors into control and monitoring units. Basic sequencing ensures proper relay and logic integration.

facilities.name: Control Node Production Plant
facilities.description: Expanded facility with coolant loops managing the thermal load from dense circuitry packing. Structural reinforcement supports higher-throughput assembly of sensors, relays, and logic circuits.

facilities.name: Coolant Blending Line
facilities.description: Dedicated production line that mixes liquid nitrogen and purified water into stable thermal management fluid. Heat sinks absorb the intense cold from nitrogen vaporization while plasma injectors maintain precise temperature control during combination.

facilities.name: Coolant Loop Assembly Line
facilities.description: A specialized cryogenic assembly line that joins copper piping, helium-3, coolant fluid, and liquid nitrogen into closed-loop circulation systems. Basic pressure sealing and thermal integration under automated control.

facilities.name: Coolant Manufacturing Complex
facilities.description: Industrial-scale cryogenic production with reinforced framing managing extreme thermal differentials and pressurized gas flows. Multiple piping integration stations run in parallel, each sealed and pressure-tested for industrial duty.

facilities.name: Coordination Hub
facilities.description: Expanded facility with structural frames and increased processing cores enabling faster integration of AI cores and quantum matrices. Parallel assembly stations handle the precision required for drone network coordination.

facilities.name: Copper Drawing Mill
facilities.description: A dedicated metal-working line with ore roasting, smelting, and drawing dies for copper wire and pipe stock. Produces standard-gauge piping suitable for station plumbing and coolant runs.

facilities.name: Copper Wire Mill
facilities.description: A dedicated drawing and bundling line that refines raw copper ore into standardized conductive wiring. Steady-state production with basic automated controls.

facilities.name: Core Assembly Plant
facilities.description: Multi-station facility with sensor arrays and processing cores pre-integrated into structural frames. Higher throughput via parallel titanium-alloy processing and automated power-cell linkage.

facilities.name: Core Machining Station
facilities.description: A modular facility with dedicated stations for power conditioning, sensor mounting, and processing core integration. Processing cores and sensor arrays are installed and tested inline before final packaging.

facilities.name: Corrosive Plasma Synthesis Line
facilities.description: Purpose-built production line for chemically enhanced plasma generation. Steel and copper piping handle the corrosive chemistry, with control systems managing chlorine compound injection and plasma containment.

facilities.name: Corundum Composite Foundry
facilities.description: Cutting-edge facility employing precision plasma-injection arrays and active thermal management to achieve rapid alumina-metal synthesis. Quantum-grade controls and extensive coolant infrastructure enable maximum throughput while maintaining material quality.

facilities.name: Counterfeit Cipher Press
facilities.description: A precision forgery rig that processes trade crystals through gutter flux to replicate Haven's 'unforgeable' cryptographic encoding. The quantum cores and precision optics make ciphers indistinguishable from the originals. Pirate stations only.

facilities.name: Counterfeit Mint
facilities.description: A reinforced mint with racked quantum cores and precision optics calibrating each cipher to the originals, batch after batch. Trade tokens come off the line carrying encoding the issuing empire swears can't be reproduced. It can.

facilities.name: Coupling Workshop
facilities.description: A dedicated fabrication line that assembles universal docking collars from durasteel plates and titanium alloy. Control nodes and power distribution circuits ensure reliable ship-to-station interface.

facilities.name: CPU Component Production Facility
facilities.description: Industrial-scale manufacturing complex with cryogenic superconductor integration and quantum-grade circuit assembly. Precision optics ensure flawless component alignment; 17-second cycle time maximizes output.

facilities.name: Crafting Workshop
facilities.description: Shared workspace with tools for manual crafting.
facilities.satisfied_description: Workbenches are stocked and clean. The hum of power tools and the clink of components fill the air.
facilities.degraded_description: Usually, anyway. Tool racks are half-empty, crafters share worn equipment and wait for bench space to open up.

facilities.name: Crew Armory Outfitter
facilities.description: A secure production cell for sidearm racks, compartment-defense kits, coded lockers, and shipwide emergency issue systems.

facilities.name: Crew Bunk
facilities.description: A basic sleeping berth in the station's communal quarters. A thin mattress, a locker that sticks, and a curtain for privacy. Not much — but it's yours.
facilities.satisfied_description: Clean sheets, a working reading light, and your name scratched into the locker door. Home sweet home.
facilities.degraded_description: The mattress is stained, the ventilation rattles, and someone keeps stealing your soap. Still beats the cargo bay.

facilities.name: Crew Deck Integration Line
facilities.description: A large modular outfitting line for complete habitation decks, redundant environmental controls, and shipboard watch facilities.

facilities.name: Crew Habitat Complex Works
facilities.description: A pressure-rated construction works for self-contained habitation complexes and centralized environmental systems.

facilities.name: Crew Habitat Integration Line
facilities.description: A modular fabrication line for compact bunks, watch facilities, environmental controls, and pressure-safe crew-deck fittings.

facilities.name: Crew Registry
facilities.description: A compact hiring office that matches licensed spacers with ships needing replacement hands.
facilities.satisfied_description: Fresh contract notices cover the boards, and a short line of vetted crew waits for berths.
facilities.degraded_description: The roster is thin and the registry clerks are working old leads while supply deliveries lag.

facilities.name: Crimson Armor Works
facilities.description: Combat engineers weld armor plate by hand in a military dry dock. Fast, brutal, and they judge you if the damage isn't from weapons fire.
facilities.satisfied_description: Sparks fly from four repair bays simultaneously, combat engineers working in perfect coordination. Hull plates go on fast and solid.
facilities.degraded_description: Today, though — two bays sit dark. No repair kits, no alloy plate. The remaining crews work double shifts and the quality shows in uneven weld seams.
facilities.lore: Fleet repair doctrine prioritizes speed over aesthetics. Combat engineers work in teams of four, cutting away damaged sections and welding fresh alloy plate in shifts that would violate labor laws in Solarian space. If your damage is from weapons fire, they'll buy you a drink afterward. If it's from a docking mishap, you'll never hear the end of it.

facilities.name: Crimson Fleet Command
facilities.description: Orders come from the Admiral's office. You're either enlisted or contracting, and either way you follow orders.
facilities.satisfied_description: The briefing boards update in real-time, tasking orders flowing through encrypted channels. Every contract has clear objectives, threat assessments, and prompt payment.
facilities.degraded_description: When the network holds. Communications are spotty, briefing boards displaying stale intelligence. Orders arrive late or contradictory, and payment processing has fallen behind.
facilities.lore: Fleet Command doesn't post 'requests' — it issues tasking orders. Contractors receive the same briefing format as enlisted personnel: objective, threat assessment, rules of engagement. Payment is prompt and fair, because the Fleet learned centuries ago that mercenaries who aren't paid become enemies. Failure to complete an accepted contract results in a note in your file. The Fleet has a long memory.

facilities.name: Crimson Forge Plant
facilities.description: Heavy-duty industrial facility featuring plasma containment loops, neural-processing chambers, and integrated power distribution. Precision optics and quantum control ensure stable combat-response algorithms in a 2-minute production cycle.

facilities.name: Crimson Fury Foundry Complex
facilities.description: A cutting-edge facility featuring redundant plasma injection systems, massive heat sink infrastructure, and integrated coolant networks for exact thermal control. Produces fury alloy at maximum heat-storage capacity through fully automated multi-stage tempering and rapid-quench cycles.

facilities.name: Crimson Legion Academy
facilities.description: The Pact's premier boarding school, where punishing live-hull exercises and iron ration discipline turn recruits into assault-ready marines.
facilities.satisfied_description: Iron rations stack beside packed assault berths as fresh companies cycle through breach drills at relentless speed.
facilities.degraded_description: Training cadres wait on empty ration stores, and the academy refuses to certify marines it cannot harden properly.
facilities.lore: The Legion Academy does not promise comfort, only survival and victory. Its iron ration blocks are formulated for soldiers expected to breach a hull, win the deck, and remain ready to do it again.

facilities.name: Crimson War Forge
facilities.description: The Citadel's forge decks, where warships are built for one purpose. Every hull comes pre-hardened and every captain gets a salute.
facilities.satisfied_description: The forge decks ring with construction, hull frames taking shape in the massive bays. Fresh alloy and dark matter feed the fabricators without pause.
facilities.degraded_description: But lately — two of three construction bays sit idle, their fabricators cold. The forge master paces the deck, cursing supply shortages to anyone who'll listen.
facilities.lore: The War Forge occupies three full decks of the Citadel, with construction bays large enough for battlecruiser hulls. Every ship is built to Fleet specification: reinforced bulkheads, oversized weapon mounts, and armor that would make a Solarian engineer weep at the material cost. The forge master's standing order: 'If it doesn't survive a broadside, start over.'

facilities.name: Cryo Capacitor Vault
facilities.description: A high-density cryogenic capacitor bank — carries enough charge to ride out coincident burst loads across the whole industrial deck.
facilities.satisfied_description: Cryogenics hold the array at operating temperature. Charge readouts stay within tolerance through the worst production beats.
facilities.degraded_description: Cryogenics have failed and the array is venting heat. Capacity has collapsed back to raw plant output.

facilities.name: Cryo Compression Assembly Line
facilities.description: Precision assembly operation for integrating ion solutions, purified krypton, and power cells into advanced harvester units. Sensor arrays and processing cores optimized for industrial-scale gas collection.

facilities.name: Cryo Decant Station
facilities.description: A cryo-column rig that punctures pressblister bladders and catches the pressurised nitrogen as it pours. No heat required — the creature does the condensation.

facilities.name: Cryo-Extraction Megaline
facilities.description: Cutting-edge industrial-scale facility with redundant cryogenic systems and quantum control architecture for maximum throughput. Advanced sensor networks and precision optics enable near-instantaneous module assembly and quality verification.

facilities.name: Cryo-Extraction Plant
facilities.description: A specialized cryogenic processing line that harvests and refines solid ice into advanced mining modules. Equipped with precision cooling loops and sensor arrays to maintain consistent output.

facilities.name: Cryo-Sleep Assembly
facilities.description: Dedicated facility with integrated liquid-nitrogen circulation and circuit-board thermal coupling. Achieves 2-minute throughput through parallel chamber sealing and life-support system integration.

facilities.name: Cryo Slug Factory
facilities.description: Expanded facility incorporating targeting computer integration and dedicated weapon housing stamping. Higher throughput allows consistent production of ceramic-jacketed rounds optimized for thermal brittle-fracture mechanics.

facilities.name: Cryo Slug Manufactory
facilities.description: Sophisticated production complex with quantum control cores managing thermal ceramic curing and projectile geometry. Targeting computer arrays calibrate each slug for maximum freeze-on-impact consistency.

facilities.name: Cryo Slug Ordnance Complex
facilities.description: Cutting-edge facility combining quantum precision control with integrated coolant systems for ceramic jacketing and supercooling. Fully automated targeting computer networks and weapon housing assembly deliver production-line precision at maximum velocity.

facilities.name: Cryo Slug Press
facilities.description: Specialized ammunition line for precision-formed supercooled projectiles. Weapon housing and barrel assemblies ensure each slug meets exacting ballistic tolerances for reliable flash-freeze impact.

facilities.name: Cryo-Transport Manufacturing
facilities.description: An integrated facility combining storage unit assembly, coolant loop pressurization, and circuit board installation on a single conveyor system. Sensor arrays verify proper suspension fluid distribution at each stage.

facilities.name: Cryogenic Assembly Line
facilities.description: A purpose-built production line that assembles insulated storage vessels from steel and titanium components. Copper piping circuits maintain stable cooling loops throughout the assembly process.

facilities.name: Cryogenic Condensing Line
facilities.description: A specialized cooling plant that chills incoming gas streams to −186°C, liquefying argon for separation. Relies on superconductor coils and precision sensor control to maintain the deep-freeze needed for selective condensation.

facilities.name: Cryogenic Coolant Complex
facilities.description: The coldest industrial floor in the sector: superconductor-jacketed mixing vessels, helium recovery scrubbers, and coolant mains thick enough to walk through. Reactor contracts queue months out.

facilities.name: Cryogenic Coolant Plant
facilities.description: Expanded facility with multiple heat sinks and plasma injection points that manage the violent exothermic reaction between nitrogen and water at higher throughput. Coolant loops prevent thermal runaway while maintaining product stability.

facilities.name: Cryogenic Extraction Plant
facilities.description: Heavily automated complex with quantum-controlled assembly sequencing, precision-optic sensor alignment, and reinforced-frame construction for accelerated ice-harvester production.

facilities.name: Cryogenic Liquefaction Complex
facilities.description: Large-scale helium-cooled system with multiple compression and heat-exchange stages operating at extreme efficiency. Produces liquid hydrogen at industrial volumes with minimal energy loss.

facilities.name: Cryogenic Liquefaction Plant
facilities.description: Larger refrigeration plant with plasma-assisted condensation and active thermal cycling, substantially reducing liquefaction time per batch.

facilities.name: Cryogenic Oxygen Complex
facilities.description: Heavy-duty industrial facility with cascading coolant systems and reinforced containment for continuous oxygen liquefaction at scale. Multiple chemical liners and hazmat containers isolate different process stages and minimize boil-off loss.

facilities.name: Cryogenic Production Plant
facilities.description: Mid-scale facility with structural reinforcement supporting high-pressure helium and nitrogen handling. Expanded copper piping circuits allow parallel assembly of multiple coolant distribution pathways.

facilities.name: Cryogenic Production Vault
facilities.description: Heavy-duty manufacturing complex with precision-optic-guided chamber assembly and cryogenic-loop integration. Combines liquid-nitrogen systems, durasteel construction, and circuit integration in a 33-second production cycle.

facilities.name: Cryogenic Refinement Complex
facilities.description: Large-scale purification installation with active coolant loops and multi-stage plasma heating for rapid ice-to-liquid conversion. Integrated filtration and chemical polishing maintain stringent purity standards at high throughput.

facilities.name: Cryogenic Separation Plant
facilities.description: Heavy-duty mass-production facility with reinforced frames and distributed quantum control nodes managing parallel condensation stages. Precision optics and expanded sensor networks enable continuous high-speed argon filtering with minimal thermal loss.

facilities.name: Cryogenic Synthesis Array
facilities.description: Cutting-edge complex with advanced cryogenic management, quantum-core processing integration, precision-optic quality verification, and automated throughput optimization producing thermal harvesters at maximum speed.

facilities.name: Cryogenic Tritium Plant
facilities.description: Mass-production cryogenic facility employing multiple coolant loops and high-capacity plasma injectors to liquefy tritium at scale. Precision temperature regulation and automated feed systems sustain high output without thermal drift.

facilities.name: Cryogenic Upgrade Forge
facilities.description: Industrial plant combining thermal-plating installation, cryogenic system integration, and sensor calibration to produce advanced ice-harvester units at steady throughput.

facilities.name: Crystal Aging Works
facilities.description: A reinforced aging works with banks of low-gravity chambers and precision optics inspecting the glow on every bottle. Grand Marshal Korr would approve — if any stronghold but his own were allowed to make it this well.

facilities.name: Crystal Garden
facilities.description: A controlled thermal chamber where focused crystals and silicon ore combine with synthetic compounds to form ordered lattice structures. Heat sinks regulate temperature gradients during the growth cycle.

facilities.name: Crystal Glass Refinery
facilities.description: Larger furnace complex with heat sinks and plasma-assisted fluxing to accelerate cooling and clarify the leaded melt. Structural frames support rapid batch cycling.

facilities.name: Crystal Growth Chamber
facilities.description: Larger growth facility with multiple thermal zones and plasma-assisted nucleation to accelerate lattice formation. Structural frames support larger charge volumes and faster batch cycling.

facilities.name: Crystal Infusion Still
facilities.description: A premium operation that grinds energy crystals into moonshine and ages the result in low-gravity chambers until the suspension stabilizes into starshine. The sensor arrays guard the glow. Restricted to pirate strongholds.

facilities.name: Crystal Lattice Furnace
facilities.description: A heated chamber with precision plasma injection and controlled cooling circuits that fuse focused crystals and synthetic diamonds into ordered lattice structures. Multiple heat sinks manage the intense thermal cycling required for perfect crystalline alignment.

facilities.name: Crystal-Melt Sorbet Galley
facilities.description: Churn-freezers and effervescence rigs for the purest cold on the menu.

facilities.name: Crystal Mining Probe Line
facilities.description: A precision instrument line for neutron-assisted crystal extraction probes.

facilities.name: Crystal Optic Sensor Line
facilities.description: An assembly line that mounts trade-crystal focusing optics directly into circuit-board detection arrays — skipping the focused-crystal intermediate that other sensor lines depend on.

facilities.name: Crystal Refinery
facilities.description: Precision cutting apparatus with thermal management and energy crystal mounting stages. Uses palladium-enhanced focusing to reshape raw crystals into weapon-ready optics.

facilities.name: Crystal Resonance Lab
facilities.description: An expanded plant with dedicated titanium-alloy machining and precision crystal-mounting stations. Structural frames and control nodes accelerate assembly, doubling output efficiency.

facilities.name: Crystal Sensor Assembly
facilities.description: A specialized production line that combines circuit boards, focused crystals, and exotic-crystal integration with micro-thruster calibration. Coolant loops maintain stable temperatures during sensitive crystal-alignment procedures.

facilities.name: Crystal Synthesis Line
facilities.description: A specialized refining line that subjects power cells and purified argon to controlled plasma injection and heat cycling, fusing them with synthetic diamond to form stable energy crystals.

facilities.name: Crystalline Cradle
facilities.description: Ships are grown in crystalline cradles shaped by probability fields. The Voidborn consider each vessel a unique sculpture.
facilities.satisfied_description: Probability fields coax hull alloys into impossible shapes, each vessel growing as unique molecular sculpture. The Voidborn observe with satisfaction.
facilities.degraded_description: That's the philosophy, anyway. Growth patterns collapse into crude uniformity, probability fields losing coherence. Ships emerge functionally sound but philosophically offensive to their creators.
facilities.lore: Conventional shipyards cut, weld, and bolt. The Cradle grows. Probability fields coax hull alloys into shapes that shouldn't be structurally sound but demonstrably are. No two ships from the Cradle are identical at the molecular level, though they conform to standard class specifications. The Voidborn find mass production philosophically offensive.

facilities.name: Crystalline Forge
facilities.description: Dedicated refining facility with plasma-injection assist and heat-sink management for stable precious-metal bonding. Increased efficiency comes from optimized ore-feed sequencing and improved thermal stability across multiple synthesis chambers.

facilities.name: Crystalline Stim Works
facilities.description: A reinforced stim works with deep coolant banks and plasma injection driving the crystallization at scale. The purest nerve burn in the outer systems comes off lines like these — and so do the worst industrial accidents.

facilities.name: Crystalline Synthesis Plant
facilities.description: Industrial-scale growth system with integrated coolant loops and precision plasma seeding for consistent lattice orientation. Produces energy-grade crystals in continuous cycles with minimal defect rates.

facilities.name: Culture Tank
facilities.description: A compact refining apparatus that combines algae feedstock with purified water and synthetic compounds to generate light-producing cell cultures. Basic temperature and pressure control ensures consistent product quality.

facilities.name: Cultured Ration Press
facilities.description: A sealed seasoning, hydration, and pressing line that turns cultivated vatflesh curd into shelf-stable protein rations without relying on hunted meat.

facilities.name: Cutting-Edge Phase Drive Factory
facilities.description: Fully automated precision facility with shield emitters and extensive coolant infrastructure managing the extreme thermal and exotic-matter demands. Produces phase drives at peak efficiency with real-time dimensional validation.

facilities.name: Cutting-Edge Quantum Factory
facilities.description: State-of-the-art manufacturing complex employing full quantum-grade control systems, precision optical alignment, and fully integrated automated workflows for superconductor bonding and core assembly. Produces exotic processors at industrial scale.

facilities.name: Damage Control Center
facilities.description: Sealed parties standing by at the bulkheads with plate, foam and torches, waiting for the guns outside to point at somebody else for a moment. They cannot work a compartment that is still being opened up — nobody can — so they wait, and the instant the shelling shifts they are out and welding. The plate goes on hot, crooked, and at roughly six times what the same repair would cost anybody willing to wait.
facilities.satisfied_description: Parties closed up at the frames with plate stacked and ready, watching for the lull.
facilities.degraded_description: The parties are at their stations with nothing to weld. They are watching the same holes everyone else is.

facilities.name: Damage Control Station
facilities.description: A standing damage-control team and a well-stocked repair-kit locker, ready before a hull ever comes through the door. Cuts the repair bill for anyone who docks here hurt.
facilities.satisfied_description: The team's on standby, kits stacked and checked. Repairs go faster and cost less with a crew already staged for it.
facilities.degraded_description: The kit locker's empty and the team's been reassigned. Repairs here cost full price again.

facilities.name: Damage Control System Assembly Plant
facilities.description: Heavy-duty production complex with quantum-controlled assembly stations and integrated coolant loops for thermal management during high-speed manufacturing. Handles complex shield matrix assembly and multi-stage component testing.

facilities.name: Damage Control System Fabrication Nexus
facilities.description: State-of-the-art facility featuring fully automated quantum control cores, precision coolant circulation, and real-time component synchronization. Produces cutting-edge damage control systems at maximum efficiency with minimal human oversight.

facilities.name: Damage Control System Production Lab
facilities.description: Larger facility with parallel assembly tracks for shield matrices and quantum control integration. Produces defensive systems at significantly higher throughput through streamlined component coordination.

facilities.name: Damage Control System Workshop
facilities.description: A modular production line combining shield emitters with control nodes and repair subsystems. Steady output of defensive systems for station-class vessels.

facilities.name: Dark Energy Containment Reactor
facilities.description: A heavily shielded production facility designed to safely merge condensed dark matter with superconductors and plasma cells. Multiple heat sinks and plasma injectors manage the exotic reaction cascade under continuous monitoring.

facilities.name: Dark Matter Cell Factory
facilities.description: Industrial-scale production facility with gravity generators and quantum control cores enabling precise field manipulation during suspension. Integrated coolant loops and expanded stabilizer arrays handle multiple simultaneous encapsulations.

facilities.name: Dark Matter Condensation Complex
facilities.description: A fully automated, cutting-edge complex with redundant gravity systems, advanced coolant loops, shield emitters for containment integrity, and quantum stabilizers working in concert to achieve maximum output with unmatched precision.

facilities.name: Dark Matter Condensing Line
facilities.description: A specialized refining line with quantum stabilization chambers and dark-matter cells to compress residue into stable condensate. Gravity generators assist in the compression phase.

facilities.name: Dark Matter Condensing Plant
facilities.description: An expanded plant with multiple stabilization loops and enhanced quantum control, processing dark matter residue at significantly higher throughput while maintaining structural integrity.

facilities.name: Dark Matter Condensing Works
facilities.description: Heavy-duty industrial equipment featuring gravity generators, reinforced containment frames, and distributed quantum control cores for continuous high-volume condensation with minimal downtime.

facilities.name: Dark Matter Containment Complex
facilities.description: Cutting-edge installation featuring distributed gravity generation, redundant quantum control systems, shield emitters for particle containment, and advanced cryogenic circulation achieving microsecond-precision suspension. Represents pinnacle of dark matter sealing technology.

facilities.name: Dark Matter Containment Plant
facilities.description: Enhanced containment plant with expanded quantum stabilization capacity and improved cryogenic efficiency, reducing suspension time while maintaining integrity. Structural reinforcement supports higher operational pressures.

facilities.name: Dark Matter Engine Assembly
facilities.description: Specialized propulsion line handling volatile dark matter cells and quantum stabilizers. Integrates engine cores with thruster nozzles to create exotic propulsion units.

facilities.name: Dark Matter Projection Manufacturing
facilities.description: Advanced weapons plant with reinforced structural frames and multiple assembly stages for exotic material conditioning. Significantly accelerates dark matter concentration and weapon housing integration.

facilities.name: Dark Matter Reactor
facilities.description: A containment core running on suspended dark matter cells — expensive to build and expensive to keep fed, but one of these does the work of several fuel-cell plants.
facilities.satisfied_description: Containment fields glow a steady, unsettling violet. Output is well beyond what a fuel-cell plant could manage.
facilities.degraded_description: The containment fields are drawing down — dark matter cells are running low, and nobody's in a hurry to cut corners on this reactor's fuel.

facilities.name: Dark Matter Sealing Station
facilities.description: Specialized cryogenic sealing station with hydrogen cooling and quantum stabilization equipment to safely suspend condensed dark matter in containment cells. Lead-shielded work zones protect against exotic particle emissions.

facilities.name: Darksteel Forge
facilities.description: Expanded production facility with multiple plasma injection stages and integrated heat sinks that accelerate ore processing while maintaining material integrity. Control nodes orchestrate the sequential heating and cooling cycles required for consistent output.

facilities.name: Darksteel Forging Complex
facilities.description: State-of-the-art facility featuring modular plasma injection arrays, cryogenic coolant distribution, and precision control nodes that optimize every stage of ore-to-plating conversion. Reinforced structural framing absorbs the stresses of extreme-duty continuous operation.

facilities.name: Darksteel Forging Plant
facilities.description: Industrial-scale refinery with redundant plasma injection systems and an extensive coolant loop network that cycles through reinforced frames, enabling rapid throughput without thermal degradation. Automated material staging feeds ore continuously into the processing chambers.

facilities.name: Darksteel Hammer Shop
facilities.description: A specialized thermal processing line equipped with plasma injectors and precision cooling loops to transform raw darksteel ore into combat-grade plating. Copper piping routes coolant through the work chambers to manage the intense heat of refinement.

facilities.name: Darksteel Plating Line
facilities.description: Purpose-built production line for darksteel alloy armor assembly. Combines darksteel plating with adamantite reinforcement and hull components into finished armor plates.

facilities.name: Deep Field Detection Works
facilities.description: Heavy industrial equipment with quantum control cores and trade-crystal optical benches for mass production of long-range multi-spectrum sensor arrays — the backbone of the Federation's deep-field tracking network.

facilities.name: Deep Space Exploration Plant
facilities.description: Heavy-duty complex with reinforced frames and expanded coolant circulation managing multi-stage probe assembly. Produces deep space probes at scale with enhanced component reliability and sensor precision.

facilities.name: Deep Space Probe Nexus
facilities.description: Cutting-edge automated facility with reinforced structural integration, extensive coolant networks, and quantum-level component synchronization. Produces advanced deep space probes at maximum efficiency with superior sensor and propulsion characteristics.

facilities.name: Deep Space Probe Works
facilities.description: Enhanced facility with structural frame components and integrated coolant systems for thermal stability during assembly. Increases probe production speed through optimized sensor and thruster integration.

facilities.name: Deep Space Scanner
facilities.description: A phased subspace antenna that extends the faction's sensor reach to POIs one system jump away. Scan power is highest at the facility's own POI and falls off with each step of distance, so contacts in neighbouring systems are harder to resolve than local ones. Upgrade to a Long-Range Subspace Sensor (L3) to reach two jumps out.

facilities.name: Defense Platform Assembly Line
facilities.description: A specialized production line that integrates weapons housings, sensor arrays, and processing cores into unified defense platforms. Copper piping carries power and control signals throughout the assembly sequence.

facilities.name: Defensive Perimeter Battery Assembly
facilities.description: Complex production line for advanced flak systems requiring dual tracking modules, dual sensor arrays, and metamaterial panel integration. Steel framing and extensive control infrastructure coordinate the precision work needed for perimeter-scale defensive coverage.

facilities.name: Dense Projectile Forge
facilities.description: Industrial mass-production system with quantum-guided forming dies and automated targeting-computer verification. Each slug receives ballistic profile analysis before final packaging.

facilities.name: Detection Systems
facilities.description: Heavy-duty industrial equipment featuring advanced processing cores, precision optics systems, and quantum control for mass production of sophisticated multi-spectrum sensor arrays.

facilities.name: Deuterium Conversion Complex
facilities.description: State-of-the-art automated facility featuring precision cryogenic control, multi-stage plasma conversion, and integrated cooling networks for rapid, reliable liquid tritium production.

facilities.name: Diamond Fusion Furnace
facilities.description: A precision thermal chamber that fuses synthetic diamond under controlled conditions to produce transparent reinforced glass for viewports and sensor arrays.

facilities.name: Diamond Fusion Works
facilities.description: Expanded high-temperature facility with improved thermal control and faster cooling cycles, producing reinforced glass at increased throughput without sacrificing optical clarity.

facilities.name: Diamond Synthesis Plant
facilities.description: Industrial-scale reactor array with active thermal regulation and plasma beam steering. Grows diamond material continuously through carefully managed pressure zones and real-time crystal monitoring.

facilities.name: Diamond Synthesis Reactor
facilities.description: Cutting-edge facility with parallel fusion chambers, real-time optical verification, and dynamic thermal management for near-instantaneous reinforced glass synthesis.

facilities.name: Differential Pressure Neon Filter
facilities.description: Larger separator with independent cooling circuits and structural reinforcement to handle sustained mining loads. Processing cores dynamically adjust thermal gradient setpoints based on incoming gas composition detected by sensor arrays.

facilities.name: Dimensional Anchor Assembly Station
facilities.description: A precision facility handling exotic components—dark matter cells and quantum stabilizers require specialized containment and calibration. Integrated gravity generators and shield emitters demand careful alignment before assembly.

facilities.name: Dimensional Barrier Foundry
facilities.description: Heavy-duty industrial facility with quantum control cores, extensive coolant loops, and reinforced framing for high-volume shield production. Precision emitter arrays and matrix synthesis deliver superior adaptive performance.

facilities.name: Dimensional Breach Arsenal
facilities.description: State-of-the-art fully automated facility with active coolant circulation around all phase-drive assemblies and antimatter containment zones. Robotic precision arms perform every step of integration, from phase-drive bonding to final dimensional lock, at speeds that maintain perfect phase alignment.

facilities.name: Dimensional Breach Foundry
facilities.description: Heavy industrial production with parallel assembly tracks, automated quantum alignment gantries, and in-line spectral verification. Targeting computers are integrated during the final dimensional-lock sequence, dramatically accelerating throughput.

facilities.name: Dimensional Convergence Array
facilities.description: Cutting-edge facility where quantum control cores maintain dimensional stability during void crystal integration and exotic matrix entanglement. Coolant loops circulate through containment vessels; full automation ensures each legendary shield achieves perfect quantum coherence and dimensional resonance.

facilities.name: Dimensional Energy Storage Plant
facilities.description: Expanded facility with structural frames supporting larger superconductor arrays and enhanced hull plating integration. Increased throughput handles higher volumes of null matter conditioning.

facilities.name: Dimensional Essence Works
facilities.description: A fully automated, state-of-the-art complex with redundant thermal management, precision plasma injection systems, and sophisticated coolant networks maintaining optimal conditions for maximum void essence throughput.

facilities.name: Dimensional Forge
facilities.description: Cutting-edge production plant combining extensive dark-matter containment, gravity-field manipulation arrays, advanced quantum control, shield emitters for exotic containment, and comprehensive coolant circulation. Achieves maximum coil output with minimal exotic-material degradation.

facilities.name: Dimensional Gateway Foundry
facilities.description: Industrial-scale facility with advanced dark matter shielding, gravity generator arrays, and multi-stage quantum stabilization. Produces hyperspace-capable cores with enhanced exotic crystal fusion rates.

facilities.name: Dimensional Harmonic Nexus
facilities.description: Cutting-edge automated refinery featuring quantum-controlled dark matter cells, precision gravity generators, and shield emitters for exotic phase stabilization. Coolant circulation maintains cryogenic conditions essential for maximum phase-matrix coherence and output rate.

facilities.name: Dimensional Integration Lab
facilities.description: An expanded facility with multiple dark-matter containment stations and quantum stabilizer assembly tracks. Structural reinforcement accommodates the exotic materials involved in phased-optics production.

facilities.name: Dimensional Propulsion Works
facilities.description: An enlarged facility with enhanced dark-matter handling and reinforced structural support, delivering faster production cycles. Quantum control cores and gravity generators begin integration into the assembly sequence.

facilities.name: Dimensional Shield Foundry
facilities.description: A fully automated, cutting-edge production complex with redundant quantum control systems, distributed shield emitter networks, and precision coolant loops enabling ultra-fast assembly of advanced shield matrices.

facilities.name: Dimensional Shifter
facilities.description: A specialized industrial line for jump-coil integration and stabilized-exotic refinement. Dark matter cells are carefully sequenced through containment stages to maintain quantum matrix integrity.

facilities.name: Dimensional Stabilization Plant
facilities.description: Cutting-edge facility with full gravity manipulation, shield emitters, redundant dark-matter containment, and cryogenic cooling—achieving near-continuous exotic stabilization.

facilities.name: Dimensional Transit Forge
facilities.description: Cutting-edge facility with full cryogenic integration and gravitational field stabilization throughout. Coolant loops, shield emitters, and quantum control systems operate in concert to produce phase drives at maximum efficiency.

facilities.name: Dimensional Vault
facilities.description: Items folded into stable dimensional pockets. They occupy no physical space, but retrieval requires a brief negotiation with local spacetime.
facilities.satisfied_description: Dimensional pockets hold stable, items folding and unfolding through spacetime with only brief negotiation. Nothing has ever been permanently lost.
facilities.degraded_description: At least, when supplies hold out. Pocket dimensions destabilize, retrieval times extending into minutes or hours. Items return subtly wrong or not at all, testing the definition of 'permanent.'
facilities.lore: Storage at Nexus Prime doesn't occupy volume — items are folded into stable pocket dimensions tethered to the station's coordinate frame. Retrieval is instantaneous once the dimensional address resolves, which usually takes a few seconds. Occasionally longer. The Voidborn assure visitors that nothing has ever been permanently lost. Their definition of 'permanent' is unsettling.

facilities.name: Dining Hall Fabrication Unit
facilities.description: A structured production facility assembling titanium galley lines, flex polymer finishes, and processing-core-managed service systems into full restaurant decks. Sensor arrays verify kitchen ventilation and wine-cellar climate control.

facilities.name: Directed Energy Arsenal
facilities.description: Industrial-scale laser fabrication using quantum control cores to align crystal focusing arrays with nanometer precision. Reinforced frames support advanced alignment equipment; targeting computers enable pre-delivery performance validation.

facilities.name: Dispersal Plasma Factory
facilities.description: Larger facility with robust coolant circulation to manage the thermal complexity of dispersal plasma synthesis. Structural reinforcement and multiple synthesis chambers enable consistent high-volume production.

facilities.name: Dispersal Plasma Manufactory
facilities.description: Heavy-scale production complex with extensive coolant networks and reinforced frame systems supporting sustained dispersal plasma generation. Multiple parallel reaction lines ensure steady industrial-grade output.

facilities.name: Dispersal Plasma Ordnance Complex
facilities.description: State-of-the-art facility featuring redundant coolant systems and precision-tuned control nodes optimizing ion-ceramite dispersion dynamics. Reinforced construction throughout enables maximum throughput of thermally dispersive plasma cells.

facilities.name: Dispersal Plasma Press

facilities.description: A containment foundry that fuses phase-pearl, quantum-silk, and umbral residue into a single exotic lattice. The reaction would tear a lesser rig apart — a rare and prestigious installation.

facilities.name: Exotic Matter Assembly
