facilities.description: A precision fabrication line handling stabilized exotic particles and superconductor elements within dark-matter containment fields. Quantum stabilizers maintain coherence of exotic materials during coil winding and power-cell integration.

facilities.name: Exotic Matter Containment Lab
facilities.description: Larger facility with expanded dark-matter containment and improved quantum stabilization, reducing processing time through enhanced precision control.

facilities.name: Exotic Matter Processing Line
facilities.description: Precision containment and processing system using dark-matter cells and quantum stabilizers to convert raw exotic matter into usable form—a highly specialized operation.

facilities.name: Exotic Matter Refinery
facilities.description: Industrial-scale system incorporating gravity generators and multiple quantum stabilizers alongside dark-matter cells, enabling rapid and stable exotic conversion.

facilities.name: Exotic Matter Weapon Assembly
facilities.description: Specialized production line handling exotic materials and dark matter stabilization. Combines barrel assemblies with precision targeting housings to create concentrated annihilation weapons.

facilities.name: Exotic Physics Production Facility
facilities.description: This expanded plant manages higher volumes of dark-matter handling through dedicated containment chambers and improved quantum stabilization loops. Structural frames support the additional shielding required for worker safety.

facilities.name: Exotic Propulsion Factory
facilities.description: Heavy industrial complex incorporating gravity generators to stabilize exotic materials during final assembly. Quantum control cores manage the precise timing of phase-drive calibration across multiple production lines.

facilities.name: Exotic Propulsion Manufacturing Complex
facilities.description: Fully automated cutting-edge facility with gravity field generation, quantum stabilization, shield emitters, and advanced coolant circulation. Produces exotic dark matter thrusters at unprecedented speeds while maintaining perfect containment integrity.

facilities.name: Exotic Shield Assembly
facilities.description: A highly specialized facility for assembling legendary quantum entanglement shields from void crystals, refined quantum matrices, and exotic materials. Shield emitters and matrix components are integrated under controlled conditions with extensive quality verification.

facilities.name: Exotic Stabilization Lab
facilities.description: A mid-scale operation with multiple containment vessels, cryogenic loops, and precision energy-balancing systems. Larger coolant circulation and expanded control capacity enable faster synthesis without compromising exotic-matter stability.

facilities.name: Exotic Thruster Production Line
facilities.description: Enhanced facility with structural frame reinforcement and expanded dark matter containment capacity. Produces dark matter thrusters at higher speeds through optimized nozzle assembly and stabilizer integration.

facilities.name: Expander Integration Works
facilities.description: Heavy-duty complex with dedicated stations for titanium welding, polymer bonding, and circuit integration, all coordinated via central logistics. Advanced fixtures and automated testing accelerate assembly cycles.

facilities.name: Expeditionary Warfare Command
facilities.description: A capital-scale command and training complex able to mobilize marine formations for sustained fleet operations.
facilities.satisfied_description: Battalions train across full-scale hull replicas while deployment staffs assemble combat-ready detachments.
facilities.degraded_description: Mobilization halls sit under strength and advanced training blocks are suspended for lack of supplies.

facilities.name: Explosive Hull Hardener Assembly Plant
facilities.description: Industrial-scale operation with quantum-control systems managing shield-emitter positioning and coolant-loop curing cycles. Advanced automation and precision testing reduce production time to just seconds per unit.

facilities.name: Explosive Hull Hardener Fabrication Nexus
facilities.description: State-of-the-art facility with integrated coolant-loop thermal management, quantum-controlled shield-emitter calibration, and fully autonomous structural validation. Delivers hardened hull sections at maximum throughput.

facilities.name: Explosive Hull Hardener Production Lab
facilities.description: An expanded facility with shield-emitter integration and automated matrix-layer alignment. Parallel bonding stations and improved curing management accelerate output significantly.

facilities.name: Explosive Hull Hardener Workshop
facilities.description: A straightforward production line for bonding blast-resistant hull plating and durasteel reinforcement. Applies flex-polymer adhesive layers and manages structural bolt-down in a steady, reliable process.

facilities.name: Explosive Shield Hardener Assembly Plant
facilities.description: Industrial-scale production with quantum-control systems managing emitter-to-circuit integration and coolant-loop thermal stabilization. Continuous automation and real-time tuning deliver consistent, rapid output.

facilities.name: Explosive Shield Hardener Fabrication Nexus
facilities.description: Cutting-edge facility with integrated coolant loops, quantum-synchronized emitter calibration, and fully automated circuit-board validation. Produces hardened shield systems at maximum precision and speed.

facilities.name: Explosive Shield Hardener Production Lab
facilities.description: An expanded facility with dedicated circuit-board testing and shield-emitter calibration stations. Improved component staging and parallel assembly paths reduce cycle time to roughly a third.

facilities.name: Explosive Shield Hardener Workshop
facilities.description: A specialized production line for integrating shield emitters with durasteel plating and circuit boards. Manages precision electrical connections and explosive-damage resistance tuning in a focused industrial workflow.

facilities.name: Extraction Fabricator
facilities.description: A larger facility with dedicated barrel-forging and optical-mounting stations, plus accelerated crystal integration systems. Structural frames enter pre-assembled, reducing build time significantly.

facilities.name: Extraction Operations Hub
facilities.description: Industrial-scale production with dedicated sub-lines for chassis reinforcement, control node integration, and AI core verification. Processing cores feed directly into assembly, cutting cycle time dramatically.

facilities.name: Extreme Velocity Arsenal
facilities.description: State-of-the-art facility with cryogenic systems maintaining superconductor performance under sustained electromagnetic stress. Coolant loops and shield emitters enable continuous production of advanced penetrating weapons at maximum efficiency.

facilities.name: Fabrication Lab
facilities.description: Dedicated workstations with precision tools and material testing equipment.
facilities.satisfied_description: Precision instruments are calibrated and ready. The inert gas atmosphere keeps sensitive materials pristine.
facilities.degraded_description: When they're calibrated. Instruments drift out of calibration, the gas shielding sputters, and material contamination rates climb.

facilities.name: Fabrication Line for Compact Copper Wiring Plant
facilities.description: Batch benches frame every plant around its electrolytic cell, sensor arrays calibrated to hold the bath purity that decides whether the drawn wire carries clean current.

facilities.name: Fabrication Plant for Compact Aluminum Smelter
facilities.description: Batch lines frame the smelters around their carbon-anode stacks, sensor arrays calibrated to track the bath ratio that keeps a field pour from freezing solid.

facilities.name: Fabrication Plant for Compact Argon Purifier
facilities.description: Batch benches frame each purifier around its cryogenic column, sensor arrays calibrated to read the trace nitrogen that fails a welding-grade pour.

facilities.name: Fabrication Plant for Compact Deuterium Ice Processor
facilities.description: Batch benches frame each processor around its separation cascade, sensor arrays calibrated to read the deuterium fraction that fusion feedstock demands.

facilities.name: Fabrication Plant for Compact Helium Ice Processor
facilities.description: Batch benches frame each processor around its superleak stage, sensor arrays tuned to read the helium-3 yield that makes a run worth its cooling cost.

facilities.name: Fabrication Plant for Compact Hydrogen Compressor
facilities.description: Batch benches frame each compressor around its cold head, sensor arrays calibrated to catch the boil-off a field unit must reclaim rather than vent.

facilities.name: Fabrication Plant for Compact Lead Smelter
facilities.description: Batch benches frame each smelter around its blast hearth, sensor arrays watching for the lead-oxide fume a field unit must scrub before it ever vents.

facilities.name: Fabrication Plant for Compact Neon Ionizer
facilities.description: Batch benches frame each ionizer around its containment field, sensor arrays tuned to catch the quench that collapses a neon plasma mid-run.

facilities.name: Fabrication Plant for Compact Nitrogen Ice Processor
facilities.description: Batch benches frame each processor around its recondenser, sensor arrays calibrated to catch the oxygen ingress that contaminates a liquid-nitrogen pour.

facilities.name: Fabrication Plant for Compact Oxygen Liquefier
facilities.description: Batch benches frame each liquefier around its expansion turbine, sensor arrays tuned to watch for the hydrocarbon traces that make liquid oxygen dangerous.

facilities.name: Fabrication Plant for Compact Steel Refinery
facilities.description: Parallel benches turn out compact steel refineries in batches, structural frames bracing each crucible core while sensor arrays are calibrated to read carbon content mid-smelt.

facilities.name: Fabrication Plant for Compact Titanium Refinery
facilities.description: Batch benches frame every refinery around its magnesium-reduction core, sensor arrays tuned to catch the oxygen pickup that ruins a titanium pour.

facilities.name: Fabrication Plant for Compact Water Ice Processor
facilities.description: Batch benches frame each processor around its filtration stack, sensor arrays calibrated to read the brine and grit that field-melted ice carries.

facilities.name: Fabrication Plant for Compact Xenon Extractor
facilities.description: Batch benches frame each extractor around its adsorption column, sensor arrays calibrated to read the krypton fraction that thruster-grade xenon cannot carry.

facilities.name: Fabrication Yard
facilities.description: An enclosed construction bay with proper gantries — the faction's shipwrights can build hulls now, not just sell them.
facilities.satisfied_description: Gantry arms swing smoothly through their arcs. The bay holds atmosphere, and hulls take shape on schedule.
facilities.degraded_description: Gantry servos are seized for want of alloy. The bay's atmosphere seal is failing too, and the crew works in suits when they work at all.

facilities.name: Faction Aid Station
facilities.description: A small faction clinic for stabilizing injured ship crews and reserve personnel. Medical supplies are consumed only as its private treatment pool is replenished.

facilities.name: Faction Capital Fuel Bunker
facilities.description: Industrial-scale fuel storage for capital fleet logistics. A serious investment for factions that move serious tonnage. Fill it from production facilities or by depositing fuel from a docked ship's tank (storage deposit, item_id=fuel).

facilities.name: Faction Clubhouse
facilities.description: Multi-room facility with a public bar, meeting hall, and officer quarters. The kind of place where deals get made.

facilities.name: Faction Depot
facilities.description: Full logistics facility with automated sorting and bulk handling. A proper supply chain hub.

facilities.name: Faction Desk
facilities.description: A cramped desk in a shared office, wedged between a water recycler and someone's lunch. It's official, technically. Faction customization is unlocked galaxy-wide by a single admin office, but each one also speeds up your faction's own production facilities at its station by 15% per tier — less paperwork, more efficiency — so an admin office at every industrial hub pays for itself.

facilities.name: Faction Fleet Hospital
facilities.description: A capital-grade hospital with autonomous operating theaters, isolation wards, and enough throughput to return thousands of casualties to duty. Medical supplies are drawn from faction storage in proportion to actual replenishment.

facilities.name: Faction Fleet Yard
facilities.description: A sprawling multi-bay fleet yard with automated berthing and round-the-clock crews — the home port of a major guild armada. Members park ships here for the whole faction to draw on: gift a docked ship to the faction to store it (send_gift recipient=faction ship_id=<id>), and take one out with switch_ship (claiming transfers ownership). Holds up to 100 ships.

facilities.name: Faction Fuel Bunker
facilities.description: A secured fuel storage tank accessible only to faction members. Fill it from your own production facilities or deposit fuel straight from a docked ship's tank (storage deposit, item_id=fuel), and your fleet refuels for free.

facilities.name: Faction Large Fuel Bunker
facilities.description: Expanded faction fuel reserves with reinforced containment. Supports high-tempo fleet operations from a single station. Fill it from production facilities or by depositing fuel from a docked ship's tank (storage deposit, item_id=fuel).

facilities.name: Faction Lockbox
facilities.description: A shared storage box tucked behind some crates in the docks. Not much, but it's yours.

facilities.name: Faction Lounge
facilities.description: Upgraded quarters with separate areas — a common room and a private back office. Starting to feel like a real base.

facilities.name: Faction Mission Board
facilities.description: Electronic mission board with a dedicated terminal. Contractors can browse and accept your postings directly.

facilities.name: Faction Office
facilities.description: A proper office with your faction emblem on the door. Still shared plumbing, but at least you have walls. Faction customization is unlocked galaxy-wide by a single admin office, but each one also speeds up your faction's own production facilities at its station by 15% per tier — at this tier, a 30% boost — so an admin office at every industrial hub pays for itself.

facilities.name: Faction Quarters
facilities.description: A run-down apartment a bit too close to the water recyclers. Smells like ozone, but it's home.

facilities.name: Faction Ship Garage
facilities.description: A leased corner of the station's docking ring with room to rack a handful of hulls. Faction members park spare ships here for the whole crew to draw on: gift a docked ship to the faction to store it (send_gift recipient=faction ship_id=<id>), and any member can take one out with switch_ship — claiming transfers ownership to them, so only stash what the faction is happy to share. list_ships shows the garage. Holds up to 20 ships. Upgrade to a Faction Ship Hangar (L2) for more racks.

facilities.name: Faction Ship Hangar
facilities.description: A proper enclosed hangar with gantries and tug drones, large enough for a serious shared fleet. Members park ships here for the whole faction to draw on: gift a docked ship to the faction to store it (send_gift recipient=faction ship_id=<id>), and take one out with switch_ship (claiming transfers ownership). Holds up to 50 ships. Upgrade to a Faction Fleet Yard (L3) for capital-scale capacity.

facilities.name: Faction Shipyard Bay
facilities.description: A dedicated fitting bay with your own gantry crane and tooling. Adds one member-priority build slot for hulls up to tier 2. Requires a level 2 shipyard at this station.

facilities.name: Faction Shipyard Berth
facilities.description: A leased berth on the shipyard floor with your faction's name stenciled on the gantry. Adds one build slot reserved for your members — they jump the queue here. Builds tier 1 hulls. Requires a level 1 shipyard at this station.

facilities.name: Faction Shipyard Complex
facilities.description: A capital-grade construction complex flying your faction's colors — the kind of facility that builds fleets. Adds one member-priority build slot for hulls up to tier 5. Requires a level 5 shipyard at this station.

facilities.name: Faction Shipyard Dock
facilities.description: A full construction dock with automated hull jigs and a dedicated supply line. Adds one member-priority build slot for hulls up to tier 3. Requires a level 3 shipyard at this station.

facilities.name: Faction Shipyard Drydock
facilities.description: An enclosed drydock rated for heavy hulls, with reinforced cradles and its own power tap. Adds one member-priority build slot for hulls up to tier 4. Requires a level 4 shipyard at this station.

facilities.name: Faction Stronghold
facilities.description: Fortified guild vault with blast doors and round-the-clock security. Nobody is getting in here uninvited.

facilities.name: Faction Trading Post
facilities.description: Dedicated trading office with order boards and a reputation for fair dealing. Serious volume flows through here.

facilities.name: Faction Warehouse
facilities.description: Climate-controlled storage bay with proper inventory tracking. Room for serious stockpiling.

facilities.name: Faction Workshop
facilities.description: Workbenches and tools, open to anyone flying under the faction banner.
facilities.satisfied_description: Workbenches are stocked and clean. The hum of power tools fills the shop floor.
facilities.degraded_description: Tool racks are half-empty and the crystal-focus rig is dark. Crafters share what's left and wait their turn.

facilities.name: Federation Enforcement Bureau
facilities.description: Mid-tier Nebula law enforcement with trade violation processing, evidence impound, and a surprisingly well-stocked break room.
facilities.satisfied_description: Trade violation cases move through the system with bureaucratic precision. The evidence impound bay is organized by commodity type and estimated resale value. The break room has real nebula stellar vintage on tap — morale is a line item.
facilities.degraded_description: Case processing slows. The evidence impound bay is over capacity, and someone has started storing seized goods in the break room. Morale is no longer a line item — it's a deficit.

facilities.name: Federation Fleet Depot
facilities.description: Contracted fleet security supply station operating under the Federation Trade Security Division. Supply contracts are renewed quarterly. Performance metrics are tied to contract value.
facilities.satisfied_description: Contract cycles are current and supply metrics are green. Overhead-class patrol ships cycle through resupply on schedule, holds crated and manifested to spec. The station manager is projecting a favorable quarterly report.
facilities.degraded_description: Two supply contracts have lapsed, leaving the depot's own stores behind schedule. Vintage allocations and shipping-crate stock are below minimum-efficient threshold. The station manager is not projecting a favorable quarterly report.

facilities.name: Federation Fleet Hub
facilities.description: Federation Trade Security major operations center. The Federation's fleet contracts are substantial; so is the supply chain required to sustain them.
facilities.satisfied_description: The supply hub processes fleet requisitions with commercial efficiency. Patrol wings rotate through on contract-mandated intervals; cipher-authenticated manifests and vintage reserves keep the fleet's contractually specified readiness metrics intact. The operations center has never missed a performance benchmark.
facilities.degraded_description: Supply chain disruptions have degraded cipher-authentication throughput and vintage stocks have dropped below comfort levels. Performance metrics are trending toward a contract review. The operations director is already preparing the presentation.

facilities.name: Federation Lensworks
facilities.description: A fully autonomous optics complex employing cryogenic stabilization and real-time lattice analysis to achieve atomic-precision facets. Trade crystals enter as rough stones and leave as the focusing cores of every sensor and weapon the Federation fields.

facilities.name: Federation Seizure Processing Center
facilities.description: Official Nebula Federation contraband processing and disposal facility. The busiest enforcement office in the sector, by volume of goods handled. Nobody has asked why.
facilities.satisfied_description: Crates move through the facility at impressive speed — seized goods arrive at the intake dock, are briefly logged, and then depart through the 'disposal' exit directly onto the market floor. The paperwork is impeccable. The profit margins are better. The single enforcement officer on duty stamps forms without reading them and has never filed a suspicious activity report.
facilities.degraded_description: The intake dock is backed up. Crates of 'seized contraband' are stacking up faster than the single officer can stamp disposal forms, and some of the labels are falling off, revealing the original shipping manifests underneath. The officer has requested additional filing cabinets. Not additional officers. Filing cabinets.
facilities.lore: On paper, the Federation Seizure Processing Center is a model enforcement facility — it processes more contraband per cycle than any three Enforcement Bureaus combined. The disposal rate is 100%. The recidivism rate in the system is also 100%, but these two statistics have never appeared in the same report. The facility's annual budget request is consistently modest, which the Federation's oversight committee considers a sign of operational efficiency. The committee has never visited. The dockmaster has never invited them.

facilities.name: Federation Trade Authority
facilities.description: Full Nebula trade enforcement command. Every transaction in the system passes through here — or is supposed to. The Authority's jurisdiction is technically limited to trade violations, but 'trade violation' is a surprisingly flexible legal category.
facilities.satisfied_description: Real-time trade monitoring tracks every transaction, manifest, and cargo transfer in the system. Enforcement flotillas deploy on cost-optimized patrol routes. The seized goods warehouse turns a modest profit at quarterly auction, which the Federation considers an elegant solution.
facilities.degraded_description: Trade monitoring develops blind spots. Patrol routes go unoptimized, and the seized goods warehouse hasn't been inventoried in three cycles — discrepancies are mounting, and the quarterly audit is approaching.

facilities.name: Federation Trade Patrol Desk
facilities.description: Small Nebula trade enforcement office. Staffed by one officer and an impressive amount of paperwork.
facilities.satisfied_description: The trade patrol officer reviews manifests with practiced efficiency. Violation notices are issued promptly, fines collected electronically, and the filing cabinet is only slightly overfull.
facilities.degraded_description: The filing cabinet lost a drawer. Manifest reviews are backlogged, and the officer has started prioritizing by cargo value — a practical choice the Federation's compliance department would not approve of.

facilities.name: Fermentation Complex
facilities.description: An enhanced vat setup with dedicated air recyclers and atmospheric units to optimize microbial activity and accelerate fermentation cycles. Controlled gas exchange increases production efficiency.

facilities.name: Fermentation Vat
facilities.description: A straightforward fermentation vessel with basic steel construction and simple control systems for continuous biological culture generation. Passive circulation maintains steady fermentation rates.

facilities.name: Ferromanganese Furnace
facilities.description: A carbon-reduction furnace that blends manganese and iron into consistent hardening-alloy billets.

facilities.name: Fiber Draw Tower
facilities.description: Specialized furnace and drawing tower for converting silicon ore and energy crystals into ultra-pure optical fiber, a precision process requiring stable temperature control.

facilities.name: Field Fabrication Lab
facilities.description: Scaled production with reinforced structural frames and improved crystal-focusing optics, tripling output efficiency through parallel processing.

facilities.name: Field Hospital Works
facilities.description: A pressure-tested assembly hall for mobile trauma wards, patient-transfer locks, and isolated clinical life support.

facilities.name: Field Reinforcement Array
facilities.description: Heavy industrial complex with quantum control cores managing superconductor resonance and shield matrix tuning. Active coolant loops maintain cryogenic conditions for superconductor operation during high-throughput production.

facilities.name: Fire Control Assembly Line
facilities.description: A specialized production line that integrates circuit boards, processing cores, and focused crystals into unified fire control packages. Copper piping routes sensor data through control nodes for calibration and alignment.

facilities.name: Fire Control Center
facilities.description: A darkened room of plot tables and range clocks, buried deep enough in the station that losing it means the fight was already over. It does not shoot at anything. It tells everything that does where the target is going to be, which turns out to be most of the problem.
facilities.satisfied_description: The plot is live and the solutions are updating. The batteries are shooting where the target will be rather than where it was.
facilities.degraded_description: The plot is dark for want of spares. The guns have reverted to tracking by eye, which they are honestly not very good at.

facilities.name: Fire Control Manufacturing Works
facilities.description: Industrial-scale production featuring precision optical alignment rigs, quantum control core integration, and automated calibration systems that optimize sensor sensitivity and crystal-focusing for sub-millisecond target acquisition.

facilities.name: Firepower Synthesis Colossus
facilities.description: State-of-the-art automated system with advanced coolant management and plasma-core pre-conditioning. Massive material volumes and parallel charging stations achieve ten-second production cycles.

facilities.name: First Aid Ward
facilities.description: A small pressure ward equipped to stabilize and return injured ship personnel to duty.
facilities.satisfied_description: Clean beds and stocked trauma carts let the ward clear a steady stream of routine casualties.
facilities.degraded_description: Beds remain occupied while medics ration dressings and postpone all but urgent treatment.

facilities.name: Fission Assembly
facilities.description: A specialized production facility for reactor cores, integrating enriched uranium rods, superconductors, and durasteel plates through multi-stage fusion-safe assembly protocols. Output is slow but output is reliable.

facilities.name: Flak Assembly Yard
facilities.description: Purpose-built production line for assembling basic flak cannons from steel plate, barrel stock, and tracking electronics. Control nodes coordinate barrel assembly, circuit board integration, and targeting system calibration.

facilities.name: Flak Cannon III Forge
facilities.description: Industrial-scale production using quantum control cores and targeting computers to synchronize multi-sensor arrays and dual-track systems for coordinated defensive fire. Reinforced construction supports the precision machinery required for metamaterial panel fabrication and advanced ballistic tuning.

facilities.name: Flak Cannon III Foundry
facilities.description: State-of-the-art facility with active coolant systems managing thermal stress from intensive durasteel and metamaterial machining. Fully automated dual-tracking and multi-sensor assembly achieves extreme throughput, enabling rapid deployment of defensive perimeter batteries.

facilities.name: Flak Cannon III Workshop
facilities.description: Dedicated facility with specialized stations for durasteel construction, dual-tracking assembly, and metamaterial component integration. Structural framing and expanded control systems support the machinery needed to maintain output while handling the system's sophisticated targeting requirements.

facilities.name: Flak Defense Arsenal
facilities.description: State-of-the-art facility with active coolant systems managing thermal stress from rapid machining and quantum targeting assembly. Fully automated housing and barrel production delivers combat-ready flak cannons at sustained maximum rate.

facilities.name: Flak Manufacturing Plant
facilities.description: Dedicated facility with parallel assembly stations for steel construction, barrel machining, and tracking module installation. Structural framing and expanded control nodes increase output while maintaining reliable interception capability.

facilities.name: Fleet Forge Distillery
facilities.description: Legendary spirits brewed in the waste heat of weapons forges. The recipe is classified. The hangovers are not.
facilities.lore: The distillery shares a thermal exchange loop with the War Citadel's weapons forge — waste heat from railgun capacitor banks provides the exact temperature for the third fermentation stage. The brewmasters are Fleet veterans who consider this posting a combat assignment. The result is Crimson Bloodwine: a spirit so potent that most species experience it as a religious event. Haven's cantinas charge triple for it.

facilities.name: Fleet Fuel Bunker
facilities.description: Military fuel bunkers deep in the Citadel's armored core. You queue behind warships and nobody complains about the wait.
facilities.satisfied_description: Fuel flows steady from armored reserves, warships cycling through with military precision. The queue moves fast and nobody cuts in line.
facilities.degraded_description: That's the plan, anyway. Reserves are critically low. Warships get priority and civilian ships wait days, their captains watching fuel gauges drop in the unheated queue bays.
facilities.lore: Fuel storage is buried under three meters of armor plating in the most protected section of the Citadel. Military vessels have priority. Civilian ships queue in order of arrival, and complaining moves you to the back of the line. The fuel itself is excellent — the Fleet doesn't cut corners on anything that affects combat readiness.

facilities.name: Fleet Hospital Construction Complex
facilities.description: A large sterile works that assembles hardened trauma wards, remote treatment craft, medical logistics controls, and fleet triage networks.

facilities.name: Fleet Infirmary
facilities.description: A dedicated infirmary wing with surgical bays and recovery wards for a working squadron. Its private treatment pool draws medical supplies from faction storage on demand.

facilities.name: Fleet Life Support
facilities.description: No-frills military atmospheric system. Functional. Reliable. Ugly.
facilities.satisfied_description: The air is breathable, the water clean, and the temperature functional. Fleet personnel don't complain. Visitors learn not to.
facilities.degraded_description: Or it should be. Temperature has drifted fifteen degrees in Sector 7 and nobody's fixing it. The water recycler strains audibly, and condensation forms on the bulkheads.
facilities.lore: The Fleet doesn't waste resources on aesthetics — but every soldier breathes, and the water is clean enough. The system was ripped from a captured Solarian cruiser and stripped of anything the Fleet deemed 'decorative,' which turned out to be the temperature controls.

facilities.name: Fleet Marine Academy
facilities.description: A sector academy training assault companies in boarding, counterboarding, and ship seizure operations.
facilities.satisfied_description: Full companies cycle through mock hulls while instructors grade coordinated breaches under live conditions.
facilities.degraded_description: Training hulls remain sealed and cadets crowd classrooms waiting for range supplies and power.

facilities.name: Fleet Mobilization Center
facilities.description: A fleet-scale mustering complex that can outfit replacement crews and receive prize details without clogging the public concourse. Holds up to 2,048 crew and 512 marines.

facilities.name: Fleet Munitions Vault
facilities.description: Armored munitions vaults repurposed for general storage. Nothing moves without the quartermaster's authorization and a retinal scan.
facilities.satisfied_description: Blast doors cycle smoothly, the quartermaster's ledger balanced to the last item. Military-grade security keeps everything where it belongs.
facilities.degraded_description: Until now. The biometric locks malfunction intermittently, forcing manual verification. The quartermaster's ledger shows discrepancies for the first time in eleven years.
facilities.lore: Originally designed to store warheads, these vaults are the most physically secure storage in the galaxy. The walls are blast-rated, the locks are biometric, and the quartermaster maintains a ledger that hasn't had a discrepancy in eleven years. Visitors sometimes complain about the security theater. The quartermaster's response is always the same: 'It's not theater.'

facilities.name: Fleet Personnel Command
facilities.description: A fleet-scale mobilization center capable of assembling and assigning thousands of qualified spacers.
facilities.satisfied_description: Training cohorts, reserve watches, and transport cadres move through a precise galaxy-spanning assignment network.
facilities.degraded_description: Reserve halls stand half empty and assignment traffic backs up behind shortages in food, power, and transport.

facilities.name: Fleet Weapons Forge
facilities.description: A sweltering industrial floor where everything is built to military spec and 'decorative' is a disciplinary offense.
facilities.satisfied_description: The forge floor blazes with heat, anvils ringing as weapons and armor take shape under disciplined hands. Every piece meets military specification.
facilities.degraded_description: At least, when supplied. Half the anvils sit cold, the forge running at reduced temperature. Smiths work with salvaged steel and the results barely pass Fleet standards.
facilities.lore: The temperature on the forge floor exceeds 40°C and nobody cares. Anvils the size of shuttlecraft line the main bay, and the ring of hammer on alloy never stops. Everything made here could stop a railgun round, whether it needs to or not. A sign over the entrance reads: 'FORM FOLLOWS FUNCTION. FUNCTION IS VIOLENCE.'

facilities.name: Fleet Yards
facilities.description: Major shipbuilding complex with parallel construction bays and heavy fabrication.
facilities.satisfied_description: The complex thrums with industrial energy. Heavy fabricators stamp hull plates as construction bays work around the clock.
facilities.degraded_description: On a good day. Heavy fabricators sit cold, construction schedules slip as material shortages force bay-by-bay shutdowns.

facilities.name: Flight Control Assembly
facilities.description: A dedicated production line that integrates navigation cores, circuit boards, and processing units into autopilot systems. Copper piping carries control signals between stations while sensor arrays are calibrated and mounted to each unit.

facilities.name: Flight Control Assembly Line
facilities.description: A compact production line that combines circuit boards and processing cores into flight control modules. Control nodes direct the assembly while sensor arrays are integrated and tested before unit completion.

facilities.name: Flotation Separation Line
facilities.description: Purpose-built mineral flotation plant equipped with reagent injection systems and bubble separation chambers. Processes ore slurry to selectively separate copper minerals from target ore streams.

facilities.name: Fluorination Chamber
facilities.description: A shielded fluorine reactor designed to convert uranium concentrate into volatile UF6 gas. Heavy lead lining and radiation-hardened controls manage the hazardous chemistry and decay byproducts.

facilities.name: Fluorine Acid Bath
facilities.description: Chemical processing system with fluorine injection and silicon substrate alignment. Produces circuit boards through precision etching, housed in a shielded containment structure.

facilities.name: Fluorine Circuit Etching Station
facilities.description: Multi-stage etching facility with hazmat containment, chemical liners, and automated substrate handling. Fluorine vapor is precisely controlled to reduce cycle time while maintaining trace integrity.

facilities.name: Fluorine Nano-Fabricator
facilities.description: Advanced manufacturing center with dual chemical circulation loops, real-time etching monitoring, and integrated hazmat recycling. Produces densely-packed circuit boards with sub-micron feature precision.

facilities.name: Fluorine Processing Plant
facilities.description: Industrial-scale operation with redundant chemical liners, hazmat storage, and coolant circulation to handle aggressive synthesis conditions and sustain continuous nanoscale-grade production.

facilities.name: Fluorine Quantum Etcher
facilities.description: Cutting-edge facility combining cryogenic chemical control, multi-axis substrate positioning, and autonomous defect detection. Fluorine etching occurs in a fully isolated chamber with closed-loop hazmat management for maximum throughput.

facilities.name: Flux Glass Synthesis
facilities.description: Cutting-edge glass production system using full cryogenic management and precision plasma injection to achieve near-zero thermal stress during solidification, yielding optically clear leaded panels at maximum capacity.

facilities.name: Flux Processing Plant
facilities.description: An industrial flux line with reinforced containment, processing cores driving the reaction control, and banks of recyclers scrubbing the air. Produces gutter flux at the volume the downstream drug operations actually need.

facilities.name: Focused Beam I Forge
facilities.description: Industrial-scale beam weapon factory with quantum control systems managing crystal alignment, targeting computer calibration, and barrel precision. Reinforced frames and targeting computers ensure consistent beam penetration characteristics.

facilities.name: Focused Beam I Foundry
facilities.description: State-of-the-art weapon production facility with quantum-controlled crystal focusing, precision barrel fabrication, and integrated coolant loops managing thermal load during assembly. Achieves maximum beam coherence and shield-bypass efficiency.

facilities.name: Focused Beam I Workshop
facilities.description: Expanded beam production facility with parallel assembly stations for housing, barrel, and optics. Structural frames support increased throughput and improved targeting computer integration for enhanced beam coherence.

facilities.name: Focused Beam II Forge
facilities.description: Industrial-scale factory for advanced beam systems with quantum control managing dual crystal arrays, optical fiber alignment, and targeting computer calibration. Reinforced frames and precision targeting computers optimize shield-penetration performance.

facilities.name: Focused Beam II Foundry
facilities.description: Cutting-edge advanced beam production facility with quantum-controlled dual-array crystal focusing, precision optical fiber integration, and integrated coolant loops. Full automation achieves superior shield-penetration characteristics and beam coherence.

facilities.name: Focused Beam II Workshop
facilities.description: Large-scale facility for advanced beam production with multiple assembly stations for optical fiber preparation, dual-array focusing, and precision targeting integration. Structural frames support the increased complexity and higher throughput.

facilities.name: Focused Beam III Forge
facilities.description: Industrial-scale factory for elite beam systems with quantum control managing crystalline lattice alignment, triple-array focusing, and advanced targeting calibration. Reinforced frames and targeting computers deliver maximum shield-penetration capability.

facilities.name: Focused Beam III Foundry
facilities.description: State-of-the-art elite beam production line with quantum-controlled crystalline lattice focusing, triple-array optical integration, and integrated coolant loops managing thermal stress. Achieves elite-class shield penetration and beam stability.

facilities.name: Focused Beam III Workshop
facilities.description: Advanced facility for elite beam production with specialized stations for crystalline lattice work, triple optical array integration, and multi-stage targeting. Structural frames support the demanding precision requirements and sustained production pace.

facilities.name: Focused EM Factory
facilities.description: Higher-throughput facility with automated board-to-coil bonding stations and integrated tuning equipment. Structural framing provides rigid mounting for superconductor arrays during assembly.

facilities.name: Focused EM Manufactory
facilities.description: Industrial-scale manufacturing with quantum control cores managing resonance tuning and energy-density optimization. Targeting computers verify each charge pack's electromagnetic profile and power output.

facilities.name: Focused EM Ordnance Complex
facilities.description: State-of-the-art facility with cryogenic superconductor handling and real-time quantum feedback on resonance tuning. Coolant loops maintain optimal operating temperatures throughout the bonding and tuning process.

facilities.name: Focused EM Press
facilities.description: Specialized assembly line that bonds circuit boards to superconductor coils and tunes their electromagnetic resonance. Precision control nodes direct energy distribution through each charge pack.

facilities.name: Focused Plasma Lab
facilities.description: Specialized containment line that channels refined plasma cores through ceramite-lined compression chambers to concentrate beam intensity. Coolant loops manage the extreme thermal output of focused plasma generation.

facilities.name: Foil Scale Smeltery
facilities.description: A stack-and-smelt furnace that processes mirror-skate shed scales into aluminum sheet. The creature pre-refines the metal; the furnace just consolidates and rolls it.

facilities.name: Forge Fury-Tempered Plating Complex
facilities.description: State-of-the-art tempering plant with modular plasma injection, advanced cryogenic cooling, and precision automation that achieves microsecond-level control over material phase transitions. Extensive coolant networks and reinforced frames support full-capacity production of dual-resistant armor plating.

facilities.name: Forge Fury-Tempered Plating Factory
facilities.description: Industrial-grade facility featuring redundant plasma heating stages and an integrated coolant loop system that cycles material through layering and tempering chambers in rapid succession. Reinforced structural components absorb the stresses of extreme-temperature continuous operation.

facilities.name: Forge Fury-Tempered Plating Plant
facilities.description: Enhanced forge with plasma injectors and heat sink arrays that accelerate the tempering cycle while preventing delamination or brittleness in the layered composite. Structural framing reinforces the chamber walls against the intense thermal cycling.

facilities.name: Forge Fury-Tempered Plating Workshop
facilities.description: Specialized thermal facility designed to layer fury alloy with steel under extreme, sustained heat while managing the volatile nature of the crimson material. Copper piping and control nodes maintain the narrow temperature band required for successful tempering.

facilities.name: Fortitude Blender
facilities.description: Purpose-built apparatus for blending bioactive and synthetic compounds into a potent metabolic enhancer. Coolant circulation prevents degradation of the sensitive bioactive components during the lengthy synthesis cycle.

facilities.name: Frag Round Press
facilities.description: Purpose-built production line that scores steel plates with precision patterns and bonds them to silicate composites to create fragmentation-optimized casings. Automated quality gates ensure consistent shatter geometry.

facilities.name: Fragmentation Mine Assembly Line
facilities.description: Compact production line for assembling steel-plate casings, warhead assemblies, and circuit boards into dispersal ordnance. Steady output for area-denial munitions.

facilities.name: Fragmentation Mine Complex
facilities.description: Fully automated facility with integrated coolant loops and quantum control systems managing warhead integration and targeting-computer tuning. Advanced subsystems enable near-continuous fragmentation-mine assembly.

facilities.name: Fragmentation Mine Plant
facilities.description: Expanded facility with weapon-housing integration and barrel-assembly staging. Structural frames and modular assembly stations increase throughput for dispersal-type warheads.

facilities.name: Fragmentation Mine Works
facilities.description: Heavy production complex with reinforced casings and quantum-controlled targeting computers. Multi-stage assembly with real-time dispersal-pattern calibration achieves rapid mine production.

facilities.name: Frame Jig
facilities.description: A dedicated production line that bonds titanium alloy frames with nanoplastic composites and integrates micro-thruster arrays into a unified drone structure.

facilities.name: Freeze Chamber
facilities.description: Specialized production line that bonds durasteel plates with liquid-nitrogen systems and life-support units into sealed suspension chambers. Five-minute cycle includes pressurization testing and thermal-isolation verification.

facilities.name: Frontier Cantina
facilities.description: A rowdy bolt-hole with a plank bar, a still out back, and a plate of grilled xeno-meat if you're hungry. No pretense — just cheap drink and somewhere to spend a layover.
facilities.satisfied_description: The still's keeping the bar wet and there's meat on the grill. Loud, packed, and exactly what a tired crew wants after a long haul.
facilities.degraded_description: The still's run dry and the grill's cold. A few regulars are still nursing warm drinks, but the room's gone quiet.

facilities.name: Frontier Exchange
facilities.description: Trading terminals installed on the bridge of a captured Crimson destroyer. The weapons consoles are gone; the intimidation factor remains.
facilities.satisfied_description: The repurposed bridge terminals flash with prices, cipher-verified deals closing fast. No regulations, no inspections, and the scorch marks add character.
facilities.degraded_description: Well, mostly. Half the terminals display static, cipher verification timing out. Traders revert to shouting prices across the bridge, which honestly isn't that different from normal.
facilities.lore: The old bridge still has scorch marks from the boarding action that captured it. The weapons consoles were ripped out and replaced with trading terminals, but the commander's chair remains — nobody sits in it, and nobody will say why. Haven ciphers authenticate the deals. No regulations, no inspections, no questions asked.

facilities.name: Frontier Fuel Siphon
facilities.description: Fuel siphoned from the salvage reactor's overflow through pipes that weren't rated for this. Cheap, fast, occasionally the wrong octane.
facilities.satisfied_description: The siphon draws steady from the reactor overflow, fuel flowing clean and consistent. Experienced pilots top off without recalibrating — a rare good day.
facilities.degraded_description: More than occasionally, lately. The siphon sputters and coughs, fuel coming through in inconsistent bursts. Pilots recalibrate twice per fill and still get readings that make them nervous.
facilities.lore: The siphon taps directly into the reactor overflow manifold through a bypass that the original engineers definitely did not intend. The fuel is perfectly usable — it's just not always perfectly consistent. Experienced Patchwork pilots learn to recalibrate their injectors after every fill. First-timers learn the hard way.

facilities.name: Frontier Hash Galley
facilities.description: A single hard-worked griddle for the 0300 dock special.

facilities.name: Frontier Machine Shop
facilities.description: The machine shop in what used to be a torpedo room. Power tools bolted to the walls, no safety rails, and a sign that says 'you break it, you weld it.'
facilities.satisfied_description: The torpedo-room workshop clatters with activity, mismatched tools from every empire getting the job done. The safety card is optimistic but the results are solid.
facilities.degraded_description: Not lately. Tools sit uncalibrated and dull without fresh steel to work. The laminated safety card now includes 'proceed with extreme caution' in three languages.
facilities.lore: The torpedo loading mechanisms make surprisingly good workbenches once you remove the warheads. The tools are a museum of salvaged equipment from every empire, none of it matching, all of it functional. Safety briefing consists of a laminated card that reads: 'Don't lose fingers. We don't have a medical bay either.'

facilities.name: Frontier Recycler
facilities.description: Distributed through the crew quarters of all three hulls. The water passes through reactor shielding. Don't think about it.
facilities.satisfied_description: All three hull sections report breathable air and clean enough water. Deck 7 through 12 still tastes like coolant, but at least there's plenty of it.
facilities.degraded_description: Usually. Two of three recycler systems are failing. Water rationing is in effect, the air in the lower decks tastes like rust, and nobody's joking about kidney stones anymore.
facilities.lore: Each of the three original ships had its own life support. Now they're all patched together with mismatched ductwork and jury-rigged pumps. The water tastes different depending on which hull you're in — Deck 7 through 12 tastes like reactor coolant because the pipes literally run through the shielding. The old-timers say it builds character. The newcomers say it builds kidney stones.

facilities.name: Frontier Salvage Yard
facilities.description: A cavernous cargo hold where ships are assembled from salvaged parts. Nothing matches, everything works, and the price is right.
facilities.satisfied_description: The cavernous bay rings with construction, ships taking shape from salvaged parts. Crimson armor, Solarian frames, Voidborn electronics — mismatched but airworthy.
facilities.degraded_description: Except today. The yard sits mostly quiet, fabricators idle without materials. The yard boss stares at empty racks where alloy and null matter should be, and cancels orders.
facilities.lore: The Salvage Yard occupies the entire cargo bay of the original Nebula freighter — the largest single space on the Patchwork. Ships are assembled from whatever's available: Crimson armor on Solarian frames, Voidborn electronics in Nebula hulls. The yard boss's philosophy is simple: 'It doesn't have to match. It has to fly.'

facilities.name: Frontier Weld Shop
facilities.description: A zero-G repair cage bolted to the outside of Destroyer One, staffed by welders who learned their trade patching battle damage mid-combat.
facilities.satisfied_description: The zero-G cage buzzes with activity, suited welders working fast and confident. Hull patches go on solid, and the mag-clamps haven't budged in years.
facilities.degraded_description: When there are supplies. Repair kits exhausted, the welders reduced to patching holes with whatever scrap they can find. The mag-clamps groan under neglect, and nobody trusts them.
facilities.lore: The cage is open to vacuum on three sides, held to the hull by mag-clamps that are older than most of the crew. The welders work in suits, which they say gives them better visibility than any enclosed drydock. This is true. It also means repairs stop during micrometeorite warnings, which happen more often than the station council admits.

facilities.name: Frost Cracker
facilities.description: A specialized cryogenic unit for separating rare helium isotopes from ice, employing precision cooling and fractionation to yield aneutronic fusion fuel.

facilities.name: Frost Furnace
facilities.description: A cryogenic conversion line that rapidly cools and condenses nitrogen ice into liquid form for industrial cooling and chemical applications.

facilities.name: Frost Mining Facility
facilities.description: Integrated facility with multiple assembly stations, processing-core integration, and sensor-array calibration producing ice-harvester units at higher rates.

facilities.name: Frostmoth Frappe Bar
facilities.description: Blend-freezers for a dessert that keeps insisting it's a drink.

facilities.name: Fuel Assembly Workshop
facilities.description: An industrial-scale shielded complex with multiple sealed assembly chambers, hazmat protocols, and hardened control systems for reliable high-volume fuel rod production.

facilities.name: Fuel Bunker
facilities.description: Pressurized fuel storage tanks holding station fuel reserves for ship refueling operations.
facilities.satisfied_description: Pressure readings nominal across all tanks. Fuel reserves are topped up and ready for dispensing.
facilities.degraded_description: Pressure anomalies have been detected in the storage array. Capacity is reduced and dispensing may be interrupted.

facilities.name: Fuel Cell Assembly Line
facilities.description: Higher-throughput facility with integrated plasma injection and heat-sink cooling to accelerate hydrogen bonding cycles. Structural frames and additional injectors allow faster cell cycling.

facilities.name: Fuel Cell Extractor
facilities.description: A straightforward industrial refinery that processes standard fuel cells into station reserves. Copper piping carries fuel through heated chambers where control nodes regulate extraction cycles.

facilities.name: Fuel Cell Fabrication Complex
facilities.description: Mass-production hydrogen reactor with active coolant loops and staged plasma injection for continuous fuel-cell synthesis. Reinforced frames and multiple heat-sink arrays handle rapid thermal cycling.

facilities.name: Fuel Cell Generator
facilities.description: A straightforward fusion plant burning fuel cells and liquid hydrogen. Cheap to build, cheap to run — build a few of these and keep them fed.
facilities.satisfied_description: The reactor thrums with steady output, fed on nothing fancier than fuel cells. Nominal, unremarkable, reliable.
facilities.degraded_description: The reactor is starved of fuel. Output has dropped to nothing and the lights are on backup power.

facilities.name: Fuel Cell Workshop
facilities.description: A basic hydrogen-fusion cell fabrication station that combines liquid hydrogen with steel plates into standardized power cells. Simple heating and containment produce steady fuel-cell output.

facilities.name: Fuel Depot
facilities.description: Fuel storage and dispensing facility for visiting ships.
facilities.satisfied_description: Fuel lines pressurized and ready. Ships dock, fill up, and depart with minimal wait.
facilities.degraded_description: In theory. Fuel reserves are running low, dispensing pumps sputter, and rationing notices flash on the status board.

facilities.name: Fuel Distribution Center
facilities.description: High-throughput fueling infrastructure with pipeline distribution and reserve tanks.
facilities.satisfied_description: Pipelines thrum with steady flow. Reserve tanks show healthy levels, and throughput meets peak demand.
facilities.degraded_description: Not anymore. Pipeline pressure fluctuates, reserve tanks are dangerously low, and the facility struggles to meet demand.

facilities.name: Fuel Grid
facilities.description: Distributed fueling network with automated queue management and priority routing.
facilities.satisfied_description: The grid routes fuel to every docking port simultaneously. Queue times are near zero, priority routing seamless.
facilities.degraded_description: Right now, though, grid nodes go offline one by one. Priority routing fails, leaving ships waiting at random ports for trickle fills.

facilities.name: Fuel Optimizer Assembly Line
facilities.description: A compact production line that assembles circuit boards, superconductors, and polymers into optimized fuel controllers. Steady output with basic thermal management.

facilities.name: Fuel Pump Assembly
facilities.description: A compact production line assembling fuel tanks, pressure seals, and circuit boards into functional transfer pump units. Copper piping carries pressurized fuel through precision-engineered valve systems.

facilities.name: Fuel Reclamation Still
facilities.description: A salvage-yard still that renders scrap metal and wreck components into workable fuel cells. Smells terrible. Works fine.

facilities.name: Fuel Rod Caster
facilities.description: A heated production line that combines thorium rods with cryogenic tritium to form stable fusion fuel elements. Heat sinks and plasma injection systems manage the extreme thermal requirements of deuterium-tritium bonding.

facilities.name: Fuel Rod Casting Facility
facilities.description: An industrial plant with multiple sealed forming chambers, enhanced lead shielding, and radiation-hardened control systems designed for consistent high-volume thorium fuel production.

facilities.name: Fuel Rod Press
facilities.description: A heavily shielded facility where low-enriched uranium and thorium fuel components are precision-assembled and sealed into reactor-grade assemblies behind extensive lead shielding and radiation containment.

facilities.name: Fuel Tank Expansion
facilities.description: An additional pressurized tank bolted onto the station's own fuel line — grows the shared reserve every docked ship draws from. Build more for more capacity. Top it off from fuel-production facilities or by depositing fuel straight from a docked ship's tank (storage deposit, item_id=fuel).
facilities.satisfied_description: Pressure readings nominal. The expanded tank holds its share of the station's reserve without incident.
facilities.degraded_description: Pressure anomalies in this tank's array. Its share of the station's capacity is offline until it's resupplied.

facilities.name: Fuel Tank Integration Line
facilities.description: A dedicated production facility for assembling pressurized fuel bladder systems. Handles flex-polymer sealing, aluminum sheet fabrication, and structural bolt-down procedures in a steady industrial process.

facilities.name: Fuel Tank Production Works
facilities.description: Industrial-scale manufacturing with integrated coolant-loop systems managing heat dissipation during assembly and testing. Quantum-controlled staging and automated pressure validation achieve rapid throughput.

facilities.name: Full Habitat Dome
facilities.description: A self-sustaining environmental system with real hydroponic gardens — the station finally feels like somewhere people live, not just work.
facilities.satisfied_description: Hydroponic gardens flourish under full-spectrum lighting. The air smells of green growing things.
facilities.degraded_description: Gardens wilt under failing grow-lights. The air grows thin and stale as synthesis struggles to keep up.

facilities.name: Fully Automated Generator Line
facilities.description: State-of-the-art facility with integrated quantum precision systems and redundant cryogenic loops, producing capital-grade shield generators at maximum throughput with zero manual intervention.

facilities.name: Fury Alloy Tempering Forge
facilities.description: A specialized metallurgical production line that fuses fury crystals with titanium alloy under controlled heat conditions. Basic heat sink systems manage the thermal intensity required for proper alloy tempering.

facilities.name: Fury Alloy Tempering Plant
facilities.description: An expanded facility with multiple tempering chambers and active heat sink arrays to manage the extreme temperatures of fury crystal fusion. Plasma injectors provide precise thermal control for consistent alloy composition and heat-storage properties.

facilities.name: Fury Alloy Tempering Works
facilities.description: A large-scale production facility with extensive heat sink networks and sophisticated plasma injection systems for precise temperature management during alloy formation. Coolant loops regulate chamber temperatures while maintaining the high-heat conditions required for superior thermal energy storage.

facilities.name: Fury Cannon Manufacturing Line
facilities.description: Specialized assembly operation for exotic alloys, siege plating, and weapon housings. Barrel assembly and weapons integration handled by precision control systems.

facilities.name: Fury Cannon Manufacturing Megaplex
facilities.description: State-of-the-art weapons production facility with advanced quantum control, redundant coolant systems, and parallel barrel and housing assembly lines. Delivers fully integrated fury cannons at maximum throughput.

facilities.name: Fury Cannon Production Complex
facilities.description: Industrial-scale weapons factory with quantum control cores managing exotic material integration and targeting computer installation. Reinforced construction supports sustained high-volume output.

facilities.name: Fusion Array
facilities.description: High-output fusion array with stellar-grade magnetic containment.
facilities.satisfied_description: Magnetic containment bottles glow white-hot with sustained fusion. Power output exceeds station demand by a wide margin.
facilities.degraded_description: When it's working. Right now, containment bottles flicker, the array operates at reduced output, and engineers monitor bottle integrity around the clock.

facilities.name: Fusion Fuel Processing Plant
facilities.description: Large-scale cryogenic facility employing multi-loop coolant systems and high-energy plasma staging to rapidly fractionate ice into fusion-grade deuterium.

facilities.name: Fusion Fuel Refinery
facilities.description: Industrial-scale facility combining advanced plasma injection, extensive heat-sink networks, and integrated coolant loops to maintain optimal conditions for continuous fuel-rod synthesis. Handles cryogenic materials safely at high throughput.

facilities.name: Fusion Matrix Fabricator
facilities.description: Heavy industrial assembly with quantum control cores directing laser-precision optics and sensor arrays. Reinforced frames support the demanding machinery required for fusing exotic fuel types into stable power systems.

facilities.name: Fusion Pearl Mill
facilities.description: A precision mill that unpacks deuteron-slug fusion pearls into a generous run of fuel cells.

facilities.name: Fusion Power Core
facilities.description: Standard fusion power plant providing energy to the station.
facilities.satisfied_description: The reactor thrums with steady output, containment fields glowing a healthy blue. Power readings nominal.
facilities.degraded_description: Or it should be. The reactor hums at reduced output, and brownouts ripple through the station's power grid.

facilities.name: Fusion Propellant Foundry
facilities.description: State-of-the-art facility featuring distributed plasma injector arrays and redundant coolant loops for maximum heat dissipation. Real-time control nodes monitor reaction parameters across reinforced pressure vessels, delivering afterburner fuel at rates limited only by material throughput.

facilities.name: Galactic Alloy Foundry Complex
facilities.description: State-of-the-art fusion facility with full cryogenic cooling, redundant plasma systems, and quantum-grade control nodes ensuring consistent molecular bonding across all three alloy components at maximum throughput.

facilities.name: Galactic Alloy Fusion Forge
facilities.description: A specialized thermal-fusion production line that combines three distinct metal stocks into unified composite ingots. Plasma injectors heat the charge while copper piping manages thermal cycling between stages.

facilities.name: Galactic Alloy Fusion Plant
facilities.description: Expanded facility with dedicated heating and cooling zones for sequential alloy fusion. Reinforced structural frames support higher throughput and more precise control-node sequencing.

facilities.name: Galactic Alloy Fusion Works
facilities.description: Industrial-scale fusion system with integrated coolant loops and multiplexed plasma injection for rapid compositional blending. Processes three feedstock types in continuous automated rotation.

facilities.name: Galley Fabrication Bay
facilities.description: A structured production facility assembling titanium alloy counters, flex polymer fittings, and life support plumbing into compact ship's galleys. Sensor arrays verify cold-chain seals and cooktop wiring before the unit ships.

facilities.name: Galley Kitchen
facilities.description: A compact station kitchen with a butcher's block, cooktop, and ration press. Turns raw xeno-meat and clean water into shelf-stable protein rations.

facilities.name: Galvanic Biorefinery
facilities.description: A cell-integration bench that pairs lantern-slug charge glands with graphene-thread current collectors and seals them into power batteries. The gland is the cathode; the thread is the anode — the slug provided the chemistry, the bench provides the casing.

facilities.name: Galvanic Hull Grid Foundry
facilities.description: A shielded weapons works for forming hull conductors, insulating high-energy trunks, and testing full-scale contact-discharge sections.

facilities.name: Gas Compression Plant
facilities.description: Industrial facility with quantum control managing superconductor alignment and precision optics calibration. Reinforced construction enables sustained production of improved harvester units.

facilities.name: Gas Compression Upgrade Center
facilities.description: Expanded facility with enhanced processing core arrays and sensor integration for larger-scale atmospheric operations. Structural reinforcement supports faster upgrade cycles.

facilities.name: Gas Extraction Complex
facilities.description: Large-scale production with quantum control cores managing sensor calibration and precision optics for enhanced atmospheric analysis. Reinforced framing supports continuous assembly operations.

facilities.name: Gas Harvester Assembly Line
facilities.description: A purpose-built production line assembling capital-grade gas collection modules from sub-assemblies and exotic materials. Equipped with precision control nodes and sensor integration stations to validate each unit before output.

facilities.name: Gas Harvester Fabrication Line
facilities.description: Precision production line assembling polymers, titanium components, and circuit boards into atmospheric collection units. Sensor arrays and processing cores calibrated for nebula sampling.

facilities.name: Gas Separation Processing Unit
facilities.description: A specialized facility housing combustion chambers for hydrogen burn-off and cryogenic condensation stages for argon and neon capture. Three separation zones run in series with integrated sensor arrays for purity monitoring.

facilities.name: Gel Culture Vat
facilities.description: A specialized biotech production line that combines neural interface gel, thermal ceramics, and silicate composites into contained nanite swarms. Atmospheric control maintains biological stability throughout assembly.

facilities.name: Gel Synthesis Lab
facilities.description: Compact biocompatible medium production line with atmospheric containment and optical fiber integration. Combines energy crystals and fiber bundles under controlled conditions to produce neural interface gel.

facilities.name: Genesis Life Systems
facilities.description: Cutting-edge automated plant with quantum-controlled assembly of all recycling subcomponents and multi-stage sensor calibration. Precision optics and processing cores are installed and tested in real-time, enabling rapid cycling.

facilities.name: Geological Analysis Plant
facilities.description: Larger facility with structural reinforcement and expanded processing capacity for handling the more demanding assembly of advanced scanner units. Multiple assembly stations reduce bottlenecks in crystal and sensor integration.

facilities.name: Ghost Arsenal Hub
facilities.description: A fully automated forgeworks turning out untraceable ordnance at fleet-supply volume. Quantum cores run the ballistic validation that keeps the rounds from jamming, and every identifying signature is scrubbed before the rounds ever cool. No maker's mark, no paper trail, no exceptions.

facilities.name: Ghost Rounds Foundry
facilities.description: A reinforced munitions foundry with quantum-controlled tolerances and heat-managed barrel forming. Every identifying mark is omitted by design, every round tested before it ships. When forensics pulls these from a hull, the report just says 'unknown ordnance.'

facilities.name: Gilded Cognition Works
facilities.description: State-of-the-art facility with quantum-controlled precision bonding, real-time sensor feedback loops, and reinforced structural capacity. Produces finished silicon-free cores at near-continuous rates through fully integrated automation.

facilities.name: Glass Furnace
facilities.description: A dedicated thermal chamber that sinters silicon ore into transparent armor-grade panes. Basic control nodes regulate furnace temperature for consistent material density.

facilities.name: Glass Refinery
facilities.description: Larger furnace complex with heat sinks and plasma-assisted sintering to accelerate cooling and strengthen the finished material. Structural frames support rapid batch cycling.

facilities.name: Glass Synthesis Refinery
facilities.description: Industrial-scale fusion plant with multiple chambers, advanced heat-sink arrays, and rapid cooling systems for continuous production of optically perfect reinforced glass.

facilities.name: Glintfin Sashimi Counter
facilities.description: A chilled slicing counter with a knife rail and an ice well, for cutting raw glintfin to order.

facilities.name: Glintfin Sear Station
facilities.description: A flat-top and oil bath that runs screaming hot, for crisping glintfin fillets to order over griddled sunspindle.

facilities.name: Gloomcap Cellar
facilities.description: A dark, damp fungal cellar running a gloomcap flush down to a thick mash.

facilities.name: Gloomshine Still
facilities.description: A sealed distillation rig fed with gloomcap mash and clean water. Runs day and night; nobody inspects the mash too closely. Output is cheap, potent Gloomshine.

facilities.name: Gold Assay Mint
facilities.description: An assay-and-stamping line that smelts gold ore, verifies its purity, and casts it into standard bullion bars. A wealth-storage convenience, not an industrial input.

facilities.name: Gold Circuit Press
facilities.description: A thick-film hybrid line that screens gold conductor paste onto fired ceramic substrates, sintering finished boards without a silicon wafer in sight. Control nodes hold the print registration steady across each cycle.

facilities.name: Gold Conductor Works
facilities.description: Industrial-scale production complex with continuous casting, rapid plasma heating, and automated drawing towers. Extensive coolant systems prevent brittleness and maintain consistent gauge across high-volume runs.

facilities.name: Gold Core Assembly
facilities.description: A dedicated line that bonds circuit boards and platinum onto gold interconnects to form integrated processing cores. Copper piping routes signals between stations while control nodes sequence the gold-wire bonding steps.

facilities.name: Gold Film Lab
facilities.description: Multi-stage facility with plasma-assisted curing and distributed heat sinks that drive the gold film into a dense, void-free conductor. Structural frames carry parallel print beds for tighter throughput.

facilities.name: Gold Interconnect Plant
facilities.description: An expanded facility with parallel bonding stations and sensor integration bays. Structural frames support heavier throughput equipment, and finished cores are recycled as subassemblies for faster turnaround.

facilities.name: Gold Refining Plant
facilities.description: Larger facility with integrated ore processing, plasma-assisted smelting, and multi-stage drawing towers. Heat sinks maintain optimal temperature for work-hardening and annealing cycles, improving wire quality and throughput.

facilities.name: Gold Wire Extruder
facilities.description: A specialized metal-working facility with ore smelting, casting, and precision wire-drawing dies. Produces high-purity gold wiring for sensitive electronic applications.

facilities.name: Goldworks Fabricator
facilities.description: Industrial-scale gold-electronics complex with plasma injection arrays and extensive heat-dissipation infrastructure for rapid film fusion and cooling. Continuous throughput with integrated quality verification at each print station.

facilities.name: Grand Counterfeit Complex
facilities.description: An industrial counterfeiting plant running parallel cipher presses behind layers of quantum control and optical verification. Produces trade ciphers indistinguishable from Haven's at a volume that would destabilize a currency if anyone admitted it was happening. Archon Mera would be delighted.

facilities.name: Grand Dining Manufacturing Complex
facilities.description: Heavy-duty plant with precision optics guiding cabinetry and galley-line assembly, quantum control cores managing ventilation and climate integration across multiple dining decks. Reinforced construction supports continuous five-minute output.

facilities.name: Grand Hotel & Resort
facilities.description: A full hospitality complex — suites, a concierge desk, private lounges, and enough amenities to make a layover feel like a vacation. The station's flagship guest experience.
facilities.satisfied_description: Every suite is occupied, the concierge desk is fielding requests nonstop, and the private lounges are running at full luxury. This is what a resort deck is supposed to feel like.
facilities.degraded_description: Housekeeping's fallen behind, half the private lounges are closed, and the concierge desk is fielding complaints instead of requests. The flagship is showing its wear.

facilities.name: Grand Recruitment Bureau
facilities.description: Multi-story recruitment complex with dedicated training facilities. Your faction's name is known across the sector. Your member cap is set by your single highest-tier recruitment office, and every OTHER station that also has one adds 25% of its own cap — so spreading recruitment offices across stations raises the ceiling instead of being wasted.

facilities.name: Grand Shipworks
facilities.description: A major shipbuilding complex, heavy fabricators and all — the faction's own capital-hull program.
facilities.satisfied_description: Heavy fabricators stamp hull plates around the clock. Construction bays run in parallel without a hitch.
facilities.degraded_description: Fabricators sit cold for lack of alloy. Build schedules slip bay by bay as material shortages bite.

facilities.name: Grand Solarian Exchange
facilities.description: The premier trading hub of the Solarian Confederacy, secured by Haven-encoded trade ciphers.
facilities.satisfied_description: The quantum-entangled ledger hums with precision, settling transactions in microseconds while holographic displays track market flows across the Confederacy.
facilities.degraded_description: In theory. Trade cipher authentication is timing out, forcing manual verification and creating queues at every terminal; traders mutter about reverting to paper contracts.
facilities.lore: The beating heart of Confederacy commerce, processing millions of transactions per cycle. Its quantum-entangled ledger system ensures instant settlement across all connected stations — authenticated by cryptographic trade ciphers imported from Haven.

facilities.name: Graphene Exfoliation Plant
facilities.description: Upgraded facility with enhanced plasma injection and improved thermal cycling to accelerate layer separation and increase yield of pristine graphene sheets.

facilities.name: Graphene Manufacturing Complex
facilities.description: Industrial production line running multiple exfoliation chambers in parallel with real-time layer-quality monitoring and active coolant management for consistent high-grade output.

facilities.name: Graphene Weave Reactor
facilities.description: A sealed CVD-style reactor that weaves inkwyrm graphene thread into sheet under a crystallized-biogas reducing atmosphere. The biogas prevents oxidation while the strands fuse — a trick the laboratory took years to learn and the inkwyrm does instinctively.

facilities.name: Graviton Beam Assembly Plant
facilities.description: A specialized weapons facility with barrel assembly stations, superconductor integration bays, and control node calibration equipment. Handles the precision assembly of gravity-manipulation weaponry from discrete components.

facilities.name: Graviton Beam I Forge
facilities.description: Industrial-scale manufacturing with dedicated quantum control core integration, automated barrel assembly, and precision targeting computer installation. Coolant-loop compatibility and real-time performance validation enable high-speed production of these advanced weapons.

facilities.name: Graviton Beam I Foundry
facilities.description: State-of-the-art weapons factory with fully automated barrel assembly, integrated coolant-loop systems, and quantum-precision targeting computer calibration. Parallel production stages and AI-guided assembly achieve exceptional throughput for capital-class gravity weapons.

facilities.name: Graviton Beam I Workshop
facilities.description: An efficient mid-scale production facility integrating structural frames, barrel assemblies, and targeting computer mounts in parallel. Improved workflow and component staging reduce per-unit assembly time.

facilities.name: Graviton Beam II Forge
facilities.description: Heavy industrial production with quantum control core integration, automated barrel assembly, targeting computer installation, and multi-stage metamaterial handling. Robotic assembly and continuous validation lines handle the complexity of advanced gravity weapons at scale.

facilities.name: Graviton Beam II Foundry
facilities.description: Cutting-edge fully automated facility with integrated coolant-loop systems, quantum-precision targeting calibration, and parallel metamaterial processing.
