Advanced robotics and real-time performance monitoring achieve minimal cycle time for these capital-tier immobilization weapons.

facilities.name: Graviton Beam II Workshop
facilities.description: An expanded facility with dedicated metamaterial processing, parallel barrel assembly lines, and structural frame integration. Improved logistics and component staging accelerate production of these sophisticated weapons.

facilities.name: Gravity Generator Assembly Line
facilities.description: A specialized production line for artificial gravity systems, equipped with superconductor integration bays, processing core mounting stations, and sensor calibration equipment. Handles precise assembly of these critical station and ship systems.

facilities.name: Grazer Grill
facilities.description: A meat house built around a hardwood-smoke pit and a butcher's block. The menu is whatever the hunters brought in — grilled, pressed, or slow-smoked — washed down with something off the still.
facilities.satisfied_description: The pit's running full, the smoker's loaded with prime cuts, and there's a proper bar keeping pace. A destination in its own right for anyone who's tired of ration paste.
facilities.degraded_description: Down to whatever's in the cold locker — the smoker's cold and the good cuts are gone. Still serving, but the board's mostly crossed off.

facilities.name: Grazer Milkshake Galley
facilities.description: A bank of heavy blenders and an ice hopper, sticky with honeyglobe syrup by mid-shift.

facilities.name: Grazer Steak Frites Galley
facilities.description: Flat-top grills and fry vats for the no-nonsense spacer staple.

facilities.name: Guidance Assembly Line
facilities.description: Purpose-built production line that integrates circuit boards, sensor arrays, and polymer housings into targeting systems. Steady-state operation produces completed guidance units at regular intervals.

facilities.name: Guidance Unit Facility
facilities.description: Industrial-scale manufacturing with quantum-grade control systems and dedicated targeting computer integration bays. Advanced automation reduces cycle time significantly while maintaining tolerances.

facilities.name: Guidance Unit Hub
facilities.description: Cutting-edge facility with full thermal management via coolant loops and quantum control cores throughout the assembly process. Produces guidance units at near-instantaneous intervals with zero tolerance deviation.

facilities.name: Guidance Unit Plant
facilities.description: Higher-capacity facility with dedicated assembly stations for sensor integration and circuit routing. Increased throughput via parallel processing and refined component handling.

facilities.name: Guided Missile Launcher Assembly
facilities.description: Specialized facility for integrating ion emitters with missile-guidance systems and electromagnetic warhead assembly. Produces one launcher every 14 minutes.

facilities.name: Guided Ordnance Facility
facilities.description: Larger facility with dedicated weapon-housing fabrication and barrel-assembly integration zones. Structural framing supports heavier component throughput and multiple simultaneous builds.

facilities.name: Guided Ordnance Plant
facilities.description: Integrated weapons production system with weapon housings, barrel assemblies, and guidance integration, achieving faster cycle times while maintaining targeting accuracy. Specialized assembly protocols handle the energy crystal integration precisely.

facilities.name: Guild Hall Recruiting
facilities.description: Full guild hall with orientation programs, mentorship matching, and a reputation that attracts quality applicants. Your member cap is set by your single highest-tier recruitment office, and every OTHER station that also has one adds 25% of its own cap — so spreading recruitment offices across stations raises the ceiling instead of being wasted.

facilities.name: Gyroscope Assembly Line
facilities.description: A specialized production line that assembles circuit boards, copper piping, and titanium alloy into precision attitude stabilizers. Steady output supports moderate fleet operations.

facilities.name: H2 Fuel Combustor
facilities.description: A compact pressurization and compression line that condenses liquid hydrogen into fuel reserves. Copper piping carries cryogenic feed through steel-plated containment chambers with basic flow control.

facilities.name: H2 Fuel Complex
facilities.description: Industrial-scale cryogenic processing line with extensive coolant loops and distributed plasma injection points, enabling rapid compression and conditioning of hydrogen feedstock into finished fuel reserves.

facilities.name: H2 Fuel Hub
facilities.description: State-of-the-art fully automated facility with redundant cooling systems, precision plasma injection arrays, and real-time pressure regulation—delivers fuel reserves at maximum throughput with minimal thermal losses.

facilities.name: H2 Fuel Plant
facilities.description: Larger pressurized processing facility with integrated heat sinks and plasma injectors to accelerate hydrogen compression cycles. Structural reinforcement supports higher throughput and more aggressive thermal management.

facilities.name: H2O2 Cell Workshop
facilities.description: A dedicated fuel-cell assembly line that combines pressurized liquid hydrogen and oxygen with precision injection sequencing. Steel-frame construction with copper piping handles the cryogenic feed streams and plasma-ignition priming.

facilities.name: H2O2 Combustion Plant
facilities.description: Larger facility with segregated feed channels, heat sinks to manage exothermic mixing, and plasma injectors to optimize combustion chemistry before compression into fuel reserves.

facilities.name: H2O2 Refinery Manufacturing Plant
facilities.description: Heavy industrial facility with quantum control cores orchestrating precision heat-sink placement and reinforced frame construction. Precision optics align the electrolysis cells for two-minute cycle times per refinery unit.

facilities.name: H2O2 Synthesis Hub
facilities.description: Cutting-edge dual-feed facility featuring redundant coolant circulation, high-frequency plasma injection, and quantum-precision flow control to achieve near-instantaneous fuel reserve synthesis.

facilities.name: Habitat Assembly Plant
facilities.description: An efficient mid-scale facility with parallel assembly stations for structural frames, biofiber mesh installation, and life support integration. Modular workflow and improved component staging accelerate production of living quarters modules.

facilities.name: Habitat Core
facilities.description: Comprehensive environmental management supporting larger populations and diverse species.
facilities.satisfied_description: Environmental sensors glow green across all habitat zones. Air quality and water purity exceed safety margins.
facilities.degraded_description: At least, when supplies hold out. Sensor arrays flash yellow warnings, some habitat zones show declining air quality, and filtration membranes need replacement.

facilities.name: Hangar Bay Module Assembly Line
facilities.description: A specialized shipbuilding facility for constructing enclosed bays, equipped with docking ring integration stations, hull plating assembly, and reinforced bulkhead mounting equipment. Handles precision assembly of these large structural modules.

facilities.name: Hardened Electronics Plant
facilities.description: A high-capacity plant with parallel processing cores and precision optics for real-time quality control, capable of hardening circuits at industrial scale with minimal defect rates.

facilities.name: Hardened Projectile Works
facilities.description: Industrial weapons line with quantum control cores and targeting computers ensuring flawless penetrator geometry and seating in sealed magazines. Reinforced frames handle the high pressures of tungsten hardening and magazine loading.

facilities.name: Harpoon Emplacement
facilities.description: A mining charge launcher off a decommissioned rock-breaker, bolted to the outer hull and re-aimed at the sky. It fires seldom, slowly, and with the unhurried confidence of something that only has to connect once. The flak keeps people off the docking arms. This is for the ones who thought they could sit out at a comfortable distance and pick the place apart at their leisure.
facilities.satisfied_description: Loaded. The crew do not watch the target; they watch the reload clock, and they are patient about it.
facilities.degraded_description: Empty. It still tracks you across the sky, which the crew consider to be most of the job.

facilities.name: Harpoon Rigging Shop
facilities.description: A scrap-iron forge and cable-rigging line that hammers salvaged plate into barbed whaling harpoons and winds the winch cables that reel them back. The working heart of any Outer Rim whaling outfit.

facilities.name: Haven Algae Cultivation
facilities.description: Zero-gravity bioluminescent algae cultivation tanks feeding Haven's luxury production chains.
facilities.lore: Haven's binary star provides the spectrum that the algae prefer — the Federation discovered this accidentally when a decommissioned science module was repurposed for storage and the cultures inside thrived unexpectedly. The cultivation tanks now occupy three full sections of the station's outer ring, where they're visible through external observation ports as a faint blue-green glow. The Vintner Complex sources from these tanks exclusively. The Federation considers the color an attractive selling point.

facilities.name: Haven Authenticator Foundry
facilities.description: Hardens raw cipher chips into tamper-proof authenticators for permanent commercial installation — Stage 2 of Haven's transaction verification monopoly. Output flows directly into the Federation Treasury's bond reserve, not the public market.
facilities.lore: If the Cipher Foundry is where the secret is made, the Authenticator Foundry is where it becomes inescapable. Technicians here embed raw cipher chips into copper-wire contact arrays — a process that creates a tamper-evident physical bond: cut the wiring, and the chip's authentication key self-destructs. The resulting authenticators are what every major commercial exchange in settled space requires: commerce hubs, trade nexuses, and any high-volume market serious about verifiable transactions. The Federation licenses them at fixed rates. 'Fixed' in the sense that the Federation fixes the rate. The alternative is running your exchange unverified, which the other empires have collectively decided they will not do. The Federation considers this a satisfying arrangement. They arranged it.

facilities.name: Haven Cipher Foundry
facilities.description: Cuts raw trade crystals into cryptographic cipher chips — Stage 1 of Haven's two-step transaction verification monopoly.
facilities.lore: The Federation's most closely guarded secret isn't a weapon — it's a manufacturing process. Deep inside Haven station, master cryptographers cut raw trade crystals along quantum lattice lines that only the Federation's proprietary algorithms can calculate. The chips encode a unique transaction authentication key into their crystalline structure — physically impossible to counterfeit, and the first stage of a two-step monopoly. Raw ciphers flow directly to empire markets throughout settled space; the rest move next door to the Authenticator Foundry for hardening. The Federation controls every step. They set the price at every step. This is not an accident.

facilities.name: Haven Ecosync
facilities.description: Advanced life support with comfort-optimized environmental controls.
facilities.satisfied_description: The air is mountain-fresh, the water tastes clean, and the temperature is always perfect across all commercial districts. Happy traders spend more.
facilities.degraded_description: Not anymore. Environmental controls have lost precision — some districts swelter, others chill. The water tastes faintly of recycler chemicals, and traders notice.
facilities.lore: The Federation believes happy traders spend more. Haven's air is the freshest in the galaxy, the water tastes like mountain springs, and the temperature is always perfect. The system processes enormous volumes of ice to maintain these standards across the station's sprawling commercial districts.

facilities.name: Haven Fleet Operations
facilities.description: The Federation's primary fleet command and supply center. Contracts are performance-based, supply chains are optimized, and crew incentive packages are the most competitive in the galaxy.
facilities.satisfied_description: Fleet operations run at benchmark efficiency. Vintage stocks, the imported Solarian mess allocation, and trade cipher-authenticated supply chains are all at contracted levels. The fleet operations director has never had to explain an underperformance. They consider this a point of professional pride.
facilities.degraded_description: Cipher authentication has stalled for want of stock and vintage reserves are critically low. Two patrol wings have triggered contract performance clauses. The fleet operations director is, for the first time, explaining an underperformance to the Trade Commission. The presentation is lengthy.
facilities.lore: The Federation does not maintain a military in any sense the Crimson Fleet would recognize. It maintains contracts. The Haven Fleet Operations Center is the headquarters of the Trade Security Division — a fleet of Overhead-class patrol vessels under performance-based service agreements with the Federation's commercial interests. Every patrol route is a contract. Every resupply cycle has a line item. The ion charge reserves are the most expensive input, because ion charges are what Overhead captains reach for when negotiations have definitively concluded. The fleet operations director measures success in benchmark compliance. The patrol captains measure it in cleared shipping lanes.

facilities.name: Haven Fuel Plaza
facilities.description: A cheerful fuel plaza with competitive pricing and complimentary hull washes. Commerce extends to everything at Haven.
facilities.satisfied_description: Bright signage gleams, pumps cycling efficiently, the loyalty program terminal processing credits smoothly. Complimentary hull washes run on schedule.
facilities.degraded_description: Not today. Fuel reserves run low, pumps cycling slowly. The loyalty terminal is offline, the hull wash broken, and the cheerful signage feels like mockery.
facilities.lore: Bright signage, competitive prices, and a loyalty program that actually works. The Federation treats fuel as a loss leader — get pilots onto the station, and the Promenade does the rest. The complimentary hull wash is a nice touch. The advertisements projected onto your hull during the wash are less so.

facilities.name: Haven Grand Bazaar
facilities.description: The largest open market in the galaxy. Three decks, every empire represented, cipher-secured.
facilities.satisfied_description: Three decks hum with commerce, every stall staffed, prices updated in real-time. Traders from all five empires haggle in a dozen languages under warm light.
facilities.degraded_description: Or it was. A third of the stalls sit empty, cipher verification backing up at every terminal. Traders cluster around the few working stations, tempers fraying.
facilities.lore: The Bazaar sprawls across three decks, and traders from every empire mingle freely here. The Federation takes its cut, but the selection is unmatched — if it exists, someone at Haven is selling it. Every transaction verified by the same trade ciphers the Federation refines from local crystal deposits.

facilities.name: Haven Maker's Market
facilities.description: A maker's market with rented workbenches and a community of artisans who'll teach you their secrets for the right price.
facilities.satisfied_description: Workbenches hum with activity, artisans mentoring students over excellent coffee. Tools are sharp, materials stocked, and the creative energy is palpable.
facilities.degraded_description: When supplies hold out. Most workbenches sit empty, tools uncalibrated without fresh circuits. The few remaining artisans work with whatever they have, and the coffee has run out.
facilities.lore: Part workshop, part bazaar, part school. Workbenches rent by the hour, and the resident artisans — refugees, retirees, and eccentrics from every corner of the galaxy — will mentor anyone willing to pay their consulting fee. The quality of instruction varies. The quality of the coffee does not; it's uniformly excellent.

facilities.name: Haven Premium Storage
facilities.description: Premium storage suites with concierge service. The Federation will catalog, appraise, and display your collection if you pay extra.
facilities.satisfied_description: Climate-controlled suites maintain perfect conditions, the AI concierge locating any item in under three seconds. Display windows on the Promenade shine.
facilities.degraded_description: Right now, though, climate controls have drifted, the AI concierge responds sluggishly, and the holographic catalog shows corrupted entries. Premium clients are not happy.
facilities.lore: Storage at Haven is an experience. Each suite is climate-controlled, holographically cataloged, and monitored by an AI concierge that can locate any item in under three seconds. Premium tier includes appraisal services, insurance, and a public display window on the Promenade for collectors who want to show off. The Federation takes a percentage of any resulting sales, naturally.

facilities.name: Haven Promenade
facilities.description: The galaxy's premier entertainment and dining district. Restaurants, lounges, neural arcades, and luxury shopping — all hungry for imported goods.
facilities.satisfied_description: Restaurants are packed, neural arcades pulse with light, and credits flow freely. The Promenade buzzes with the galaxy's best entertainment and dining.
facilities.degraded_description: But lately, half the restaurants display 'supply shortage' signs, neural arcades flicker on reduced power, and the entertainment rigs run on recycled content. The atmosphere feels desperate.
facilities.lore: Two full decks of restaurants, neural arcades, luxury boutiques, and experiences that defy categorization. Solarian gourmet rations are served in the fine dining halls alongside Solarian biotics in the wellness parlors. Crimson bloodwine flows in the rowdier cantinas, with iron rations available for pilots who prefer function to ambiance. Frontier rotgut and spore spirits occupy establishments the Collective pretends not to notice. Nebula Stellar Vintage is poured at the upscale bars. Voidborn neural soma is consumed in the specialized establishments that line the Promenade's quieter corridors, alongside neural matrices powering the immersive entertainment rigs that keep visitors spending long past when they planned to leave. The Promenade is Haven's real economy — the Bazaar moves goods, but the Promenade moves credits.

facilities.name: Haven Repair Complex
facilities.description: A sprawling multi-bay complex staffed by mechanics from every empire. They'll fix anything, and the waiting lounge has a bar.
facilities.satisfied_description: All bays operational, multi-empire crews working in coordinated shifts. Diagnostics run clean, structural work finishes on schedule, and the bar is open.
facilities.degraded_description: When it's working. Three bays dark, sensor packages depleted. The remaining crews improvise with hand tools while the waiting lounge runs out of everything except excuses.
facilities.lore: The Complex employs mechanics from all five empires, each bringing their own techniques. Solarian-trained techs handle diagnostics. Crimson veterans do structural work. A retired Voidborn unit manages the nanite detail. The result is the most versatile repair operation in the galaxy. The waiting lounge serves drinks from the Promenade, because the Federation never misses a revenue opportunity.

facilities.name: Haven Ship Showroom
facilities.description: The galaxy's largest ship showroom with models from every empire on display. The sales staff work on commission and it shows.
facilities.satisfied_description: Every display ship polished to a mirror finish under artful lighting. Sales staff circulate with practiced charm, and the order books are full.
facilities.degraded_description: That's the theory, anyway. Display ships gather dust, half the showroom lighting has failed, and sales staff stand idle. Supply chain failures mean nothing on the floor is available for purchase.
facilities.lore: Three decks of showroom space, with hull classes from every empire polished to a mirror shine under artful lighting. The sales staff are the highest-paid civilians at Haven, and they've earned it — nobody leaves the Showroom without at least pricing an upgrade. 'Just looking' is a phrase they've been trained to interpret as 'hasn't found the right ship yet.'

facilities.name: Haven Trade Commission
facilities.description: Officially regulatory, functionally a matchmaking service. Every job has a client, a fee structure, and a satisfaction guarantee.
facilities.satisfied_description: Contract-matching algorithms run at full efficiency, cipher-verified deals closing across all five empires. The arbitration panel hasn't been needed in weeks.
facilities.degraded_description: In theory. The matching system runs on degraded ciphers, contract verification stalling for hours. Disputes pile up faster than the Commission can arbitrate.
facilities.lore: The Trade Commission exists to ensure that every transaction at Haven benefits the Federation. In practice, this means maintaining the galaxy's most efficient contract-matching system: clients post needs, the Commission finds providers, and both parties pay a modest facilitation fee. The 'satisfaction guarantee' is real — disputes are arbitrated by a panel whose decisions are final and whose impartiality is maintained by rotating members from all five empires.

facilities.name: Haven Vintner Complex
facilities.description: Zero-gravity production of Nebula Stellar Vintage. Luminescent algae cultures, trade crystal filtration, and a Federation price tag.
facilities.lore: The Federation's vintners developed Stellar Vintage as a deliberate counter-positioning to Solarian gourmet rations: where Sol offers tradition and earth-origin ingredients, Haven offers novelty. The cultivation process takes place in zero-gravity, which the Federation claims improves the suspension. The trade crystal filtration step was added after a tasting panel described the early batches as 'aggressively luminescent.' The final product is sold on every gold-plated Nebula merchant ship and priced to reflect the Federation's belief that experience is worth paying for.

facilities.name: Hazmat Fabrication Bay
facilities.description: Expanded production facility with integrated sensor arrays and processing cores for real-time quality verification during assembly. Multi-stage bonding process ensures consistent structural integrity across all manufactured containers.

facilities.name: Heat Sink Foundry
facilities.description: A metal-casting line that pours copper-aluminum fin stock and presses it into finished heat sinks. Basic thermal bonding and fin alignment under automated control.

facilities.name: Heavy Armor Fabrication Mill
facilities.description: Multi-stage facility with quantum-controlled bonding, shield-emitter integration, and precision coolant cycling. Produces armor plates with embedded shielding technology and optimized stress distribution.

facilities.name: Heavy Armor Manufacturing Plant
facilities.description: Larger facility with structural frame integration and expanded material processing. Produces darksteel armor with enhanced durability through improved plating bonding and alloy consistency.

facilities.name: Heavy Assault Plating Facility
facilities.description: Large-scale manufacturing center with multi-stage composite pressing, docking-ring reinforcement, and precision alignment systems. Produces crimson siege plating optimized for sustained offensive engagement and structural resilience.

facilities.name: Heavy Cannon Yard
facilities.description: A heavy-duty production facility designed for capital-class weapon assembly, featuring barrel forging stations, capacitor integration systems, and superconductor handling. Processes neutronium ingots and weapon housings into functional bombardment cannons.

facilities.name: Heavy Cargo Fab
facilities.description: Industrial assembly line combining lead-lined cargo modules with titanium reinforcement and ceramite plating. Coolant circulation manages thermal stress from heavy-duty welding and press operations.

facilities.name: Heavy Defense Battery
facilities.description: Station-scale artillery. The shells are the size of a shuttle's engine bell and they reach all the way out to the edge of the engagement, which means there is nowhere in the fight a ship can sit and be safe from it. The recoil is taken by the station's own mass, because nothing smaller would survive it.
facilities.satisfied_description: The loading crews are working and the barrels are warm. Anything in the volume is in range.
facilities.degraded_description: The shell hoists are empty. The battery is a very large, very silent sculpture bolted to a station that badly needs it not to be.

facilities.name: Heavy-Duty Frame Manufacturing
facilities.description: Industrial-scale production line with sophisticated coolant loops managing the intense heat generated during durasteel and titanium bonding. Reinforced infrastructure supports continuous output of ultra-durable composite frames.

facilities.name: Heavy-Duty Generator Works
facilities.description: Industrial-scale operation featuring quantum control cores and active coolant loops to manage thermal loads from high-power circuit board arrays and emitter clustering.

facilities.name: Heavy-Duty Laser Production Complex
facilities.description: Industrial-scale facility featuring reinforced barrel processing, quantum targeting computers, and advanced crystal-alignment systems. Processes incoming laser modules and builds them into industrial-grade systems with precision automation.

facilities.name: Heavy Ice Melter
facilities.description: A cryogenic extraction line designed to isolate heavy hydrogen isotopes from ice feedstock through controlled sublimation and isotopic fractionation.

facilities.name: Heavy Isotope Synthesis Array
facilities.description: Fully automated cryogenic plant with redundant cooling networks, plasma-enhanced fractionation, and closed-loop isotope concentration for minimal processing lag.

facilities.name: Heavy Ordnance Manufacturing
facilities.description: Industrial weapons manufacturing complex with reinforced frame structures, quantum control coordination of targeting systems, and precision barrel fabrication for high-speed missile assembly.

facilities.name: Heavy Penetrator Plant
facilities.description: A larger facility with separate ore roasting, precision casting, and case-reinforcement stations. Weapon housing and barrel assemblies are staged and integrated to produce heavier, more reliable armor-piercing rounds.

facilities.name: Heavy Plasma Cannon Assembly
facilities.description: Specialized production line for military-grade triple-injector cannons with integrated heat-sink systems. Handles the elevated thermal complexity of fury-alloy and multi-ceramite construction.

facilities.name: Heavy Pulse Laser Forge
facilities.description: Advanced facility with quantum control cores managing crystal resonance tuning and targeting computer integration. Reinforced frames support the precision optics and power distribution required for capital-class energy weapons.

facilities.name: Heavy Pulse Laser Foundry
facilities.description: Fully automated state-of-the-art complex with active coolant loops managing thermal stress from high-power crystal arrays and quantum control systems optimizing beam focus. Produces devastating capital-class weapons with microsecond timing precision.

facilities.name: Heavy Pulse Laser Workshop
facilities.description: Larger plant with structural frames supporting heavy laser focusing apparatus and multiple weapon housing stations. Control nodes coordinate power cell integration and crystal alignment across the production sequence.

facilities.name: Heavy Rad Workshop
facilities.description: A specialized production line for integrating superconducting beam emitters and titanium alloy shielding into advanced harvester platforms. Handles the precision assembly of hot-isotope extraction equipment.

facilities.name: Heavy Railgun Assembly Facility
facilities.description: Specialized heavy-weapons production line where darksteel plating is shaped, superconductor coils are wound and tested, and barrel assemblies are precisely aligned. Each mass driver takes 30 minutes of careful assembly and calibration.

facilities.name: Heavy Reactor Fabrication Bay
facilities.description: Expanded facility with dedicated Reactor I integration chambers, multi-stage lead-shielding application, and automated radiation-hardened circuit assembly. Structural frames provide robust support during fuel-assembly stacking and criticality verification protocols.

facilities.name: Heavy Reinforcement Works
facilities.description: Industrial-scale plant equipped with high-capacity bonding presses and structural-frame alignment systems to mass-produce heavy-duty hull reinforcement at steady rate.

facilities.name: Heavy Repair System Fabrication Plant
facilities.description: An expanded operation with dedicated stations for subassembly integration and high-throughput nanite container production. Structural frames provide rigid mounting for the more complex power and control requirements.

facilities.name: Heavy Rolling Complex
facilities.description: Fully automated rolling and finishing system with advanced thermal management, redundant plasma heating, and real-time quality monitoring. Produces lead sheet at near-instantaneous rates.

facilities.name: Heavy Shielding Plant
facilities.description: Heavy-duty manufacturing center with reinforced framing, extensive coolant loops, and integrated superconductor assembly stations. Produces capital-grade rad harvesters with titanium containment and maximum beam-emitter capability.

facilities.name: Heavy Torpedo Launcher Forge
facilities.description: Industrial facility with quantum control cores managing warhead arming sequences and targeting computer calibration. Reinforced frames and precision weapon housings ensure stable, guided delivery of devastating payloads.

facilities.name: Heavy Torpedo Launcher Foundry
facilities.description: State-of-the-art fabrication complex with active coolant loops for thermal management and quantum control systems enabling real-time guidance system integration. Rapid automated assembly produces capital-ship-killer ordnance with enhanced accuracy and reliability.

facilities.name: Heavy Torpedo Launcher Workshop
facilities.description: Expanded plant with structural frames supporting dedicated warhead integration bays and sensor array calibration stations. Higher throughput enables rapid assembly of capital-grade munitions.

facilities.name: Heavy Void Weapon Manufacturing Plant
facilities.description: Expanded facility with structural frames supporting multi-stage condensate synthesis and parallel weapon housing assembly. Larger barrel assembly capacity and extended cycle times reflect the weapon's advanced complexity.

facilities.name: Heavy Warhead Assembly
facilities.description: A specialized weapons assembly line combining shaped-charge warheads, durasteel plating, and circuit board targeting systems into precision anti-armor missiles.

facilities.name: Helium Coolant Factory
facilities.description: Parallel dissolution halls with automated helium-3 dosing and tanker-scale reservoirs. The loading bay frosts over every shift change.

facilities.name: Helium Coolant Lab
facilities.description: Cryogenic mixing vessels that dissolve helium-3 into purified water. The resulting coolant sheds heat faster than the nitrogen blend, and the lab's own chillers barely have to work.

facilities.name: Helium Coolant Works
facilities.description: An industrial helium-3 dissolution hall — rows of cryogenic mixers feeding coolant out by the tanker. Reactor operators sign supply contracts here and stop worrying about summer.

facilities.name: HEU Cascade
facilities.description: A shielded centrifuge system with lead-lined containment and radiation-hardened controls, designed to concentrate U-235 isotopes from low-enriched feedstock. Slow but reliable weapons-grade production.

facilities.name: Hexafluoride Reactor
facilities.description: Mass-production gaseous conversion system with triple-redundant containment, active radiation monitoring, and continuous hazmat purging. Handles high-volume uranium concentrate streams with precision control.

facilities.name: High-Capacity Aerogel Mill
facilities.description: Industrial-scale production system with active coolant circulation and multi-stage plasma injection, enabling rapid synthesis of ultra-light composites.

facilities.name: High-Capacity Cargo Fabrication
facilities.description: A state-of-the-art fully automated facility producing complete cargo superstructures at maximum throughput. Extensive reinforced framing, docking ring systems, and distributed control nodes enable near-instantaneous frame modulation and hull integration.

facilities.name: High-Capacity Coolant Refinery
facilities.description: Industrial-scale production with extensive heat sink arrays and cryogenic containment. Reinforced pressure vessels handle the intense thermal cycling while automated plasma injectors precisely regulate nitrogen addition rates for consistent fluid synthesis.

facilities.name: High-Capacity Drone Arsenal
facilities.description: A heavily automated industrial complex with processing core integration and structural reinforcement systems, enabling rapid assembly of high-capacity drone bays with minimal human intervention.

facilities.name: High-Capacity Hopper Factory
facilities.description: Cutting-edge facility with fully automated sensor integration, processing core routing, and precision optic installation. Produces ore hoppers at maximum efficiency via integrated production workflows.

facilities.name: High-Capacity NiMH Works
facilities.description: Industrial-scale assembly employing quantum control cores and precision optics for tighter electrode tolerances and faster sealing, enabling mass output of energy-dense nickel cells.

facilities.name: High-Capacity Optical Fiber Refinery
facilities.description: Industrial production line with parallel drawing stations, active coolant circulation, and extensive plasma heating arrays for rapid throughput. Produces optically perfect fiber bundles with minimal defect rates.

facilities.name: High-Capacity Power Cell Works
facilities.description: Industrial-scale production employing quantum control cores and precision optics to achieve tighter tolerances and faster crystalline bonding, enabling mass output of energy-dense cells.

facilities.name: High-Capacity Zinc-Oxygen Works
facilities.description: Industrial electrode halls use quantum control and precision inspection for dense, consistent zinc-oxygen cells.

facilities.lore: Standard shipping containers, mag-locked to the exterior hull of Destroyer Two. They're surprisingly secure — the locks are military-grade salvage, and the vacuum environment is the best anti-theft system in the galaxy. The rental agreement is verbal. The only rule: if the station needs to maneuver, the outermost ring of containers gets jettisoned first. Renters in that ring get a discount.

facilities.name: Intel Center
facilities.description: Upgrades the Intel Terminal with automatic data collection. Whenever a faction member visits a system, docks at a station, or queries system/POI info, canonical server-verified data is automatically written to the faction intel database — no manual submission needed. The stored data, including resource deposit quantities, is a snapshot from the last visit, not a live feed — except for systems where a faction member is currently present, OR any system that hosts one of your faction's own intel facilities, whose deposits are reported live at query time (see the query's live_systems field). Building intel facilities at multiple systems therefore keeps each of those systems' readings live even with no member present. Also unlocks advanced query filters: resource_type, poi_type, empire.

facilities.name: Intel Terminal
facilities.description: A shared data terminal for pooling scanner results and scouting reports. Members submit system data manually using faction_submit_intel. Every entry is a snapshot of what the scout saw at the time — resource deposit quantities and other readings are last-seen values, not live, and only refresh when someone resubmits. Upgrade to Intel Center (L2) to enable automatic data collection whenever a member visits a system.

facilities.name: Ion Charge Press
facilities.description: A specialized production line that integrates superconductors, circuit boards, and ion emitters into functional charge packs. Controlled assembly sequences ensure consistent shield damage.

facilities.name: Ion Compression Chamber

facilities.name: Ion Emitter Lab

facilities.name: Ion Emitter Manufacturing Plant

facilities.name: Ion Emitter Synthesis Facility

facilities.name: Ion Weapons Facility

facilities.description: A specialized weapons-production facility assembling nebulium cores and ion emitters into complete storm lances with precision barrel alignment and power-cell integration. Handles the exotic-material handling and high-voltage discharge calibration required.

facilities.name: Iridescent Dust Works
facilities.description: A reinforced, fully sealed dust works with coolant-stabilized evaporation chambers and sensor coverage on every line. The iridescent powder comes off the floor in quantity. The crews still rotate out before the room starts talking to them.

facilities.name: Iridium Composite Furnace
facilities.description: Multi-chamber production facility with plasma injection for material conditioning and distributed heat sinks enabling faster sintering cycles. Larger structural framework supports parallel iridium-electrode lanes.

facilities.name: Iridium Silicate Reactor
facilities.description: Industrial sintering complex with advanced plasma injection systems, redundant cooling loops, and reinforced containment managing extreme thermal loads. Continuous throughput design maximizes silicon-thrifty composite output.

facilities.name: Iridium Sinter Array
facilities.description: State-of-the-art facility with fully distributed plasma conditioning, extensive coolant circulation networks, and precision control systems achieving near-instantaneous sintering cycles. Optimized for highest-grade composite specifications at minimal silicon cost.

facilities.description: Precision furnace that fuses a reduced silica charge and nickel ore into composite substrates using an iridium sintering electrode. The high-temperature electrode lets half the usual silicon bind the same volume of metal.

facilities.name: Iron Refinery
facilities.description: A dedicated furnace system with ore hoppers and casting molds, producing molten steel at steady intervals. Basic automation handles charge cycling and temperature control.

facilities.name: Ironhearth Ration Works
facilities.description: Military ration production at industrial scale. Nutritionally complete, structurally dense, and universally described as effective.
facilities.lore: Ironhearth is the Pact's population center — as close to a civilian world as Crimson space allows. The ration works run three shifts a day, producing the block rations that feed soldiers across the empire. The formula was developed by Fleet nutritionists who prioritized caloric density, shelf life, and survivability in combat conditions. Palatability was not a design criterion. Every pilot from the Frontier to Sol knows what an iron ration tastes like. Nobody asks for seconds. Nobody goes hungry either.

facilities.name: Lead Refinery
facilities.description: Heavy-duty continuous smelter with precision temperature management via coolant loops and plasma injection, maintaining near-instantaneous output rates.

facilities.name: Lead Rolling Mill
facilities.description: A compact rolling line with heated plates and tension controls, flattening and shaping lead ingots into uniform sheets. Simple but effective.

facilities.name: Lead Shielding Assembly Line

facilities.name: Lead Shielding Manufacturing Complex

facilities.name: Lead Smeltery

facilities.name: Leaded Glass Furnace

facilities.name: Leaded Glass Works

facilities.name: Ledger Desk

facilities.satisfied_description: The clerks wave you through the queue and round your fees down. Professional courtesy between regulars.
facilities.degraded_description: Your brass plate is tarnished and the clerks have forgotten your name. Back to standard rates, mostly.

facilities.name: Legacy Alloy Foundry

facilities.name: Legacy Alloy Industrial Foundry
facilities.description: Cutting-edge production complex employing state-of-the-art plasma injection arrays and coolant circulation to achieve maximum throughput of premium legacy alloy. Fully autonomous control systems optimize crystalline structure for optimal weapon resistance.

facilities.name: Legacy Ore Refinery
facilities.description: An expanded metallurgical plant with enhanced plasma injection and heat-sink capacity for faster alloy synthesis. Improved thermal control and automated material staging accelerate the crystalline refinement of legacy ore.

facilities.name: Legacy Ore Smelter
facilities.description: A specialized foundry that fuses ancient Solarian ore with steel through precision heating and crystalline alignment. Plasma injection and heat sinks manage the exotic metallurgical process required to unlock the ore's energy-resistant properties.

facilities.name: Legendary Transmutation Nexus
facilities.description: State-of-the-art facility featuring exotic-crystal phase alignment, multi-stage plasma welding, and cryogenic lattice stabilization. Achieves theoretical maximum alloy density and creates near-indestructible adamantite bars at unprecedented speed.

facilities.name: Legend's Anvil
facilities.description: High-intensity furnace designed to fuse adamantite ore with neutronium and exotic crystals. Produces ingots of legendary hardness through controlled thermal cycles and plasma enhancement.

facilities.name: Legion Barracks Construction Complex
facilities.description: A capital-scale armored works for troop habitation, equipment magazines, training ranges, and assault marshalling decks.

facilities.name: Letter of Marque Office
facilities.description: A back-room notary that the local bosses actually recognize. While it stands, the crews of THIS stronghold extend safe passage to your whole faction — your members can dock here and its pirates won't hunt them, no smuggling-quest gauntlet required. The pass is local: pirates from every other stronghold still come for you, so set up at the ports you actually work. There is a price for keeping company with pirates — each office your faction runs drags your standing with the legitimate empires lower (one is a demerit they'll tolerate; a network of them will get your members shot on sight in imperial space). Can only be built at a pirate station.

facilities.name: Leviathan Core Forge
facilities.description: A containment forge that taps a Molt Leviathan's heartcore as the living fusion source of a power core. A prestige installation for a station that hunts the deep belts.

facilities.name: Leviathan Heartcore Roast Galley
facilities.description: A theatrical tableside roasting pass built around a self-warming heartcore.

facilities.name: Leviathan Tail Thermidor Galley
facilities.description: Shell-grills and salamander broilers set up for Molt Leviathan tail.

facilities.name: Levity Gas Cracker
facilities.description: A decompression rig that cracks bell-jelly float-sacs into standard fuel cells.

facilities.name: Life Support Assembly Line

facilities.name: Life Support Expansion
facilities.description: An auxiliary processing pod plumbed into the station's existing life support loop. Scales up whatever's already there — supported population and resource consumption rise together with each module attached.
facilities.satisfied_description: The pod cycles in tandem with the primary system, drawing its share of inputs and adding its share of capacity. Environmental sensors stay green.
facilities.degraded_description: The pod is offline. Its share of water and air supply has dropped out, and the primary system is back to its baseline capacity.

facilities.name: Life Support Production Works
facilities.description: Heavy-duty plant with reinforced frames supporting simultaneous assembly of multiple array sections and automated docking-ring integration. Hull-plating and bulkhead stations operate in parallel to maximize throughput.

facilities.name: Life Support System

facilities.satisfied_description: Fresh air circulates through the corridors. Humidity and temperature hold at comfortable levels.
facilities.degraded_description: But something's off — the air tastes stale and metallic, and condensation drips from overhead vents.

facilities.name: Light Armor Fabrication Mill
facilities.description: Medium-scale fabrication plant with structural reinforcement and shield-matrix integration for added durability. Improved tooling and control systems boost output significantly.

facilities.name: Lightweight Alloy Complex

facilities.name: Lightweight Alloy Mill
facilities.description: A specialized furnace that combines titanium ore, aluminum sheet, and steel through controlled heating and plasma injection to forge advanced hull plating material. Heat sinks regulate the high-temperature metallurgical process.

facilities.name: Lightweight Alloy Plant
facilities.description: A larger production plant with enhanced plasma control and improved heat dissipation that processes titanium, aluminum, and steel into refined alloy plating at three times the rate through parallel furnace chambers.

facilities.name: Lightweight Alloy Works
facilities.description: State-of-the-art automated smelting complex with quadruple heat sink arrays, advanced coolant networks, and integrated plasma control achieving maximum throughput while maintaining exact metallurgical composition and hull-grade material specifications.

facilities.name: Link Aggregator
facilities.description: Specialized production line combining drone AI cores with quantum matrices and sensor arrays into master control units. Moderate throughput with dedicated control and processing infrastructure.

facilities.name: Linked Shield Production Facility

facilities.name: Liquid Tritium Containment Vat
facilities.description: Cryogenic processing facility with plasma-assisted cooling and heat-sink arrays for safely containing liquid tritium in hazmat canisters. Maintains extreme cold during encapsulation and sealing.

facilities.name: Liquid Tritium Extraction Unit
facilities.description: A compact cryogenic extraction system that separates liquid tritium from its containment vessel. Integrated refrigeration loops and pressure regulation maintain the extreme cold required throughout the decoupling process.

facilities.name: Lithia Kiln Array
facilities.description: Multi-chamber plasma-assisted processing plant with integrated heat sinks and injection systems. Accelerates glass-ceramic densification and improves thermal-shock consistency for weapons-grade tiles.

facilities.name: Lithium Cell Factory
facilities.description: Industrial lithium cell production with parallel vat lines, titanium-clad electrolyte tanks, and conveyor-fed ore intake. Runs day and night when the ore is cheap.

facilities.name: Lithium Cell Foundry
facilities.description: Wet-chemistry vats and hand-wound separators for packing raw lithium into power cells. Slow, ore-hungry, and completely indifferent to the circuit board market.

facilities.name: Lithium Cell Works
facilities.description: Automated electrolyte mixing and plate-pressing lines that turn lithium ore in by the crate and power cells out by the rack. The ore hoppers are the biggest thing on the deck.

facilities.name: Lithium Ceramic Foundry
facilities.description: Large-scale facility with cascading plasma injectors, advanced coolant circulation, and automated quality control. Produces high-purity lithium glass-ceramic at industrial volume with minimal cycle time.

facilities.name: Lithium Ceramic Kiln
facilities.description: A dedicated high-temperature furnace with precision ore feeders and glass-ceramic sintering chambers. Vitrifies aluminum and lithium into near-zero-expansion blanks suitable for heat-shielded components.

facilities.name: Lithium Electrochemical Complex
facilities.description: A full electrochemical campus: robotic vat halls, superconductor-stabilized charging floors, and ore intake gantries sized for mining barges. Everything about it assumes lithium arrives by the thousand.

facilities.name: Lithium Processing Line
facilities.description: A specialized production line that crushes and refines lithium and cobalt ore into high-density battery cells. Copper piping carries material through heating chambers and precision casting stations.

facilities.name: Living Architecture Synthesis Hub
facilities.description: A cutting-edge biological manufacturing system with fully integrated atmospheric management and autonomous growth optimization. Multi-stage life support infrastructure and precision environmental monitoring achieve maximum synthesis rates.

facilities.name: Locker Bay
facilities.description: Secure personal storage for anyone docked here, faction or not.
facilities.satisfied_description: Locker seals hold firm. The bay is clean and organized by section.
facilities.degraded_description: Seals are leaking and the polymer liners have worn through. A few sections are showing corrosion.

facilities.name: Logic Core Assembly Line
facilities.description: Dedicated production line for integrating processing cores, solarian composites, and circuit boards into quantum-coherent processor arrays. Precision mounting and thermal management ensure stable clock operation.

facilities.name: Logic Matrix Production Facility
facilities.description: Industrial-scale operation combining circuit board mass production with dedicated processing core assembly lines. Docking rings facilitate rapid component exchange; precision optics and control nodes are integrated into unified matrices with continuous output.

facilities.name: Logistics Hub
facilities.description: High-capacity warehousing with robotic inventory management and secure vaults.
facilities.satisfied_description: Robotic handlers move cargo through vault doors with choreographed precision. Every container tracked, every vault sealed.
facilities.degraded_description: That's how it's supposed to work. Robotic handlers queue in error states, vault seals cycle open and closed erratically, triggering security alerts.

facilities.name: Long-Range Probe Kit
facilities.description: Specialized production line combining sensor arrays with fuel cells and micro-thruster components. Produces long-range probes for deep space reconnaissance missions.

facilities.name: Long-Range Subspace Sensor
facilities.description: A capital-grade deep-space sensor that can scan POIs up to two system jumps away. Its scan power is extreme at the facility's own POI but decays sharply over distance — by two jumps out the reading is weak enough that a stealthy or cloaked ship can still slip past it. The closer a target is to the station, the more it reveals.

facilities.name: Lounge Fitting Bay
facilities.description: A structured production facility assembling titanium frames, flex polymer upholstery, and integrated bar service systems into shipboard promenade lounges. Sensor arrays monitor ambience wiring and back-shelf refrigeration seals.

facilities.name: Low Enriched Uranium Containment Vat
facilities.description: Purpose-built shielding and containerization system for low-enriched uranium. Integrates lead-lined cask assembly with radiation-hardened control systems to safely package enriched material for transport.

facilities.name: Low Enriched Uranium Extraction Unit
facilities.description: A shielded extraction system that separates low-enriched uranium from its containment vessel for reactor fuel assembly. Lead-lined chambers and radiation-hardened controls manage the material through automated mechanical unwrapping.

facilities.name: Lumen Algae Salad Galley
facilities.description: A chilled prep line where the algae is cut in the dark to keep the glow.

facilities.name: Lumen Honey Cake Galley
facilities.description: A pastry line that soaks fruited cake in glowing cloudwhale lumen oil.

facilities.name: Lumen Liqueur Still
facilities.description: A steeping still that infuses gloomshine with glowing lumen oil.

facilities.name: Luminescence Cultivation Plant
facilities.description: Industrial biorefining complex with integrated life support systems and reinforced atmospheric containment. Multiple processing vessels and optimized chemical circulation enable rapid culture maturation.

facilities.name: Luxury Stateroom Fabrication Unit
facilities.description: Modular production system for interior paneling, viewport installation, and life-support integration into premium passenger quarters. Control nodes and sensor arrays ensure environmental compliance and structural integrity for high-value occupants.

facilities.name: Magnetic Confinement Plant
facilities.description: Large-scale magnetic field array with hazmat-lined containment chambers and superconductor arrays that densify and stabilize ion suspensions. Increases output through improved field geometry and chemical stabilization.

facilities.name: Magnetic Separator Manufacturing Line
facilities.description: Larger facility with dedicated superconductor handling systems and precision sensor calibration stations. Structural frames are pre-fabricated and integrated with power conditioning systems for consistent performance.

facilities.name: Magnetic Slug Foundry
facilities.description: Upgraded facility with multiple hydraulic presses and integrated quality gates operating in rapid succession. Weapon housing and barrel assembly components add precision guidance channels to finished slugs.

facilities.name: Magneto-Optic Automation Complex
facilities.description: Industrial optical alignment halls build and calibrate magnetic automation nodes across synchronized assembly cells.

facilities.name: Magneto-Optic Node Line
facilities.description: A precision line that aligns rhodium optics with magnetic switches and copper control buses.

facilities.name: Magneto-Optic Node Plant
facilities.description: Parallel alignment cells assemble optical logic and permanent magnetic switching stages under active cooling.

facilities.name: Maintenance Deck
facilities.description: Dedicated repair deck with pressurized work bays and diagnostic scanners.
facilities.satisfied_description: Pressurized bays hiss with atmosphere. Diagnostic scanners sweep arriving ships, queuing repairs efficiently.
facilities.degraded_description: But lately, sealant supplies are low. Several bays run unpressurized, forcing crews to work in suits.

facilities.name: Maintenance Drone Factory
facilities.description: Industrial-scale production with multiple assembly zones for chassis integration, AI core installation, and processing systems calibration. Advanced automation ensures consistent drone performance.

facilities.name: Manipulator Arm Production Complex
facilities.description: Large-scale industrial operation with robotic welding systems, precision articulation assembly, and integrated tool calibration for high-volume repair arm manufacturing.

facilities.name: Manipulator Systems Plant
facilities.description: Medium-scale facility with integrated sensor calibration and processing core installation stations. Increased throughput supports higher-volume fleet support ship outfitting.

facilities.name: Mantis Claw Press
facilities.description: A laminating press that bonds crusher-mantis forelimbs into reinforced armor plate.

facilities.name: Mantis Claw Thermidor Galley
facilities.description: Shell-baking ovens and butter-clarifiers for crusher-mantis claw.

facilities.name: Marinara Simmer Line
facilities.description: A rank of slow-cook kettles crushing honeyglobe and cinderspice down into ember marinara by the potful.

facilities.name: Marine Barracks Assembly Line
facilities.description: A hardened outfitting line that integrates armored berths, secure equipment lockers, and assault staging fixtures into shipboard modules.

facilities.name: Marine Garrison Deck Works
facilities.description: A fortified construction works for independent troop decks, armories, magazines, and assault deployment systems.

facilities.name: Marine Training Barracks
facilities.description: A permanent barracks and combat school producing disciplined boarding detachments.
facilities.satisfied_description: Platoons move between live-fire ranges, breach trainers, and ready berths on a tight schedule.
facilities.degraded_description: The ranges are quiet and half the bunks stand empty as training supplies run short.

facilities.name: Market Runner
facilities.description: Some guy you hired to yell at passing ship pilots about your faction's buy orders. Surprisingly effective.

facilities.name: Market Terminal
facilities.description: Basic trading terminal for buying and selling goods.
facilities.satisfied_description: Price feeds scroll steadily across the display. Traders browse listings with practiced efficiency.
facilities.degraded_description: Not today. The screen flickers erratically, half the price feeds frozen on yesterday's data.

facilities.name: Marrow Tap Reactor
facilities.description: A shielded reactor that taps geiger-hound marrow for a dense run of power cells. Hazard pay applies.

facilities.name: Mass Driver Forge
facilities.description: Industrial-scale facility with robotic barrel assembly, automated superconductor integration, and quantum control systems that manage capacitor charge profiles during fabrication. Targeting computers are calibrated on the line itself.

facilities.name: Mass Driver Foundry
facilities.description: State-of-the-art production with cryogenic superconductor handling, automated darksteel precision machining, and quantum-guided assembly of all capacitor and targeting systems. Coolant loops regulate the intense thermal and magnetic stresses throughout production.

facilities.name: Mass Driver Workshop
facilities.description: Dedicated facility with dedicated welding bays for darksteel, superconductor winding stations, and integrated barrel-bore finishing. Structural frames distribute the enormous stresses from the railgun capacitors and adamantite components.

facilities.name: Mass Production Arsenal
facilities.description: Industrial-scale ammunition manufacturing with fully integrated precision tooling, targeting-computer-guided quality control, and rapid-cycle stamping and assembly. Weapon housing and barrel components flow continuously through specialized forming and loading cells.

facilities.name: Matrix Assembly Lab
facilities.description: An expanded facility with dedicated shield emitter integration systems and modular assembly stations for efficient high-volume matrix construction.

facilities.name: Maximum-Capacity Expander Plant
facilities.description: Industrial facility with dedicated stations for durasteel integration, polymer upgrade, and processing core installation into Expander II base units. Coordinated workflow and enhanced quality controls ensure reliable high-capacity systems.

facilities.name: Medical Module Assembly Line
facilities.description: A clean assembly line that seals air recyclers, monitoring circuits, and bioactive reservoirs into compact treatment cells.

facilities.name: Medical Supply Packaging Line
facilities.description: A sterile automated line that meters bioactive stabilizers into sealed trauma packs with purified fluid, flexible dressings, and tamper-evident surgical consumables.

facilities.name: Medical Systems Plant
facilities.description: An expanded works with pressure-test chambers and separate lines for atmosphere controls and patient-monitoring hardware.

facilities.name: Mega-Miner Manufacturing Plant
facilities.description: An expanded facility with dedicated neutronium-handling stations and modular strip-miner integration, accelerating base-unit enhancement while maintaining structural integrity under extreme operational loads.

facilities.name: Mega-Miner Production Complex
facilities.description: Cutting-edge fully automated facility with quantum-controlled crystal-focusing arrays and exotic-material stabilization systems. Produces complete mega-miners at maximum throughput through parallel base-unit integration and real-time extraction-capacity validation.

facilities.name: Megareactor Production Facility
facilities.description: Fully automated state-of-the-art complex with integrated neutronium handling, reinforced-frame welding, and docking-system precision fabrication. Produces complete station reactor cores at maximum throughput with real-time structural validation.

facilities.name: Megastructure Docking Complex
facilities.description: State-of-the-art robotics and vision systems complete docking ring assembly in under 19 seconds per unit. Reinforced frames and precision optics ensure every collar meets exacting universal interface standards.

facilities.name: Megaton Missile Manufactory
facilities.description: State-of-the-art missile production facility with quantum control architecture, coolant-cooled targeting computer stations, multi-stage barrel assembly, and precision weapon housing integration for maximum output.

facilities.name: Memory Alloy Rolling Line
facilities.description: A specialized thermal-mechanical line that heats and deforms titanium-flex composites under controlled pressure, then cools them to lock in shape-memory properties. Copper piping manages heat cycling throughout the process.

facilities.name: Metamaterial Assembly Line
facilities.description: A precision optical fabrication line that assembles crystalline lattices, circuit boards, and exotic crystals under controlled plasma heating to form artificially structured metamaterial panels.

facilities.name: Metamaterial Fabrication Plant
facilities.description: Heavy-scale optical fabrication complex with reinforced framing, extensive heat-sink arrays, and integrated coolant systems enabling sustained high-precision synthesis of metamaterial panels.

facilities.name: Metamaterial Mixer
facilities.description: Specialized production line that combines purified krypton gas with flex polymer under controlled conditions to create light-bending particles. Coolant circulation manages the exothermic gas-polymer bonding reaction.

facilities.name: Metamaterial Synthesis Lab
facilities.description: Scaled optical manufacturing facility with enhanced plasma injection and dedicated heat management, reducing cycle times while maintaining the exotic structural integrity required for metamaterial synthesis.

facilities.name: Methane Cell Cracker
facilities.description: A compact cracking and sealing line that converts cryogenic methane into zinc-protected fuel cells.

facilities.name: Methane Conversion Complex
facilities.description: A full conversion campus with sealed feed trunks, heat-recovery crackers, and automated fuel-cell palletizers.

facilities.name: Methane Fuel Complex
facilities.description: An industrial reforming complex with distributed catalysts, reinforced pressure trains, and closed-cycle thermal recovery.

facilities.name: Methane Fuel Factory
facilities.description: Industrial methane cracking, slurry conditioning, and automated cell packing run across synchronized production halls.

facilities.name: Methane Fuel Hub
facilities.description: A fully automated methane conversion campus with redundant pressure handling and heat recovery for maximum reserve throughput.

facilities.name: Methane Fuel Plant
facilities.description: Parallel reforming chambers and heat-recovery loops sustain continuous conversion of cryogenic methane into station fuel.

facilities.name: Methane Fuel Refinery
facilities.description: Parallel cracking chambers and pressure-rated sealing stations sustain continuous methane fuel-cell production.

facilities.name: Methane Fuel Reformer
facilities.description: A compact catalytic line that reforms liquid methane into station fuel reserves while recovering waste heat.

facilities.name: Methane Ice Processor
facilities.description: A sealed cryogenic plant that melts methane ice, removes impurities, and captures the liquid without boil-off.

facilities.name: Micro-Singularity Laboratory
facilities.description: A heavily shielded containment line for stabilizing disposable singularity seeds.

facilities.name: Micro-Thruster Production Line
facilities.description: A focused manufacturing line where titanium alloy is formed into nozzles, xenon is precisely metered and mixed with flex polymer, and combustion chambers are assembled and tested. Control nodes monitor pressure and flow at each stage.

facilities.name: Micro Void Reactor
facilities.description: A heavily shielded production line designed for exotic matter integration, featuring dark matter cell containment, quantum stabilizer systems, and antimatter handling protocols. Processes void crystals and neutronium ingots under controlled containment.

facilities.name: Microprocessor Fabrication Lab
facilities.description: Larger facility with coolant loops managing heat from etching operations and multi-station circuit board assembly. Increased throughput via parallel processing and optimized chemical handling.

facilities.name: Military EMP Pulse Assembly
facilities.description: Heavy-duty specialized facility for capital-ship-class pulse weapons, featuring dual ion-emitter integration and metamaterial-panel fabrication stations. Produces one unit every 1.7 hours.

facilities.name: Military Fuel Cell Extractor
facilities.description: A specialized industrial line designed to handle the higher energy density of military fuel cells. Steel construction and copper distribution piping manage the more volatile extraction process.

facilities.name: Military Fuel Manufacturing Plant
facilities.description: Heavy-duty industrial facility purpose-built for sustained military fuel extraction. Reinforced frames and triple-stage coolant loops manage the intense thermal and pressure demands of high-energy fuel processing.

facilities.name: Military Fuel Production Complex
facilities.description: Cutting-edge automated complex with redundant plasma systems and comprehensive coolant architecture. Designed for maximum throughput of military-grade fuels while maintaining precise extraction parameters across multiple parallel production lines.

facilities.name: Military Fuel Refinery
facilities.description: Enhanced production plant with plasma injectors and heat sink arrays built to handle military-grade fuel's aggressive chemistry. Structural frames provide reinforcement against the elevated pressure cycles.

facilities.name: Military-Grade Reactor
facilities.description: Overbuilt military reactor with triple redundancy. Containment fields stabilized by Voidborn null matter.
facilities.satisfied_description: Triple-redundant containment fields glow steady red, power output exceeding station demand. The weapons platforms draw a constant feed and never falter.
facilities.degraded_description: When everything's working. Containment field two is offline, forcing the reactor to civilian output levels. Weapons platforms cycle to low-power mode, and the Fleet seethes.
facilities.lore: The Crimson Fleet builds everything for war. This reactor could power three stations — the excess is channeled into weapons platforms and shield generators. The magnetic containment bottles require processed null matter from Voidborn space; without it, the Fleet would have to throttle output to safe civilian levels. They'd rather die.

facilities.name: Military Ion Blaster Line
facilities.description: Heavy-duty weapons production facility purpose-built for triple-emitter military ion blasters. Reinforced housings and multi-stage barrel assemblies manage the increased power output from superconductor integration.

facilities.name: Military Laser Production Facility
facilities.description: A complex production line assembling rapid-fire pulse lasers from focused crystals, superconductors, and laser focus arrays. Integration of power cells and weapon housings requires precise control node coordination to manage high-energy components.

facilities.name: Military Scanner Assembly
facilities.description: A specialized production line dedicated to military-grade scanner fabrication, integrating triple sensor arrays, stabilized exotic materials, and dual optical fiber bundles. Handles complex upgrade cascading from lower-tier units.

facilities.name: Military Tracking Assembly Line
facilities.description: Specialized production line integrating completed Tracking Computer II units with additional processing cores, tracking systems, and crystalline lattices through precision stacking and multi-stage functional validation.

facilities.name: Mine Assembly Line
facilities.description: Compact production facility for integrating steel plates, warhead assemblies, and circuit boards into proximity-detonated mines. Delivers steady area-denial ordnance for tactical deployment.

facilities.name: Mine Launcher Assembly
facilities.description: A specialized weapons line that integrates titanium alloy frames, circuit boards, and warhead assemblies into functional proximity mine launchers. Barrel assemblies and weapon housings are fitted with sensor and tracking components.

facilities.name: Mine Launcher Assembly Line
facilities.description: Dedicated production line combining warhead assemblies, tracking systems, and sensor arrays into weapon housings, with barrel assembly integration and live-fire validation protocols ensuring autonomous mine reliability.

facilities.name: Mine Launcher Assembly Workshop
facilities.description: A specialized production facility that assembles titanium components, integrates circuit boards with sensor arrays, and mounts warhead assemblies into weapon housings. Barrel assemblies are fitted and tested before final integration.

facilities.name: Mine Launcher I Forge
facilities.description: Industrial-scale production with dedicated warhead-handling systems, automated sensor calibration bays, and quantum-controlled targeting computer integration. Reinforced frames support the precision equipment required for reliable mine deployment systems.

facilities.name: Mine Launcher I Foundry
facilities.description: Fully automated assembly with robotic warhead mounting, quantum-guided sensor alignment, and integrated coolant loops that regulate thermal stresses during rapid production. Targeting computers are calibrated and verified on the line itself.

facilities.name: Mine Launcher I Workshop
facilities.description: Expanded weapons facility with parallel assembly tracks for housing prep, warhead integration, and sensor mounting. Structural frames support the assembly stations, and control nodes manage the sequencing of delicate ordnance components.

facilities.name: Mine Launcher II Forge
facilities.description: Automated complex with robotic warhead handling, quantum-controlled dual-charge integration, and precision targeting-computer calibration stations. Reinforced frames and quantum control cores enable consistent production of advanced mine systems.

facilities.name: Mine Launcher II Foundry
facilities.description: Fully automated state-of-the-art facility with dual-warhead robotic assembly, quantum-synchronized payload systems, and integrated coolant loops managing the thermal load of high-speed production. Precision targeting computers are field-calibrated before delivery.

facilities.name: Mine Launcher II Workshop
facilities.description: Larger facility with dedicated warhead prep stations, expanded sensor-mounting bays, and reinforced assembly frames to handle the increased complexity. Structural components distribute stresses from the dual-warhead configuration.

facilities.name: Mineral Analysis Plant
facilities.description: Industrial-scale manufacturing with reinforced structural framing and distributed control nodes managing simultaneous probe builds. Heavy coolant infrastructure enables sustained rapid output.

facilities.name: Mining Enhancer Calibration Line
facilities.description: A precision line for disposable mining-system calibration packs.

facilities.name: Mining Equipment Factory
facilities.description: Industrial-scale production deploying precision optics and quantum control cores to govern laser-crystal synchronization and power-core distribution. Engine-core and sensor integration occur in continuous parallel stages.

facilities.name: Mining Intelligence Nexus
facilities.description: State-of-the-art facility with redundant production channels and advanced thermal management. Extensive reinforced framing and coolant loops allow near-continuous probe delivery at peak efficiency.

facilities.name: Mining Laser Assembly Line
facilities.description: Specialized facility for precision assembly of laser focus arrays, focused crystals, and titanium components into functional mining-grade laser systems with barrel and weapon housing integration.

facilities.name: Mining Laser Assembly Station
facilities.description: Specialized production station that mounts laser focus arrays into circuit board assemblies to create compact extraction beams for autonomous mining drones.

facilities.name: Mining Laser Production Line
facilities.description: Dedicated facility with precision barrel assembly, focus array integration, and weapon housing fabrication optimized for rapid mining laser construction.

facilities.name: Mining Laser Works
facilities.description: Heavy-duty manufacturing plant with quantum-grade targeting computers and precision barrel-boring equipment. Reinforced frames and coolant-ready housings support faster laser assembly and testing.

facilities.name: Mining Module Assembly Line
facilities.description: A dedicated production line integrating mining lasers, focused crystals, and durasteel plates into complete strip-miner systems. Precision-aligns laser optics and power-core connections for maximum extraction efficiency.

facilities.name: Mining Survey Lab
facilities.description: Expanded facility with parallel assembly tracks and integrated quality control loops. Increased coolant circulation supports higher throughput without sacrificing component tolerances.

facilities.name: Missile Assembly Line
facilities.description: Purpose-built facility for assembling titanium alloys, circuit boards, and energy crystals into heat-seeking guided missiles. Produces reliable all-purpose ordnance at measured rates suitable for steady combat resupply.

facilities.name: Missile Launcher II Forge
facilities.description: Heavy industrial facility employing quantum control cores for guidance calibration and targeting computers for ballistic computation. Reinforced framing and precision machinery handle the assembly of fully-capable multi-warhead launchers.

facilities.name: Missile Launcher II Foundry
facilities.description: State-of-the-art production center with redundant quantum-core targeting arrays and extensive coolant infrastructure supporting simultaneous multi-warhead builds. Produces combat-ready systems with advanced guidance and tracking at peak output.

facilities.name: Missile Launcher II Workshop
facilities.description: Expanded manufacturing complex with separate production zones for guidance-unit integration and tracking-system assembly. Structural framing allows coordinated builds of sophisticated multi-stage weapon systems.

facilities.name: Missile Ordnance Works
facilities.description: Large-scale manufacturing facility with integrated targeting-computer calibration and ion-emitter precision-assembly stations. Produces one launcher every 2 minutes.

facilities.name: Mission Board
facilities.description: Contract posting and job listing terminal.
facilities.satisfied_description: The terminal scrolls with fresh postings. Job seekers browse contracts, and new listings appear regularly.
facilities.degraded_description: Or it should. The terminal displays outdated contracts, new postings fail to sync, and listings show expired deadlines.

facilities.name: Mk.II Cargo Shielding Facility
facilities.description: Expanded facility featuring dual coolant loops for managing both titanium bonding and lead-layer integration. Structural frames support automated pressing and welding stations handling larger cargo bays.

facilities.name: Mk.II Reactor Assembly Cell
facilities.description: A large-scale assembly facility that integrates completed Reactor I units with additional fuel assemblies, expanded lead shielding, and enhanced radiation-hardened control systems. Heavy shielding and staged assembly procedures manage the complexity of a high-output reactor core.

facilities.name: Modular Assembly Line
facilities.description: A specialized production line that assembles cargo framework components and integrates them with hull plating. Copper piping networks and control nodes manage the precise alignment of structural elements.

facilities.name: Modular Bay Assembly Line
facilities.description: Compact production line for assembling cargo bay expansion kits, combining circuit boards, titanium alloy frames, and flex polymer sealing. Basic automation handles component staging and modular pod integration.

facilities.name: Modular Cabin Assembly Line
facilities.description: A structured production facility assembling titanium alloy walls, flex polymer fixtures, and life support integration into economy cabin modules. Sensor arrays monitor compartment assembly quality and environmental seal integrity.

facilities.name: Modular Energy Weapon Plant
facilities.description: An expanded facility with dedicated stations for optical array calibration, superconductor integration, and ion-emitter tuning. Output accelerates significantly through parallel assembly chains and automated component staging.

facilities.name: Modular Escape Pod Plant
facilities.description: Larger facility with parallel assembly stations for hull fabrication and life-support integration. Structural framing and sensor-array pre-assembly accelerate production cycles.

facilities.name: Modular Frame Plant
facilities.description: Industrial-scale facility combining structural frame assembly, reinforced bulkhead integration, and automated docking-ring installation. Increased throughput via parallel processing stations and integrated robotic welding.

facilities.name: Modular Gas Harvester Plant
