facilities.description: An expanded facility with dedicated stations for component staging, quantum control integration, and multi-stage sensor calibration. Higher throughput and stricter tolerance control enable faster assembly of these complex systems.

facilities.name: Modular Generator Manufacturing
facilities.description: Expanded facility with dedicated staging for processing core integration and structural frame reinforcement, achieving three times the assembly rate of baseline production.

facilities.name: Modular Gravity Generator Plant
facilities.description: An efficient mid-scale facility with dedicated structural frame integration, parallel sensor array assembly, and processing core staging. Improved automation reduces assembly time while maintaining the precision required for gravity field generation.

facilities.name: Modular Hangar Bay Production Plant
facilities.description: An expanded facility with parallel hull plating stations, dedicated docking ring installation, and structural frame integration. Improved workflow and material staging enable faster assembly of these substantial ship-storage modules.

facilities.name: Modular Repair Kit Plant
facilities.description: Integrated assembly station with automated polymer injection and quality-control loops, producing repair kits at nearly triple the throughput. Coolant circulation keeps the bonding process efficient during sustained runs.

facilities.name: Modular Scanner Assembly Plant
facilities.description: Expanded production floor with structural frame reinforcement and increased processing cores enabling parallel assembly of multiple scanner units. Higher throughput through dedicated sub-assembly stations.

facilities.name: Modular Shield Plant
facilities.description: An expanded facility with parallel assembly stations and precision control systems, significantly increasing throughput while maintaining the complex calibration required for adaptive shielding.

facilities.name: Modulated Mining Laser Line
facilities.description: An adaptive beam assembly line for precision mining systems.

facilities.name: Molecular Synthesis Hub
facilities.description: State-of-the-art facility featuring multiple redundant reactor trains, precision cryogenic cooling, and automated feedstock metering. Produces premium-grade flexible polymer at maximum throughput via fully integrated process control.

facilities.name: Molecular Weave Fabricator
facilities.description: Cutting-edge automated facility with redundant plasma systems and comprehensive coolant architecture enabling rapid nanoplastic composite production. Multiple synchronized extrusion chambers achieve peak throughput while maintaining uniform material properties.

facilities.name: Molt Leviathan Bisque Galley
facilities.description: A dedicated bisque line — day-long stock kettles and silk presses for the galaxy's finest soup.

facilities.name: Moonshine Works
facilities.description: A full distillation works with reinforced fermentation vats, sensor-monitored mash, and reclaimed water feeding a continuous run. The strongholds argue over whose works makes the worst hangover — a point of pride.

facilities.name: Multi-Beam Mining Station
facilities.description: Large-scale production plant with dedicated laser-optics benches, barrel-assembly stations, and structural-frame mounting systems working in coordinated sequence to produce hyper-mining lasers.

facilities.name: Multi-Stage Atmospheric Filtration Plant
facilities.description: An expanded processing facility with larger combustion reactors and enhanced cryogenic condensers, supported by structural framing for weight distribution. Dual sensor arrays provide redundant composition feedback across all three separation stages.

facilities.name: Multi-Warhead Assembly Station
facilities.description: A specialized production facility designed to integrate multi-warhead systems, guidance units, and tracking modules into complex missile launchers. Handles the intricate wiring of sensor arrays and guidance electronics.

facilities.name: Muster Office
facilities.description: A compact registry, bunk room, and secure arms cage for faction personnel between assignments. It can receive returning prize crews and hold up to 128 crew and 32 marines.

facilities.name: Mythril Smithy
facilities.description: Industrial-grade forging plant with staged heating, plasma injection, and alloy refinement chambers. Neutronium integration and exotic crystal bonding yield bars of superior durability and structural integrity.

facilities.name: Nanite Assembly Line
facilities.description: A specialized production line that integrates repair nanite containers with durasteel plating and circuit assemblies. Multiple workstations feed into a central integration chamber where components are synchronized and sealed.

facilities.name: Nanite Coating Synthesis Line
facilities.description: A specialized facility that synthesizes exotic compounds and quantum matrices into active nanite suspension for hull application. Shield emitters and matrices prepare the substrate for nanite integration.

facilities.name: Nanite Fabrication Complex
facilities.description: Cutting-edge facility with quantum-core exotic-material processing, redundant shield-emitter arrays, and advanced coolant management. Produces high-purity nanite hull coatings at industrial scale with precision quality.

facilities.name: Nanite Incubation Lab
facilities.description: An expanded production plant with enhanced atmospheric systems and air recyclers to accelerate nanite containment protocols. Multiple assembly stations and improved environmental conditions reduce cycle times substantially.

facilities.name: Nanite Patch Station
facilities.description: Specialized production line for integrating repair nanite containers with control circuitry and flex-polymer delivery systems. Steady output of active armor-repair units for combat deployment.

facilities.name: Nanite Processing Plant
facilities.description: Larger production facility with enhanced exotic-material handling and quantum-matrix refinement stages. Distributed shield emitters and matrices support higher-volume nanite coating synthesis.

facilities.name: Nanite Production Complex
facilities.description: Heavy-duty biotech facility with integrated life support infrastructure and reinforced atmospheric containment for sustained nanite synthesis. Larger culturing volumes and optimized chemical pathways enable high-throughput container production.

facilities.name: Nanite Production Facility
facilities.description: Industrial-scale manufacturing plant with redundant synthesis chambers and active cooling to manage the heat generated by rapid replication. Reinforced structural frames support sustained high-volume output.

facilities.name: Nanite Swarm Foundry
facilities.description: A coordinated fabrication line for advanced repair swarms.

facilities.name: Nanite Synthesis Complex
facilities.description: State-of-the-art facility with redundant quantum systems, full sensor arrays, and precision coolant management for optimal nanite viability and circuit fidelity. Produces armor repairers at maximum scale and reliability.

facilities.name: Nanite Synthesis Lab
facilities.description: A larger production complex with enhanced material throughput and coolant-assisted synthesis to accelerate nanobot replication cycles. Improved precision in compound ratios boosts yield per batch.

facilities.name: Nano-Integrated Armor Facility
facilities.description: State-of-the-art facility featuring continuous-flow nanite infusion, real-time exotic matter stabilization, and precision quantum control. Produces armor with maximum regenerative efficiency and structural integrity.

facilities.name: Nanocarbon Fabrication Plant
facilities.description: Expanded facility with separate weaving and lamination zones for graphene and carbon-fiber integration. Structural framing supports larger-scale composite material processing and assembly.

facilities.name: Nanocarbon Manufacturing Complex
facilities.description: State-of-the-art facility with quantum-core composite alignment, advanced reinforced framing, and precision coolant management enabling rapid production of elite nanocarbon lattice at maximum throughput.

facilities.name: Nanocomposite Manufacturing Plant
facilities.description: Industrial-scale extrusion complex with reinforced frames supporting heavy thermal loads and distributed cooling. Plasma injection systems maintain precise temperatures while coolant loops dissipate excess heat from continuous production.

facilities.name: Nanoplastic Extruder
facilities.description: Production facility with integrated plasma injection and active heat management for consistent composite formation. Multiple extrusion heads operate simultaneously under automated control to increase output.

facilities.name: Nanotube Circuit Fabricator
facilities.description: A methane-fed deposition line that grows carbon transistors and lays copper traces with rhodium contacts.

facilities.name: Narco-Refinery Complex
facilities.description: A sector-scale gutter flux operation running parallel reaction trains behind blast-rated containment. Redundant coolant loops and processing cores turn what was once a fume-choked backstreet cook into a refinery that supplies whole regions. The smell still gets out.

facilities.name: Nav Core Assembly Line
facilities.description: A specialized production line that fuses trade ciphers and dark matter with circuit boards under precise thermal control. Copper piping and heat sinks manage the exotic matter integration process.

facilities.name: Nav Core Synthesis Factory
facilities.description: Large-scale production with extensive coolant circulation and multiple plasma injectors working in parallel to accelerate dark matter synthesis and circuit board bonding. Reinforced frames support the heavy thermal loads.

facilities.name: Nav Core Synthesis Plant
facilities.description: Expanded facility with higher throughput and redundant cooling loops to handle increased dark matter throughput. Structural frames reinforce the containment and integration stages.

facilities.name: Naval Yard
facilities.description: Multi-berth construction facility capable of building frigate-class vessels.
facilities.satisfied_description: Multiple berths hum with activity. Frigate hulls take shape in parallel bays, material conveyors running at full capacity.
facilities.degraded_description: Except right now. Half the berths sit idle, their conveyors stalled. Only small hulls can be serviced with the remaining material flow.

facilities.name: Navigation Array Assembly
facilities.description: A precision-engineering facility that integrates navigation cores, autopilot modules, and sensor arrays into cohesive astrogation systems. Hull plating and reinforced bulkheads provide structural housing for sensitive navigation electronics.

facilities.name: Navigation Beacon Assembly
facilities.description: A compact automated line that assembles circuit boards, superconductors, and power cells into deployable navigation beacons. Control nodes manage calibration of the beacon's directional emitters at a measured pace.

facilities.name: Navigation Systems Works
facilities.description: Industrial-scale production complex with docking-ring infrastructure for component staging and reinforced bulkhead assembly zones. Control nodes coordinate the integration of complex navigation and autopilot subsystems.

facilities.name: Nebula Biofacture Plant
facilities.description: Industrial production facility with dedicated coolant loops maintaining optimal temperature for living hull cultures. Quantum control cores and reinforced frames enable rapid synthesis of multiple regenerator units simultaneously.

facilities.name: Nebula Crystal Crucible
facilities.description: A compact production line that integrates nebula essence with circuit boards and focused crystals to build multi-spectrum detection arrays. Control nodes coordinate the delicate alignment of optical and electronic components.

facilities.name: Nebula Crystallization Oven
facilities.description: Expanded facility with processing cores and precision optics modules that accelerate component integration and quality verification. Throughput increases significantly through parallel assembly stages and quantum control enhancement.

facilities.name: Nebula Distillation Plant
facilities.description: Larger facility incorporating dark-matter cells and quantum stabilizers to handle exotic nebular compounds. Multiple separation stages and improved containment allow faster processing of unstable gas mixtures.

facilities.name: Nebula Distillery
facilities.description: A spectrographic heating column that isolates trace exotic elements from skeinwraith distillate glands. Precise temperature control and a steady hand are the only requirements — the wraith concentrates the exotic fraction.

facilities.name: Nebula Essence Refinery
facilities.description: Industrial-scale processor with gravity generators and reinforced containment for exotic nebular chemistry. Quantum control cores enable precise isotopic separation and multi-phase concentration in rapid succession.

facilities.name: Nebula Essence Synthesis Complex
facilities.description: Cutting-edge automated complex with full quantum control architecture, advanced processing cores, and precision optic arrays working in concert to achieve near-instantaneous sensor array assembly with maximum spectral fidelity.

facilities.name: Nebula Fungus Tart Galley
facilities.description: Tart ovens and curd benches for a savoury-sweet Federation pastry.

facilities.name: Nebula Gas Separator
facilities.description: A compact gas processing line with intake filters, compression chambers, and chemical separation coils. Distills nebular gases into usable essence through basic fractional processing.

facilities.name: Nebula Optics Atelier
facilities.description: An industrial faceting plant with redundant coolant loops and automated lattice verification, turning out focusing optics with superior light transmission and minimal internal stress. The Federation's standard for sensor-grade trade crystal.

facilities.name: Nebula Perception Grid
facilities.description: A fully automated complex with redundant processing systems and trade-crystal optical alignment networks, delivering maximum-throughput production of cutting-edge sensor arrays grown around raw crystal optics.

facilities.name: Nebula Prism Optics Complex
facilities.description: Cutting-edge manufacturing featuring quantum-controlled grinding spindles, precision plasma-injection shaping, multi-loop cryogenic cooling, and real-time optical verification. Massive heat-sink arrays and advanced plasma-injector systems deliver premium prismatic lenses at volume.

facilities.name: Nebula Sensor Fabrication Plant
facilities.description: Industrial-scale operation deploying quantum control cores and high-precision optical systems to mass-produce detection equipment with tighter tolerances and faster cycle times across multiple assembly lines.

facilities.name: Nebula Shield Assembly Plant
facilities.description: Mid-scale facility with expanded shield emitter capacity and structural framing supporting higher-volume barrier synthesis. Coolant infrastructure begins managing the thermal load from superconductor and ion-generation systems.

facilities.name: Nebula Solar Array
facilities.description: Massive solar collection array bathed in constant light from Haven's binary star.
facilities.satisfied_description: Binary starlight floods the collection panels, power output steady and surplus feeding the grid. The most efficient generation in settled space.
facilities.degraded_description: Today, though, failed circuit boards have taken a quarter of the array offline. Power rationing notices appear across the station as output dips below demand.
facilities.lore: The Federation's engineers are pragmatic — why burn fuel when stars provide? Haven's binary system bathes the array in constant light, making this the most efficient power source in settled space. The panels need periodic circuit replacements, but that's it.

facilities.name: Nebulium Crystal Seeder
facilities.description: A shielded argon chamber that transfers nebulium alignment into synthetic diamond crystal seeds.

facilities.name: Nebulium Processing Complex
facilities.description: Fully automated state-of-the-art reactor employing intensive plasma acceleration, distributed multi-loop cooling, and precision control systems to achieve rapid nebulium core synthesis at maximum efficiency.

facilities.name: Nebulium Processing Plant
facilities.description: Larger furnace array with enhanced plasma injection and improved thermal stability, enabling faster core consolidation without material degradation.

facilities.name: Nebulium Processing Vat
facilities.description: A specialized pressure refinery that consolidates raw nebulium inside dense purified argon to form stable energy cores.

facilities.name: Nebulium Refinery
facilities.description: Heavy-duty synthesis facility with multiple plasma stages, extensive coolant distribution, and reinforced containment vessels for continuous high-throughput core formation.

facilities.name: Neodymium Magnet Sinter
facilities.description: An argon-purged powder press and alignment chamber for producing powerful permanent magnets.

facilities.name: Neon Cell Factory
facilities.description: Industrial neon power cell production facility with parallel ionization chambers, automated circuit integration, and titanium-reinforced pressure vessels. Fuel cells sustain the EM systems while circuit boards coordinate multi-stage discharge tuning.

facilities.name: Neon Cell Lab
facilities.description: Pressurized containment lab for ionizing neon into power cell casings. Produces two cells per run but requires careful pressure management.

facilities.name: Neon Discharge Plant
facilities.description: Dedicated neon ionization facility with electromagnetic discharge arrays and copper-wound containment coils. Fuel cells power the high-voltage ionization equipment.

facilities.name: Neon Excitation Chamber
facilities.description: A gas processing chamber with electrical excitation coils and sealed containment vessels that ionize neon gas into its characteristic glowing state. Chemical liners protect internal surfaces from reactive gas erosion.

facilities.name: Neon Ionization Plant
facilities.description: An expanded facility with multiple ionization chambers, enhanced chemical protection, and hazmat containers for rapid sequential processing of neon gas into ionized form with improved containment integrity.

facilities.name: Neon Luminescence Hub
facilities.description: Cutting-edge automated facility with sophisticated coolant loops, multi-stage chemical protection, and precision hazmat handling systems that ionize neon gas at maximum throughput while maintaining perfect spectral consistency and containment safety.

facilities.name: Neon Processing Facility
facilities.description: Large-scale gas ionization complex featuring reinforced frames, extensive chemical liners, and redundant hazmat containment systems that process neon at high throughput while cooling and stabilizing the ionized product for extended storage.

facilities.name: Neon Separator Unit
facilities.description: A thermal-gradient separation system that condenses neon at its liquefaction point and vents it away from the main cargo stream. Copper piping carries coolant loops while control nodes regulate pressure differential across the condensation chamber.

facilities.name: Neon Signal Array Plant
facilities.description: Industrial-scale production with quantum-controlled ionization precision and automated optical calibration. Precision optics measure discharge wavelength to nanometer tolerances while processing cores orchestrate multi-stage assembly in rapid succession.

facilities.name: Neon Signal Fabrication Complex
facilities.description: State-of-the-art facility running continuous ionization and assembly with quantum control cores managing discharge parameters to exact specifications. Extensive sensor and optic arrays enable real-time quality assurance and sub-second cycle times.

facilities.name: Neon Signal Workshop
facilities.description: Expanded facility with parallel ionization chambers and integrated circuit-board attachment stations. Processing cores optimize gas ionization rates and sensor arrays verify tube brightness and frequency response in real time.

facilities.name: Neon Synthesis Complex
facilities.description: State-of-the-art neon power cell megafacility with superconductor-stabilized ionization arrays, quantum pressure optimization, and fully automated cell sealing. Converts ubiquitous noble gas reserves into reliable power cells at peak efficiency.

facilities.name: Neon Tube Assembler
facilities.description: A purpose-built production line that ionizes neon gas and assembles it into discharge tube arrays for signal calibration. Copper piping distributes ionized feed while control nodes manage tube alignment and electrical discharge timing.

facilities.name: Neon Tube Lab
facilities.description: A compact production line that ionizes neon gas, stabilizes it into booster compounds, and encapsulates them with circuit board control modules. Control nodes manage gas pressure and ionization timing.

facilities.name: Nerve Burn Plant
facilities.description: Framed pressure vessels and stacked coolant loops let the lab run more crystallization cycles in parallel. The chemists are still the best-paid non-combatants on the station, and they still earn every credit.

facilities.name: Nerve Burn Synthesis Complex
facilities.description: A fully automated combat-stim plant with redundant pressure trains, quantum-metered crystallization, and coolant networks holding back a reaction that wants to run away. Produces nerve burn by the crate — sealed, tested, and never on the volunteer.

facilities.name: Neural Computing Plant
facilities.description: Large-scale industrial complex with integrated life support and atmospheric management maintaining sterile conditions throughout multi-stage extraction. Reinforced frames support the extensive piping and atmospheric infrastructure required for high-purity neural compound production.

facilities.name: Neural Core Assembly Line
facilities.description: A specialized facility that integrates processing cores and neural extracts into autonomous drone controllers. Circuit boards are populated and tested in sequence to ensure behavioral coherence.

facilities.name: Neural Disruptor Assembly Line
facilities.description: A specialized weapons manufacturing line that synthesizes superconductor coils, integrates neural interface gel into emitter chambers, and assembles the complete EM disruption weapon. Barrel assemblies are aligned and tested under controlled electromagnetic fields to verify targeting accuracy.

facilities.name: Neural Disruptor Forge
facilities.description: Heavy-scale production with reinforced weapon-housing welding lines, automated targeting-computer integration, and quantum-controlled electromagnetic calibration. Processing cores manage superconductor quench cycles while targeting computers are pre-programmed and verified in-line.

facilities.name: Neural Disruptor Foundry
facilities.description: State-of-the-art facility with extensive coolant loops managing superconductor temperatures, automated neural-gel precision dosing, and quantum control of emitter coil geometry. Targeting computers undergo rigorous electromagnetic validation and real-time system diagnostics before final assembly.

facilities.name: Neural Disruptor Workshop
facilities.description: Expanded facility with dedicated superconductor cooling loops, neural gel injection automation, and multi-stage barrel assembly. Control nodes orchestrate precise timing between gel curing and electromagnetic coil integration to ensure stable neural disruption output.

facilities.name: Neural EM Factory
facilities.description: Larger facility with dedicated weapon housing stations, barrel assembly integration, and structural reinforcement to handle the sensitive assembly of neural-interface gel into charge packs at higher volumes.

facilities.name: Neural EM Manufactory
facilities.description: Industrial-scale production system with quantum-controlled gel dispensing, targeting-computer-assisted tuning, and reinforced construction enabling high-speed assembly of neural disruption charges with precise AI-interference properties.

facilities.name: Neural EM Ordnance Complex
facilities.description: State-of-the-art fully automated facility with redundant gel-injection arrays, multi-stage barrel assembly, quantum control cores, and coolant-loop thermal management for maximum-throughput neural disruption charge pack synthesis.

facilities.name: Neural EM Press
facilities.description: A precision production line that blends superconductors, neural interface gel, and circuit boards into tuned disruption charge packs. Careful process control maintains the delicate electromagnetic-biological resonance properties.

facilities.name: Neural Extract Bioreactor
facilities.description: Larger bioprocessing plant with enhanced atmospheric management and recycling loops. Increases throughput by refining extraction timing and improving cellular separation efficiency.

facilities.name: Neural Extract Biorefinery
facilities.description: Industrial-scale facility with extensive life support integration and multi-stage atmospheric cycling. Precision cultivation and extraction of neural compounds at high volume.

facilities.name: Neural Extract Complex
facilities.description: State-of-the-art bioprocessing installation with redundant life support and atmospheric systems operating at full automation. Achieves maximum yield through continuous environmental optimization and microsecond-precision extraction timing.

facilities.name: Neural Extract Lab
facilities.description: Purpose-built extraction system with atmospheric controls and basic bioprocessing vessels. Separates and concentrates neural compounds from suspension through temperature and pressure regulation.

facilities.name: Neural Extraction Refinery
facilities.description: A specialized chemical processing line that breaks down circuit boards and optical components into neural compounds. Atmospheric units maintain inert conditions while copper piping circulates processing fluids through reaction vessels.

facilities.name: Neural Fabrication Lab
facilities.description: Mid-scale synthesis facility with improved atmospheric recycling and thermal regulation. Streamlined optical-to-gel conversion process increases consistency and output speed.

facilities.name: Neural Growth Chamber
facilities.description: Cultivates quantum computing substrates in null-energy fields. For the Voidborn, this is art. For everyone else, it's the most powerful hardware money can buy.
facilities.lore: The Voidborn don't manufacture neural matrices — they grow them, tending crystalline lattices in null-energy baths until quantum coherence emerges spontaneously. Each matrix is unique. The Collective calls it computation; the Voidborn call it sculpture. Haven's Promenade buys every one the Collective can produce, powering entertainment rigs that organic minds find irresistible.

facilities.name: Neural Interface Factory
facilities.description: Large-scale production plant with comprehensive life support systems and atmospheric management. Multi-chamber design enables parallel synthesis runs and superior gel homogeneity.

facilities.name: Neural Nanite Foundry
facilities.description: Advanced biotech complex with distributed life support systems and precision atmospheric management across all synthesis stages. Fully automated nanite cultivation and containment protocols achieve unprecedented production rates.

facilities.name: Neural Quickstep Lab
facilities.description: Dedicated pharmaceutical production line combining neural extract with bioactive compounds. Precision dosing and mixing equipment ensures consistent enhancer potency.

facilities.name: Neural Synthesis Lab
facilities.description: Advanced refining plant with atmospheric circulation and air recycling systems that stabilize volatile neural compounds during synthesis. Multiple processing stages separate and concentrate the extracted materials.

facilities.name: Neurokinetic Synthesis Hub
facilities.description: Industrial-scale production complex with extensive coolant infrastructure and multi-chamber processing. Parallel synthesis runs and optimized reaction timing enable high-volume reflex enhancer manufacturing.

facilities.name: Neutron Bombardment Cell
facilities.description: A cryogenic refining system that processes deuterium and reactor fuel assembly through controlled temperature reduction, converting tritium gas into stable liquid form for fusion applications.

facilities.name: Neutron Source Laboratory
facilities.description: A shielded irradiation laboratory that converts reactor-grade plutonium into sealed californium sources for mineral analysis.

facilities.name: Neutron Star Synthesis Plant
facilities.description: Industrial-scale exotic matter facility featuring gravity generator integration, enhanced dark matter containment, and quantum control core management. Automated stabilization systems maintain safe conditions during singularity core synthesis.

facilities.name: Neutronium Compression Chamber
facilities.description: Heavy-duty reactor with plasma injection and heat dissipation systems for handling weapons-grade plutonium and power cores. Compresses and stabilizes degenerate matter through controlled thermal cycles.

facilities.name: Neutronium Consolidation Forge
facilities.description: Industrial-scale reactor with enhanced plasma injection and expanded heat sink arrays. Improved pressure sequencing and thermal management reduce cycle time while maintaining matter stability.

facilities.name: Neutronium Slug Factory
facilities.description: Integrated assembly system combining material feeding, compression, and ballistic profiling. Weapon housing and barrel components are fed continuously to increase throughput and consistency.

facilities.name: Neutronium Slug Manufactory
facilities.description: Industrial-scale production with quantum-guided targeting computers and automated barrel assembly. The system maintains exacting tolerances on each slug's core density and aerodynamic profile.

facilities.name: Neutronium Slug Ordnance Complex
facilities.description: State-of-the-art facility with full quantum control and coolant-loop thermal management. Every slug is individually calibrated for maximum penetration performance before discharge.

facilities.name: Neutronium Slug Press
facilities.description: A dedicated production line that compresses neutronium ingots and durasteel plates into dense slug casings. Precision-guided hydraulic presses ensure consistent hardness and penetration geometry.

facilities.name: Next-Generation Cryo-Pod Line
facilities.description: An ultra-efficient facility where quantum cores manage thousands of simultaneous assembly micro-steps, from storage integration through final system pressurization and diagnostics. Precision optics ensure every pod meets suspension-readiness standards before shipment.

facilities.name: Nexus Drone Complex
facilities.description: State-of-the-art automated facility with real-time AI training systems and advanced processing core coordination. Produces salvage drones with enhanced material recognition and extraction efficiency.

facilities.name: Nexus EMP Manufacturing
facilities.description: Cutting-edge facility with quantum precision handling of superconductor embedding and automated targeting computer calibration. Reinforced weapon housing assembly and coolant systems enable maximum-throughput production of EMP-disruption rounds.

facilities.name: Nexus Engine Forge
facilities.description: Fully automated facility with redundant quantum control systems and integrated coolant loops. Advanced sensor and optics subsystems ensure every core meets exacting performance standards at maximum speed.

facilities.name: Nexus Nanite Synthesis
facilities.description: Produces Voidborn nanite suspensions through processes the Collective declines to document. The output is consistent. The method is not discussed.
facilities.lore: The synthesis facility occupies a section of Nexus Prime that does not appear on standard station maps. Access requires clearances that are not issued through normal Collective channels. What occurs inside is not described in any documentation accessible to non-Voidborn parties. The output — a suspension of nanoscale constructs in a medium that is technically a fluid — emerges through a one-way delivery interface. The Collective calls it a product. Buyers call it useful. Everyone leaves the question of what exactly it is politely unresolved.

facilities.name: Nexus Navigation Engine
facilities.description: Cutting-edge facility with redundant dark matter shielding, integrated gravity field stabilization, and cryogenic coolant systems. Achieves near-instantaneous calibration of quantum matrices for maximum jump drive compatibility.

facilities.name: Nexus Soma Dispensary
facilities.description: Produces Voidborn Neural Soma for export. The Collective's preferred response to questions about what it is: 'Consumed.'
facilities.lore: The Collective began exporting Neural Soma after observing that organic visitors to Nexus Prime responded positively to exposure to certain Voidborn operational byproducts. The soma is a refined version of those byproducts, packaged for distribution. Whether it constitutes food, medicine, or a form of software is a classification question the Collective finds tedious. 'It is consumed,' the Collective says, when pressed. 'The effects are well-documented. The mechanism is proprietary.' Haven's Promenade sells it in specialized establishments. Demand consistently exceeds supply.

facilities.name: Nickel Alloy Hardening Plant
facilities.description: A heavily automated alloy plant with synchronized plasma injection and advanced coolant loops that enable near-continuous flow through the hardening chambers. Reinforced frames distribute the thermal and structural stresses of rapid production cycles.

facilities.name: Nickel Flash Furnace
facilities.description: A heavy flash-smelting installation with reinforced framing and extensive coolant loops, oxidizing ore concentrate in suspension to pour billets at industrial pace while sustained plasma injection keeps the reaction self-feeding.

facilities.name: Nickel Refinery
facilities.description: An upgraded plant adding plasma-assisted roasting and tighter thermal management, with heat sinks and plasma injectors driving faster, cleaner smelting cycles and more consistent billet purity.

facilities.name: Nickel Smelter
facilities.description: A basic shaft furnace that roasts and smelts low-grade nickel ore into cast billets. Copper piping carries coolant past the crucible while simple controls hold the burn steady — slow, but it turns ore piles into usable metal.

facilities.name: Nickel-Steel Forge
facilities.description: A purpose-built alloy forge that folds nickel billets into steel plate under controlled plasma heating, producing a tough, corrosion-resistant composite. Copper piping channels coolant to prevent warping during the alloying phase.

facilities.name: NiMH Battery Foundry
facilities.description: Industrial-scale production with extensive coolant circulation to manage the thermal load of continuous plasma-assisted welding. Reinforced frames support heavy machinery running near-constant output cycles.

facilities.name: NiMH Battery Line
facilities.description: A processing line that assembles nickel-metal-hydride cells into power batteries, casting electrodes and welding terminals while copper-piped coolant holds temperatures in check.

facilities.name: NiMH Cell Line
facilities.description: A production line that packs nickel billets and copper wiring into nickel-metal-hydride power cells through automated electrode rolling, electrolyte filling, and containment.

facilities.name: NiMH Pack Plant
facilities.description: A larger facility with integrated heat management and plasma-assisted cell fusion, running multiple pack-assembly stages in parallel at elevated throughput.

facilities.name: Nitro Cold Brew Bar
facilities.description: Cold-steep towers and nitrogen chargers for the night shift's lifeline.

facilities.name: Nitrogen Sublimation Separator
facilities.description: A thermal-control system that maintains a precise temperature gradient between nitrogen's and water's sublimation points, vaporizing nitrogen while preserving other frozen ices. Control nodes regulate cryogenic flow to sustain the narrow operating window.

facilities.name: Noble Contact Control Works
facilities.description: A fully automated control-node works with robotic contact winding, in-line relay endurance testing, and real-time logic verification — noble-metal automation units at maximum throughput.

facilities.name: Noble Gas Liquefier
facilities.description: A cryo-column that renders halo-drifter noble condensate into dense fuel cells.

facilities.name: Noble Gas Refinery
facilities.description: Industrial-scale cryogenic facility with multi-stage plasma enhancement and extensive coolant loop infrastructure for high-volume helium-3 production.

facilities.name: Noble-Gas Spritz Bar
facilities.description: An aeration bar that lifts dry fruit spritzes with noble condensate.

facilities.name: Noble Matte Reducer
facilities.description: A reduction furnace that draws a bullionaut's noble matte down into zero-resistance conductor with only a wrap of copper wiring. The animal already did the concentrating, so no raw palladium or iridium ever hits the melt.

facilities.name: Noble Metal Catalysis Works
facilities.description: A fully automated complex with cryogenic gas separation and real-time surface analysis, producing catalytic platinum sponge at maximum throughput and purity for the fuel-cell trade.

facilities.name: Notice Board
facilities.description: A physical notice board near the docks. Your posted bounties compete for attention with lost pet notices and propaganda.

facilities.name: Nuclear Assembly Plant
facilities.description: Dedicated fusion-fuel facility with dual-stage heating and plasma injection for precise isotope combination. Structural reinforcement supports the cryogenic systems needed to handle liquid tritium at production scale.

facilities.name: Nuclear Cell Foundry
facilities.description: Industrial power cell fabrication line with lead shielding and radiation containment. Handles enriched uranium rods and copper wiring in a controlled, purpose-built environment.

facilities.name: Nuclear Manufacturing Plant
facilities.description: Industrial-scale reactor production leveraging quantum control cores and precision optics for advanced fuel rod geometry and containment-field optimization. Continuous monitoring ensures each unit meets exacting power-output specs.

facilities.name: Nuclear Mine Assembly Line
facilities.description: Specialized weapons production line for assembling durasteel plates, weapons-grade plutonium, and warhead assemblies into tactical nuclear mines. Robust control systems manage the assembly of high-yield ordnance.

facilities.name: Nuclear Mine Complex
facilities.description: State-of-the-art ordnance facility with coolant loop systems managing thermal and radiation stress in plutonium assembly. Quantum targeting and precision barrel work deliver maximum-yield nuclear mines at accelerated rates.

facilities.name: Nuclear Mine Plant
facilities.description: Dedicated ordnance facility with weapon housing and barrel assembly integration for mine stabilization. Expanded plutonium handling and warhead staging enable sustained tactical weapons production.

facilities.name: Nuclear Mine Works
facilities.description: Industrial weapons manufacturing complex with quantum-controlled targeting computers and reinforced weapon housing systems. Precision assembly and targeting integration accelerate tactical nuclear mine production.

facilities.name: Nuclear Module Fabrication Bay
facilities.description: Expanded facility with dedicated fuel-assembly staging, automated lead-shielding welding, and integrated radiation-hardened circuit insertion. Structural frames provide containment during assembly while control nodes coordinate multi-stage fuel and shielding integration.

facilities.name: Nuclear Power Cell Facility
facilities.description: Heavy industrial complex with hazmat containers, multi-layer lead shielding, and redundant radiation-hardened control systems. Sophisticated automation handles isotope handling and cell assembly at scale.

facilities.name: Null Atmosphere Processor
facilities.description: Maintains a breathable atmosphere for organic visitors through void-energy conversion.
facilities.satisfied_description: The air tastes of ozone and mathematics but breathes perfectly clean. Void-energy conversion hums at optimal efficiency.
facilities.degraded_description: Or it should be. Atmospheric composition drifts unstable, oxygen levels fluctuating. The air tastes metallic and wrong, triggering primitive panic responses.
facilities.lore: The Voidborn do not breathe, but their stations accommodate all visitors. This processor converts void energy directly into atmospheric components — the air tastes faintly of ozone and mathematics. Water ice is still required as a hydrogen source for the reaction.

facilities.name: Null Cannon Assembly Line
facilities.description: A specialized production line for fabricating null-space weapons, equipped with precision barrel and housing assembly stations. Handles the integration of void matrices and quantum control systems at steady throughput.

facilities.name: Null Cannon Fabrication Complex
facilities.description: State-of-the-art weapon production facility with full coolant-loop thermal management for the exotic materials involved. Quantum control cores and targeting systems feed into parallel weapon assembly lines, each station handling the complete null-space weapon integration.

facilities.name: Null Cannon Manufacturing Works
facilities.description: Industrial-scale production with quantum control cores and targeting computers integrated at speed. Reinforced frames and multiple barrel stations run concurrently, with precision assembly automation handling the exotic null-matter components.

facilities.name: Null Cannon Production Plant
facilities.description: An expanded facility with parallel assembly tracks and automated weapon housing integration. Multiple control nodes and targeting systems are assembled in parallel, increasing output significantly.

facilities.name: Null Condenser
facilities.description: A cold containment loop that condenses a riftbloom's null curd into processed null matter. The bloom already curdled it past raw density, so the condenser runs light.

facilities.name: Null-Energy Shaping Chamber
facilities.description: A meditation space where crafters interface with null-energy fields to reshape matter. The Voidborn insist the process is intuitive.
facilities.satisfied_description: Null-energy fields respond to focused intent with uncanny precision, materials reshaping themselves through alien logic. It works once you stop trying to understand.
facilities.degraded_description: When it cooperates. The fields refuse to respond or respond chaotically, matter warping wrong. Crafters emerge frustrated and vaguely nauseous from failed communion.
facilities.lore: The chamber contains no tools in any conventional sense. Crafters place raw materials on the central platform and the null-energy field responds to focused intent — or so the Voidborn claim. Organic visitors report that it works, eventually, once you stop trying to understand it. Success rates improve dramatically after the third visit.

facilities.name: Null Energy Tap
facilities.description: Draws power from the void between dimensions. No conventional fuel required.
facilities.satisfied_description: Dimensional micro-fractures pulse with steady energy flow, the containment matrices holding firm. Station power reads as infinite and eerie.
facilities.degraded_description: When it's stable. Right now, containment matrices flicker dangerously, energy flow sputtering as micro-fractures threaten to collapse or expand uncontrolled.
facilities.lore: The Voidborn discovered that the space between realities seethes with energy. This device siphons it through controlled dimensional micro-fractures, requiring no fuel — only periodic recalibration of its containment matrices via fresh circuit boards.

facilities.name: Null Matrix Assembly Line
facilities.description: A specialized production line for lattice fabrication and void-energy focusing. Shield matrices are bonded to processing cores while null matter is precisely layered, building up the mathematical structure that channels void energy through impossible geometries.

facilities.name: Null Matrix Fabrication Complex
facilities.description: Fully automated facility with precision robotic lattice construction and real-time null-matter composition verification. Each matrix is assembled in a controlled electromagnetic environment, with all components bonded and verified before the final dimensional-lock sequence.

facilities.name: Null Matrix Production Facility
facilities.description: An expanded plant with dedicated lattice-weaving stations and null-matter integration zones. Each matrix is assembled in stages, with processing cores calibrated to synchronize the layers of null matter before final encapsulation in reinforced bulkheads.

facilities.name: Null Matter Complex
facilities.description: State-of-the-art fully automated facility with intensive plasma treatment stages, redundant containment systems, and real-time stability monitoring to achieve maximum null matter throughput.

facilities.name: Null Matter Forge
facilities.description: A purpose-built production line for void-phase weapons assembly, with dedicated barrel-forging and housing-alignment stations. Void condensate handling requires continuous environmental control to prevent dimensional instability.

facilities.name: Null Matter Processing Plant
facilities.description: Larger processing facility with enhanced plasma treatment and improved containment fields, reducing stabilization cycle time and increasing output consistency.

facilities.name: Null Matter Processing Vat
facilities.description: A precision containment and treatment unit that stabilizes raw null matter through controlled electromagnetic and plasma conditioning for stealth applications.

facilities.name: Null Matter Processor
facilities.description: Stabilizes raw null matter from the Anomaly into containment-grade material. The Crimson Fleet's reactors depend on it.
facilities.lore: Raw null matter is harvested from the dimensional boundary near Nexus Prime — a region where space itself thins. In its raw state it's dangerously unstable, absorbing energy and light unpredictably. The Voidborn stabilize it through a process they describe as 'teaching it to remember its shape.' The Crimson Fleet pays handsomely for the result.

facilities.name: Null Matter Refinery
facilities.description: Heavy-duty stabilization system with multi-stage plasma conditioning, distributed coolant loops, and reinforced containment architecture for rapid null matter processing.

facilities.name: Null Void Factory
facilities.description: Multi-stage facility with enhanced coolant loops and structural reinforcement to manage the extreme energies of null-space formation. Void crystals and stabilized exotics are combined in pressurized containment vessels.

facilities.name: Null Void Manufactory
facilities.description: Large-scale industrial operation with redundant coolant systems and reinforced containment architecture. Control nodes coordinate precise timing of void crystal compression and exotic material infusion to prevent cascade failures.

facilities.name: Null Void Ordnance Complex
facilities.description: Cutting-edge facility employing advanced control cores and extensive coolant infrastructure to stabilize null-space pocket formation at maximum efficiency. Each core pack undergoes quantum verification before completion.

facilities.name: Null Void Press
facilities.description: Specialized industrial chamber designed to handle void crystals and exotic materials under heavy coolant circulation. Continuous cooling prevents destabilization while condensate is precisely metered into casings.

facilities.name: Observation Deck Fabrication Unit
facilities.description: A structured production facility assembling reinforced panoramic viewports, flex polymer lounge fittings, and integrated bar systems into domed observation decks. Precision optics certify every viewport pane before the unit ships.

facilities.name: Officer's Suite
facilities.description: A spacious two-room suite on the station's upper ring. Separate sleeping and living areas, a proper desk, climate control, and a viewport that spans half the wall.
facilities.satisfied_description: Fresh air circulation, adjustable lighting, and enough space for a shelf of souvenirs from across the galaxy. This is where a career lives.
facilities.degraded_description: The climate control has opinions of its own and the viewport seal needs replacing. The view's still worth it.

facilities.name: Omega Core Line
facilities.description: An exotic containment line for the strongest void ammunition.

facilities.name: Onboard Fuel Unit Workshop
facilities.description: A mid-scale facility assembling burner modules in parallel, with structural frames supporting expanded combustor handling. Copper piping channels coolant while processing cores tune each unit's combustion circuit.

facilities.name: Operations Center
facilities.description: Full mission coordination facility with briefing rooms and real-time objective tracking.
facilities.satisfied_description: Holographic situation displays track active missions across the sector. Briefing rooms run back-to-back sessions.
facilities.degraded_description: When resources allow. Situation displays show gaps in coverage, briefing rooms sit dark, and mission coordination falls back to text-only comms.

facilities.name: Optical Assembly Station
facilities.description: A precision optical and electronic assembly line that integrates fiber bundles, circuit boards, and focusing crystals into functional stealth units. Shield emitters and matrices provide the electromagnetic cloaking effect.

facilities.name: Optical Fabrication Plant
facilities.description: Industrial-scale operation featuring active coolant loops and precision plasma heating, enabling rapid, high-throughput fiber production with minimal defects.

facilities.name: Optical Fiber Drawing Station
facilities.description: A precision glass-work facility that fuses synthetic diamond with energy crystals and draws the resulting material into ultra-fine optical fibers. Heat sinks and plasma injection maintain the critical temperature window for fiber formation.

facilities.name: Optical Glass Synthesis
facilities.description: Cutting-edge glass production system using full cryogenic management and precision plasma injection to achieve near-zero thermal stress during solidification, yielding optically perfect panels at maximum capacity.

facilities.name: Optical Grinding Station
facilities.description: A precision grinding mill that shapes reinforced glass into laser-grade optics and bonds silver wiring for focusing. Control nodes maintain spindle speed and feed rates for consistent lens geometry.

facilities.name: Optical Sensor Workshop
facilities.description: An expanded line with processing cores and precision optical mounting stations that seat trade-crystal lattices into higher-throughput sensor arrays without losing alignment.

facilities.name: Optical Stealth Factory
facilities.description: An automated production complex using quantum control cores to manage the precise assembly of optical and electronic components. Coolant loops regulate heat from crystal focusing, while expanded shield systems enable faster cloaking field generation.

facilities.name: Optics Lab
facilities.description: Expanded facility with dedicated fiber alignment and crystal integration stations. Increased weapon housing inventory and improved barrel precision enable higher throughput and consistency.

facilities.name: Optimized Expander Plant
facilities.description: Industrial facility integrating sub-assembly stations for titanium reinforcement and circuit board modules, then combining with base expanders in a synchronized workflow. Improved automation reduces manual intervention.

facilities.name: Optimizer Production Complex
facilities.description: State-of-the-art fully automated factory with redundant cooling systems and advanced plasma injection arrays. Produces optimized fuel controllers at near-continuous rates.

facilities.name: Orbital Docking Works
facilities.description: Reinforced frames and quantum control cores enable precision alignment of docking mechanisms to micron tolerances. Precision optics guide automated drilling and welding for consistent port geometry.

facilities.name: Orbital Habitation Forge
facilities.description: Cutting-edge fully automated facility with integrated life support systems, precision environmental sensors, and parallel modular assembly lines. Advanced robotics and real-time quality monitoring achieve rapid production of comfortable, validated crew living spaces.

facilities.name: Orbital Spa & Resort Deck
facilities.description: A full wellness deck — soak pools, a viewing dome, and staff trained to make first-class passengers forget they're on a station at all.
facilities.satisfied_description: The soak pools are running hot and the viewing dome's booked solid. Guests are staying longer than they planned to — which is exactly the point.
facilities.degraded_description: The pools have gone lukewarm and half the treatment rooms are closed for lack of supply. Guests are noticing, and saying so.

facilities.name: Orchard Wine Cellar
facilities.description: Fermenting tuns and a small bottling line for honest fruit wine.

facilities.name: Ordnance Amplification Factory
facilities.description: Industrial-scale facility with redundant coolant circulation and reinforced containment for plasma-core handling. Heavy copper piping manages energy throughput while cooling systems maintain thermal stability.

facilities.name: Ordnance Manufacturing Plant
facilities.description: Specialized industrial facility with integrated ammunition fabrication and barrel-assembly staging. Reduces cycle time to 2 minutes through parallel weapon-core preparation and targeting-computer calibration.

facilities.name: Ordnance Works
facilities.description: A high-capacity plant with quantum-controlled forming presses, precision optics for bore verification, and distributed processing that manufactures weapon housings at mass-production speeds.

facilities.name: Ordnance Workshop
facilities.description: Specialized production line for handling weapons-grade plutonium, integrating durasteel plates, and circuit-board coupling. Produces explosive warhead cores suitable for missile and ordnance fabrication.

facilities.name: Ore Extraction Forge
facilities.description: State-of-the-art facility featuring automated barrel rifling, quantum targeting alignment, and integrated coolant-loop systems. Produces fully calibrated mining lasers at industrial velocity.

facilities.name: Ore Harvester Nexus
facilities.description: Fully automated manufacturing hub with continuous-flow assembly, real-time component tracking, and automated quality gates. Processes thousands of drone components simultaneously to deliver finished units every 21 seconds.

facilities.name: Ore Separation Assembly
facilities.description: A specialized production line integrating magnetic ore separators, flotation cells, and processing cores into complete refinery modules. Control nodes coordinate the electromagnetic and flotation system calibration.

facilities.name: Organic Compound Mill
facilities.description: A large-scale bioprocessing plant with dozens of sealed fermentation vessels, advanced life support systems, and atmospheric monitoring that operates continuous production of synthetic compounds.

facilities.name: Organic Synthesis Chamber
facilities.description: An expanded biofacility with multiple fermentation vats, atmospheric units, and air recyclers that maintain optimal microbial conditions and accelerate compound synthesis across parallel culture lines.

facilities.name: Osmium Plate Sinter
facilities.description: A reinforced argon-purged press built to consolidate ultra-dense osmium without contaminating the plate.

facilities.name: Outer Rim Recycling Complex
facilities.description: Heavy-duty manufacturing with quantum control cores and precision optics integrated at scale. Multiple parallel assembly tracks handle sensor arrays and processing cores simultaneously for high-volume output.

facilities.name: Outfitting Bay
facilities.description: A modest ship lot the faction runs itself — a showroom, an outfitting crew, and a line of credit with the local yards.
facilities.satisfied_description: The outfitting crew configures new purchases without fuss. Nothing fancy, but everything on the lot works.
facilities.degraded_description: The outfitting crew has downed tools — no steel, no boards, nothing to finish a fit-out with. New buyers wait in the lot.

facilities.name: Outfitting Manufactory for Compact Aluminum Smelter
facilities.description: A continuous automated line seats anode cores and trims busbars without a hand touching them, turning raw frames into finished field smelters.

facilities.name: Outfitting Manufactory for Compact Argon Purifier
facilities.description: A sealed automated hall stacks and tunes each purifier's column without a leak, turning raw frames into field separators.

facilities.name: Outfitting Manufactory for Compact Copper Wiring Plant
facilities.description: An automated works draws, anneals, and seats each module's die train untouched, turning out field wiring plants at mill pace.

facilities.name: Outfitting Manufactory for Compact Deuterium Ice Processor
facilities.description: A sealed automated hall stacks and tunes each separation cascade untouched, turning frames into field isotope processors.

facilities.name: Outfitting Manufactory for Compact Helium Ice Processor
facilities.description: A cryogenic automated hall builds and seals each separation loop untouched, turning frames into field units that draw helium-3 from hold ice.

facilities.name: Outfitting Manufactory for Compact Hydrogen Compressor
facilities.description: An automated works stacks and seals each compressor's stages untouched, turning out units that render raw hydrogen to liquid fuel in the field.

facilities.name: Outfitting Manufactory for Compact Lead Smelter
facilities.description: A fully enclosed automated works builds and seals smelter after smelter, every fume path verified so crews can refine lead in the field without poisoning the hold.

facilities.name: Outfitting Manufactory for Compact Neon Ionizer
facilities.description: An automated works seats electrodes and trims field coils untouched, turning out neon ionizers ready to excite gas in any hold.

facilities.name: Outfitting Manufactory for Compact Nitrogen Ice Processor
facilities.description: A sealed automated works builds and purges each processor untouched, turning frames into field units that render nitrogen ice to liquid coolant.

facilities.name: Outfitting Manufactory for Compact Oxygen Liquefier
facilities.description: A sealed automated hall builds and purges each liquefier untouched, turning frames into field units that make propellant-grade oxygen on the move.

facilities.name: Outfitting Manufactory for Compact Steel Refinery
facilities.description: A lights-out line whose quantum-governed manipulators seat crucible cores and laser-trim the tap channels, turning out field smelters faster than a foundry can feed them ore.

facilities.name: Outfitting Manufactory for Compact Titanium Refinery
facilities.description: A sealed automated hall where inert-atmosphere manipulators assemble refinery after refinery, every weld and seal verified before the unit ever meets ore.

facilities.name: Outfitting Manufactory for Compact Water Ice Processor
facilities.description: An automated works seats melt heads and filter trains untouched, turning out processors that render hold ice to potable water anywhere.

facilities.name: Outfitting Manufactory for Compact Xenon Extractor
facilities.description: A sealed automated hall packs and tunes each extractor's sieve train without loss, turning frames into propulsion-grade separators.

facilities.name: Outpost Frame Assembler
facilities.description: A modest assembly bay that flat-packs hardened lockboxes, fuel bladders, and mooring spars into deployable outpost kits. A fraction of the scale a Station Core Foundry demands — within reach of a young faction that wants a presence out in the lawless dark.

facilities.name: Overcharge Manufacturing Complex
facilities.description: Heavy pressurization equipment with quantum control cores and coolant circulation to safely contain superconductor excitation during charge acceleration.

facilities.name: Overcharged Plasma Factory
facilities.description: Larger facility with dedicated coolant loops managing the intense heat generated during overcharging. Structural reinforcement and control nodes allow sustained production of dangerously energized cell packs.

facilities.name: Overcharged Plasma Manufactory
facilities.description: Heavily automated complex with reinforced frames and extensive coolant circulation to handle extreme thermal stress. Multiple production channels operate simultaneously while maintaining precise overcharge parameters.

facilities.name: Overcharged Plasma Ordnance Complex
facilities.description: Fully automated state-of-the-art facility with quantum-level control and sophisticated coolant management. Superconductor elements are continuously optimized for maximum energy density in each cell pack.

facilities.name: Overcharged Plasma Press
facilities.description: Purpose-built production system that combines refined plasma cores with ceramite plating and superconductor elements. Integrated cooling ensures thermal stability during the overcharging process.

facilities.name: Overclock Chip Fabrication Line
facilities.description: Specialized production facility for overclock chip assembly, combining fluorine etchant processes, circuit board integration, and gold ore processing. Produces performance-enhancement consumables in steady batches.

facilities.name: Oxygen Compression Cylinder
facilities.description: A compact cryogenic plant that compresses and cools oxygen gas to liquid state for propellant storage. Copper piping and steel containment handle the extreme pressure and temperature differentials of the liquefaction cycle.

facilities.name: Oxygen Ice Sublimator
facilities.description: A sealed warming and filtration line that converts oxygen ice into a clean pressurized gas stream.

facilities.name: Oxygen Liquefaction Plant
facilities.description: Multi-stage refrigeration system with chemical-lined vessels and hazmat containment for high-volume oxygen liquefaction. Coolant loops maintain precise temperatures throughout the compression and expansion stages.

facilities.name: Package Logistics Bay
facilities.description: A compact freight-handling bay with container seals, manifest scanners, and automated pallet movers for rapid package assembly and breakdown. Even this entry-level installation works substantially faster than hand unpacking at a workshop.

facilities.name: Package Logistics Center
facilities.description: An expanded freight center with parallel packing stations, automated routing conveyors, and continuous manifest verification. Multiple containers can be processed without interrupting inbound handling.

facilities.name: Package Logistics Hub
facilities.description: A heavy industrial freight hub using robotic handling cells, high-speed seal inspection, and redundant manifest systems to process package traffic at scale.

facilities.name: Package Logistics Nexus
facilities.description: A fully automated freight nexus whose synchronized handling grids, quantum manifests, and continuous container flow provide exceptional package throughput.

facilities.name: Pact Forward Armory
facilities.description: Crimson Fleet forward supply depot. Ammunition is always stocked first. Everything else is 'supplies.'
facilities.satisfied_description: Ammo lockers are full and the rationing board is dark. Patrol Mandates cycle through in under an hour, the armorer checking each load-out personally. The Fleet runs on rounds and iron rations, and both are in supply.
facilities.degraded_description: The rationing board has lit up for the first time in three cycles and the hull-plate racks are down to offcuts. Patrol crews notice the mess before they notice anything else. The armorer has submitted an emergency resupply request with three exclamation points.

facilities.name: Pact Garrison Block
facilities.description: Crimson Fleet enforcement garrison. Part armory, part brig, part reminder of who runs this system.
facilities.satisfied_description: The armory is stocked, the brig is occupied, and patrol crews rotate on schedule. The weapons maintenance bay smells of gun oil and purpose. Nobody asks what the reinforced door at the end of the corridor is for.
facilities.degraded_description: Ammunition rationing has patrol crews running light. The brig's environmental systems are unreliable — not that the Fleet considers prisoner comfort a priority. Weapons maintenance is behind schedule, and the duty sergeant's mood reflects it.

facilities.name: Pact Grand Armory
facilities.description: The largest military supply depot in Crimson space. Enough ordnance to sustain a full fleet engagement for thirty cycles. The Fleet considers this a two-week buffer.
facilities.satisfied_description: Fleet supply lines run hot with ordnance. The Grand Armory's blast-rated vaults hold more firepower than most stations have ever seen. Combat patrols launch fully armed, and the armory chief's standing report has three words: 'Mission-capable. All wings.'
facilities.degraded_description: Titanium and hull plate stocks have depleted to alert thresholds and the iron ration board has lit. The armory chief's three-word report has become a page. Patrol wings are turning around slower than the Fleet will tolerate. Fleet High Command has been notified and is unhappy about it.
facilities.lore: The Grand Armory occupies the most heavily armored section of the War Citadel — deeper than the reactor, better shielded than the command center. It was designed on the principle that running out of ammunition is the only defeat the Fleet cannot fight its way out of. Blast-rated vaults hold standard rounds by the million, armor-piercing stocks calculated by patrol rotation, depleted uranium reserves for contested engagements, and antimatter-core rounds for the situations that require absolute certainty. The armory chief's standing brief is three words. When it becomes more than that, the High Command listens immediately.

facilities.name: Pact Security Post
facilities.description: Crimson Fleet checkpoint. The guards are armed. The desk is armored. The questions are short.
facilities.satisfied_description: Armed guards process traffic with efficient hostility. The weapons rack is full, the checkpoint barrier works, and nobody lingers longer than necessary.
facilities.degraded_description: Ammo supplies are low, and the guards compensate by being louder. The checkpoint barrier is jammed open, which the duty officer considers a personal insult.

facilities.name: Pact War Depot
facilities.description: Major Crimson Fleet logistics base. Enough hardware to resupply a full patrol wing between engagements. The depot commander considers 'sufficiently stocked' a personal failure.
facilities.satisfied_description: Heavy-grade ammo lockers are filled to capacity. Patrol wings rotate through on tight schedule, Mandates re-arming in under thirty minutes. The depot commander walks the floor twice per shift and signs off on every load-out.
facilities.degraded_description: Iron ration stores are critical and hull plating requisitions are two cycles behind. Two patrol wings are turning around on short commons — acceptable, the depot commander says, with the expression of someone for whom nothing is acceptable.

facilities.name: Pact War Precinct
facilities.description: Full Crimson Fleet law enforcement command. The distinction between 'police station' and 'forward operating base' is, the Fleet insists, a matter of perspective.
facilities.satisfied_description: Tactical displays track every vessel in the system. The armory could supply a small invasion. Patrol Mandates launch on five-minute readiness, and the interrogation rooms have been recently cleaned. The Fleet's version of community policing is efficient, if not gentle.
facilities.degraded_description: Ammunition stocks are critical — patrol crews are down to standard rounds only. Tactical displays show gaps in coverage, and the duty commander has started personally escorting supply convoys. The interrogation rooms are still clean. They're always clean.

facilities.name: Palladium Diffusion Plant
facilities.description: Purpose-built diffusion facility with stacked palladium membrane cells and fuel cell-driven thermal regulation. Sustains high membrane throughput for reliable, high-yield hydrogen liquefaction.

facilities.name: Palladium Membrane Still
facilities.description: Compression chamber lined with a thin palladium membrane that selectively absorbs hydrogen and releases it fuel-grade. Slower than a brute-force compressor, but it captures gas that would otherwise be vented.

facilities.name: Pan-Galactic Foundry
facilities.description: An automated leviathan-shell foundry with lattice-binding cells that draws more matrix from each carapace. The pinnacle of wildlife-sourced endgame metallurgy.

facilities.name: Panoramic Deck Assembly Plant
facilities.description: A larger facility with parallel deck fit-out stations, structural frames supporting the assembly of multiple domed viewports at once. Processing cores coordinate viewport alignment, lounge lighting, and beverage service integration.

facilities.name: Parallel Dimension Barrier Plant
facilities.description: Industrial-scale production of legendary shields using quantum control cores to align exotic crystals and entanglement matrices across dimensional boundaries. Coolant loops manage the exotic thermal signatures; reinforced frames support the specialized containment equipment.

facilities.name: Particle Disruption Institute
facilities.description: State-of-the-art fully automated facility with quantum-calibrated processing cores, precision-optic fabrication chambers, and reinforced-frame substrates, delivering emitters every 10 seconds.

facilities.name: Particle Trap
facilities.description: A shielded containment facility combining liquid hydrogen and antimatter cells under controlled dark-matter confinement. Quantum stabilizers maintain magnetic field integrity throughout the synthesis cycle.

facilities.name: Passenger Cabin Assembly Plant
facilities.description: A specialized production facility that fabricates titanium-alloy frames, installs life support units, and integrates control systems into luxury cabin modules. Flex polymer linings and circuit boards are fitted for comfort and climate control.

facilities.name: Patch Workshop
facilities.description: A compact industrial assembler that bonds steel stock with synthetic compounds to seed self-replicating nanite matrices. Basic automation handles material feeding and output collection.

facilities.name: Patchwork Fleet Command
facilities.description: The Outer Rim's fleet command hub. No bureaucracy, no paperwork — just operational readiness and the Marshal's standing order: 'Launch ready in under five minutes.'
facilities.satisfied_description: Every Last Warning in the Rim's patrol wing is launch-ready. Ammo stacked. Tanks full. Plate and containment cells are stacked deep enough that the Marshal has stopped asking about either. The fleet commander's standing brief is four words: 'Ready on short notice.'
facilities.degraded_description: Antimatter containment cells are running short and the plate racks are down to scrap. Three patrol ships are grounded pending resupply, and the rotgut ran out two days before either did. The fleet commander's brief is now four pages and the Marshal is personally reviewing every word.
facilities.lore: The Patchwork Fleet Command looks like the rest of Frontier: improvised, functional, and held together by stubbornness. The commander's station is a repurposed navigation console with a direct channel to every Last Warning in the patrol wing. No formal chain of command, no operational planning cycle — just a manifest, a ready board, and the standing principle that any patrol ship not launch-capable within five minutes is a maintenance failure, not a scheduling issue. The antimatter containment cells for the salvage reactor are the real chokepoint: they feed the reactor that fuels everything. When they run short, the math gets brutal fast.

facilities.name: Patchwork Fungal Vats
facilities.description: Sealed culture vats in Patchwork's lower decks. The contents are biological, the origin is debated, and the safety officer stopped filing reports years ago.
facilities.lore: Nobody is entirely sure when the vats appeared. The maintenance log shows they were 'pre-existing infrastructure' when the Patchwork absorbed the station module they occupy. The cultures inside are vigorous, self-sustaining, and thoroughly uninterested in being classified. Frontier biologists have identified fourteen distinct organisms. They disagree on whether any of them are earth-origin. The Frontier Council's official position is that this is a matter for science, not policy.

facilities.name: Patchwork Spore Still
facilities.description: A secondary distillation operation running cultures from the fungal vats through a careful process. The output is marketed as a premium product. The ingredients remain undisclosed.
facilities.lore: The spore still operates under a Frontier Council production license that was approved in a session the minutes describe only as 'brief.' The distillers are characteristically tight-lipped about their inputs, noting only that the cultures are 'biologically active,' the process is 'proprietary,' and the result is 'not subject to standard ingredient disclosure.' Haven's Promenade stocks it in the back. It moves quickly.

facilities.name: Pathfinder Drive Assembly Station
facilities.description: A precision production line for fabricating experimental long-range drives. Jump cores, navigation systems, and phase drives are carefully integrated with quantum matrices and exotic stabilizers.

facilities.name: Pathfinder Drive Fabrication Complex
facilities.description: Cutting-edge production facility with advanced quantum control systems and precision optics calibration for raw galactic navigation. Multiple assembly tracks handle jump cores, phase drives, and exotic matrix integration simultaneously, achieving rapid drive synthesis.

facilities.name: Pathfinder Drive Manufacturing Line
facilities.description: An expanded facility with dedicated stations for jump calculator assembly and navigation core integration. Structural framing and processing cores support the complex coordinate-plotting systems.

facilities.name: Pathfinder Drive Production Works
facilities.description: Industrial-scale drive fabrication with reinforced frames and quantum control cores managing the exotic material integration. Precision optics and sensor arrays are assembled in parallel with jump drive subsystems.

facilities.name: Pathfinding Systems Lab
facilities.description: Mid-scale facility with expanded structural framing and control capacity. Higher throughput accommodates rapid assembly of the sensor and processing components critical to hyperspace computation.

facilities.name: Pattern Council Terminal
facilities.description: Missions manifest as probability-weighted suggestions that the Voidborn claim optimize for galactic benefit.
facilities.satisfied_description: Probability calculations flow with crystalline clarity, missions manifesting as inevitable suggestions for mutual benefit. The patterns feel almost comprehensible.
facilities.degraded_description: But something's off — pattern calculations fragment and contradict, probability percentages drifting meaninglessly. Mission suggestions become noise disguised as wisdom.
facilities.lore: The Pattern Council does not issue orders or post contracts. It presents probabilities. 'There is a 94.7% likelihood that transporting cargo to Haven will result in mutual benefit.' Organic visitors find this maddening. The Voidborn find organic mission boards equally so.

facilities.name: Payload Integration Facility
facilities.description: An expanded weapons facility with dedicated weapon housing stations, barrel assembly tooling, and structural frames to rapidly produce armor-penetrating missiles at higher volumes.

facilities.name: PD Burst Line
facilities.description: A rapid electronics line for emergency interception packages.

facilities.name: Peak-Extraction Laser Manufacturing Hub
facilities.description: State-of-the-art facility with full automation for exotic-material processing, superconductor alignment, and multi-array laser-focus integration. Delivers peak-performance mining lasers every 5 minutes with integrated coolant and power infrastructure.

facilities.name: Peak-Extraction Laser Production Works
facilities.description: Industrial production facility with specialized handling for stabilized exotic materials and superconductor integration. Quantum targeting computers and reinforced barrel processing support rapid assembly of capital-class mining systems.

facilities.name: Peak-Performance Laser Assembly Plant
facilities.description: A specialized facility taking Mining Laser IV modules and integrating multiple crystalline lattices, laser focus arrays, stabilized exotic materials, and superconductors into peak-extraction systems. Extended assembly sequences ensure complete integration.

facilities.name: Peak-Thrust Afterburner Factory
facilities.description: A large-scale automated complex with quantum control cores and precision optics optimizing durasteel-superconductor integration, producing high-performance afterburners with maximum efficiency.

facilities.name: Perception Enhancer Calibration Line
facilities.description: An optics workshop for disposable sensor-range amplifiers.

facilities.name: Perception Matrix Factory
facilities.description: A fully automated, state-of-the-art complex with redundant processing systems, precision optical alignment networks, and sophisticated quantum control cores delivering maximum-throughput production of cutting-edge sensor arrays.

facilities.name: Percussion Weapons Plant
