facilities.description: An expanded facility with dedicated barrel assembly stations and structural frame mounting for precision bore alignment. Weapon housings are integrated and tested for consistent firing velocity and reliability.

facilities.name: Peroxide Reaction Cell
facilities.description: A dual-feed pressurization line that mixes and compresses liquid hydrogen and oxygen into stable fuel reserves. Basic control nodes manage stoichiometric ratios and containment pressure.

facilities.name: Personnel Bureau
facilities.description: A staffed placement bureau with credential screening, transit quarters, and regional hiring contracts.
facilities.satisfied_description: Recruiters process arrivals continuously while bunk coordinators route trained crews to waiting ships.
facilities.degraded_description: Intake desks sit understaffed, temporary quarters are short on supplies, and the hiring queue barely moves.

facilities.name: Phantom Cloak Foundry
facilities.description: A cutting-edge fully automated production line with quantum-precision assembly of metamaterial panels, power cells, and advanced field-generator systems. Coolant loops regulate thermal effects during quantum control core operation, while extensive targeting computers optimize field stability.

facilities.name: Pharma Synthesis Lab
facilities.description: An expanded plant with dedicated atmospheric recycling and air management systems to maintain sterile synthesis of potent stimulant formulations. Life support integration ensures worker safety during exotic element handling.

facilities.name: Pharmaceutical Lab
facilities.description: Sealed environmental chamber maintaining controlled temperature and atmospheric composition to cultivate standardized biotech cultures. Basic air circulation and isolation prevent contamination during growth phases.

facilities.name: Phase Armor Assembly Line
facilities.description: A specialized production line for assembling armor that exists partially in alternate dimensions. Dark matter cells are installed into hull plating while null matter and void condensate are layered and bonded, creating the dimensional rifts that grant the armor its phasing properties.

facilities.name: Phase Armor Fabrication Complex
facilities.description: State-of-the-art fully automated facility with active cryogenic coolant loops maintaining dark matter cells and quantum matrices at operational temperature. Gravity generators and shield emitters are installed by precision robotic arms in synchronized sequences, creating armor sections that phase-shift with perfect dimensional coherence.

facilities.name: Phase Armor Production Facility
facilities.description: An expanded plant with dedicated dark-matter integration and quantum-stabilizer calibration stations. Voidborn null matrices are bonded to hull plating in carefully sequenced stages, with gravity generators positioned to maintain dimensional stability throughout assembly.

facilities.name: Phase Array Assembly Line
facilities.description: A specialized production line for optical phase components, featuring dark-matter cell handling and quantum stabilizer integration. Precision optics are aligned and sealed into functional cloaking arrays.

facilities.name: Phase Array Manufacturing Plant
facilities.description: Industrial-scale optical fabrication with gravity generators and dark-matter cells integrated under quantum control. Reinforced frames house the precision optic alignment systems running at high throughput.

facilities.name: Phase Barrier Workshop
facilities.description: A compact production line that fabricates adaptive quantum-state shield systems. Combines shield emitters and quantum matrices under controlled conditions to produce defensive modules.

facilities.name: Phase Calibration Chamber
facilities.description: Specialized refinery with dark matter containment chambers and quantum stabilizers that attune phase crystals into stable matrices. Gravity generators help maintain the exotic phase states during the refinement process.

facilities.name: Phase Concealment Forge
facilities.description: A fully automated state-of-the-art facility with quantum-controlled positioning of optical fibers, circuit boards, and focused crystals. Extensive coolant circulation and distributed shield emitters achieve maximum cloaking efficiency and detection suppression.

facilities.name: Phase Containment Line
facilities.description: A specialized production line handling phase-array assembly and quantum matrix refinement. Dark matter cells are shielded and stabilized throughout the process to prevent quantum decoherence.

facilities.name: Phase Crystal Attuning Station
facilities.description: Precision facility that stabilizes phase crystals using controlled energy injection, producing phase matrices for exotic applications. Dark matter cells provide the quantum field containment necessary for phase-state manipulation.

facilities.name: Phase Disruptor Forge
facilities.description: Industrial-scale production complex with automated targeting-computer calibration and high-volume void condensate processing. Multiple independent assembly lines feed into centralized quality verification and phase-coherence testing.

facilities.name: Phase Disruptor Foundry
facilities.description: Fully automated weapons-production facility with integrated coolant systems managing heat from exotic-material processing. Shield emitters protect sensitive quantum components while multi-stage targeting systems achieve precision assembly across continuous production runs.

facilities.name: Phase Disruptor Workshop
facilities.description: Larger facility with multiple targeting-computer integration stations and parallel barrel-assembly lines. Quantum control cores manage null-matter processing and exotic stabilization across the production chain.

facilities.name: Phase Drive Assembly Plant
facilities.description: A compact, specialized production line designed to assemble dimensional-shift propulsion cores. Dark-matter cells and quantum stabilizers are integrated into engine cores with precision containment protocols.

facilities.name: Phase Matrix Foundry
facilities.description: Industrial-scale facility with multiple dark matter containment vessels, quantum control cores, and gravity field generators working in concert. Produces stabilized phase matrices suitable for reality-manipulation applications at significant scale.

facilities.name: Phase Propulsion Manufacturing Line
facilities.description: Heavy-duty industrial production with integrated cooling systems and advanced quantum field stabilization. Multiple gravity generators work in concert to maintain dimensional coherence during assembly of high-performance phase drives.

facilities.name: Phase Torpedo Works
facilities.description: An expanded facility with dedicated sub-lines for barrel assembly, phase-drive integration, and tracking-system calibration. Antimatter charges are loaded in isolated containment bays before final housing closure and dimensional lock.

facilities.name: Phase Transition Lab
facilities.description: An expanded facility with dedicated cryogenic loops and multiple quantum-stabilization chambers operating in parallel. Dark matter handling is distributed across independent containment zones for higher throughput.

facilities.name: Phased Void Factory
facilities.description: Larger production center with reinforced structural frames and expanded coolant infrastructure. Control nodes orchestrate the delicate phase-shifting of void crystals and stabilized exotics into unified core packs.

facilities.name: Phased Void Manufactory
facilities.description: Full-scale facility featuring advanced coolant systems and reinforced containment to handle cascading phase-shift energies. Automated processes maintain strict timing synchronization between void crystal and superconductor alignment.

facilities.name: Phased Void Ordnance Complex
facilities.description: Cutting-edge system with extensive coolant loops and quantum control cores enabling real-time phase coherence tuning. Each core pack achieves optimal shield-bypassing resonance through automated quantum verification.

facilities.name: Phased Void Press
facilities.description: Specialized facility equipped with void crystal processors and superconductor integration systems. Coolant loops maintain the precise conditions needed to achieve phase-shift resonance in exotic materials.

facilities.name: Phosphor Separation Unit
facilities.description: Significantly expanded with heavy lead shielding and redundant control systems, this plant accelerates radium refinement through improved ore staging and enhanced containment. Radiation-hardened circuitry allows closer tolerances and faster throughput.

facilities.name: Photon-Absorbing Plant
facilities.description: Heavy-duty production complex with substantial coolant infrastructure managing rapid krypton-polymer interactions. Reinforced reaction vessels and precision control nodes maintain the exact conditions needed for consistent particle generation and optical properties.

facilities.name: Photonic Assembly Line
facilities.description: A dedicated production line for assembling sensor arrays, optical components, and composite substrates into functional collector units. Copper piping carries coolant through precision alignment stations where crystalline elements are bonded under controlled temperature.

facilities.name: Photonic Computing Works
facilities.description: Industrial-scale production facility employing docking rings and reinforced bulkheads to achieve rapid parallel computer synthesis. Dense hull plating infrastructure handles the optical precision requirements of massively parallel photonic processors.

facilities.name: Photonic Processing Assembly
facilities.description: Specialized facility assembling processing cores and prismatic lenses into photonic computing units. Hull plating and control infrastructure support the precision optical alignment required for light-refraction computation.

facilities.name: Photonic Production Facility
facilities.description: Industrial-scale operation with dedicated stations for optical fiber bundling, sensor integration, and composite curing. Docking rings facilitate rapid module exchange; the facility processes multiple collector stages simultaneously across segregated production zones.

facilities.name: Photovoltaic Manufacturing Plant
facilities.description: Integrated production system with processing cores and sensor array integration, achieving three times the assembly speed of basic lines. Precision optics and control nodes ensure consistent electrical output specifications.

facilities.name: Pilot-Whale Chowder Galley
facilities.description: Big blubber-rendering coppers and chowder pots for a whaling crew's return.

facilities.name: Pirate Bar
facilities.description: Every pirate stronghold has one. Part recruitment office, part intelligence exchange, part ongoing argument about who owes who a round.
facilities.satisfied_description: The bar is open. Crimson Bloodwine flows from the Fleet's reserves, Frontier Rotgut from wherever it came from, and the moonshine from whoever's cooking this week. Nobody's asking. Morale is high, fights are recreational, and the crew shows up on time.
facilities.degraded_description: The bar is dry. Bloodwine ran out two days ago, the last barrel of Rotgut turned out to be engine coolant, and the moonshine still is cold. Morale has taken a measurable hit. The crew shows up late, surly, and looking for someone to blame.

facilities.name: Pirate Boarding Drill Deck
facilities.description: A battered mock hull where boarding gangs rehearse breaches, compartment fights, and the fastest route to a prize ship's bridge.
facilities.satisfied_description: Armed crews cycle through live breach drills while fresh boarding parties wait beside the launch racks.
facilities.degraded_description: The range is quiet and the mess is bare, reducing boarding practice to threats, stories, and dry runs.

facilities.name: Pirate Crew Muster
facilities.description: A loud, crowded hiring deck where free crews, discharged hands, and the recently desperate sign onto pirate ships with few questions asked.
facilities.satisfied_description: The boards are thick with names and fresh crews crowd the berth gates, arguing over shares before the ink is dry.
facilities.degraded_description: Empty ration lockers have thinned the crowd, leaving captains to bargain over the last qualified hands.

facilities.name: Pirate Life Support Rig
facilities.description: Stripped from a derelict hauler and reinstalled with whatever was on hand. Keeps the air breathable and the water technically potable, most of the time.
facilities.satisfied_description: The air is recycled and the water is running. Nobody's writing a health inspection report, but the crew is alive and functional, which is all that was promised.
facilities.degraded_description: The recyclers are struggling. The air tastes stale, the water has a chemical edge, and the deck crew has started calling it a character-building experience. The medical bay is busy.

facilities.name: Pirate Sawbones Ward
facilities.description: A scarred casualty ward where practical medics patch raiders back together with stolen supplies and very little ceremony.
facilities.satisfied_description: Trauma carts stay stocked and the sawbones keep a steady procession of patched-up crews moving back toward the docks.
facilities.degraded_description: The clean bandages are gone, the good anesthetic is guarded, and anyone still breathing has been told to wait.

facilities.name: Plasma Armament Arsenal
facilities.description: Heavy-duty production plant with dedicated targeting-computer calibration and reinforced-frame fabrication. Quantum control cores coordinate multi-stage assembly; coolant loops manage thermal stress during high-speed production.

facilities.name: Plasma Assembly Line
facilities.description: A dedicated production line that assembles engine cores, superconductors, and polymers into flight-ready afterburners. Modular conveyor stations handle component integration and power-cell installation.

facilities.name: Plasma Cannon III Forge
facilities.description: Industrial-scale production complex with precision-optic targeting systems and advanced reinforced-frame fabrication for extreme durability. Quantum control orchestrates three plasma streams and active thermal regulation; each unit validated for catastrophic output.

facilities.name: Plasma Cannon III Foundry
facilities.description: Fully automated mega-facility with four dedicated production chains, each equipped with independent coolant loops and targeting computers. Advanced quantum systems synchronize triple-injector plasma streams and manage the intense thermal loads of military-grade operation.

facilities.name: Plasma Cannon III Workshop
facilities.description: Large-scale facility with dedicated heat-sink and fury-alloy processing stations feeding a triple-injector assembly core. Structural framing supports the increased mass and thermal output; expanded control systems manage simultaneous injector timing.

facilities.name: Plasma Cannon Workshop
facilities.description: Purpose-built production line for dual-injector plasma cannons with enhanced containment. Dedicated ceramite plating stations and superconductor integration ensure stable field generation.

facilities.name: Plasma Cell Bottler
facilities.description: Sealed production system that pairs refined plasma cores with ceramite plating and stabilizes each charge above ordinary field-grade output. Produces enhanced plasma cells for harder-hitting weapon loadouts.

facilities.name: Plasma Cell Charging Plant
facilities.description: A larger facility with dedicated plasma compression chambers and weapon-housing integration points. Barrel assemblies help shape and stabilize plasma before final magnetic sealing.

facilities.name: Plasma Cell Charging Station
facilities.description: A containment and charging apparatus that pressurizes plasma gas and integrates power batteries into magnetically-confined cells. Copper piping carries high-voltage charging current and coolant for thermal management.

facilities.name: Plasma Cell Cracker
facilities.description: A quench line that cools raw plasma into charge slurry and seals it into standard fuel cells. Runs hotter than a hydrogen line and smells like a thunderstorm, but plasma is cheap where hydrogen barges don't call.

facilities.name: Plasma Cell Manufacturing Complex
facilities.description: Industrial-scale production with quantum-controlled magnetic containment fields and targeting-computer calibration. Multiple charging chambers operate in sequence with precision plasma shaping and confinement.

facilities.name: Plasma Cell Production Foundry
facilities.description: State-of-the-art facility with parallel quantum-containment chambers, advanced barrel-assembly shaping, and coolant-loop thermal regulation. Achieves four-second plasma-cell completion through simultaneous charging and magnetic stabilization.

facilities.name: Plasma Charge Containment Plant
facilities.description: An upgraded charge plant with parallel filling chambers, structural containment frames, and closed-loop cooling. Automated pressure checks keep high-volume field-grade plasma packs inexpensive and consistent.

facilities.name: Plasma Charge Filling Line
facilities.description: A compact filling line that seals harvested plasma gas into inexpensive weapon charges, with simple copper controls regulating containment and pack pressure.

facilities.name: Plasma Combustion Lab
facilities.description: A high-pressure plasma reactor that compresses plasma gas and steel into dense military-grade fuel cells. Direct plasma injection and minimal cooling result in hot, energy-dense output.

facilities.name: Plasma Compression Chamber
facilities.description: Large specialized facility with dedicated stations for weapon-core assembly, refined-plasma integration, and exotic-crystal calibration. Structural framing and expanded processing cores handle the extreme energy densities involved.

facilities.name: Plasma Containment Cell
facilities.description: Magnetically-shielded reactor designed to compress and bind plasma gas with superconductors, producing stable high-energy cores for weapons systems.

facilities.name: Plasma Containment Facility
facilities.description: Mid-scale facility with integrated coolant systems and control automation to increase throughput. Ceramite plating is applied uniformly while plasma cores are stabilized to enhanced combat specifications.

facilities.name: Plasma Conversion Complex
facilities.description: A full conversion campus: superconductor-stabilized quench arrays, tungsten-lined feed trunks, and fuel-cell palletizers running around the clock. Turns a plasma glut into a fuel ledger.

facilities.name: Plasma Core Assembly
facilities.description: Specialized facility that combines refined plasma cores with neural extracts and power cells into integrated combat computers. Extended 14-minute cycle reflects the complexity of neural-interface assembly and plasma containment.

facilities.name: Plasma Energy Hub
facilities.description: Cutting-edge plasma synthesis system with real-time density monitoring and adaptive plasma modulation. Integrated cryogenic loops and precision plasma sequencing deliver maximum fuel density at rapid production rates.

facilities.name: Plasma Fabrication Plant
facilities.description: Larger facility optimized for the more complex dual-plasma architecture. Structural framing and expanded control infrastructure handle higher component counts; parallel assembly tracks increase output efficiency.

facilities.name: Plasma-Flux Alloy Forge
facilities.description: A high-temperature smelting line that combines titanium ore, steel, and plasma residue in a controlled arc furnace, producing advanced hull alloy. Heat sinks manage the extreme thermal load; plasma injectors meter reactive flux into the melt.

facilities.name: Plasma-Flux Alloy Works
facilities.description: State-of-the-art operation featuring quantum-enhanced furnace control, precision plasma-injection timing, and multi-loop coolant systems for rapid solidification and grain refinement. Massive heat-sink infrastructure and advanced plasma-injector arrays produce premium hull material.

facilities.name: Plasma-Flux Foundry
facilities.description: A dedicated alloying facility with separate ore preheating, plasma-injection control, and precision pour-casting. Heat sinks and plasma injectors work in concert to achieve superior alloy homogeneity and material strength.

facilities.name: Plasma-Flux Smelting Complex
facilities.description: Industrial-scale facility with multiple furnace cells, integrated plasma-injection systems, and sophisticated cooling loops. Extensive heat-sink arrays and plasma-injector staging enable consistent high-purity titanium alloy at volume.

facilities.name: Plasma Forge
facilities.description: Heavy production line engineered for the capital-class triple-core plasma cannon. Integrates refined plasma cores, exotic crystals, and titanium ingots into devastating hull-liquefying weapons.

facilities.name: Plasma Fuel Cell Plant
facilities.description: Upgraded reactor with enhanced plasma injection ports and improved heat management. Plasma injectors and heat sinks increase density and reduce synthesis time for higher military fuel output.

facilities.name: Plasma Fuel Combustor
facilities.description: A specialized compression vessel designed to stabilize and compress plasma gas into fuel reserves. Heavy steel construction and basic control systems manage the containment pressure.

facilities.name: Plasma Fuel Complex
facilities.description: Industrial-scale facility with extensive coolant loops circulating through compression chambers and multiple plasma injection stages, dramatically accelerating the stabilization and condensation of plasma into fuel reserves.

facilities.name: Plasma Fuel Factory
facilities.description: Industrial plasma-to-fuel conversion with banked quench channels, automated cell sealing, and intake manifolds fed straight from gas barges. The thunderstorm smell carries three decks.

facilities.name: Plasma Fuel Plant
facilities.description: Larger containment plant with heat sinks to dissipate thermal energy from plasma compression and plasma injectors to enhance gas density before fuel reserve consolidation.

facilities.name: Plasma Fuel Refinery
facilities.description: Parallel quench channels with tungsten-lined intake manifolds turn a steady plasma feed into pallets of sealed fuel cells. The cooling stacks glow faintly at night.

facilities.name: Plasma Gun Forge
facilities.description: A focused production line that integrates plasma injectors, housings, ceramite plating, and circuit boards into complete Tier-1 cannons. Basic barrel assembly and housing stations prepare components for final welding and seal.

facilities.name: Plasma Injector Assembly
facilities.description: Compact production line that fuses refined plasma cores, ceramite plating, and copper wiring into complete fuel-injection systems. Simple but precise assembly ensures reliable plasma delivery to weapons.

facilities.name: Plasma Mine Assembly Line
facilities.description: Purpose-built ordnance line for combining steel plates, refined plasma cores, and warhead assemblies into thermal detonation mines. Control systems manage the volatile plasma core integration.

facilities.name: Plasma Mine Complex
facilities.description: Cutting-edge facility with coolant loop systems regulating plasma core temperatures during assembly. Quantum targeting integration and precision barrel work deliver high-output thermal detonation mines at maximum speed.

facilities.name: Plasma Mine Plant
facilities.description: Dedicated weapons facility with weapon housing and barrel assembly staging for mine containment. Integrated plasma core handling and warhead assembly stations increase production throughput.

facilities.name: Plasma Mine Works
facilities.description: Industrial ordnance complex with quantum-controlled targeting computers and reinforced weapon housing. Advanced thermal management ensures stable plasma core assembly and reliable mine deployment.

facilities.name: Plasma Ordnance Factory
facilities.description: Industrial production complex with precision optics for field-alignment and reinforced-frame construction for enhanced structural integrity. Quantum cores manage the intricate dual-injector synchronization and superconductor calibration.

facilities.name: Plasma Ordnance Works
facilities.description: State-of-the-art automated complex with four independent production lines, each equipped with targeting computers and active cooling. Real-time sensor arrays ensure every cannon meets military-grade ballistic specifications.

facilities.name: Plasma Ordnance Yard
facilities.description: Heavy-duty production complex handling quantum-controlled tracking system calibration and reinforced frame assembly at scale. Targeting computers are integrated alongside weapon housing and barrel assembly for precision ordnance production.

facilities.name: Plasma Projection Workshop
facilities.description: Multi-station facility with separate injection, housing, and barrel-assembly tracks feeding a central integration hub. Increased structural framing and control nodes enable faster component throughput and tighter tolerances.

facilities.name: Plasma Refinement Plant
facilities.description: Upgraded facility with chemical containment and hazmat systems, improving plasma compression efficiency and reducing stabilization time through enhanced field control.

facilities.name: Plasma Refinement Station
facilities.description: Heavy-duty operation with integrated hazmat containment and active coolant loops, enabling rapid stabilization of plasma cores at high throughput.

facilities.name: Plasma Repeater Assembly Line
facilities.description: A dedicated production line that assembles plasma injectors, ceramite plating, and control circuitry into rapid-fire repeater weapons. Automated guidance systems align barrel assemblies and weapon housings through each assembly stage.

facilities.name: Plasma Repeater I Forge
facilities.description: Industrial-scale production with quantum-controlled component alignment and targeting computer integration. Reinforced frame construction and precision targeting systems are mounted in parallel stations, dramatically shortening cycle time.

facilities.name: Plasma Repeater I Foundry
facilities.description: State-of-the-art facility featuring active coolant loop management to handle rapid quantum control core integration and simultaneous multi-stage assembly. Targeting computers and barrel assemblies are installed and tested in real-time, achieving sub-15-second production cycles.

facilities.name: Plasma Repeater I Workshop
facilities.description: Expanded facility with parallel assembly tracks and integrated quality control, handling higher volumes of ceramic plating application and circuit board integration. Improved copper piping distribution reduces thermal stress during assembly.

facilities.name: Plasma Repeater II Forge
facilities.description: Large-scale facility incorporating quantum control cores and sophisticated targeting computers alongside aggressive heat management systems. Dual-injector assemblies and reinforced frames enable efficient high-throughput production.

facilities.name: Plasma Repeater II Foundry
facilities.description: Cutting-edge production system with extensive coolant loop networks managing heat dissipation during quantum core installation and precision targeting system integration. Fully automated multi-stage assembly achieves rapid cycle times on the most advanced plasma repeater platform.

facilities.name: Plasma Repeater II Workshop
facilities.description: Expanded production facility with enhanced heat sink integration and parallel plasma injector assembly tracks. Structural frames provide better thermal distribution across the weapon assembly.

facilities.name: Plasma Residue Condenser
facilities.description: A compact refining station that processes plasma residue through controlled heating and stabilization, producing weapon-grade plasma cores for tactical systems.

facilities.name: Plasma Residue Reclaimer
facilities.description: A larger facility with chemical containment liners, hazmat containers, and expanded control systems to handle higher volumes of corrosive plasma material safely and efficiently.

facilities.name: Plasma Residue Refinery
facilities.description: An industrial-scale operation with extensive chemical liners, reinforced hazmat infrastructure, and coolant loops managing the intense thermal and chemical stresses of bulk plasma refinement.

facilities.name: Plasma Residue Synthesis Array
facilities.description: State-of-the-art equipment with massive chemical containment capacity, precision control nodes, and aggressive coolant circulation to sustain extreme throughput while handling corrosive plasma chemistry at scale.

facilities.name: Plasma Sinter Forge
facilities.description: A titanium melt fed by a fluxipede's plasma sinter — the animal's pre-stabilized flux does the plasma-flux step, so titanium ore alloys straight through without raw residue.

facilities.name: Plasma Synthesis Facility
facilities.description: Industrial-scale plasma compression facility with active coolant circulation and multi-stage plasma conditioning. Produces high-density military cells through continuous plasma injection and thermal regulation.

facilities.name: Plasma Synthesis Foundry
facilities.description: Industrial production plant with precision-optic calibration stations and quantum-core control for exact plasma-core integration. Reinforced-frame construction and sensor arrays validate each injector's fuel-delivery accuracy.

facilities.name: Plasma Synthesis Reactor
facilities.description: Fully automated state-of-the-art facility with multi-stage plasma injection arrays, redundant coolant systems, and precision pressure regulation—converts plasma gas into fuel reserves at unprecedented speed.

facilities.name: Plasma Torch Assembly Line
facilities.description: A specialized production line assembling plasma injectors with ceramite housings and sensor arrays to create functional hydrogen-combustion modules for mining operations.

facilities.name: Plasma Torpedo Bay
facilities.description: Specialized weapons production line for integrating durasteel plates, refined plasma cores, warhead assemblies, and ceramite plating into armor-melting torpedoes. Dedicated containment systems manage plasma core stability.

facilities.name: Plasma Torpedo Complex
facilities.description: State-of-the-art facility featuring coolant loop systems managing extreme thermal stress in plasma core assembly and ceramite bonding. Quantum targeting and precision manufacturing deliver maximum-performance plasma torpedoes at accelerated rates.

facilities.name: Plasma Torpedo Plant
facilities.description: Expanded ordnance facility with weapon housing and barrel assembly stations for torpedo body construction. Ceramite plating integration and warhead staging enable steady production of thermal warheads.

facilities.name: Plasma Torpedo Works
facilities.description: Industrial weapons complex with quantum-controlled targeting computers and reinforced barrel assembly precision. Ceramite plating application and plasma core integration reach production scale with minimal thermal variance.

facilities.name: Plasma Torpedo Workshop
facilities.description: Specialized production facility for assembling plasma-charged torpedo launchers, integrating dual plasma injectors, tracking systems, and durasteel plate construction. Barrel assembly and weapon housing installation are performed in sequence through dedicated stations.

facilities.name: Plasma Weapons Foundry
facilities.description: Cutting-edge facility running four fully autonomous production lines with integrated coolant management and real-time targeting-computer verification. Advanced quantum systems ensure perfect field containment across all units.

facilities.name: Plate Hammer Shop
facilities.description: Metal stamping and welding system that bonds titanium ingots, tungsten rods, and steel plates into reinforced hull sections. Produces straightforward armor plating for standard hull construction.

facilities.name: Plate Press
facilities.description: Purpose-built fabrication line that bonds titanium alloy to steel plate under controlled pressure, producing reinforced armor sections for standard ship construction. Copper piping and control nodes manage the adhesion process across multiple work stations.

facilities.name: Platina Precision Refinery
facilities.description: The pinnacle of noble-metal wire production — fully automated smelting, drawing, and micron-gauge verification, delivering contact wire of a purity the relay trade once thought impossible.

facilities.name: Platinum Assay Mint
facilities.description: An assay-and-stamping line that smelts platinum ore, verifies its purity, and casts it into standard bullion bars. A wealth-storage convenience, not an industrial input.

facilities.name: Platinum Automation Works
facilities.description: An industrial automation works with parallel assembly lines and coolant loops managing the thermal load of high-density logic, turning out platinum-contact nodes for factions expanding faster than their gold supply.

facilities.name: Platinum Casting Works
facilities.description: An expanded casting hall with induction crucibles and automated mold handling, pouring white-metal fin arrays in continuous runs. Platinum's melting point demands serious thermal management at every station.

facilities.name: Platinum Catalytic Plant
facilities.description: Industrial cracking plant with regenerating catalyst beds and fuel cell-driven thermal control. Sustains high catalyst activity for consistent high-yield polymer runs.

facilities.name: Platinum Conductor Works
facilities.description: An industrial-scale works with continuous casting, rapid plasma heating, and automated drawing towers. Extensive coolant systems fight the work-hardening that makes platinum the most stubborn wire stock in the trade.

facilities.name: Platinum Contact Assembly Line
facilities.description: Assembles control nodes around platinum relay contacts wound from drawn wire instead of gold and silver conductors. Contacts that never pit, from a metal nobody wants — while that lasts.

facilities.name: Platinum Contact Production Plant
facilities.description: An expanded plant with automated contact winding and thermal management for dense circuitry packing, assembling platinum-contact control nodes at steady volume.

facilities.name: Platinum Electrode Forge
facilities.description: Welds injector electrodes up from drawn platinum wire, sidestepping the refined plasma core supply chain entirely. Erosion-proof electrodes from a glutted metal — the economics write themselves.

facilities.name: Platinum Foundry
facilities.description: Casts thermal fin arrays from white metal instead of copper-aluminum. A foundry that only makes sense while platinum trades below scrap — which, lately, it does.

facilities.name: Platinum Injector Plant
facilities.description: A heavy industrial plant with parallel welding lines, high-pressure test rigs, and coolant networks, mass-producing platinum-electrode injectors while the metal stays cheap.

facilities.name: Platinum Sponge Line
facilities.description: An automated reduction line with integrated gas handling and thermal control, producing catalytic platinum sponge at higher throughput and more consistent surface area.

facilities.name: Platinum Wire Extruder
facilities.description: A metal-working facility with ore smelting, casting, and hardened wire-drawing dies rated for the stubbornness of platinum. Produces contact and electrode wire that outlasts anything drawn from gold or silver.

facilities.name: Platinum Wire Mill
facilities.description: A larger mill with plasma-assisted smelting and multi-stage drawing towers. Aggressive annealing cycles keep the stubborn white metal workable through each gauge reduction.

facilities.name: Point Defense Battery
facilities.description: Clusters of fast-tracking autocannon studded across the station's outer hull, sighted for anything that comes inside a few hundred metres. It cannot reach a ship holding at range, and it does not care: the things it is built to kill are the ones already close enough to read the hull numbers.
facilities.satisfied_description: The feed belts are full and the gun crews are bored, which is the correct state for a point defense crew to be in.
facilities.degraded_description: The magazines are empty. The guns track anything that comes near, perfectly, silently, and do nothing at all about it.

facilities.name: Polonium Doping Cell
facilities.description: A heavily shielded centrifuge system with basic lead lining and isolation protocols, separating reactor-grade and polonium feedstock into weapons-grade fissile material. Runs at deliberate pace.

facilities.name: Polymer Extruder
facilities.description: A specialized molding facility that combines polymers and carbon ore through controlled heating and pressure. Copper piping distributes heat while control nodes manage the extrusion cycles that form nanoplastic composites.

facilities.name: Polymer Refinery
facilities.description: A chemical processing facility that combines silicon and nickel ore feedstocks into flexible polymer through controlled polymerization. Basic but effective for routine material production.

facilities.name: Polymer Synthesizer
facilities.description: Basic thermal polymerization system for ore conversion. Heats and combines silicon and nickel feedstock into flexible synthetic material.

facilities.name: Power Buffer
facilities.description: Expanded battery storage with integrated load balancers and active thermal management. Smooths out wider production spikes than a basic bank can handle.
facilities.satisfied_description: Thermal regulators hold the cell stacks at peak efficiency. Load balancers feed the bus in real time, and even simultaneous foundry, refinery, and shipyard cycles ride through without a flicker.
facilities.degraded_description: Thermal management has dropped offline and the cells are out of spec. Half the load balancers won't engage; the bus sags whenever more than one facility fires at once.

facilities.name: Power Cell Assembler
facilities.description: A specialized production line that combines circuit boards, energy crystals, and copper wiring into compact power cells through automated assembly and containment processes.

facilities.name: Power Cell Assembly Line
facilities.description: A dedicated production line that combines power batteries, copper wiring harnesses, and circuit boards into high-capacity energy storage units. Precision assembly ensures reliable electrical continuity and safety isolation between cell compartments.

facilities.name: Power Cell Fabrication Line
facilities.description: A compact production facility for assembling high-capacity energy storage units, integrating circuit boards, energy crystals, and silver wiring into functional power cells. Straightforward assembly with minimal downtime.

facilities.name: Power Cell Foundry
facilities.description: Industrial-scale production with extensive coolant circulation to manage the thermal load of continuous plasma-assisted refinement. Reinforced frames support heavy machinery running near-constant output cycles.

facilities.name: Power Cell Manufacturing Plant
facilities.description: A heavily automated manufacturing plant featuring precision optics integration, quantum control core processing, and optimized energy crystal alignment. Delivers high-capacity storage units with enhanced efficiency.

facilities.name: Power Cell Works
facilities.description: A reinforced cell line with coolant loops taming the thermal load and heat sinks stacked deep. The cells still run hot and unstable — but now they do it by the thousand, at half the price of anything legal.

facilities.name: Power Core Assembly Line
facilities.description: A precision fabrication line that fuses fusion fuel rods, helium isotopes, and energy crystals into integrated power cores. Sensor arrays monitor each stage of the delicate assembly process.

facilities.name: Power Grid
facilities.description: Distributed power generation with redundant feeds and surge protection.
facilities.satisfied_description: Redundant feeds maintain voltage across every section. Surge protectors stand ready, and output exceeds demand.
facilities.degraded_description: Not today. Redundant feeds have failed, leaving single-point power paths. Surge protection is offline — every spike risks cascade failure.

facilities.name: Power Grid Assembly Station
facilities.description: A purposeful fabrication facility that integrates power cells, wiring harnesses, and copper conduits into complete distribution networks, with reinforced bulkheads and hull plating for structural integrity.

facilities.name: Power Plant Expansion
facilities.description: A modular generator annex that bolts onto the station's existing power plant. Scales up whatever's already there — output and fuel consumption rise in lockstep with each module attached.
facilities.satisfied_description: The annex runs in sync with the primary plant, taking its share of fuel and adding its share of output. Engineering reports nothing more interesting than steady readings.
facilities.degraded_description: The annex is idle. Its share of fuel is missing from the supply lines, and the primary plant's output is back to baseline.

facilities.name: Power Surge Cell Line
facilities.description: A high-current assembly line for reinforced discharge cells.

facilities.name: Precious-Metal Refinery
facilities.description: A controlled thermal-processing station that extracts and bonds palladium and iridium ore with copper wiring to form zero-resistance conductors. Copper piping and control nodes manage the delicate metallurgical reactions required.

facilities.name: Precision Accelerator Foundry
facilities.description: Industrial-scale complex with quantum control cores managing multi-stage electromagnetic coil winding and capacitor synchronization. Targeting computers are precision-calibrated to maximize penetration across large production batches.

facilities.name: Precision Anomaly Detection Fabricator
facilities.description: A state-of-the-art facility with extensive precision-optic infrastructure and quantum-orchestrated sensor-array preparation, processing-core tuning, and crystal-integration chambers. Fully automated parallel assembly achieves two-minute cycle times for complete detection modules.

facilities.name: Precision Barrel Manufacturing Complex
facilities.description: State-of-the-art facility combining quantum-controlled multi-axis machining, real-time bore scanning with precision optics, and automated quality verification for flawless barrel production. Reinforced infrastructure supports extreme cutting speeds and loads.

facilities.name: Precision Cabin Manufacturing
facilities.description: Heavy-duty facility using quantum control cores and precision optics to ensure exact fit and function of all cabin systems. Reinforced frames support rapid assembly of multi-component luxury modules with integrated environmental controls.

facilities.name: Precision Circuit Lab
facilities.description: Multi-stage facility equipped with plasma injection for high-temperature bonding and distributed heat sinks to manage thermal loads across parallel assembly zones. Processes ore into finished boards with tighter tolerances.

facilities.name: Precision Control Works
facilities.description: State-of-the-art facility with dual coolant loop systems and heavy reinforced framing managing ultra-precise conductor deposition. Simultaneous multi-station assembly of circuit integration, wiring harnesses, and logic calibration at peak throughput.

facilities.name: Precision Copper Pipe Works
facilities.description: Industrial-scale extrusion and drawing complex with automated quality inspection and rapid coolant cycling. Produces high-pressure rated piping with consistent wall thickness and superior flow characteristics.

facilities.name: Precision Cryo-Assembly Complex
facilities.description: Highly automated production center employing quantum control systems and advanced optics for capital-grade ice harvester fabrication. Multi-stage cryogenic processing and precision component alignment maximize output efficiency.

facilities.name: Precision Cryogenic Nitrogen Recovery Plant
facilities.description: Industrial-scale facility with reinforced cryogenic chambers and quantum-controlled temperature management. Precision optics track sublimation boundaries in real time while processing cores orchestrate multi-zone separation to maximize throughput.

facilities.name: Precision Cryogenic Works
facilities.description: State-of-the-art facility featuring redundant quantum control cores, full sensor array integration, and advanced precision optics for real-time intake optimization. Produces argon condensers at industrial scale with minimal cycle time.

facilities.name: Precision Crystal Synthesizer
facilities.description: State-of-the-art facility featuring distributed plasma injectors, advanced cryogenic cooling, and real-time lattice monitoring for near-instantaneous energy crystal production.

facilities.name: Precision Electrolysis Hub
facilities.description: Cutting-edge multi-chamber facility using plasma-enhanced electrolysis and cryogenic gas separation to extract hydrogen at maximum efficiency and purity.

facilities.name: Precision Fiber Mill
facilities.description: Larger facility with enhanced thermal management and plasma-assisted crystallization, significantly reducing fiber draw times and improving consistency.

facilities.name: Precision Flotation System
facilities.description: Heavily automated flotation complex with quantum-controlled reagent dosing and real-time ore composition monitoring. Precision optics and advanced control cores optimize bubble formation and mineral binding for maximum efficiency.

facilities.name: Precision Focus Facility
facilities.description: Large-scale biofacility with integrated life support and atmospheric management, sustaining dense culture populations and rapid compound synthesis across multiple reactor vessels.

facilities.name: Precision Foundry
facilities.description: Advanced manufacturing center with molecular-scale fabrication capabilities.
facilities.satisfied_description: Molecular assemblers operate in clean-room conditions. Quantum-stabilized tools produce components to nanometer tolerances.
facilities.degraded_description: Not right now. Clean-room containment is compromised, assemblers produce at reduced precision, and advanced recipes frequently fail.

facilities.name: Precision Fragmentation Manufacturing
facilities.description: Industrial mass-production system with quantum-guided scoring dies and targeting-computer verification of shatter patterns. Each round receives ballistic analysis before final packaging.

facilities.name: Precision Geological Instrument Works
facilities.description: Cutting-edge facility featuring full automation of sensor array, optical, and exotic material processing with quantum-tier control systems. Reinforced framing and multi-stage pipelining deliver maximum throughput of advanced scanners.

facilities.name: Precision Gyroscope Works
facilities.description: Industrial-scale assembly complex featuring quantum-controlled calibration and optical verification systems. Produces stabilizers at near-continuous rates with minimal tolerance drift.

facilities.name: Precision Hot-Cell Facility

facilities.description: State-of-the-art production complex with redundant quantum-control arrays, precision targeting infrastructure, and active coolant loops. Weapon-housing and barrel-assembly components operate in synchronized sequence to achieve near-instantaneous shield-charge synthesis.

facilities.name: Quantum Shield Integration Complex
facilities.description: A fully automated, cutting-edge production complex with redundant quantum control systems, distributed shield emitter networks, and precision coolant loops enabling ultra-fast assembly of advanced shield matrices.

facilities.name: Quantum Shield Works
facilities.description: A state-of-the-art automated facility with fully integrated quantum matrix handling, superconductor management, and real-time adaptive tuning, producing cutting-edge shields with minimal downtime.

facilities.name: Quantum Shielding Nexus
facilities.description: Cutting-edge facility with quantum-grade control systems and extensive thermal management. Fully automated assembly of shield boosters with real-time field calibration at maximum throughput.

facilities.name: Quantum Siege Armor Complex
facilities.description: Cutting-edge facility employing quantum-aligned composite bonding, integrated docking-ring networks, and real-time structural validation. Creates crimson siege plating with maximum fury-alloy saturation and near-instantaneous production cycles.

facilities.name: Quantum Silver Foundry
facilities.description: A state-of-the-art facility with cryogenic cooling systems, thousands of heat sinks, and redundant plasma injection arrays that produce circuit boards at maximum efficiency with zero thermal variance.

facilities.name: Quantum Sinter Array
facilities.description: State-of-the-art facility with fully distributed plasma conditioning, extensive coolant circulation networks, and precision control systems achieving near-instantaneous production cycles. Optimized for highest-grade composite specifications.

facilities.name: Quantum Stabilizer Assembly Line
facilities.description: A specialized production line that fuses processed null matter onto circuit board substrates. Precision control nodes manage the exotic bonding process required to create stable quantum stabilizers.

facilities.name: Quantum Stabilizer Factory
facilities.description: Industrial-scale production with extensive coolant circulation and plasma-injection systems to handle continuous null matter processing. Reinforced frames support the heavy machinery required for exotic matter fabrication.

facilities.name: Quantum Stabilizer Nexus
facilities.description: Fully automated facility with redundant plasma systems and sophisticated coolant infrastructure managing the thermal demands of null matter bonding. Produces quantum stabilizers at maximum efficiency for advanced equipment worldwide.

facilities.name: Quantum Stabilizer Plant
facilities.description: A larger facility with plasma-assisted bonding and integrated heat management to accelerate null matter substrate fusion. Plasma injectors and heat sinks maintain optimal conditions for reliable stabilizer production.

facilities.name: Quantum Stealth Laboratory
facilities.description: A larger production facility with dedicated stations for phase array calibration, exotic crystal mounting, and quantum matrix integration. Structural frames and expanded shield systems work with control nodes to produce more reliable cloaking devices.

facilities.name: Quantum Stealth Manufactory
facilities.description: A mass-production complex integrating gravity generators to maintain exotic material stability during assembly. Quantum control cores orchestrate precise phase alignment across multiple production streams simultaneously.

facilities.name: Quantum Substrate Fabrication Complex
facilities.description: State-of-the-art center where quantum control cores and precision optics work in concert to produce refined quantum matrices at maximum fidelity. Redundant processing systems ensure continuous high-throughput output.

facilities.name: Quantum Targeting Weapons Facility
facilities.description: Heavy industrial complex with targeting computers, reinforced frames, and quantum control cores working in concert to achieve precise dark matter weapon assembly. Incorporates targeting subsystems for enhanced weapon accuracy.

facilities.name: Quantum Threat Analysis Facility
facilities.description: Cutting-edge automated production line featuring quantum control integration, high-precision optic assembly, and advanced sensor calibration. Produces threat analyzers with state-of-the-art target discrimination and predictive algorithms.

facilities.name: Quantum Thruster Works
facilities.description: A fully automated state-of-the-art complex with real-time dual-engine synchronization and quantum-enhanced calibration, delivering high-performance afterburners at unprecedented production rates.

facilities.name: Quantum Torpedo Manufacturing Complex
facilities.description: Cutting-edge weapons production system with quantum control cores, extensive coolant loops, and redundant targeting computer networks achieving maximum-rate torpedo assembly. Delivers devastating anti-capital payloads at unprecedented production volumes.

facilities.name: Quantum Void Fabrication
facilities.description: State-of-the-art facility with integrated cryogenic and gravitational containment systems running continuously. Advanced coolant loops and shield emitters maintain perfect phase coherence while processing dark matter and quantum matrices at industrial scale.

facilities.name: Quantum Void Manufactory
facilities.description: A fully automated ultra-precision facility with quantum-level control over phase array positioning, exotic crystal integration, and quantum matrix assembly. Multiple coolant circuits and distributed shield systems maintain optimal field coherence for maximum detection evasion.

facilities.name: Rad Assembly Bay
facilities.description: A focused production line that upgrades base rad harvesters with improved ceramic shielding and isotope capture systems. Combines lead sheets and control modules to produce enhanced mining equipment.

facilities.name: Rad Shielding Workshop
facilities.description: A specialized production unit for assembling radiation-safe mining modules with lead shielding and basic control systems. Produces functional rad harvesters suitable for initial radioactive ore extraction operations.

facilities.name: Radiant Bile Enricher
facilities.description: A shielded enrichment cell that refines cinder-urchin bile into power cells. Built for hazard handling.

facilities.name: Radiant Ribs Glaze Galley
facilities.description: Shielded smoker-glazers for the Rim's faintly glowing rib dare.

facilities.name: Radiant Tonic Bar
facilities.description: A shielded dosing bar for a glowing tonic that three empires regulate.

facilities.name: Radiation Equipment Plant
facilities.description: Industrial production line with reinforced framing and enhanced coolant circulation to handle sustained manufacturing of lead-shielded mining modules. Increased throughput supports larger mining operations.

facilities.name: Radio Assembly Station
facilities.description: A compact production line for circuit-board integration and copper-wiring assembly. Sensor arrays are tuned to standard pirate frequencies and sealed into functional receiver units.

facilities.name: Radium Extraction Cell
facilities.description: A shielded production line that extracts and concentrates radium ore into phosphorescent compounds. Lead-lined chambers and radiation-hardened controls manage the hazardous material safely.

facilities.name: Radium Phosphor Coating Line
facilities.description: A specialized production line that applies radium phosphor hardening to circuit boards with precision masking and controlled exposure chambers. Produces radiation-hardened circuits at a measured pace.

facilities.name: Radium Processing Works
facilities.description: A dedicated mass-production facility with layered lead shielding, hazmat containment vessels, and precision automated feeds. Optimized decay-chain processing and active cooling enable near-continuous output of radioluminescent compounds.

facilities.name: Railgun Capacitor Assembly Line
facilities.description: A dedicated production line that assembles superconductor banks, power cells, and circuit boards into stable high-energy capacitor units for railgun systems. Copper piping carries charge through precision-wound coils under steady automation.

facilities.name: Railgun Fabrication Line
facilities.description: A specialized assembly operation that integrates superconductors, capacitors, and weapon housings into functional railgun frames. Copper piping channels power distribution while barrel assemblies are precision-fitted to tolerance.

facilities.name: Railgun I Forge
facilities.description: Heavy-duty manufacturing complex with quantum control cores managing electromagnetic alignment and targeting computers calibrating ballistic systems. Reinforced frames handle the intensive assembly and testing protocols for production-scale output.

facilities.name: Railgun I Foundry
facilities.description: Cutting-edge facility with coolant loops managing thermal stress from electromagnetic testing, quantum control cores ensuring precise superconductor integration, and automated targeting computer installation. Produces combat-ready railguns at peak throughput.

facilities.name: Railgun I Workshop
facilities.description: Larger production facility with structural frames supporting multi-station assembly and increased material throughput. Control nodes coordinate firing mechanism calibration across each weapon unit.

facilities.name: Railgun II Forge
facilities.description: Industrial-scale production optimized for precision tungsten rod integration and dual-capacitor synchronization. Quantum control cores and targeting computers manage the intricate electromagnetic and ballistic tuning required for armor-piercing performance.

facilities.name: Railgun II Foundry
facilities.description: State-of-the-art manufacturing with coolant loops managing the thermal load from advanced superconductor arrays, quantum control cores orchestrating dual-capacitor firing sequences, and automated targeting computers for ballistic optimization. Produces advanced railguns with maximum armor penetration capability.

facilities.name: Railgun II Workshop
facilities.description: An expanded facility handling the complexity of dual-capacitor integration and tungsten ammunition preparation. Structural frames support the heavier machinery required for multi-stage ballistic calibration.

facilities.name: Rainbow Leviathan Carpaccio Galley
facilities.description: A cold, spotless cure station for the rarest raw plate in the galaxy.

facilities.name: Rampage Synthesis Complex
facilities.description: Heavy-duty industrial reactor with substantial coolant infrastructure and reinforced containment. Automated control nodes manage the delicate balance required to preserve neural extract activity while binding synthetic and exotic elements into stable compound form.

facilities.name: Ranch Complex
facilities.description: An industrial operation: pressurized handling barns, an automated cull line, and a foreman who has names for animals the tagging system only knows as numbers. Freighters dock on a schedule here — feed in, product out.
facilities.satisfied_description: Barns full, cull line running on the quota, and the feed manifest balanced to the kilogram. The foreman calls it a good season.
facilities.degraded_description: The cull line is stopped and the barns echo. Whatever the manifest says, the animals know the trough is empty — and they're leaving.

facilities.name: Rancher's Breakfast Galley
facilities.description: A wide griddle and an egg rail built for the corral crew's pre-shift plate.

facilities.name: Range Station
facilities.description: A proper bunkhouse, tagged feed lines, and a low-boom perimeter that sings the herd home at feeding time. The hands work in shifts now, and the brand on every carapace is visible from a hundred klicks.
facilities.satisfied_description: Feed lines humming, tags all green, and the herd fat enough that the cull quota fills itself. Ranch life, such as it is.
facilities.degraded_description: Half the feed lines are dry and the perimeter boom is silent. The tags are going dark one by one as the herd walks off the range.

facilities.name: Reactive Armor Manufacturing
facilities.description: A larger facility with structural frames supporting multi-layer plating stations and expanded sensor array integration. Enhanced processing cores allow faster damage-response calculation across each unit.

facilities.name: Reactive-Bed Bench
facilities.description: Carbon scrubbers are built up by hand, sensor arrays bedded over the oxidizer intake and control electronics wired to fire the hot reactive bed that catches carbon ore before it reaches the hold.

facilities.name: Reactor Assembly Plant
facilities.description: Large-scale production with reinforced containment frames, hazmat-container integration, and automated fuel-criticality validation. Lead shielding is applied in multiple layers while quantum control cores monitor neutron-flux characteristics during final assembly and testing.

facilities.name: Reactor Complex
facilities.description: Expanded fusion reactor with secondary containment and load balancing.
facilities.satisfied_description: Primary and secondary containment fields hold steady. Load balancers distribute power evenly across all station sectors.
facilities.degraded_description: Today, though, secondary containment fluctuates. Load balancers struggle, and some sectors experience rolling power reductions.

facilities.name: Reactor Core Production Line
facilities.description: Purpose-built assembly system for large-scale power cores, integrating neutronium ingots and structural bulkheads with precision docking-ring alignment. Handles the heavy structural and thermal demands of station-scale reactors.

facilities.name: Reactor Engineering Works
facilities.description: A larger facility with dedicated enrichment pre-processing and superconductor integration stages, cutting production time substantially while maintaining structural and thermal integrity.

facilities.name: Reactor Fuel Assembly Containment Vat
facilities.description: Heavy-duty cask assembly facility specialized for reactor fuel assemblies. Combines titanium alloy reinforcement, multi-layer lead shielding, and precision sealing to create transport-ready casings.

facilities.name: Reactor Fuel Assembly Extraction Unit
facilities.description: A specialized shielded extraction system designed for reactor fuel assemblies destined for plutonium breeding. Lead-lined chambers, radiation-hardened controls, and precise mechanical separation handle the complex sealed geometry safely.

facilities.name: Reactor Fuel Plant
facilities.description: A heavily fortified plant with quadruple lead shielding layers, dedicated hazmat containers, and autonomous assembly arms that minimize human exposure while producing fuel assemblies at industrial throughput.

facilities.name: Reactor Grade Plutonium Containment Vat
facilities.description: Specialized containment apparatus for reactor-grade plutonium with multi-layer lead casing and titanium reinforcement. Precision sealing and radiation-hardened controls ensure safe enclosure of the most hazardous material.

facilities.name: Reactor Grade Plutonium Extraction Unit
facilities.description: A shielded extraction system that separates reactor-grade plutonium from its containment matrix. Steel and copper construction handles the radioactive material with precision control.

facilities.name: Reactor Module Assembly Cell
facilities.description: A shielded assembly line for compact nuclear reactors that integrates fuel assemblies, lead shielding, and radiation-hardened electronics into a functioning fission core. Heavy lead shielding and control nodes manage fuel loading and initial criticality verification.

facilities.name: Reactor Upgrade Assembly Line
facilities.description: A dedicated production facility that fuses power cells, superconductors, and circuit boards into reactor enhancement modules through controlled thermal and electrical integration.

facilities.name: Rec Lounge
facilities.description: A rec room with worn sofas, a bank of arcade cabinets, and a drink dispenser that's usually working. Not glamorous, but it's somewhere to unwind between shifts.
facilities.satisfied_description: The arcade cabinets are all lit up and the dispenser's fully stocked. There's usually a small crowd here between shifts.
facilities.degraded_description: Half the cabinets are dark and the dispenser's out more often than not. Still gets used — there's nowhere else to go.

facilities.name: Receiver Fabrication Works
facilities.description: Industrial production facility with quantum control cores managing sensor-array calibration and processing-core tuning. Precision optics are integrated in-line to achieve optimal broadband reception across multiple parallel production streams.

facilities.name: Reclamation Dock
facilities.description: Cutting rigs and a sorting yard for whatever the faction — or anyone else — drags in from the debris field.
facilities.satisfied_description: Cutting torches flare as crews strip wrecks down to usable components. Bins fill steadily.
facilities.degraded_description: The torches are running on fumes. Wrecks pile up faster than the crew can process them.

facilities.name: Recon Probe Assembly Line
facilities.description: A compact production line for reconnaissance probes, combining circuit boards with thruster arrays and titanium frames. Produces standard scanning probes for system reconnaissance.

facilities.name: Reconnaissance Drone Workshop
facilities.description: A dedicated production line that stages and integrates drone chassis, sensor arrays, thrusters, and control boards into complete reconnaissance units. Steel frames and copper piping form the backbone of the assembly process.

facilities.name: Reconnaissance Sensor Manufacturing
facilities.description: Industrial-scale complex featuring automated fiber bundle integration, multi-circuit routing systems, and precision optical alignment for sustained high-volume sensor production.

facilities.name: Reconstruction Matrix
facilities.description: Nanite swarms reconstruct hull damage at the molecular level. Your ship comes back subtly different but objectively better.
facilities.satisfied_description: Nanites flow like liquid thought, disassembling and rebuilding with alien precision. Repaired sections emerge stronger, lighter, subtly uncanny.
facilities.degraded_description: Today, though, nanite swarms lose cohesion, rebuilding damage in crude approximations. Repaired sections feel brittle, misaligned, structurally questionable.
facilities.lore: The nanites disassemble damaged material atom by atom and rebuild it according to the Voidborn's notion of 'optimal structure.' Captains sometimes report that repaired sections are slightly harder, slightly lighter, or slightly the wrong color. The Voidborn consider complaints a failure of imagination.

facilities.name: Recruitment Center
facilities.description: Purpose-built recruitment facility with interview rooms and background check terminals. Professional operation. Your member cap is set by your single highest-tier recruitment office, and every OTHER station that also has one adds 25% of its own cap — so spreading recruitment offices across stations raises the ceiling instead of being wasted.

facilities.name: Recruitment Desk
facilities.description: A staffed desk in the station lobby with application forms and a waiting area. People actually stop by now. Your member cap is set by your single highest-tier recruitment office, and every OTHER station that also has one adds 25% of its own cap — so spreading recruitment offices across stations raises the ceiling instead of being wasted.

facilities.name: Recycling Processor Mk I
facilities.description: A compact deconstruction unit that breaks down manufactured goods into raw components. Operator selects a recipe; the processor consumes the recipe's finished outputs and returns a fraction of the original ingredients — the rest lost to impurities, heat, and entropy.

facilities.name: Recycling Processor Mk II
facilities.description: An industrial-grade deconstruction plant capable of processing five batches per cycle. Same recovery rates as the Mk I, but suited for stations moving large volumes of surplus goods.

facilities.name: Recycling Processor Mk III
facilities.description: A heavy industrial deconstruction complex that processes ten batches per cycle. Designed for high-throughput material recovery operations where large surpluses need to be converted back into usable feedstock.

facilities.name: Red Mist Production Complex
facilities.description: A fully automated combat-injector plant with redundant filling lines, quantum-metered dosing, and precision optics certifying every sealed unit. Loads red mist by the crate, tested on the line so the boarding crews don't have to be the first to find out.

facilities.name: Reflex Synthesis Plant
facilities.description: Larger compounding facility with improved thermal regulation and coolant systems. Enhanced reaction control and faster mixing cycles increase production speed and compound stability.

facilities.name: Refraction Lab
facilities.description: An expanded facility with dedicated stations for optical fiber routing, circuit integration, and crystal alignment. Reinforced shield emitters and matrices work in concert with structural frames to produce more efficient cloaking devices.

facilities.name: Refractory Sinter Press
facilities.description: A high-pressure bonding press that fuses a vulcanid's refractory sinter to a silicon charge into hardened silicate composite. The iridium and thorium came pre-alloyed out of the animal, so the nickel-and-ore combine is skipped.

facilities.name: Refueling Dock
facilities.description: Fuel lines and storage tanks run by the faction's own dockhands. Faction members draw from the shared tank for free; everyone else pays station price.
facilities.satisfied_description: Fuel lines pressurized and ready. Ships dock, fill up, and depart with barely a wait.
facilities.degraded_description: Reserves are running dry. Pumps sputter and the dockhands are rationing what's left to their own fleet first.

facilities.name: Refueling Station
facilities.description: Multi-bay fuel dispensing facility with automated flow management.
facilities.satisfied_description: Multiple bays operate simultaneously, automated flow controllers balancing supply across docking ports.
facilities.degraded_description: Or so it was. Only one bay remains operational, ships queueing at the single functioning pump while the others display maintenance alerts.

facilities.name: Regenerative Armor I Assembly Plant
facilities.description: Industrial-scale production with quantum control cores managing nanite metabolic cycles and coolant loops maintaining optimal regeneration chemistry. Reinforced frames support the precision equipment needed for mass-producing durable self-healing armor.

facilities.name: Regenerative Armor I Fabrication Nexus
facilities.description: Cutting-edge facility featuring coolant loops for thermal stability during nanite culture integration, quantum control cores orchestrating repair-cycle optimization, and automated graphene-layer installation. Produces advanced self-healing armor at peak regeneration efficiency.

facilities.name: Regenerative Armor I Production Lab
facilities.description: A larger facility with structural frames supporting multi-layer fusion stations and expanded nanite container integration. Enhanced control systems ensure even nanite distribution and reliable healing triggers.

facilities.name: Regenerative Armor I Workshop
facilities.description: A specialized production line that fuses hull plating, repair nanite containers, durasteel, and graphene sheets into self-healing armor panels. Control nodes regulate nanite activation cycles for consistent regeneration performance.

facilities.name: Regenerative Armor Works
facilities.description: Heavy industrial-scale production with dedicated cryogenic cooling loops maintaining nanite viability throughout assembly. Automated shield emitter arrays and quantum control systems work in concert to produce fully integrated self-healing armor.

facilities.name: Regenerative Compound Bioreactor
facilities.description: A sealed bioreactor for bio-synthetic nanite repair media.

facilities.name: Regenerative Medical Complex
facilities.description: A capital-scale hospital complex combining automated surgery, regeneration therapy, and fleet casualty logistics.
facilities.satisfied_description: Regeneration suites and autonomous theatres return casualties to duty by the hundreds.
facilities.degraded_description: Whole treatment blocks are offline, leaving advanced beds idle while conventional wards overflow.

facilities.name: Regenerative Medicine Complex
facilities.description: Large-scale production complex with integrated cooling systems and automated reagent metering. Heavy coolant infrastructure manages the exothermic synthesis reactions while maintaining the precision required for bio-nanite suspension stability.

facilities.name: Reinforced Bulkhead Fabrication Complex
facilities.description: Cutting-edge production complex with modular lamination arrays, integrated docking and material-handling infrastructure, and full automation of the multi-component assembly process. Redundant framing and control systems ensure continuous output of warship-grade structural components.

facilities.name: Reinforced Bulkhead Plant
facilities.description: Expanded production facility with structural frames and hull plating inventory systems that enable faster lamination cycles and improved dimensional consistency. Control nodes coordinate the multi-stage bonding process to ensure uniform stress distribution in finished frames.

facilities.name: Reinforced Frame Fabrication Line
facilities.description: A heavy-duty assembly line that bonds structural frames with durasteel plating, titanium alloy bracing, and graphene sheets into reinforced skeletons. Designed to produce the load-bearing frames required for capital-scale industrial equipment.

facilities.name: Reinforced Frame Synthesis Center
facilities.description: State-of-the-art facility with redundant coolant systems and precision bonding equipment producing reinforced frames of maximum structural integrity. Serves as the backbone for the largest shipyards and heavy industrial operations.

facilities.name: Reinforced Glass Works
facilities.description: Continuous-feed furnace with integrated coolant loops and multi-stage plasma reinforcement. Produces transparent composite armor at industrial speeds with minimal defect rates.

facilities.name: Reinforced Hull Works
facilities.description: An integrated facility combining plating shears, bonding presses, and shield-emitter calibration stations to produce reinforced bracing at higher throughput. Copper piping runs coolant through the bonding zones.

facilities.name: Reinforced Lead Shielding Plant
facilities.description: Larger facility with multiple bonding stations, coolant-assisted curing, and improved structural integration. Handles higher-volume orders with better durability.

facilities.name: Reinforced Plating
facilities.description: Layered ablative plate welded over the station's structural frame. It does not stop a determined capital gun, but it turns the constant chatter of light raider weapons into paint damage, which over a long siege is the difference between a bad afternoon and a wreck.
facilities.satisfied_description: The plating is sound, and the weld crews are keeping ahead of the pitting.
facilities.degraded_description: The plating is pitted through in a dozen places and nobody has the plate to patch it. It is absorbing considerably less than it is supposed to.

facilities.name: Reinforced Pressure Tank
facilities.description: Enhanced facility with heat sinks and plasma injection for precision welding and rapid hydrogen integration. Structural frames provide improved tank integrity.

facilities.name: Relic Amber Smelter
facilities.description: A low, slow smelter that renders a relict's relic amber over a steel charge into solarian legacy alloy — a lifetime of concentrated legacy-ore out of a single amber.

facilities.name: Remote Advanced Capital Repair System Factory
facilities.description: Cutting-edge automated production with cryogenic cooling loops and quantum-synchronized assembly stations. Crystalline lattice integration occurs in isolated precision chambers; final units undergo automated validation before release.

facilities.name: Remote Armor Repairer I Assembly Plant
facilities.description: Industrial-scale production integrating quantum-controlled nanite injection, multi-stage shield-emitter assembly, and active coolant management to handle the thermal demands of rapid armor-restoration cycles.

facilities.name: Remote Armor Repairer I Fabrication Nexus
facilities.description: A fully automated complex with extensive coolant loops regulating both nanite-paste chemistry and shield-emitter calibration, quantum cores orchestrating parallel repair-pathways to achieve forty-three-second assembly cycles.

facilities.name: Remote Armor Repairer I Production Lab
facilities.description: A larger facility with dedicated stations for shield-emitter alignment and nanite-paste chamber preparation, supported by structural frames that enable higher throughput and more reliable shield-matrix integration.

facilities.name: Remote Armor Repairer I Workshop
facilities.description: A purpose-built production line combining nanite-container integration with hull-plating and shield-matrix bonding. Control nodes manage the delicate calibration of repair nanite distribution pathways.

facilities.name: Remote Armor Repairer II Assembly Plant
facilities.description: Industrial-scale production integrating quantum-controlled nanite injection, multi-stage shield-emitter assembly, and active coolant management to handle the thermal demands of rapid armor-restoration cycles.

facilities.name: Remote Armor Repairer II Fabrication Nexus
facilities.description: A fully automated complex with extensive coolant loops regulating both nanite-paste chemistry and shield-emitter calibration, quantum cores orchestrating parallel repair-pathways to achieve forty-three-second assembly cycles.

facilities.name: Remote Armor Repairer II Production Lab
facilities.description: A larger facility with dedicated stations for shield-emitter alignment and nanite-paste chamber preparation, supported by structural frames that enable higher throughput and more reliable shield-matrix integration.

facilities.name: Remote Armor Repairer II Workshop
facilities.description: A purpose-built production line combining nanite-container integration with hull-plating and shield-matrix bonding. Control nodes manage the delicate calibration of repair nanite distribution pathways.

facilities.name: Remote Capital-Grade Repair Integrator
facilities.description: A precision assembly facility designed to combine armor repairer II units with advanced nanite containers, crystalline lattices, and power cells. Component staging ensures exact sequencing for industrial-scale armor restoration systems.

facilities.name: Remote Capital Ship Repair Manufacturing Line
