facilities.description: Industrial-scale facility with heavy reinforced framing and extensive coolant circulation to manage the thermal load of quantum control cores and high-density shield emitter arrays. Continuous flow production ensures steady output of capital-grade repair modules.

facilities.name: Remote Heavy Repair System Fabrication Plant
facilities.description: An expanded operation with dedicated stations for subassembly integration and high-throughput nanite container production. Structural frames provide rigid mounting for the more complex power and control requirements.

facilities.name: Repair Arm Assembly
facilities.description: A focused production line for remote manipulator systems, combining precision optics with control circuitry. Builds functional repair arms capable of autonomous hull patching operations.

facilities.name: Repair Arm Assembly Line
facilities.description: Production line that fabricates and assembles steel plates with flex polymer components to create welding and repair manipulator arms for autonomous maintenance drones.

facilities.name: Repair Bay
facilities.description: Ship repair facility with basic hull patching equipment.
facilities.satisfied_description: Welding arcs flash behind safety shields. A crew patches hull breaches with practiced speed.
facilities.degraded_description: When it's working. Repair kits are running low, and technicians jury-rig patches from whatever scrap they can find.

facilities.name: Repair Drone Assembly Line
facilities.description: A dedicated production line integrating drone chassis, AI cores, and nanite containment systems. Produces autonomous repair drones ready for field deployment.

facilities.name: Repair Kit Assembly Line
facilities.description: A modular assembly station that combines titanium alloy components, flex polymer sheets, and circuit boards into professional repair kits with basic quality control.

facilities.name: Repair Kit Factory
facilities.description: A compact production line that stamps and bonds steel plates with flex polymer into standardized emergency repair kits. Steady output feeds station maintenance crews with reliable hull-patching supplies.

facilities.name: Repair Slip
facilities.description: A hull-patching bay the faction built and staffs itself, stocked from its own supply lines.
facilities.satisfied_description: Welding arcs flash behind safety shields. The crew works through the queue at a steady clip, repair kits stacked and ready.
facilities.degraded_description: The repair kit locker is bare. Technicians are jury-rigging patches from scrap and turning away anything past a graze.

facilities.name: Repair Synthesis Workshop
facilities.description: A specialized production line equipped with precision chemical reactors and bio-culture chambers for serum synthesis. Combines neural extracts with biofiber meshes under controlled conditions to generate regenerative compounds.

facilities.name: Repair Systems Manufacturing
facilities.description: Expanded facility with automated material handling, precision joint assembly, and tool integration stations that accelerate repair arm production.

facilities.name: Reserve Barracks
facilities.description: A proper barracks complex with personnel administration, training rooms, and enough berths for several ship crews. Holds up to 512 crew and 128 marines.

facilities.name: Residential Production Complex
facilities.description: Industrial-scale production with dedicated life support integration lines, precision optic systems for quality control, and parallel biofiber mesh assembly. Robotic handling and continuous environmental validation ensure reliable crew quarters output at volume.

facilities.name: Resonance Cannon Foundry
facilities.description: State-of-the-art production system with integrated coolant-loop infrastructure and real-time targeting-computer tuning. Produces one cannon every 17 seconds.

facilities.name: Resonance Chamber
facilities.description: A more capable facility equipped with quantum-grade control nodes and expanded sensor networks to handle the complex timing of multi-component fusion. Processing cores coordinate the integration of four distinct energy sources.

facilities.name: Resonance Containment Lab
facilities.description: An expanded production plant with dedicated plasma chambers and reinforced structural frames to handle higher throughput. Increased heat sink capacity allows faster cycle times while maintaining crystalline integrity.

facilities.name: Restoration Engineering Center
facilities.description: Fully automated state-of-the-art complex featuring AI core neural initialization, real-time processing core synchronization, and integrated flight-readiness testing. Produces elite repair drones with optimized autonomous behavior.

facilities.name: Restoration Works
facilities.description: Industrial repair facility with automated hull assessment and multi-bay operations.
facilities.satisfied_description: Automated scanners map hull damage in seconds. Multiple bays work in parallel, restoring ships to factory condition.
facilities.degraded_description: At least, when supplies hold out. Automated scanners are offline, technicians assess damage by eye, and wait times stretch across multiple cycles.

facilities.name: Rhodium Deposition Chamber
facilities.description: An argon-purged vacuum chamber that deposits optical-grade rhodium without oxidation or surface defects.

facilities.name: Rhodium Optics Workshop
facilities.description: A clean precision line for coating and aligning heat-resistant crystal optics.

facilities.name: Rift Assembly Station
facilities.description: A specialized production line for assembling phase-shifted torpedo systems. Tracking systems and phase drives are integrated into barrel housings under controlled conditions, with void crystals inserted during the final calibration stage to ensure dimensional stability.

facilities.name: Rift Beam Assembly
facilities.description: A specialized production line for assembling phase-shifted laser systems. Multiple assembly stations feed completed barrel and housing modules into quantum alignment chambers, where exotic crystals are precisely oriented and fused into the final weapon matrix.

facilities.name: Rift Forge Station
facilities.description: An expanded facility with dedicated sub-lines for barrel machining, housing fabrication, and quantum matrix assembly. Integrated testing rigs validate phase coherence before final dimensional coupling of the void crystals.

facilities.name: Rim Marshal's Office
facilities.description: The Patchwork's idea of a law enforcement headquarters. The Marshal answers to nobody except the Patchwork Council, and the Council has better things to worry about. This is considered an ideal arrangement.
facilities.satisfied_description: The Marshal's tactical display covers the whole system — or the parts worth covering, which the Marshal decides personally. Last Warning interceptors launch on the Marshal's word alone. The brig is small because sentences in the Rim are short. So are the trials.
facilities.degraded_description: Ammunition supplies are stretched. The tactical display has dead zones the Marshal pretends don't exist. Interceptor readiness is down to two ships, and the Marshal has started flying patrol personally — which is either reassuring or alarming, depending on who you ask.

facilities.name: Rim Ranger Cache
facilities.description: Improvised supply depot for Outer Rim patrol operations. Nothing matches, everything works, and the emergency inventory is surprisingly comprehensive.
facilities.satisfied_description: Ammo crates are stacked in every available corner. Patrol Last Warnings cycle through resupply with Rim efficiency — fast, informal, and somehow always correct. The supply chief doesn't use inventory software; she knows exactly where everything is.
facilities.degraded_description: Frontier rotgut reserves are conspicuously low, which is how you know things are serious. Hull patch stock is thin enough that the supply chief has started cutting plate to fit. She has activated what she calls 'the backup backup plan.'

facilities.name: Rim Ranger Shack
facilities.description: A converted storage closet with a badge on the door. The Rim's idea of a police presence.
facilities.satisfied_description: The ranger's chair faces the door. The gun rack is within arm's reach. The wanted board has three names on it — one crossed out, one circled, one with a question mark. This is the entire operation.
facilities.degraded_description: The ranger is out on patrol and nobody's covering the desk. The wanted board has a fourth name, but nobody can read the handwriting. The ammo crate is low.

facilities.name: Rim Ranger Station
facilities.description: An actual building with multiple rooms. By Rim standards, this is a major law enforcement investment.
facilities.satisfied_description: The dispatch board tracks three patrol zones. The armory has a lock on it now, which is progress. A holding cell occupies what used to be the supply room — detainees and spare fuel cells share the space amicably.
facilities.degraded_description: Two of three patrol zones are uncovered. The armory lock broke and nobody's replaced it. The holding cell's ventilation is questionable, and the duty ranger has started leaving the outer door open for airflow.

facilities.name: Rim Rapid Response Base
facilities.description: Outer Rim fast-strike fleet operations base. Built for speed over polish, capable of sustaining a patrol wing through extended operations. The building codes are whatever works.
facilities.satisfied_description: Fuel tanks are full, ammo is counted and ready, and every Last Warning in the wing has a full load-out. The base commander runs tight rotations and shows the supply manifest to anyone who asks. Nothing fancy, nothing wasted.
facilities.degraded_description: Antimatter containment cell reserves are down — the salvage reactor fuel profile is demanding. Patrol wings are running lean loads, and the rotgut and spore spirits that keep morale functional have both dropped below comfortable levels. The base commander is doing math.

facilities.name: Rime Fang Press
facilities.description: A cold press that sets frost-lurker fangs into cold-hardened armor plate.

facilities.name: Rimeblue Cellar
facilities.description: A cold cellar of needled wheels where rime milk and gloomcap mold age into veined Rimeblue. Slow work at low temperature.

facilities.name: Rivetshell Steamer
facilities.description: A bank of lidded broth kettles that steam rivetshell open by the crate and finish them with spice.

facilities.name: Rocket Assembly Yard
facilities.description: A purpose-built production station where titanium alloys, circuit boards, and weapon housings converge with barrel assemblies into firing-ready missile launchers. Barrel assembly integration requires precision mechanical alignment.

facilities.name: Sable's Still
facilities.description: Director Sable saw the numbers on recreational beverage consumption across the strongholds and did what she does best: built a supply chain. The still runs around the clock.

facilities.name: Salvage Assembly Depot
facilities.description: A compact production line that integrates sensor arrays and processing cores into salvage equipment. Control nodes and optical components are assembled into functional debris-extraction systems.

facilities.name: Salvage Assembly Line
facilities.description: A functional production line for constructing cannons from salvaged and raw materials. Combines steel plates, durasteel, and heat sinks into operational firing systems.

facilities.name: Salvage Bay
facilities.description: Basic wreck intake facility with manual cutting tools and a sorting area.
facilities.satisfied_description: Cutting torches flare as crews strip wrecks down to usable components. The sorting bins fill steadily.
facilities.degraded_description: Barely operational. Dull cutting tools and missing safety gear slow every job. Wrecks pile up faster than they can be processed.

facilities.name: Salvage Complex
facilities.description: Full-scale wreck processing complex with molecular separation and advanced material reclamation.
facilities.satisfied_description: Molecular separators break wrecks down to raw elements while reclamation arrays rebuild useful components. Nothing is wasted.
facilities.degraded_description: Separators drift out of calibration, contaminating output streams. Reclamation yields drop as precision equipment runs without proper maintenance.

facilities.name: Salvage Dock
facilities.description: Enclosed processing dock with powered cutting rigs and component extraction bays.
facilities.satisfied_description: Powered rigs make quick work of hulls, extraction bays humming as components are pulled and cataloged.
facilities.degraded_description: The rigs sputter on low power. Extraction bays jam frequently, and half-processed wrecks block the intake.

facilities.name: Salvage Drone Assembly
facilities.description: A specialized production line for wreck-processing drones, combining drone chassis with nanite-based material extraction systems. Builds compact autonomous salvage units.

facilities.name: Salvage Enhancer Calibration Line
facilities.description: A recovery systems line for disposable salvage analyzers.

facilities.name: Salvage Module Assembly
facilities.description: A focused production line for wreck-extraction systems, integrating processing cores with nanite containment and sensor arrays. Builds functional salvage modules for component recovery.

facilities.name: Salvage Phase Tinkerer
facilities.description: A sophisticated facility assembling phase arrays, exotic crystals, and quantum matrices into advanced cloaking systems. Precision control nodes and shield matrices manage the complex electromagnetic interactions required for high-level stealth.

facilities.name: Salvage Processing Station
facilities.description: Expanded production capacity with multiple sensor integration stations and improved processing core automation. Reinforced structural frames increase durability while throughput climbs steadily.

facilities.name: Salvage Reactor
facilities.description: Three destroyer reactor cores welded together in the engineering section. Fed by antimatter from Sol and sheer stubbornness.
facilities.satisfied_description: All three reactor cores hum in their improvised cradle, antimatter injectors feeding steady power. The Patchwork has light, heat, and enough energy to move if needed.
facilities.degraded_description: When it has fuel. Reactor core two is sputtering, containment shielding running hot. The engineering crew patches what they can, but without fresh fuel cells, the station's going cold.
facilities.lore: Deep in the engineering decks where two destroyer hulls meet, three reactor cores sit in a cradle of improvised shielding. The antimatter injectors — salvaged from the third ship's weapons magazine — give it enough punch to move the entire Patchwork through hyperspace, slowly. Sol's containment cells keep the injectors fed. Without them, the station's just a very large, very cold tomb.

facilities.name: Salvage Smelter
facilities.description: A foundational smelting operation that reduces iron ore into refined steel plate through controlled combustion and casting. Simple, reliable, and purpose-built for steady metal production.

facilities.name: Salvage Works
facilities.description: Industrial salvage operation with automated disassembly lines and material recovery systems.
facilities.satisfied_description: Automated arms tear through hull plates while recovery systems extract every gram of usable material. Efficient and relentless.
facilities.degraded_description: Half the arms are locked in error states. Material recovery runs at a fraction of capacity, wasting good salvage.

facilities.name: Salvaged Life Support Module
facilities.description: A recycler unit pulled from a derelict and patched into the station's life support. Scales up everything — capacity, water draw, ice draw, the whole supply chain that feeds the primary.
facilities.satisfied_description: The unit is processing. It takes its cut of the supply lines and the air in the expanded sections is, by local standards, fine.
facilities.degraded_description: The unit is dry. The primary life support is back to its previous load, and the bunks the expansion was meant to support are getting stuffy.

facilities.name: Scanner Assembly Line
facilities.description: A compact production line that integrates sensor arrays, circuit boards, and optical components into functional scanner units. Steady throughput suitable for routine scanning equipment production.

facilities.name: Scanner Optics Lab
facilities.description: An expanded facility with parallel assembly stations and automated component staging, handling the increased volume of sensor and processing core inputs. Precision alignment systems ensure consistent optical performance.

facilities.name: Scarab Plate Forge
facilities.description: A rolling forge that co-presses cauldronback alloy scales with ferrous nodules into durasteel plate. The vanadium in the scale hardens the iron matrix the nodule provides — the cauldronback did the alloying work; the forge does the forming.

facilities.name: Scavenged Battery Rig
facilities.description: A wall of mismatched ship batteries — fleet surplus, prize cargo, things found floating — chained in parallel and jury-rigged to the power bus. It works. Mostly.
facilities.satisfied_description: The rig holds. Cell tags spell out the names of three navies and a freight cooperative, and they're all charging in unison. The bus rides through the worst of the production beats.
facilities.degraded_description: Half the cells are flat and one has started smoking again. The rig is back to ballast, the bus is on raw reactor output, and engineering is taking bets on which battery goes next.

facilities.name: Scout Drone Assembly Plant
facilities.description: Purpose-built factory with enhanced conveyor systems and modular assembly stations that significantly accelerate chassis integration and sensor mounting. Reinforced structural frames support higher throughput and more complex subassembly workflows.

facilities.name: Scout Drone Manufacturing Hub
facilities.description: Industrial-scale production facility with parallel assembly lines and automated testing stations. Processing cores enable real-time quality validation, while increased drone chassis inventory supports rapid, continuous output.

facilities.name: Scrap Ammo Works
facilities.description: A press, a cutting torch, and a queue of men feeding it the hull of the last ship that tried something. Nobody buys shells for a stronghold. The stronghold makes them, badly, forever, out of the people who came to take it.
facilities.satisfied_description: The press is running and the shot is piling up faster than the gun crews can carry it away.
facilities.degraded_description: The press is cold. Nobody has dragged anything worth cutting up in a while, which is its own kind of compliment.

facilities.name: Scrap Armor Assembly Works
facilities.description: An efficient facility with multiple stamping and welding stations operating in sequence. Shield matrix integration and plating assembly happen in parallel tracks, boosting output.

facilities.name: Scrap Armor Fabrication Line
facilities.description: A specialized production line that stamps and welds salvaged materials into functional armor plating. Shield emitters and wiring harnesses are integrated into durable hull components.

facilities.name: Scrap Armor Forge
facilities.description: A heavy press and heat forge that pounds layered salvage metal into rough armor plate. The output is thick, uneven, and nearly impossible to kill.

facilities.name: Scrap Armor Manufacturing Complex
facilities.description: Fully automated armor production with advanced coolant thermal management and reinforced frame handling. Parallel shield emitter and matrix installation lines feed into rapid armor plating completion, achieving maximum throughput.

facilities.name: Scrap Armor Production Plant
facilities.description: Industrial-scale armor fabrication with coolant loops managing heat from high-speed welding and pressing operations. Quantum control nodes and shield emitters are installed across multiple assembly stations simultaneously.

facilities.name: Scrap Cartridge Shop
facilities.description: A bench, a press, and a bucket of powder nobody will vouch for. It turns salvage into autocannon rounds at a rate that would horrify a safety inspector, if one had ever been permitted aboard.
facilities.satisfied_description: The bench is loud and the crates are stacking up.
facilities.degraded_description: Nothing to cut up. The press sits idle and the crew get ideas.

facilities.name: Scrap Flak Battery
facilities.description: Six salvaged autocannon welded to a rotating collar that used to be a cargo crane. It throws an appalling volume of metal in roughly the right direction. Accuracy was never the point; the point is that boarding a stronghold should feel like a bad idea from a long way out.
facilities.satisfied_description: The belts are fed and somebody has chalked a running total on the mount. It is a large number.
facilities.degraded_description: Out of shot. The crew have wandered off to the bar, which is the most honest thing about the whole installation.

facilities.name: Scrap Ordnance Shed
facilities.description: Where the seeker heads come off the tow and go onto lengths of pipe. It is kept at the far end of the station, downwind, and the people who work in it are not invited to the bar.
facilities.satisfied_description: The racks are filling with things that will mostly fly in the correct direction.
facilities.degraded_description: Empty racks and a shed full of men with nothing to weld, which historically ends badly for the station.

facilities.name: Scrap Reactor
facilities.description: A reactor core pulled from a decommissioned hull and bolted to whatever conduits were on hand. Least output of the lot, but nothing's cheaper to get running.
facilities.satisfied_description: The reactor holds steady on scavenged parts and a trickle of fuel. Nobody's proud of it, but it works.
facilities.degraded_description: Half the station's on emergency power. The scrap reactor needs fuel and hull plate it isn't getting.

facilities.name: Scrap Torpedo Slip
facilities.description: A cradle, a gantry, and the patient business of joining a warhead that was not being used to a drive that was. Slow work. Nobody hurries it, because everyone has seen what happens when somebody does.
facilities.satisfied_description: Three on the cradles and the welds cooling. Nobody is running.
facilities.degraded_description: The cradles are bare. The gantry crew are sitting on them, watching the door, waiting for somebody to tow something in.

facilities.name: Scrapgun Assembly Station
facilities.description: A straightforward production line that cuts steel plate, assembles weapon housings, installs barrel assemblies, and mounts heat sinks into firing-ready scrapguns. Basic control nodes manage the stamping and welding sequence.

facilities.name: Scrapgun Forge
facilities.description: Heavy-duty manufacturing center with precision barrel lathes, reinforced frame assembly jigs, and quantum-controlled targeting computer integration. Targeting computers and quantum cores enable tighter tolerances and more lethal output.

facilities.name: Scrapgun Foundry
facilities.description: Cutting-edge facility featuring automated barrel rifling, precision heat-sink bonding with active coolant loops, and integrated targeting-computer calibration. Quantum cores and coolant systems ensure weapons are optimized for accuracy and sustained fire.

facilities.name: Scrapgun Workshop
facilities.description: Expanded facility with dedicated barrel-boring equipment, improved weapon housing molds, and faster heat-sink installation systems. Structural frames support more robust machinery and higher cycle rates.

facilities.name: Scrapper's Drone Bay
facilities.description: A specialized production line that integrates drone chassis, weapon cores, and circuit boards into autonomous combat units. Drone AI cores and control nodes provide the computational foundation for autonomous operation.

facilities.name: Scrubber Cartridge Assembly Line
facilities.description: Packs catalytic platinum sponge into finned air-scrubber cartridges — the consumable heart of every station's life-support loop.

facilities.name: Scrubber Cartridge Complex
facilities.description: A fully automated cartridge complex with continuous sponge feed and in-line catalytic assay, supplying every life-support deck in range with cartridges by the crate.

facilities.name: Scrubber Cartridge Plant
facilities.description: An industrial cartridge plant with parallel packing lines and climate-controlled sponge handling, holding catalytic activity consistent across high-volume runs.

facilities.name: Scrubber Cartridge Workshop
facilities.description: An expanded cartridge line with automated sponge dosing and chemical-lined packing stations, turning out scrubber cartridges in steady batches for the life-support trade.

facilities.name: Sealed Dust Lab
facilities.description: An airtight compartment where nebular gas and gutter flux are coaxed into void dust. The recyclers scrub the air and the sensor arrays watch the reaction, because one misread and the room is condemned. Pirate stations only.

facilities.name: Sector Labor Exchange
facilities.description: A major spacer exchange coordinating certified crews, transport, and shipboard specialists across a whole sector.
facilities.satisfied_description: Arrival boards update by the minute as full watches cycle through orientation and assignment.
facilities.degraded_description: Transport delays and empty mess stores have reduced the exchange to a fraction of its normal intake.

facilities.name: Security Bulkhead Works
facilities.description: A hardened fabrication line for compartment barriers, controlled choke points, and anti-intrusion pressure doors.

facilities.name: Security Training Post
facilities.description: A compact drill deck that trains armed shipboard security personnel for marine duty.
facilities.satisfied_description: Small squads rotate through boarding drills, weapons checks, and vacuum-response exercises.
facilities.degraded_description: Training rotations have slowed to lectures while the range and mess wait on supplies.

facilities.name: Sensor Array Integration Line
facilities.description: A specialized assembly facility that combines dual sensor arrays, sensor packages, and circuit boards into coherent multi-spectrum clusters. Reinforced bulkheads and hull plating provide structural rigidity for the integrated sensor unit.

facilities.name: Sensor Array Production Line
facilities.description: A specialized assembly facility that integrates circuit boards, crystals, and palladium into multi-spectrum detection arrays for surveillance and targeting systems.

facilities.name: Sensor Assembly Line
facilities.description: Higher-capacity facility with expanded processing core arrays and structural reinforcement to handle increased throughput. Sensor arrays and control nodes are staged through dedicated assembly stations.

facilities.name: Sensor Cluster Assembly Plant
facilities.description: Larger production facility with improved mounting fixtures, better alignment systems, and faster cross-referencing analysis core integration. Structural frames and expanded hull plating storage enable higher throughput and more robust assemblies.

facilities.name: Sensor Cluster Manufacturing Complex
facilities.description: Industrial-scale production center with automated sensor alignment systems, precision docking ring integration, and multi-channel calibration stations. Reinforced frames and docking rings support complex, high-performance cluster configurations.

facilities.name: Sensor Dampener Assembly Facility
facilities.description: Industrial-scale production operation with parallel suppression reactors, precision polymer-layering systems, and quantum-controlled field calibration. Precision optics and quantum cores optimize dampening frequency response and output consistency.

facilities.name: Sensor Dampener Production Lab
facilities.description: Expanded facility with dedicated signal-suppression chambers, improved polymer bonding equipment, and faster circuit integration. Processing cores and sensor arrays enable dynamic field tuning and accelerated assembly.

facilities.name: Sensor Dampener Technology Nexus
facilities.description: State-of-the-art fully automated facility with multi-stage field-generation pipelines, AI-driven polymer composition tuning, and integrated precision optic calibration. Quantum cores and expanded processing capacity deliver maximum dampening effectiveness at sustained high volume.

facilities.name: Sensor Dampener Workshop
facilities.description: A production line that assembles sensor arrays, circuit boards, and flex polymer into signal-suppression units. Control nodes regulate the field-generation parameters and polymer curing cycles.

facilities.name: Sensor Dome
facilities.description: A radar dome bolted to the station hull. Lets faction members run faction_scan_poi against any POI in this station's home system to read who is there — its high scan power can pierce all but the strongest cloaks at close range. Build at most one per station. Upgrade to a Deep Space Scanner (L2) to reach POIs in adjacent systems.

facilities.name: Sensor Integration Assembly
facilities.description: A precision production line combining sensor arrays, processing cores, and exotic-crystal integration for anomaly detection. Control nodes manage calibration of the detection algorithms across circuit-board substrates.

facilities.name: Sensor Integration Line
facilities.description: A compact automated assembly line that integrates sensor arrays with circuit boards and optical crystals into functional survey scanners. Steady throughput with basic control systems and copper piping for signal integrity.

facilities.name: Sensor Integration Plant
facilities.description: Dedicated facility with circuit assembly, precision wiring stations, and integrated sensor array mounting. Processing cores enable real-time target analysis and threat classification at moderate production rates.

facilities.name: Sensor Manufacturing Complex
facilities.description: State-of-the-art facility featuring quantum-grade control systems, massive sensor array capacity, and precision optical integration. Fully automated staging and quality control systems achieve near-continuous production.

facilities.name: Sensor Obscurant Packaging Line
facilities.description: A cryogenic line that seals conductive particles into dispersal capsules.

facilities.name: Sensor Package Assembly Line
facilities.description: A focused production line that integrates circuit boards and crystals into complete sensor packages. Copper piping carries control signals through the assembly stages.

facilities.name: Sensor Probe Assembly Line
facilities.description: A dedicated production line that integrates titanium alloy frames with sensor arrays and micro-thrusters into combat-ready tactical probes. Steady three-minute cycle time supports modest operational demand.

facilities.name: Sensor Suite Assembly Station
facilities.description: Dedicated production station that integrates multiple circuit boards with optical fiber bundles to create compact detection packages for drone reconnaissance missions.

facilities.name: Sensor Systems Production Plant
facilities.description: Larger facility with parallel circuit board routing, automated optical fiber installation, and calibration systems enabling faster sensor suite assembly.

facilities.name: Sensor Workshop
facilities.description: An expanded production facility with processing cores and precision optical mounting stations for higher-throughput sensor array construction and quality integration.

facilities.name: Sentience Synthesis Complex
facilities.description: Fully automated neural extraction and processing at scale, with integrated drone chassis assembly reaching completion every 19 seconds. Multiple processing cores are synchronized and tested in parallel to ensure swarm-ready behavioral synchronization.

facilities.name: Sentinel Manufacturing Complex
facilities.description: A fully automated facility operating at industrial scale with minimal idle time between units. Quantum control cores and precision optics enable sophisticated fire-control systems to be assembled and tested in parallel, reducing per-unit output to just 18 seconds.

facilities.name: Sentinel Shield Nexus
facilities.description: Fully automated pressurization system with quantum-grade containment and real-time thermal management, producing stable overcharge units at extreme speed.

facilities.name: Separator Module Plant
facilities.description: Batch benches frame each ejector around its magnetic throat, processing cores calibrated to catch paramagnetic vanadium without snagging the ore beside it.

facilities.name: Service Center
facilities.description: Expanded multi-station assembly platform with structural framing, active cooling, and enhanced control systems to manage component tolerances and accelerate kit assembly.

facilities.name: Service Station Assembly
facilities.description: Expanded facility with dedicated drone AI core programming stations and structural frame integration. Higher capacity supports larger fleet maintenance operations.

facilities.name: Shaped Charge Workshop
facilities.description: Dedicated production line that combines steel plates with warhead assemblies into precision-formed explosive slug casings. Controlled compression ensures proper blast geometry for maximum penetration on impact.

facilities.name: Sheet Metal Press
facilities.description: Larger rolling facility with plasma heating, multiple press stages, and improved feed mechanisms. Heat sinks and plasma injectors accelerate forming cycles.

facilities.name: Shelter Frame
facilities.description: A purpose-built production line for crew quarters, featuring biofiber mesh integration, flex polymer sealing stations, and life support unit mounting. Handles assembly of these essential residential modules with integrated environmental controls.

facilities.name: Shield Array Assembly
facilities.description: A specialized production line that bonds shield emitters with circuit boards and power cells into integrated arrays. Steel and copper infrastructure supports the electromagnetic field calibration stages.

facilities.name: Shield Array Manufacturing
facilities.description: Expanded facility with structural frame reinforcement and increased shield matrix capacity. Multiple assembly tracks process emitters and control nodes in parallel to boost production speed.

facilities.name: Shield Assembly Line
facilities.description: A dedicated production line for assembling adaptive shield systems, integrating shield emitters and quantum matrices into functional defensive modules at steady output.

facilities.name: Shield Bastion
facilities.description: What you build when you have decided that the station will not be taken. A bastion projects a screen a raiding party can throw itself at all day, and it consumes cells and coolant at a rate that would keep a small fleet flying. It holds exactly as long as the warehouse does.
facilities.satisfied_description: The bastion is up. The screen is a solid wall and the supply clerks are weeping.
facilities.degraded_description: The bastion is down. Nothing dramatic happened — the cells simply ran out, and a wall that cost a fortune stopped existing between one cycle and the next.

facilities.name: Shield Boost Lab
facilities.description: Upgraded facility with shield emitter integration and structural reinforcement for handling higher charge densities, doubling production capacity.

facilities.name: Shield Booster II Assembly Plant
facilities.description: Industrial-scale production center with quantum control systems and coolant loop infrastructure for thermal management during superconductor integration. Reinforced frames support sustained high-volume assembly.

facilities.name: Shield Booster II Fabrication Nexus
facilities.description: State-of-the-art facility featuring quantum-precision control, extensive coolant networks, and massive superconductor processing capacity. Produces military-enhanced booster modules with continuous automated calibration.

facilities.name: Shield Booster II Production Lab
facilities.description: Larger facility with structural frame infrastructure and expanded shield emitter capacity. Increased processing throughput handles the more complex component integration required for II-tier boosters.

facilities.name: Shield Booster II Workshop
facilities.description: A dedicated production line integrating shield emitters, superconductors, crystals, and circuits into enhanced capacity modules. Control nodes manage the precision assembly of booster components.

facilities.name: Shield Booster III Assembly Plant
facilities.description: Heavy industrial production center with quantum control cores and comprehensive coolant circulation for managing the thermal intensity of superconductor processing. Reinforced frames enable sustained military-grade assembly.

facilities.name: Shield Booster III Fabrication Nexus
facilities.description: Advanced production complex with redundant quantum control systems and massive coolant infrastructure for continuous superconductor integration at military specifications. Fully automated production achieves maximum military booster output.

facilities.name: Shield Booster III Production Lab
facilities.description: Expanded facility with structural reinforcement and substantially increased component staging areas. Higher throughput accommodates the complex multi-stage assembly of military-specification boosters.

facilities.name: Shield Booster III Workshop
facilities.description: A specialized production line handling dual shield emitters, superconductors, and focused crystals for military-grade enhancement modules. Steel and copper infrastructure supports the precision bonding required.

facilities.name: Shield Booster MK2 Line
facilities.description: A shield-cell line with magnetic high-current reinforcement.

facilities.name: Shield Charge Plant
facilities.description: Semi-automated production facility with integrated targeting systems and weapon-housing components arranged for rapid charge synthesis. Quantum control nodes manage the energy-crystal resonance needed to achieve faster charge output.

facilities.name: Shield Disruption Factory
facilities.description: Industrial-scale plant featuring quantum control cores, precision optics alignment, and reinforced-frame construction for consistent, high-fidelity emitter output at 30-second intervals.

facilities.name: Shield Emitter Assembly Line
facilities.description: Specialized production line assembling solarian composites, legacy alloys, and shield emitter components into functional defensive systems. Control nodes orchestrate integration of focused crystal arrays and power cell mounts.

facilities.name: Shield Emitter Production Line
facilities.description: Purpose-built assembly for focused crystal alignment and superconductor integration. Produces defensive projector units at steady industrial pace.

facilities.name: Shield Fabrication Plant
facilities.description: Heavy industrial equipment with multiple assembly stations, precision quantum control cores, and advanced shield emitter arrays for continuous matrix production at scale.

facilities.name: Shield Generator Assembly Plant
facilities.description: Integrated production facility that combines emitters, processing cores, and superconductors into large-scale projector units. Handles the complex integration requirements for station and capital defense.

facilities.name: Shield Hardener Fabrication Plant
facilities.description: Cutting-edge fully automated facility with cryogenic precision assembly arms and real-time spectral analysis of every component bonding. Coolant loops maintain quantum matrices in their optimal phase state, enabling production rates that guarantee perfect void-energy compatibility.

facilities.name: Shield Hardener Line
facilities.description: A protected assembly line for disposable resistance matrices.

facilities.name: Shield Hardening Production Line
facilities.description: An expanded facility with dedicated calibration stations and resonance-tuning chambers. Multiple assembly tracks operate in parallel, each equipped with null-matter processors that verify circuit coherence before final matrix encapsulation.

facilities.name: Shield Integration Works
facilities.description: Heavy industrial plant with quantum control cores and extensive coolant loop infrastructure to manage the thermal load of linked emitter testing. Reinforced frames and high-volume matrix production enable rapid field-linked assembly.

facilities.name: Shield Matrix Production Facility
facilities.description: Heavy industrial equipment with multiple assembly stations, precision quantum control cores, and advanced shield emitter arrays for continuous matrix production at scale.

facilities.name: Shield Matrix Weaving Line
facilities.description: A purpose-built production line that assembles graphene, silicate, and gold-wiring components into energy distribution matrices for shield systems.

facilities.name: Shield Overcharge Assembly Line
facilities.description: A compact industrial charging line that pressurizes superconductors and power cells into consumable overcharge packages. Basic but reliable output.

facilities.name: Shield Projector
facilities.description: A projector array that thickens the station's own screen. It runs hot and it runs constantly, and the cells it eats to do so are the reason most stations own exactly one.
facilities.satisfied_description: The screen reads deep and even. Power draw is enormous and entirely worth it.
facilities.degraded_description: Cold. The projector is drawing nothing and contributing nothing, and the station's shield readout has quietly dropped back to whatever the hull can manage alone.

facilities.name: Shield Recharger I Assembly Plant
facilities.description: Advanced manufacturing with quantum control precision and active coolant systems to prevent thermal degradation of energy crystals during alloy bonding.

facilities.name: Shield Recharger I Fabrication Nexus
facilities.description: Fully automated line with quantum-optimized crystal positioning and redundant cooling, producing recharger units at maximum efficiency with microsecond cycle precision.

facilities.name: Shield Recharger I Production Lab
facilities.description: Expanded facility with improved energy crystal alignment and structural frame staging, increasing throughput while maintaining crystalline integrity.

facilities.name: Shield Recharger I Workshop
facilities.description: An industrial production line that bonds titanium alloys with energy crystals and circuit boards to create shield regeneration modules. Steady, reliable output.

facilities.name: Shield Recharger II Assembly Plant
facilities.description: Heavy-duty facility with quantum control cores managing emitter-crystal synchronization and integrated coolant loops preventing thermal stress during assembly.

facilities.name: Shield Recharger II Fabrication Nexus
facilities.description: State-of-the-art fully autonomous production with quantum-precision emitter alignment and redundant cryogenic systems, achieving peak output in next-generation regeneration technology.

facilities.name: Shield Recharger II Production Lab
facilities.description: Larger production complex with improved emitter staging and crystal-focus calibration, tripling throughput through parallel assembly lines and enhanced precision routing.

facilities.name: Shield Recharger II Workshop
facilities.description: Specialized production facility integrating shield emitters with focused crystals and circuit boards into high-performance regeneration systems. Complex assembly with steady output.

facilities.name: Shield Regenerator Line
facilities.description: A superconducting line for sustained shield recharge packs.

facilities.name: Shield Resonance Assembly
facilities.description: A focused production line for tuning and assembling shield matrices. Circuit boards are calibrated to resonate with void energy patterns, then bonded to shield emitters in shielded chambers that isolate the assembly from external electromagnetic interference.

facilities.name: Shield Response Array
facilities.description: Industrial-grade manufacturing plant with quantum control core integration, advanced coolant systems, and reinforced assembly stations. Produces enhanced adaptive shields with sophisticated learning algorithms at sustained throughput.

facilities.name: Shield Thermal Reinforcement Station
facilities.description: A dedicated facility that processes shield emitters with thermal ceramics and circuit boards to enhance shield thermal resistance. Control nodes regulate the integration of shield matrix compounds at measured pace.

facilities.name: Shield Weave Station
facilities.description: A purpose-built production line that assembles graphene, silicate, and electrum components into energy distribution matrices for shield systems.

facilities.name: Shielded Cell Plant
facilities.description: Larger facility featuring extensive lead shielding, radiation-hardened circuitry, and automated uranium rod positioning. Improved efficiency and safety protocols reduce production time substantially.

facilities.name: Shielded Circuit Fab
facilities.description: An expanded facility with multiple coating stations and sensor feedback loops that accelerate throughput while maintaining consistent hardening quality across each board.

facilities.name: Shielded Container Works
facilities.description: Heavy-duty manufacturing complex with quantum-grade control systems and advanced sensor networks to verify layer integrity and seal quality. Precision optics inspect each container before release to ensure hazardous-material containment standards.

facilities.name: Ship Maintenance Bay Line
facilities.description: A heavy assembly line for self-contained field repair and refit workshops.

facilities.name: Shipboard Sickbay Integration Lab
facilities.description: A sterile integration lab for compact trauma bays, isolated life support, surgical monitoring, and vibration-safe medical equipment.

facilities.name: Shipyard
facilities.description: Ship purchasing and outfitting facility.
facilities.satisfied_description: Display models gleam under showroom lights. Outfitting crews stand ready to configure new purchases.
facilities.degraded_description: Not quite. Showroom lights dim, several ship models sit unfinished, and outfitting waits stretch into days.

facilities.name: Siege Lance
facilities.description: A spinal energy weapon run the length of a station module, firing rarely and arriving like a decision. It takes a long time to charge and it drinks power the whole while, and what it hits generally stops being a coherent object. Stations that own one tend to be stations that have already been raided once.
facilities.satisfied_description: The capacitor stack is charged and the coolant loops are running cold. The lance is ready.
facilities.degraded_description: The capacitors are flat and the coolant loops are dry. Firing it in this state would take the module off, so it does not fire.

facilities.name: Siege Ordnance Facility
facilities.description: Industrial-scale weapons facility featuring quantum control core integration, precision targeting computer assembly, and automated barrel alignment systems. Superconductor networks and power distribution systems operate at full capacity.

facilities.name: Siege Plating Assembly Station
facilities.description: Fabrication line combining armor plates, fury alloy, and durasteel into specialized siege plating. Produces aggressive-profile armor designed for close-quarters combat and maximum impact resistance.

facilities.name: Siege Railgun Assembly Plant
facilities.description: Heavy industrial facility for assembling gravitational accelerators and mounting neutronium payloads. Weapon housings and barrel assemblies are precision-fitted under strict tolerances to handle exotic matter.

facilities.name: Siege Torpedo Bay
facilities.description: Purpose-built facility for assembling heavy warhead ordnance, integrating durasteel plating, warhead components, and weapons-grade plutonium into devastating anti-station payloads. Long cycle times reflect the precision required for maximum destructive yield.

facilities.name: Siege Torpedo Complex
facilities.description: Cutting-edge weapons manufacturing system with parallel assembly streams, quantum control cores, and extensive coolant networks managing thermal loads from concurrent production. Delivers maximum firepower at unprecedented production rates.

facilities.name: Siege Torpedo Plant
facilities.description: Specialized weapons assembly facility with dedicated weapon housings, barrel assemblies, and plutonium containment protocols, tripling production speed while maintaining payload integrity. Heavy structural reinforcement supports the hazardous assembly process.

facilities.name: Siege Torpedo Works
facilities.description: Heavily automated facility with quantum targeting computers and specialized weapon housings orchestrating rapid assembly of siege-class ordnance. Advanced control systems manage the volatile materials and ensure consistent warhead synchronization.

facilities.name: Signal Reception Plant
facilities.description: An expanded facility with dedicated sensor-array tuning stations and parallel circuit-board assembly. Processing cores handle frequency calibration while precision optics begin integration for enhanced signal clarity.

facilities.name: Signal Relay
facilities.description: A rack-mounted signal amplifier patched into the station's comm array. Extends your drone control bandwidth beyond what ship-mounted equipment can manage alone.
facilities.satisfied_description: Strong signal, low latency. Your drones respond like extensions of your own hands.
facilities.degraded_description: Signal degrades at the edge of range and the amplifier runs hot. Drones get sluggish at distance.

facilities.name: Signal Resonance Plant
facilities.description: Expanded facility with dedicated gas ionization chambers, improved stabilization tanks, and faster encapsulation presses. Sensor arrays and processing cores enable real-time purity monitoring and accelerated output.

facilities.name: Silica Optics Lab
facilities.description: A clean lab that laps silica-borer lenses into the optical cores of control nodes.

facilities.name: Silicate Kiln
facilities.description: Precision furnace that fuses silicon and nickel ore into semiconductor-grade composite substrates through controlled high-temperature sintering. Copper piping manages thermal distribution across the chamber.

facilities.name: Silicate Reactor
facilities.description: Industrial sintering complex with advanced plasma injection systems, redundant cooling loops, and reinforced containment managing extreme thermal loads. Continuous throughput design maximizes composite output.

facilities.name: Silicon Etching Line
facilities.description: A specialized chemical etching system that dissolves and patterns silicon wafers using chlorine compounds to form circuit traces. Produces integrated boards at modest throughput.

facilities.name: Silver Assay Mint
facilities.description: An assay-and-stamping line that smelts silver ore, verifies its purity, and casts it into standard bullion bars. A wealth-storage convenience, not an industrial input.

facilities.name: Silver Battery Workshop
facilities.description: An expanded facility with parallel assembly stations and integrated energy crystal processing. Handles circuit board staging and silver wiring integration at increased production volume.

facilities.name: Silver Circuit Lab
facilities.description: An expanded facility with plasma injection systems and heat sinks that accelerate the circuit-bonding process while maintaining precise temperature control across multiple production stations.

facilities.name: Silver Circuitry Plant
facilities.description: A high-throughput industrial plant equipped with coolant loops, advanced plasma injectors, and distributed processing cores that simultaneously produce circuits with tight tolerance specifications.

facilities.name: Silver Conductor Foundry
facilities.description: Heavy-duty production complex with continuous casting, plasma-enhanced heating, and parallel drawing towers. Active coolant circulation preserves silver's conductive properties during rapid processing cycles.

facilities.name: Silver Trace Workshop
facilities.description: A foundational production line that combines silver wiring, silicon, and energy crystals into integrated circuit boards using controlled heat and basic automation.

facilities.name: Silver Wire Drawing Mill
facilities.description: A dedicated metal-refining line with ore smelting, casting, and wire-drawing dies optimized for silver. Produces precision silver wiring for shield systems and precision electronics.

facilities.name: Silver Wire Refinery
facilities.description: Larger production facility with integrated ore processing and multi-tower drawing stations. Plasma injection and heat sinks enable faster wire formation while maintaining the purity required for high-conductivity applications.

facilities.name: Singularity Ammunition Line
facilities.description: A void-shielded line for phased singularity ammunition cores.

facilities.name: Singularity Armaments Factory
facilities.description: Fully automated cutting-edge facility with extensive coolant loops managing the quantum control systems and targeting computer networks, enabling rapid sequential void cannon production at industrial scale.

facilities.name: Singularity Charge Foundry
facilities.description: State-of-the-art operation featuring quantum-enhanced containment fields, multi-loop cryogenic cooling, and real-time exotic-matter resonance control. Massive coolant infrastructure and advanced quantum systems enable rapid, stable void-core production at scale.

facilities.name: Singularity Containment Lab
facilities.description: An expanded shielded facility with dedicated dark matter processing stations and quantum stabilizer networks. Temporal stabilizer integration ensures safe assembly of micro black hole power sources with improved throughput.

facilities.name: Singularity Forge
facilities.description: State-of-the-art installation with full cryogenic coolant circulation and precision plasma control. Achieves neutronium synthesis at maximum efficiency through real-time density measurement and automated pressure modulation.

facilities.name: Singularity Slug Line
facilities.description: A dense-munitions line for osmium-jacketed singularity penetrators.

facilities.name: Singularity Weapon Assembly
facilities.description: State-of-the-art fully automated facility with cryogenic cooling loops maintaining quantum matrices at operational temperature throughout assembly. Robotic arms perform precision crystal bonding and phase-coherence calibration at speeds that would be impossible manually.

facilities.name: Slag Smeltery
facilities.description: A blast smeltery that renders slag-tortoise iron nodules into steel plate at scale. A steady outlet for a hunted belt.

facilities.name: Slice Deck
facilities.description: A counter, an oven, and a stack of boxes — pizza by the slice and milkshakes so thick the straws are ornamental. Nobody sits down for long, and nobody leaves without a second slice.
facilities.satisfied_description: The oven's turning out pies faster than the counter can box them and the shake blenders never stop. There's a line, and the line is happy.
facilities.degraded_description: The cheese ran out two shifts ago and the board's down to plain crust and apologies. The regulars are drifting to the diner.

facilities.name: Slug Casting Pit
facilities.description: Purpose-built production line that compresses and shapes iron ore into dense ferrous slugs. Automated pressing stations ensure uniform density and consistent ballistic performance.

facilities.name: Smart Cluster Missile Assembly Line
facilities.description: A guided-ordnance line that integrates carrier warheads, independent seekers, and target-distribution computers into smart cluster missiles.

facilities.name: Smart Cluster Missile Complex
facilities.description: A hardened ordnance complex with redundant targeting computers, coolant loops, and automated test ranges for continuous smart-cluster production.

facilities.name: Smart Cluster Missile Plant
facilities.description: Parallel guidance and warhead lines raise production without relaxing the calibration required for each submunition to select a separate hostile target.

facilities.name: Smart Cluster Missile Works
facilities.description: Quantum control cores coordinate high-volume seeker programming and verify that every carrier missile can distribute its payload across a moving formation.

facilities.name: Snail Draw Mill
facilities.description: A progressive draw-plate mill that pulls kiln-snail carbide beads into tungsten rod stock. The beads are denser than press-formed material going in — the mill is just shaping what the snail already made.

facilities.name: Sol Biotic Dispensary
facilities.description: Produces Solarian Biotech Division certified wellness supplements for export. Premium pricing, premium packaging, and documentation nobody reads.
facilities.lore: The Biotech Division has been producing wellness supplements since the early Confederacy period, when keeping Sol Central's population healthy became a strategic priority. The current formulation is the result of forty-three revisions, seventeen clinical studies, and one extended regulatory dispute with the Nebula Trade Federation over market access. Whether the supplements work better than alternatives is a matter of ongoing scientific debate. They are certified, branded, and more expensive. The Confederacy considers this sufficient.

facilities.name: Sol Nacre Press
facilities.description: A Confederacy composite press that bonds a coronid's sol-nacre with a steel charge into solarian composite, skipping the three-ore melt the crab already did in its shell.

facilities.name: Sol Pharmaceutical Lab
facilities.description: Certified clean-room biological culture facility producing standardized pharmaceutical culture media for Confederacy biotech production chains.
facilities.lore: The Confederacy's Biotech Division operates Sol Central's pharmaceutical lab under a regulatory framework that runs to eleven volumes. Every culture batch is certified, documented, and traceable to a named technician. The media produced here feeds both the Biotic Dispensary and export chains supplying pharmaceutical operations across the galaxy. Operators outside Solarian space sometimes reverse-engineer the process. The Confederacy considers this flattering but declines to license it.

facilities.name: Solar Array Manufacturing Plant
facilities.description: Increased throughput via parallel assembly tracks and automated optical testing. Structural frames and reinforced bulkheads are integrated on moving conveyors, with integrated quality checkpoints ensuring alignment tolerances before final composite layering.

facilities.name: Solar Lance Forge
facilities.description: Heavy industrial operation incorporating quantum control cores and targeting computer assembly lines running in parallel with barrel and housing fabrication. Coolant loops manage thermal stress from high-precision laser focus array integration.

facilities.name: Solar Lance Foundry
facilities.description: Cutting-edge manufacturing combining quantum-controlled precision with continuous-flow assembly. Redundant coolant systems manage the extreme thermal loads of crystalline lattice bonding; targeting computers and weapon housings are mass-produced and integrated with near-zero downtime.

facilities.name: Solar Lance Workshop
facilities.description: Expanded production with dedicated forging and precision machining sections for barrel components and weapon housings. Structural frames and multiple assembly stations increase throughput; integrated targeting computer mounts are pre-calibrated before final assembly.

facilities.name: Solar Panel Assembly Line
facilities.description: Automated facility for laminating circuit boards, aluminum sheets, and silver wiring into functional photovoltaic arrays. Produces steady power-generation modules for station infrastructure expansion.

facilities.name: Solarian Aegis Production Facility
facilities.description: Industrial-scale operation with dedicated zones for legacy alloy processing, quantum control integration, and shield emitter arrays. Coolant loops dissipate heat from high-power emitter testing; shield matrix components are precision-machined and validated before assembly.

facilities.name: Solarian Biosphere
facilities.description: A fully enclosed ecosystem spanning three decks, with hydroponic gardens and atmospheric recycling.
facilities.satisfied_description: The gardens flourish under precisely-tuned grow lights, filtering air and providing fresh vegetables while technicians tend the ecosystem with scientific care.
facilities.degraded_description: That's how it's designed. Water rationing has wilted half the hydroponic beds, and atmospheric scrubbers labor to compensate; residents notice the air growing stale.
facilities.lore: The jewel of Sol Central — a self-sustaining biosphere that provides fresh air, clean water, and real food to thousands of inhabitants. The gardens produce enough oxygen to supply a small fleet, and the water filtration system is the benchmark against which all others are measured.

facilities.name: Solarian Biosphere Kitchen
facilities.description: Real food, grown in real soil, prepared by real chefs. In space, this is an absurd luxury.
facilities.lore: Sol Central's biosphere produces actual food — hydroponically grown vegetables, vat-cultured proteins, and spices from the last surviving Earth seed bank. The chefs are Confederacy employees with security clearances, because apparently seasoning is classified. The vacuum-sealed rations they produce are the most sought-after luxury in the galaxy. Haven can't get enough of them.

facilities.name: Solarian Biotics Institute
facilities.description: A capital medical institute using tailored Solarian biotics to accelerate tissue reconstruction and return casualties to duty with exceptional efficiency.
facilities.satisfied_description: Biotic cultures move from synthesis vaults to regenerative suites without delay, sustaining a rapid stream of successful recoveries.
facilities.degraded_description: The institute's biotic reserves are exhausted, leaving its advanced suites idle while conventional wards carry the load.
facilities.lore: Solarian medicine treats recovery as an optimization problem. The Institute cultivates tailored biotics against each casualty manifest, accepting nothing less than a measured return to duty.

facilities.name: Solarian Composite Forge
facilities.description: A specialized high-temperature refining line equipped with plasma injection and heat management systems to blend Sol alloy ore into advanced composite material.

facilities.name: Solarian Composite Foundry Complex
facilities.description: Cutting-edge facility featuring integrated plasma control, dynamic heat-sink arrays, and precision coolant circulation for near-instantaneous composite production at maximum throughput.

facilities.name: Solarian Composite Refinery
facilities.description: Heavy-duty industrial refinery with cascading plasma injectors and multi-loop cryogenic cooling, enabling rapid batch processing of Sol alloy into finished composite.

facilities.name: Solarian Composite Smelting Plant
facilities.description: Larger thermal processing facility with multiple plasma stages and expanded coolant loops, accelerating ore reduction and composite synthesis.

facilities.name: Solarian Fuel Grid
facilities.description: Automated fuel distribution grid with redundant safety interlocks. Fueling takes slightly longer because of mandatory containment scans.
facilities.satisfied_description: Seven layers of containment verification execute flawlessly, fuel cells transfer through triple-redundant lines, and safety systems maintain the Confederacy's thirty-year accident-free record.
facilities.degraded_description: Except when it doesn't. Circuit failures have disabled automated interlocks, forcing manual containment checks; engineers nervously override safety protocols to keep fuel flowing.
facilities.lore: Seven layers of containment verification before a single cell is transferred. The Confederacy hasn't had a fuel handling accident in thirty years, and they will remind you of this while you wait.

facilities.name: Solarian Fusion Plant
facilities.description: Advanced deuterium-tritium fusion reactor. Clean, efficient, and over-engineered.
facilities.satisfied_description: The containment magnets hold plasma at 99.7% efficiency, producing steady power while diagnostic readouts confirm every parameter within Confederacy specifications.
facilities.degraded_description: Or it should be. Fuel shortages have forced the reactor to cold-start cycles, stressing the containment magnets; engineers watch the efficiency drop below 90% with growing alarm.
facilities.lore: Confederacy engineering at its finest. This reactor converts hydrogen isotopes with 99.7% efficiency, a testament to Solarian scientific achievement. The containment magnets alone cost more than most frontier stations.

facilities.name: Solarian Naval Shipyard
facilities.description: The Confederacy's premier naval construction facility — gleaming bays, rigorous quality control, and a catalog of every certified hull class.
facilities.satisfied_description: Construction bays operate at full capacity, fabricators laying hull plates to micron tolerances while quality control inspects every weld against Naval Standard 7.3.
facilities.degraded_description: On schedule, at least. Material shortages have halted two bays entirely, and quality control reluctantly approves borderline welds rather than delay ship deliveries further.
facilities.lore: Every ship that rolls off these lines meets Confederacy Naval Specification in full. The construction bays can accommodate up to cruiser-class hulls, and the quality control division has rejected more ships than most yards have built. Their motto is 'Measure twice, fabricate once, inspect three times.'

facilities.name: Solarian Precision Drydock
facilities.description: Pristine automated dry docks with diagnostic AIs and certified technicians. Everything warrantied, documented, and slightly overpriced.
facilities.satisfied_description: Diagnostic AIs complete seventeen-point inspections in minutes, robotic arms execute repairs with millimeter precision, and every hull leaves with full certification documentation.
facilities.degraded_description: When supply chains cooperate. Repair kit shortages force technicians to improvise with salvaged parts, bypassing the diagnostic AI's approval; warranties are quietly voided.
facilities.lore: The drydock's diagnostic AIs run seventeen-point inspections before a human technician even looks at the hull. Every repair is logged, warrantied, and certified to Confederacy Naval Standard 7.3. The quality is unmatched. So is the bill.

facilities.name: Solarian Research Labs
facilities.description: University-grade research labs with precision equipment, safety protocols, and mandatory certification for hazardous materials.
facilities.satisfied_description: Molecular assemblers fabricate components with atomic precision, clean rooms maintain ISO Class 1 standards, and certified engineers work without resource constraints.
facilities.degraded_description: Usually. Power fluctuations have contaminated the clean rooms, forcing engineers to lower standards; crafting yields drop as precision equipment operates outside calibration.
facilities.lore: Access requires a safety orientation, a materials handling certificate, and signing three waivers. The equipment is the best in settled space — molecular assemblers, plasma etchers, and a clean room that would make a Voidborn jealous. Visiting engineers tend to overstay their welcome.

facilities.name: Space Pizza Galley
facilities.description: A stone-deck pizza line — dough stretchers, a marinara ladle rail, and an oven that never cools between shifts.

facilities.name: Spark Chamber Lab
facilities.description: An expanded facility with improved coolant circulation and multiple charging chambers operating in parallel. Structural reinforcement handles the demands of rapid cell synthesis.

facilities.name: Spatial Sensor Manufacturing Plant
facilities.description: A larger facility with dedicated processing-core initialization and sensor-array alignment stations, running structural frames to support heavier tooling and faster throughput. Expanded circuit-board integration enables more stable anomaly mapping.

facilities.name: Spore Incubator
facilities.description: A sterile bioreactor with temperature and atmospheric control, designed to culture pharmaceutical organisms and extract their bioactive compounds through enzymatic and thermal processes.

facilities.name: Spore Ragout Galley
facilities.description: Braising pots for a deep, meatless frontier stew.

facilities.name: Stainless Alloy Foundry
facilities.description: A compact alloy furnace and rolling line for corrosion-resistant structural plate.

facilities.name: Stainless Frame Assembly Line
facilities.description: A dedicated line that cuts stainless plate and welds it around aluminum and silicate structural braces.

facilities.name: Stainless Frame Factory
facilities.description: Industrial robotic welding arrays assemble stainless facility skeletons across synchronized production bays.

facilities.name: Stainless Furnace
facilities.description: A multi-chamber facility where plasma injectors hold the precise temperature window needed to dissolve nickel evenly into steel without segregation. Heat sinks and structural frames support the high-frequency cycling required for faster throughput.

facilities.name: Starshine Distillery
facilities.description: Framed infusion lines and climate-stabilized aging chambers let the still turn out the glowing stuff at volume. The crystalline suspension is finicky, so the sensors never stop watching. Some empire citizens will quietly admit to waiting on every batch.

facilities.name: Starshine Infusion Complex
facilities.description: A flagship liquor plant with parallel aging halls, quantum-metered crystal infusion, and precision optics certifying the glow at industrial volume. The only pirate product some empire citizens will cross a border to buy — and now there's enough of it to go around.

facilities.name: Stasis Webifier I Assembly Facility
facilities.description: Industrial operation combining dedicated superconductor fabrication with circuit assembly and sensor integration lines. Quantum control cores and precision optics calibrate field parameters; processing cores manage real-time output validation.

facilities.name: Stasis Webifier I Production Lab
facilities.description: Expanded facility with parallel superconductor processing and circuit board assembly stations. Structural frames and sensor array integration occur simultaneously; precision calibration ensures consistent field projection before unit completion.

facilities.name: Stasis Webifier I Technology Nexus
facilities.description: Cutting-edge facility with continuous-flow superconductor conditioning and quantum-controlled circuit fabrication. Precision optics and automated field calibration systems enable rapid production of high-fidelity velocity-dampening units.

facilities.name: Stasis Webifier I Workshop
facilities.description: Compact production line integrating sensor arrays, superconductors, and circuit boards into functional velocity-dampening units. Control nodes manage the superconductor conditioning required for stable field generation.

facilities.name: Stasis Webifier II Assembly Facility
facilities.description: Industrial-scale production with quantum-grade control cores and precision optics integrated at the component stage. Continuous-flow assembly and real-time field-strength verification reduce cycle time dramatically.

facilities.name: Stasis Webifier II Production Lab
facilities.description: An expanded facility with parallel assembly stations and integrated testing bays, significantly accelerating sensor and circuit integration while maintaining electromagnetic tolerances.

facilities.name: Stasis Webifier II Technology Nexus
facilities.description: State-of-the-art fully automated factory deploying quantum control systems, high-precision optics, and parallel redundant assembly lines. Each unit undergoes rigorous field-coherence validation before release.

facilities.name: Stasis Webifier II Workshop
facilities.description: A dedicated production line assembling sensor arrays, superconductors, and circuit boards into stasis webifier units. Handles the precision alignment and electromagnetic calibration required for field-generation equipment.

facilities.name: State-of-the-Art Beam Fabrication
facilities.description: Fully automated production facility with cryogenic coolant loops maintaining precision tolerances throughout assembly. Delivers combat-ready Judgment Beams at maximum throughput with integrated targeting and power validation.

facilities.name: State-of-the-Art Fiber Optics Complex
facilities.description: Cutting-edge facility featuring ultra-high-temperature plasma injection, advanced heat dissipation through extensive coolant loops, and real-time optical quality monitoring. Draws premium fiber bundles at maximum speed with zero transmission loss.

facilities.name: State-of-the-Art Flotation Works
facilities.description: Cutting-edge flotation production line featuring quantum control cores, full sensor integration, and precision optical systems for microsecond-level process control. Achieves near-instantaneous separation cycles with minimal reagent waste.

facilities.name: State-of-the-Art Frame Facility
facilities.description: Fully automated modular fabrication system with AI-coordinated welding, precision pipe-fitting, and redundant coolant circulation. Produces complete structural frames at maximum efficiency with minimal downtime.

facilities.name: State-of-the-Art Gas Harvester Fabrication
facilities.description: Cutting-edge fully automated facility with parallel processing core integration, real-time quantum calibration systems, and high-speed precision optic installation. Advanced robotics and AI-guided assembly achieve minimal cycle time for capital-tier harvesters.

facilities.name: State-of-the-Art Gravity Generator Fabrication
facilities.description: Cutting-edge fully automated facility with integrated quantum control systems, precision optic installation, and continuous performance validation loops. Advanced robotics and AI-guided assembly achieve minimal cycle time for capital-grade artificial gravity systems.

facilities.name: State-of-the-Art Hangar Bay Fabrication Complex
facilities.description: Cutting-edge fully automated shipbuilding facility with integrated docking ring systems, advanced hull plating installation, and continuous structural integrity validation. Parallel production lines and AI-guided assembly achieve rapid output of these capital-scale ship storage modules.

facilities.name: State-of-the-Art Incendiary Ordnance Works
facilities.description: Fully automated production facility with integrated coolant loops managing ion-solution thermal stability and quantum control systems for precision warhead integration. Advanced targeting and payload-tuning subsystems enable near-continuous output.

facilities.name: State-of-the-Art NiMH Fabrication
facilities.description: Cutting-edge facility leveraging quantum control systems and extensive sensor arrays for real-time quality assurance and near-instantaneous assembly of premium nickel-metal-hydride cells.

facilities.name: State-of-the-Art Photonic Integration Factory
facilities.description: Cutting-edge fully automated facility with quadrupled hull plating capacity and extensive docking architecture. Delivers prism computers at peak throughput through continuous photonic-optical component fusion and assembly.

facilities.name: State-of-the-Art Plasma Fabrication
facilities.description: Fully automated mega-facility running four parallel production chains with real-time sensor feedback and predictive maintenance. Achieves near-perfect unit consistency through advanced quantum process control and integrated thermal management.

facilities.name: State-of-the-Art Power Cell Fabrication
facilities.description: Cutting-edge facility leveraging quantum control systems and extensive sensor arrays for real-time quality assurance and near-instantaneous assembly of premium power cells.

facilities.name: State-of-the-Art Steel Foundry
facilities.description: Fully automated precision facility with redundant plasma systems, advanced cooling loops, and real-time alloy composition monitoring. Produces steel plate on near-continuous basis.

facilities.name: State-of-the-Art Void Ordnance Facility
facilities.description: Fully automated cutting-edge factory with extensive coolant loops and quantum control networks enabling parallel void condensate processing and exotic matter synthesis, delivering advanced void lances at maximum industrial throughput.

facilities.name: State-of-the-Art Weapon Assembly
facilities.description: Fully automated platform with parallel drone AI core integration and advanced processing architecture. Optimized material flow and quantum-level synchronization achieve six-second cycle times on every unit.

facilities.name: Station Core Foundry
facilities.description: A capital-scale assembly slip that mates reactor cores, habitat rings, and a docking spine into a complete station core. Among the largest and most demanding production lines a faction can field — every run consumes a small fortune in reactor cores and structural mass.

facilities.name: Station Defense Turret
facilities.description: A proper turret on a proper mount, throwing armor-piercing shot out to the middle distance. The workhorse of station defense: not clever, not fast, and entirely capable of putting a hole through a raider that thought a station was a soft target.
facilities.satisfied_description: The turret tracks smoothly through its arc, ready racks full.
facilities.degraded_description: The turret tracks smoothly through its arc with nothing in the ready racks. It is an expensive way to point at things.

facilities.name: Station Lager Brewery
facilities.description: A workhorse brewery kicking out cold sunspindle lager by the crate.

facilities.name: Station Power Core Fabrication
