facilities.description: Heavy industrial production deploying advanced control nodes and docking-ring integration systems for rapid modular assembly. Reinforced frames and hull plating are assembled and tested in continuous sequence.

facilities.name: Station Seltzer Bar
facilities.description: A simple high-pressure carbonation and canning line for cold, clean station seltzer.

facilities.name: Station Water Authority
facilities.description: A municipal empire of melt tanks, dosing lines, and reservoir decks — the kind of infrastructure nobody notices until it stops. Its clean-water output is measured in habitats, not tanks.

facilities.name: Stealth Charge Assembly
facilities.description: A larger fabrication plant with dedicated metamaterial handling, power cell integration, and field-generator assembly stations. Structural frames and expanded weapon housings support more efficient throughput and better component alignment.

facilities.name: Stealth Kit Workshop
facilities.description: A precision facility integrating metamaterial panels with power cells under controlled conditions. Weapon housings and barrel assemblies provide structural containment for the exotic field generator components.

facilities.name: Stealth Powder Works
facilities.description: Larger facility with enhanced coolant loops and structural reinforcement to handle higher-volume reactions between krypton and polymer feedstock. Multiple synthesis chambers operate in parallel, each producing fine cloaking dust particles at steady pace.

facilities.name: Steel Frame Assembly Line
facilities.description: A dedicated production line that cuts, bends, and welds steel plates into girder skeletons, then integrates copper piping runs for internal systems. Output is steady and reliable for basic facility construction.

facilities.name: Steel Pressure Vessel
facilities.description: Specialized machinery for forming and welding steel plates with titanium reinforcement. Handles liquid hydrogen integration with basic containment protocols.

facilities.name: Steel Production Complex
facilities.description: Industrial-scale operation with reinforced frames, heavy coolant circulation, and parallel production lines. Multiple plasma injectors and extensive heat management enable rapid cycle times.

facilities.name: Stellar Annihilation Works
facilities.description: Fully automated state-of-the-art facility with four independent production chains, each featuring advanced coolant systems and precision targeting computers. Cutting-edge quantum control ensures perfect synchronization of triple-core plasma streams and flawless exotic-crystal integration.

facilities.name: Stellar Antimatter Generator
facilities.description: State-of-the-art antimatter generation system with redundant gravity generators, multi-layer dark-matter shielding, shield emitters for fail-safe containment, and full cryogenic support for stable synthesis at extreme throughput.

facilities.name: Stellar Biosynth Complex
facilities.description: A state-of-the-art facility with extensive life support networks, redundant atmospheric units, and autonomous culture management systems that produce synthetic compounds at maximum biological throughput.

facilities.name: Stellar Bistro
facilities.description: A proper sit-down restaurant with real tables, a rotating menu, and a view of the docking bay traffic. Business-class travelers eat here between meetings.
facilities.satisfied_description: Tables are turning over at a healthy clip and the kitchen's keeping pace with a full menu. A solid, dependable dining room.
facilities.degraded_description: The menu's shrunk to whatever the pantry can still support, and the wait staff are apologizing more than serving.

facilities.name: Stellar Bulwark Fabricator
facilities.description: Cutting-edge facility producing capital armor plates in under a minute through quantum-controlled forming and precision shield integration. Coolant loops maintain optimal conditions throughout high-speed production while automated validation ensures every plate meets spec.

facilities.name: Stellar Chart Lab
facilities.description: Expanded facility with dedicated dark matter cell handling and quantum matrix integration bays. Incorporates gravity generators to support precise component alignment during assembly.

facilities.name: Stellar Collector Grid
facilities.description: Panel arrays with no fuel line at all — power from starlight and a steady supply of replacement circuit boards. No fuel runs to manage, but the circuit-board pipeline has to stay open.
facilities.satisfied_description: Panels track the local star without fault. No fuel to haul, no fuel to burn — just periodic circuit swaps.
facilities.degraded_description: Half the array's gone dark for want of replacement boards. Output has dropped well below rated capacity.

facilities.name: Stellar Compression Facility
facilities.description: Heavy industrial facility with extensive coolant loops and redundant plasma systems. Handles extreme densities through multi-stage pressure confinement and aggressive heat extraction.

facilities.name: Stellar Core Reactor
facilities.description: State-of-the-art facility where quantum control cores orchestrate every fusion step with femtosecond timing. Precision optics and advanced sensor arrays achieve near-perfect energy crystal integration at maximum throughput.

facilities.name: Stellar Detection Array
facilities.description: State-of-the-art production line featuring autonomous component verification, real-time optical tuning, and integrated quality assurance. Processes quantum control cores and precision optics at industrial scale with minimal cycle time.

facilities.name: Stellar Diamond Foundry
facilities.description: Cutting-edge synthesis facility with distributed plasma injection arrays, adaptive heat-sink networks, and quantum-level process control. Manufactures synthetic diamonds at maximum throughput with flawless crystal structure.

facilities.name: Stellar Foundry Complex
facilities.description: Cutting-edge smelting complex with redundant plasma heating, precision temperature control via extensive cooling networks, and optimized casting lines. Delivers maximum-grade steel plate at peak efficiency.

facilities.name: Stellar Fuel Nexus
facilities.description: State-of-the-art production system with multi-array plasma injection, redundant heat-management infrastructure, and precision coolant circulation for sub-second cycle times. Consistently produces high-purity fusion rods under extreme operational demands.

facilities.name: Stellar Genesis Foundry
facilities.description: Cutting-edge facility with advanced cryogenic and coolant systems supporting maximum-throughput culture synthesis. Extensive shield matrices and quantum control architecture deliver living hull coatings at peak production speed.

facilities.name: Stellar Plasma Cell Line
facilities.description: A heat-shielded line for oxygen-enriched plasma ammunition.

facilities.name: Stellar Plasma Manufactory
facilities.description: Fully automated facility employing quantum control and optimized coolant management for maximum efficiency. Every enhanced cell pack is individually stabilized, calibrated, and verified before discharge to weapons systems.

facilities.name: Stellar Plating Works
facilities.description: State-of-the-art facility with modular bonding arrays, automated material flow via docking rings, and reinforced structural framing throughout. Advanced control systems optimize adhesion parameters in real time, achieving peak throughput with zero defect rates.

facilities.name: Stellar Power Generation Complex
facilities.description: Cutting-edge automated complex with fully integrated uranium enrichment, superconductor cryogenic systems, and precision optic field-alignment. Produces high-output reactor cores at unprecedented speed through parallel assembly and real-time calibration.

facilities.name: Stellar Reclamation Nexus
facilities.description: Fully automated production complex with advanced sensor calibration and optical precision systems running continuously. Quantum cores and reinforced frames feed into rapid assembly chains, maximizing debris-extraction array output.

facilities.name: Stellar Stainless Foundry
facilities.description: A cutting-edge foundry integrating full-spectrum plasma control, cryogenic cooling, and predictive material staging to achieve single-second cycle times. Redundant plasma injectors and coolant networks ensure uniform nickel-steel composition at maximum throughput.

facilities.name: Stellar Titanium Works
facilities.description: State-of-the-art system combining multi-stage plasma enhancement, precision cryogenic cooling, and automated quality assurance. Produces weapons-grade titanium ingots with minimal cycle lag.

facilities.name: Stellar Weapon Assembly
facilities.description: Purpose-built manufacturing line for precision weapon components—solarian composites, crystalline lattice structures, and laser focus arrays are integrated into a unified barrel and housing assembly. Strict control protocols govern alignment of energy-focusing elements.

facilities.name: Stim Injector Plant
facilities.description: Framed filling lines and additional medical modules push out sealed injectors faster, each one loaded with a fixed dose nobody gets to argue with. Popular with boarding parties, who rarely read the warnings.

facilities.name: Stim Synthesis Lab
facilities.description: A pressure-crystallization rig for bonding plasma gas to gutter flux into nerve burn. The coolant loops and heat sinks manage a process that is as dangerous to make as it is to take. Buildable only at pirate strongholds.

facilities.name: Stimulant Manufacturing Plant
facilities.description: Large-scale production facility with extensive atmospheric units and life support infrastructure to manage the hazardous nature of trace exotic elements. Multiple air recyclers maintain clean-room conditions across redundant synthesis chambers.

facilities.name: Stolen Generator Module
facilities.description: A ship generator stripped out and wired into the existing station reactor. Scales up output and consumption — whatever the reactor was burning, it now burns more of, in exchange for more juice.
facilities.satisfied_description: The module is running. The wiring has not yet caught fire, the reactor is taking the extra fuel without complaint, and the lights are noticeably steadier.
facilities.degraded_description: The module is dark. The reactor is back to its old fuel draw and its old output, and the wiring is still very much a fire hazard.

facilities.name: Stolen Reactor Core
facilities.description: A decommissioned or appropriated ship reactor, dropped into whatever space was available and bolted to whatever power conduits were convenient. It works.
facilities.satisfied_description: The reactor holds steady. Radiation levels are within what the crew has agreed to call acceptable, and every deck reports consistent power. Nobody's asking where it came from.
facilities.degraded_description: The reactor is struggling. Half the station is on emergency power, the deck lights keep browning out, and the chief engineer's messages are getting increasingly terse.

facilities.name: Storage Bay
facilities.description: Secure personal storage lockers for visiting pilots.
facilities.satisfied_description: Locker seals hold firm. The bay is clean, climate-controlled, and organized by section.
facilities.degraded_description: At least in principle. Locker seals leak, humidity creeps in, and some sections show signs of corrosion.

facilities.name: Storage Extension
facilities.description: A modular storage pod bolted onto the faction vault — its own sealed compartment with a fresh 100,000-per-item-type allowance. Build up to 10 per station to carve faction stock into named buckets (a crafting pile, a free-for-all pile, whatever your faction needs). Rename it with facility action=set_name; faction crafting can pull from and deposit into a bucket with deliver_to="faction:<name>". Must be emptied before it can be dismantled.

facilities.name: Storage Optimization Plant
facilities.description: Expanded facility with increased hull plating capacity and structural framing to support faster matrix assembly. Control nodes coordinate the precise lens and polymer integration required for efficient packing.

facilities.name: Storm Barrier Manufacturing Works
facilities.description: Industrial production facility with dedicated coolant loops and quantum control cores enabling rapid synthesis of electrical-discharge shields. Reinforced frames and dense emitter arrays support continuous parallel barrier fabrication.

facilities.name: Storm Barrier Synthesis Line
facilities.description: Specialized production facility combining nebulium cores and nebula essence with shield and ion emitters into electrical-discharge barriers. Superconductor integration and circuit board assembly enable high-voltage shield generation.

facilities.name: Storm Lance Forge
facilities.description: Industrial-scale production with quantum control cores governing nebulium-core geometry and ion-emitter field alignment. Targeting computers and barrel assemblies are precision-integrated in parallel stages for rapid throughput.

facilities.name: Storm Lance Foundry
facilities.description: State-of-the-art fully automated facility with cryogenic coolant loops stabilizing nebulium cores during assembly and quantum-precision targeting-computer integration. Continuous real-time discharge testing ensures every unit meets combat specifications.

facilities.name: Storm Lance Workshop
facilities.description: Expanded facility with dedicated ion-emitter testing and targeting-computer integration stations, accelerating assembly while maintaining discharge-pattern consistency and structural reinforcement.

facilities.name: Storm Node Capacitor Bank
facilities.description: A discharge bank that drains tempest-eel storm nodes into fully charged power cells.

facilities.name: Strategic Enrichment Facility
facilities.description: Industrial-scale facility running dozens of synchronized centrifuges with automated feed management, continuous hazmat containment, and redundant cooling to maintain weapons-grade purity.

facilities.name: Strategic Material Refinery
facilities.description: Industrial-scale enrichment installation with multi-layered lead shielding, hardened circuitry, hazmat containers, and active coolant loops managing both heat and radiation. Processes fissile material at rapid intervals.

facilities.name: Strategic Missile Arsenal
facilities.description: Industrial-scale facility with quantum targeting computers, parallel assembly chambers, and weapon housing arrays coordinating high-speed missile fabrication. Control systems manage energy crystal stability throughout the production cycle.

facilities.name: Strategic Ordnance Complex
facilities.description: Fully automated production complex with quantum-stabilized plutonium handling, precision durasteel fabrication, and integrated circuit assembly. Coolant systems maintain safe thermal conditions while producing warhead cores at maximum throughput.

facilities.name: Strategic Reserve Command
facilities.description: A hardened personnel citadel capable of cycling entire battle groups through shore leave, reassignment, and prize duty. Holds up to 8,192 crew and 2,048 marines.

facilities.name: Strategic Sensor Production
facilities.description: State-of-the-art facility featuring autonomous exotic material verification, quantum-precision optical alignment, and integrated performance validation. Delivers advanced intelligence gathering systems with minimal production latency.

facilities.name: Strategic Weapons Arsenal
facilities.description: State-of-the-art facility featuring advanced coolant systems managing quantum control core thermal loads during targeting computer installation. Fully automated tracking system calibration and multi-stage assembly achieve efficient high-volume torpedo launcher production.

facilities.name: Strip Miner Manufacturing Plant
facilities.description: An expanded facility with modular laser-assembly stations and dedicated crystal-focusing calibration bays, substantially reducing assembly time while maintaining cutting-edge laser alignment.

facilities.name: Strip Miner Production Complex
facilities.description: Fully automated state-of-the-art facility with precision-optic laser-focusing systems and quantum-controlled power distribution. Every mining module undergoes real-time extraction-efficiency validation before deployment.

facilities.name: Stronghold Distillery Complex
facilities.description: An industrial moonshine plant with parallel fermentation halls, automated mash control, and water reclamation that loses almost nothing. Supplies an entire pirate stronghold's worth of thirst and still has product left to move.

facilities.name: Structural Cement Plant
facilities.description: An industrial mixer for reinforced hull repair compounds.

facilities.name: Structural Integrity Matrix
facilities.description: Cutting-edge automated facility with distributed quantum control systems managing field harmonics and power cell integration in real-time. Advanced coolant infrastructure enables continuous production of high-performance hull reinforcement systems.

facilities.name: Structural Reinforcement Plant
facilities.description: Expanded facility with improved cutting precision and automated bonding stations. Structural frames support faster material handling and increased throughput of reinforced plating assemblies.

facilities.name: Structural Reinforcer
facilities.description: Specialized production line for integrating superconductors with shield emitters and power cells. Copper piping carries control signals and power distribution to field-generating systems.

facilities.name: Sublimation Processing Plant
facilities.description: Expanded facility with parallel assembly stations handling increased processing cores and sensor arrays. Structural framing supports multiple thermal filtering modules in simultaneous production with improved heating element calibration.

facilities.name: Sunrise Griddle
facilities.description: A breakfast counter that opens before the dock lights come up — ray eggs on the flat-top, meat in the pan, and cold brew pulled by the litre. Every shift is somebody's morning.
facilities.satisfied_description: Eggs hit the griddle the second a stool empties and the cold brew keg is holding pressure. The morning rush hasn't ended since it started.
facilities.degraded_description: The egg rail is empty and the griddle's mostly warming coffee. The stools still fill up out of habit, but they don't stay.

facilities.name: Sunspindle Bay
facilities.description: Tiered grow-racks and a nitrogen-mist rig running one slow, heavy bed of sunspindle cereal at a time.

facilities.name: Superconductor Forge
facilities.description: Dedicated refining facility with plasma-injection assist and heat-sink management for stable precious-metal bonding. Increased efficiency comes from optimized ore-feed sequencing and improved thermal stability across multiple synthesis chambers.

facilities.name: Superconductor Refinery
facilities.description: Large-scale metallurgical plant running continuous precious-metal processing with active coolant circulation and reinforced reaction vessels. Plasma injectors and heat management enable rapid cycle times while maintaining conductor purity.

facilities.name: Superconductor Winding Plant
facilities.description: An expanded facility with multiple parallel assembly stations and reinforced structural frames to handle increased throughput. Enhanced control systems ensure consistent energy output across larger production batches.

facilities.name: Superfluid Caviar Galley
facilities.description: A molecular-gastronomy bench that spherifies frost-moth superfluid into cold caviar.

facilities.name: Superfluid Martini Bar
facilities.description: A chilled bar built to handle a martini that never warms.

facilities.name: Superfluid Winder
facilities.description: A cryo-winder that coils frost-moth superfluid helium into superconducting control nodes.

facilities.name: Surf-and-Turf Platter Galley
facilities.description: A combined grill-and-boil station for the classic payday board.

facilities.name: Surgical Center
facilities.description: A multi-wing medical center built for mass-casualty treatment and accelerated rehabilitation.
facilities.satisfied_description: Parallel surgical wings and rehabilitation decks process entire ship complements without losing tempo.
facilities.degraded_description: Darkened operating wings and exhausted staff have cut the center's casualty throughput sharply.

facilities.name: Survey Probe Foundry
facilities.description: Medium-capacity facility with integrated coolant systems managing thermal loads during assembly. Enhanced production rate supports frequent probe deployment.

facilities.name: Survival Kit Assembly Line
facilities.description: General-purpose production line for survival kit assembly, integrating life support units, repair nanite containers, and fuel tank modules with flexible polymer components. Straightforward module integration and structural sealing.

facilities.name: Survival Kit Manufacturing Plant
facilities.description: Expanded assembly facility with dedicated stations for life support integration, nanite container sealing, and fuel tank pressure testing. Structural frames support higher throughput and improved bulkhead reinforcement.

facilities.name: Survival Kit Production Complex
facilities.description: Industrial-scale facility with automated life support coupling, nanite container sealing under controlled atmosphere, and integrated docking ring installation. Reinforced bulkhead assembly and precision hull plating ensure field reliability.

facilities.name: Suspension Pod Assembly
facilities.description: A specialized production line that integrates cryogenic storage units with coolant circulation systems and control electronics. Each pod is tested for life-support integrity before release.

facilities.name: Sustagel Bowl Galley
facilities.description: A warmer and a stir-station. It does exactly one sad thing well.

facilities.name: Sustagel Extruder
facilities.description: A no-frills extruder pressing complete-nutrition Sustagel from water and nitrogen.

facilities.name: Swarm Command Manufacturing
facilities.description: Industrial-scale complex with specialized bays for AI core installation, parallel sensor and comms integration, and docking ring assembly for large-scale drone fleet coordination.

facilities.name: Swarm Command Platform
facilities.description: Heavy-duty production employing reinforced frames and expanded control systems to manage complex drone coordination. Processing cores and AI cores are integrated in parallel for rapid bandwidth allocation testing.

facilities.name: Swarm Command Station
facilities.description: Industrial-scale production complex with quantum control core processing and precision optics integration for enhanced swarm synchronization. Advanced automation significantly reduces assembly time per unit.

facilities.name: Swarm Missile Assembly
facilities.description: Purpose-built production line that assembles titanium alloy bodies, integrates circuit boards, and installs warhead assemblies into compact missile pods. Weapon housing components provide structural integrity for the micro-missile clusters.

facilities.name: Synthesize Pan-Galactic Matrix Complex
facilities.description: Cutting-edge automated facility with precision cryogenic loops and adaptive plasma sequencing. Achieves maximum matrix stability and performance through real-time void matter and composite phase alignment.

facilities.name: Synthesize Pan-Galactic Matrix Factory
facilities.description: Large-scale production complex with extensive coolant systems and redundant plasma injection arrays. Simultaneous processing of multiple exotic material streams ensures consistent imperial cooperation encoding.

facilities.name: Synthesize Pan-Galactic Matrix Plant
facilities.description: Industrial assembly plant with enhanced thermal management and plasma control systems. Faster integration cycles and improved component bonding yield more stable cross-empire composite matrices.

facilities.name: Synthesize Pan-Galactic Matrix Workshop
facilities.description: Specialized reactor integrating null matter, Solarian composite, and trade cipher components into unified circuit lattice. Combines exotic materials through controlled plasma injection and thermal precision.

facilities.name: Synthetic Biology Weaving Complex
facilities.description: A large-scale automated facility with parallel bioreactor arrays and advanced environmental control. Expanded atmospheric units and dedicated life support systems enable continuous high-throughput production of living mesh.

facilities.name: System Disabler Forge
facilities.description: Heavy-duty industrial complex featuring quantum control cores and targeting computer integration for precision EMP delivery. Reinforced construction accommodates the electromagnetic stresses of high-volume weapon assembly.

facilities.name: System Disabler Foundry
facilities.description: Cutting-edge production facility with quantum systems, integrated targeting computers, and coolant loop infrastructure for thermal management during rapid assembly. Full automation and reinforced framing enable maximum throughput of advanced EMP weapons.

facilities.name: System Disabler Workshop
facilities.description: Larger facility with structural reinforcement handling the complex assembly of superconductor arrays, ion emitter integration, and weapon housing fabrication. Expanded processing capacity and multiple assembly stations increase output significantly.

facilities.name: Tactical Drone Workshop
facilities.description: A purpose-built production line for integrating drone chassis, circuit boards, and power systems into functional multi-drone deployment bays.

facilities.name: Tactical Intelligence Factory
facilities.description: Multi-stage production facility featuring dedicated sensor calibration loops and quantum-precision component alignment. Combines optical assembly, thruster integration, and final systems check into a seamless 18-second cycle.

facilities.name: Tactical Missile Production Plant
facilities.description: Expanded assembly operation with dedicated stations for titanium work, circuit integration, and warhead mating. Barrel assembly components enable rapid pod configuration and targeting calibration.

facilities.name: Target Painter I Assembly Facility
facilities.description: Industrial-scale facility incorporating precision optics and quantum control cores to enhance target signature amplification. Advanced automation and multi-stage pipelining deliver rapid cycle times.

facilities.name: Target Painter I Production Lab
facilities.description: Expanded production facility with structural frames and increased processing capacity for faster sensor and circuit integration. Parallel assembly of marking and control subsystems increases throughput substantially.

facilities.name: Target Painter I Technology Nexus
facilities.description: State-of-the-art production complex with quantum-grade control systems and integrated precision optics for maximum marking accuracy. Reinforced infrastructure and maximized processing deliver the fastest output.

facilities.name: Target Painter I Workshop
facilities.description: Compact automated line integrating sensor arrays with circuit boards and focused crystals for target marking functionality. Efficient copper piping and control systems enable reliable sensor-to-targeting signal flow.

facilities.name: Target Painter II Assembly Facility
facilities.description: Industrial-scale production complex with quantum control cores and integrated precision optics lines for enhanced signature amplification. Automated fiber bundle and sensor array processing significantly reduces build time.

facilities.name: Target Painter II Production Lab
facilities.description: Larger facility with structural reinforcement and expanded processing cores for handling dual-sensor integration and optical fiber assembly. Multiple sub-assembly stations enable efficient parallel processing of targeting subsystems.

facilities.name: Target Painter II Technology Nexus
facilities.description: Cutting-edge facility featuring full automation of optical fiber, dual-sensor, and quantum control processing with precision optics manufacturing. Reinforced framing and multi-stage pipelining deliver maximum throughput of advanced targeting painters.

facilities.name: Target Painter II Workshop
facilities.description: Purpose-built production line for assembling dual-sensor targeting systems with optical fiber bundles and focused crystal arrays. Handles the increased component complexity with dedicated signal processing infrastructure.

facilities.name: Targeting Computer Facility
facilities.description: Industrial-scale production using precision optics and quantum control cores to achieve tighter tolerances in fire control systems. The facility processes vastly more sensor arrays and processing cores through dedicated calibration chambers.

facilities.name: Targeting Computer Hub
facilities.description: A state-of-the-art facility running continuous fully-automated production with reinforced frames supporting extreme component density. Quantum control cores and precision optics work in concert to deliver targeting computers at maximum throughput with zero tolerance drift.

facilities.name: Targeting Computer Plant
facilities.description: This expanded facility increases throughput by distributing assembly across multiple parallel stations, with enhanced structural framing to support higher component throughput and more quantum control cores for precision targeting alignment.

facilities.name: Targeting Synthesis Lab
facilities.description: Larger bioreactor complex with atmospheric units and air recyclers maintaining optimal growth conditions, scaling output while preserving bioactive potency.

facilities.name: Temporal Hibernation Works
facilities.description: State-of-the-art fully automated production line with real-time thermal-isolation verification and adaptive liquid-nitrogen pressurization. Produces crew-preservation chambers at 11-second intervals with guaranteed suspension stability.

facilities.name: Temporal Regulation Complex
facilities.description: Industrial-scale production incorporating gravity generators and enhanced dark matter cell processing through dedicated cryogenic loops. Quantum control cores manage the exotic state transitions required to bind temporal stabilizers at scale.

facilities.name: The Black Forge
facilities.description: Admiral Kael's weapons depot includes a dedicated munitions line that produces ammunition with no maker's mark, no energy signature, and no paper trail. Quality control is exceptional — Kael won't sell rounds that jam.

facilities.name: The Burn Ward
facilities.description: Warlord Thane named it himself. The nerve burn synthesized here is considered the purest — and the most dangerous. Thane's chemists are the best-paid non-combatants on any stronghold.

facilities.name: The Crystal Cellar
facilities.description: Grand Marshal Korr's personal project. Energy crystals are ground, dissolved in moonshine, and aged in zero-gravity chambers. Korr gifts bottles to visiting captains who've earned his respect. Everyone else pays premium.

facilities.name: The Dust Room
facilities.description: A sealed compartment deep in the Nexus where nebular gas meets gutter flux in carefully controlled reactions. Overlord Nyx doesn't use the product, but she understands its value. The room has no windows for a reason.

facilities.name: The Golden Table
facilities.description: Fine dining built for first-class passengers — a tasting menu, a reservation list, and a maître d' who remembers everyone's name and empire of origin.
facilities.satisfied_description: Every seating is booked, the tasting menu is running at full complexity, and the reservation list stretches out for cycles. The Table has a reputation to protect, and it's protecting it.
facilities.degraded_description: The tasting menu's been cut down to whatever's actually in stock, and the reservation list has quietly stopped growing. Even the maître d' looks tired.

facilities.name: The Halcyon Concourse
facilities.description: Sol Central's civilian wellness and dining concourse — three levels of biosphere-grown cuisine, biotic wellness parlors, and the kind of manicured calm that comes standard with Confederacy citizenship.
facilities.satisfied_description: The biosphere restaurants are fully booked, the wellness parlors have a waiting list, and the concourse hums with the specific contentment of people who can afford to be well-rested. Efficiency and comfort, in equal measure.
facilities.degraded_description: But the biosphere kitchens are rationing seatings and the wellness parlors have suspended new appointments. For a civilization built on certified comfort, the uncertainty is its own kind of stress.
facilities.lore: The Halcyon Concourse sits directly above the Central Command biosphere, drawing its kitchens straight from the same hydroponic decks that feed the Confederacy's food security metrics. Solarian Gourmet Rations are plated here rather than vacuum-sealed, served in dining halls that could pass for a research symposium if not for the wine list. The Biotic Wellness Parlors occupy the quieter upper level: certified supplements, calibrated lighting, and staff who will earnestly explain the clinical trial data behind your facial treatment if asked. Visitors from other empires find it either the most relaxing place in known space or deeply unsettling in its orderliness. Both reactions are filed under 'expected.'

facilities.name: The Hot Shop
facilities.description: Imperator Dross's techs crack open salvaged power systems and repackage them into cells that mostly work. The shop's name comes from the temperature, the product, and the frequency of small explosions.

facilities.name: The Leviathan Table
facilities.description: A single long table under a viewing dome, one seating a night, and a waiting list measured in seasons. The menu is written around whatever leviathan the house has secured — there is nowhere more exclusive to eat in the sector.
facilities.satisfied_description: The bisque is running, a whole tail is on the pass, and the sommelier is pouring something that glows. Every seat is spoken for and the waiting list has stopped taking names.
facilities.degraded_description: The leviathan larder is bare and the kitchen is improvising around what's left. The room's still open — you don't close The Table — but tonight's guests can tell, and they are the last people you want able to tell.

facilities.name: The Long Watch
facilities.description: A bar for the crew, run by the crew. Nothing fancy — a counter, some stools, and someone who remembers everyone's usual. Keeps the crew happy, and happy crew work cheap.
facilities.satisfied_description: The Watch is open. Someone's telling a story that gets taller every time, the taps are cold, and the crew clocks in on time. Overhead everywhere else on the station runs a little lighter for it.
facilities.degraded_description: The Watch is dry — the water's been cut and the shelves are bare. Nobody's telling stories tonight. The crew's overhead has crept back up to full.

facilities.name: The Magazine Still
facilities.description: Hidden in the former weapons magazine of a salvaged destroyer. Copper tubing where munitions racks used to be.
facilities.lore: When the Patchwork was first assembled, someone noticed that the ventilation system in Destroyer Two's weapons magazine maintained a perfect 18°C year-round. Copper tubing appeared overnight. Then condensers. Then a queue. The station council voted 7-2 to legalize it rather than lose the revenue. Nobody's quite sure what goes in — the still operators source their ingredients from whatever's available. The results are... consistent. Haven's Promenade stocks it under the label 'Frontier Character.'

facilities.name: The Mint
facilities.description: Archon Mera's most closely guarded secret. Somewhere in the Sanctum's quiet corridors, trade crystals are being processed into ciphers indistinguishable from the 'unforgeable' originals produced at Haven. Mera finds this hilarious.

facilities.name: The Notice Board
facilities.description: A wall of handwritten job postings, IOUs, and bounty notices. No regulation, no guarantees, cash up front.
facilities.satisfied_description: The wall is thick with postings, new jobs pinned daily. The DEADBEATS section is short and the community polices itself. The system works.
facilities.degraded_description: Until it doesn't. The wall is mostly bare — no new postings in days, the communication feeds that supply remote jobs are down. The DEADBEATS section keeps growing.
facilities.lore: It's literally a wall. Bulkhead 7, Section C, Destroyer Two. People pin job offers, bounty notices, warnings, and the occasional love letter. There's no verification, no escrow, no dispute resolution. If someone stiffs you on payment, you pin their name to the wall under 'DEADBEATS' and the community handles the rest. The system works better than it should.

facilities.name: The Rally Point
facilities.description: The Citadel's off-duty deck: a mess hall, a bloodwine still-turned-bar, and a ring where crews settle scores the Fleet doesn't have time to mediate. Betting is heavy. Officers pretend not to notice.
facilities.satisfied_description: Bloodwine flows freely, the ration lines move fast, and the fighting ring below draws a packed, roaring crowd betting on whoever's left standing. Morale is as high as the noise level.
facilities.degraded_description: But the bloodwine casks have run dry and the mess hall is serving recycled protein paste. The ring still runs, but the crowds have thinned — nobody bets on an empty stomach.
facilities.lore: The Rally Point occupies the Citadel's lowest habitable deck, close enough to the forges that the mess hall doubles as an unofficial furnace-testing floor. Crimson Bloodwine is poured straight from the Fleet Forge Distillery's runoff line, and Ironhearth's ration blocks are reheated in bulk rather than plated — nobody here mistakes function for luxury. What draws the crowds is the ring: a shielded pit where off-duty crews settle disputes, run sparring exhibitions, and bet obscene sums on the outcome. Command tolerates it because a crew that's already fought each other fights less among itself in the field. The betting pool is technically illegal. The betting pool has never once been shut down.

facilities.name: The Red Room
facilities.description: Commandant Voss keeps his combat stim production close to the armory. The injectors are loaded, sealed, and tested on volunteers — though 'volunteer' is used loosely on Voss's station.

facilities.name: The Rusty Welcome
facilities.description: A welded-together tavern serving rotgut, spore spirits, and whatever the kitchen scavenged this week. The chairs don't match, the drinks are strong, and everyone with a working ship is welcome at the table.
facilities.satisfied_description: The rotgut is flowing, the spore spirits are in full supply, and the card games at the back tables have real stakes riding on them. Half the Frontier's gossip network runs through this room, and it shows.
facilities.degraded_description: But the still has gone dry and the kitchen's serving whatever didn't need refrigeration. The regulars are still here — the Frontier doesn't quit a bar over hard times — but the room's a lot quieter.
facilities.lore: The Rusty Welcome was built from three mismatched cargo containers and whatever the Patchwork's engineers weren't using that week, and it shows — the bar itself is a converted fuel tank, and the tables are a mix of salvage and pure improvisation. Frontier Rotgut and Spore Spirits are poured in equal measure, both distilled a few decks over and never quite the same batch twice. What keeps the place running isn't the drinks, though — it's the card tables in the back, where captains, mechanics, and the occasional visiting trader settle debts, trade rumors, and lose ships they shouldn't have bet. The Frontier Council has no jurisdiction here in any meaningful sense. Nobody's asked them to have one.

facilities.name: The Still Current
facilities.description: A pattern-shifting leisure gallery where soma vapors, drifting light, and quantum-tuned ambience blur the line between entertainment venue and collective meditation. Visitors report losing track of time — nobody's in a hurry to fix that.
facilities.satisfied_description: The chambers pulse in slow, synchronized color, soma vapor drifts thick through the lounges, and visitors drift with it — some for minutes, some for hours neither they nor the staff bother tracking. The Current is running deep.
facilities.degraded_description: But the soma reserves are running thin and the neural matrices powering the ambient synchronization have started to stutter. The Current feels shallow now, the colors a beat behind the room.
facilities.lore: The Still Current occupies a null-gravity gallery near the Nexus's core, where dimensional fractures bleed just enough ambient distortion to make the light behave strangely. Voidborn Neural Soma is dispensed in vaporized form through the gallery's circulation system rather than consumed directly, and banks of Neural Matrix processors — the same substrate used in Nexus computing infrastructure — run the synchronized light and sound patterns that give the space its name. The Pattern Council officially classifies it as a cultural facility rather than an entertainment venue, a distinction the Council has never satisfactorily explained to outsiders, or, some suspect, to itself. Non-Voidborn visitors are welcome. Voidborn visitors rarely leave on schedule.

facilities.name: The Synthesis Bay
facilities.description: Sovereign Crix allocated an entire deck to chemical processing. The ventilation barely keeps up. Workers rotate on four-hour shifts — any longer and the fumes start talking to you.

facilities.name: The Tide-Line
facilities.description: A raw bar built around a long ice trough — glintfin sliced to order, rivetshell shucked at the rail, and the platter tower going out under the lights. The first place in the sector to serve food cold and raw on purpose, and the sector has decided it's a delicacy.
facilities.satisfied_description: The ice trough is buried in shellfish, the knife hands haven't stopped, and every platter that leaves the pass turns three more heads. There's a wait for the rail and nobody minds it.
facilities.degraded_description: The ice is half melted and the case is down to yesterday's cuts — and yesterday's cut is the one thing a raw bar can't hide. The rail's gone quiet.

facilities.name: The Wire Room
facilities.description: Stage 2 of Mera's replica of Haven's two-step authentication monopoly. Forged cipher chips are finished into market-ready authenticators using gutter flux chemical bonding instead of Haven's precision copper-wire tooling.
facilities.lore: The Mint cracked the ciphers. The Wire Room finishes the job. Federation technicians use copper-wire contact arrays to embed cipher chips — a precision process that creates a tamper-evident physical bond: cut the wire, and the key self-destructs. Mera's chemists replicated the same bond using gutter flux: the solvent dissolves the chip's outer lattice, which re-hardens around the contact surfaces into something the Federation's own verification equipment classifies as authentic. Mera read the Federation's published rationale for why authenticators are unforgeable — the precise document explaining why counterfeiting is physically impossible — and gave it to her chemists as a specification sheet. They delivered in eleven days. She found this less funny than the cipher work. More satisfying.

facilities.name: Thermal Composite Plant
facilities.description: Industrial-scale facility with multiple reaction vessels and continuous cooling loops to manage the intense thermal demands of composite formation. Reinforced construction supports sustained high-temperature operation across expanded production cycles.

facilities.name: Thermal Extraction Complex
facilities.description: Fully automated facility featuring quantum-controlled cryogenic loops, precision-optic sensor alignment, and reinforced-frame assembly for high-speed enhanced harvester production.

facilities.name: Thermal Filtering Assembly
facilities.description: A compact production line that assembles ceramite plating, power cells, and circuit boards into sublimation filters for mining operations. Intake heating elements and vapor venting channels are precision-assembled for selective ice targeting.

facilities.name: Thermal Fin Production Plant

facilities.name: Thermal Hull Hardener Production Lab

facilities.name: Thermal Hull Hardener Workshop

facilities.name: Thermal Ice Extraction Line

facilities.name: Thermal Polymer Reactor

facilities.name: Thermal Shield Enhancement Plant

facilities.name: Thermal Shield Manufacturing Center

Shield emitters and matrices flow through precision thermal integration stations at maximum velocity, delivering superior thermal-resistant shield hardeners.

facilities.name: Thermonuclear Assembly Yard

facilities.name: Thermonuclear Cartridge Works

facilities.name: Thorium Conversion Works

facilities.name: Thorium Extraction Unit
facilities.description: Multi-stage leaching and crystallization facility with extensive lead shielding and radiation-hardened controls. Increases throughput through parallel extraction chambers and automated hazmat handling.

facilities.name: Thorium Fuel Rod Containment Vat

facilities.name: Thorium Fuel Rod Extraction Unit
facilities.description: A specialized extraction facility designed to handle contained thorium fuel with precision. Lead shielding and radiation-hardened controls protect the equipment while maintaining steady throughput.

facilities.name: Thorium Rod Foundry

facilities.name: Thrust Synthesis Station

facilities.name: Thruster Hack Shop
facilities.description: A straightforward production line for assembling basic afterburner units, integrating engine cores and flex polymers into functional speed-boost modules.

facilities.name: Thruster Manufacturing Complex
facilities.description: Industrial production with precision-machined titanium components, quantum-controlled xenon metering, and real-time thrust vectoring calibration. Precision optics align nozzle geometry to within fractions of a millimeter.

facilities.name: Thruster Nozzle Fabrication Line
facilities.description: A focused production line that processes ion solutions and titanium alloys through controlled heating and pressure stages, forming exhaust nozzles with precision bore alignment.

facilities.name: Thruster Production Complex
facilities.description: Industrial-scale production employing robotic arms for precision nozzle mounting, CNC-controlled bore alignment, and in-line testing loops that verify throttle response before unit completion.

facilities.name: Tide-Line Platter Station
facilities.description: A raw-bar assembly line with a shaved-ice well and a sauce rack, building the seafood tower plate by plate.

facilities.name: Time Anchor

facilities.name: Titanium Alloy Refinery
facilities.description: Large-scale industrial operation with parallel processing stages, extensive coolant circulation, and optimized plasma control for high-volume alloy production.

facilities.name: Titanium Foam Casting Station
facilities.description: A specialized furnace and casting system that melts titanium alloy and injects purified argon to create lightweight foam structures. Heat sinks manage the thermal cycling during foam solidification.

facilities.name: Titanium Foam Foundry System
facilities.description: Advanced facility featuring multiple parallel casting chambers with real-time density monitoring and automated temperature control. Extensive heat-sink and coolant-loop infrastructure enables one-second foam production cycles.

facilities.name: Titanium Foam Manufacturing Plant
facilities.description: Industrial-scale casting complex with redundant plasma injection systems and sophisticated coolant loops for rapid thermal cycling. Produces lightweight foam at high consistency and throughput.

facilities.name: Titanium Foam Production Line
facilities.description: An automated facility with plasma injection for precise gas distribution and controlled cooling. Heat sinks and plasma injectors work in tandem to achieve uniform foam density and porosity.
