facilities.description: Heavy-duty installation with reinforced construction, redundant plasma injectors, and sophisticated coolant networks to handle sustained high-temperature refining. Delivers ingots at industrial pace.

facilities.name: Titanium Refinery
facilities.description: Upgraded plant with plasma-assisted heating and improved thermal management, cutting cycle time significantly. Enhanced control systems maintain tight alloy specifications.

facilities.name: Titanium Refining Works
facilities.description: Expanded furnace complex with improved plasma injection and heat-sink support, reducing cycle time and improving alloy purity through staged thermal treatment.

facilities.name: Titanium Reinforcement Factory
facilities.description: Heavily automated facility featuring quantum-controlled fusion chambers, multi-stage coolant loops, and precision shield-matrix installation for rapid production of advanced bracing units.

facilities.name: Titanium Smelter
facilities.description: A specialized furnace engineered for titanium's high melting point, with basic ore feed and ingot casting. Slower than steel but purpose-built for the metal's demands.

facilities.name: Titanium Structural Assembly
facilities.description: Purpose-built line for bonding titanium ingots and graphene sheets into heavy bracing units, with control nodes managing layer fusion and shield-emitter integration.

facilities.name: Titanium Synthesis Forge
facilities.description: Advanced automated facility with real-time composition feedback, multi-stage plasma injection, and integrated cryo-cooling for continuous, near-instantaneous alloy synthesis.

facilities.name: Torpedo Assembly Line
facilities.description: Compact production facility that stages warhead assemblies, mounts tracking and sensor systems, and secures payloads into weapon housings. Steel construction handles the hazardous materials involved in ordnance assembly.

facilities.name: Torpedo Construction Yard
facilities.description: Expanded facility with multiple parallel assembly tracks for tracking system integration and durasteel plate welding. Improved structural framing and power cell installation accelerate throughput.

facilities.name: Torpedo Fabrication Line
facilities.description: Specialized facility for assembling durasteel plating, warhead assemblies, and circuit boards into heavy anti-capital torpedoes. Steady production supplies capital ship combat with powerful impact ordnance.

facilities.name: Torpedo Manufacturing Plant
facilities.description: Integrated weapons assembly system with dedicated weapon housings and barrel assemblies, nearly tripling output speed compared to basic lines. Structural reinforcement and control systems ensure warhead stability during assembly.

facilities.name: Tow Assembly Line
facilities.description: Larger facility with structural frames supporting faster bonding and assembly of tow components. Parallel stations process polymer attachment and control integration simultaneously.

facilities.name: Tow Engineering Complex
facilities.description: Fully automated high-speed facility producing tow rigs in seconds through quantum-controlled bonding and precision alignment. Reinforced structure and optical systems maintain tolerances at maximum throughput.

facilities.name: Tow Rig Assembly Station
facilities.description: A straightforward production line that bonds steel plates and flex polymers into tow rigs. Control nodes manage the attachment sequence and structural integrity checks before each unit ships.

facilities.name: Tow Systems Manufactory
facilities.description: Industrial plant equipped with quantum control cores and precision optics to ensure exact alignment of tow attachment points. Reinforced frames enable rapid assembly of high-tolerance rigs.

facilities.name: Tow Systems Production Plant
facilities.description: A large-scale automated factory with quantum control cores and precision optics for fine-tuning tow mechanics, producing high-efficiency rigs with advanced speed-preservation algorithms.

facilities.name: Tracking Computer I Assembly Facility
facilities.description: Precision manufacturing environment with quantum control core integration, optical component alignment rigs, and automated burn-in testing that stresses targeting algorithms under simulated combat scenarios.

facilities.name: Tracking Computer I Production Lab
facilities.description: Multi-stage facility with dedicated stations for processing-core insertion, sensor array calibration, and circuit-board integration, featuring in-process quality gates that verify tracking accuracy before final packaging.

facilities.name: Tracking Computer I Technology Nexus
facilities.description: Cutting-edge production system combining photonic assembly, quantum processor embedding, and machine-learning-optimized calibration to produce tracking computers with microsecond-level response times.

facilities.name: Tracking Computer I Workshop
facilities.description: Modular assembly line integrating processing cores, tracking systems, and circuit boards through precision sockets and automated test benches that validate sensor responsiveness and targeting latency.

facilities.name: Tracking Computer II Assembly Facility
facilities.description: Heavy-duty production environment with precision optical workstations, quantum control core integration, and rigorous validation protocols ensuring fast-target lock capability meets military specifications.

facilities.name: Tracking Computer II Production Lab
facilities.description: Larger manufacturing facility with separate workflow streams for tracking-system pairing, optical fiber fusion, and circuit-board population, then merged for final processing-core integration and functional testing.

facilities.name: Tracking Computer II Technology Nexus
facilities.description: State-of-the-art facility employing photonic waveguide assembly, automated optical alignment lasers, and AI-driven calibration to produce tracking computers capable of acquiring hypersonic targets.

facilities.name: Tracking Computer II Workshop
facilities.description: Purpose-built production line handling dual tracking systems and optical fiber routing, with precision jigs for bundle alignment and integrated test harnesses validating multi-target acquisition.

facilities.name: Tracking Mine Launcher Forge
facilities.description: Industrial-scale production employing robotic warhead integration, precision sensor-array alignment, and automated targeting-computer calibration with environmental stress testing for autonomous pursuit verification.

facilities.name: Tracking Mine Launcher Foundry
facilities.description: State-of-the-art fully automated facility with coolant-loop integration for heat management, quantum targeting-computer embedding, and real-time autonomous-behavior simulation ensuring each launcher achieves optimal prey acquisition.

facilities.name: Tracking Mine Launcher Workshop
facilities.description: Multi-station manufacturing facility with parallel warhead staging, tracking-system embedding, and weapon-housing assembly lines that merge for final barrel installation and tracking-accuracy testing.

facilities.name: Tracking System Assembly Line
facilities.description: Purpose-built production line routing sensor arrays and circuit boards through precision assembly stations, with crystal-focusing optics integration and automated range-testing to validate target-lock response.

facilities.name: Tractor Beam Line
facilities.description: A magnetic projector line combining towing and short-range tackle hardware.

facilities.name: Trade Concourse
facilities.description: A trading floor built and staffed by the faction itself — order boards, a settlement desk, and a ledger nobody outside the crew gets to see.
facilities.satisfied_description: Order boards update in real time. The settlement desk clears trades as fast as they come in, bearer ciphers verified and logged.
facilities.degraded_description: The settlement desk has stopped verifying trades — nobody's willing to risk a bad cipher on an unbacked authenticator. Orders pile up unmatched.

facilities.name: Trade Crystal Facetry
facilities.description: A Nebula-pattern cutting bench that cleaves raw trade crystals along their natural lattice planes and polishes the facets into weapon-ready focusing optics. Palladium-free precision — the crystal's own structure does the focusing.

facilities.name: Trade Exchange
facilities.description: Organized trading floor with automated order matching and price boards.
facilities.satisfied_description: Neon price boards glow with real-time data. Order matching hums along at full speed, traders crowding the floor.
facilities.degraded_description: But something's off — price boards display stale data with intermittent gaps, order matching running in degraded mode with noticeable delays.

facilities.name: Trade Ledger
facilities.description: A dusty logbook chained to a desk in the corner of the trading floor. Members jot down prices they saw at other stations — not always accurate, but better than nothing.

facilities.name: Trade Nexus
facilities.description: Major commercial exchange with high-frequency order processing and cross-market data feeds.
facilities.satisfied_description: Cross-market feeds stream in from across the sector. High-frequency order matching processes thousands of transactions per cycle.
facilities.degraded_description: Or it should be. Right now, cross-market feeds drop in and out, order processing crawls, and the backlog grows longer each cycle.

facilities.name: Trading Booth
facilities.description: A small booth on the trading floor with your faction's banner. Traders know where to find you now.

facilities.name: Trading Office
facilities.description: A private office overlooking the exchange floor with direct terminal access and preferential fee structures. You skip the queues and the markups.
facilities.satisfied_description: Direct exchange access, priority processing, and a fee schedule that makes competitors nervous. This is how professionals trade.
facilities.degraded_description: The direct terminal access is spotty and your preferential rates have been... renegotiated. Still better than the public terminals.

facilities.name: Transcendent Aggression Engine
facilities.description: Cutting-edge facility with extensive coolant networks and redundant control systems ensuring consistent molecular integration. Reinforced frames support massive reaction vessels where exotic elements and neural extracts combine under carefully orchestrated conditions.

facilities.name: Transcendent Regeneration Core
facilities.description: State-of-the-art facility with massive coolant networks, redundant reactor arrays, and real-time composition monitoring. Produces regeneration serum at industrial scale with minimal batch variance and maximum bio-nanite viability.

facilities.name: Transit Concourse
facilities.description: A sweeping multi-gate concourse with priority lanes, a members' bar, and departure boards visible from orbit — the beating heart of a real passenger airline. Holds up to 150 connecting passengers and extends each checked-in passenger's fare deadline by 360 ticks (once per journey), keeping long multi-leg itineraries profitable.

facilities.name: Transit Lounge
facilities.description: A roped-off corner of the concourse with hard plastic seats and a departures board that mostly works. Faction ships can drop connecting passengers here (unload_passenger target=lounge) for other members to fly onward (load_passenger picks them up alongside the platform queue) — fares and fare deadlines carry over, and whoever completes the delivery collects the full fare. Layover passengers spend a little at the station's dining and leisure amenities while they wait, and the departures board warns your faction when anyone is about to miss their connection — a passenger whose fare deadline runs out mid-layover walks out to the public pickup queue and the fare is gone. Holds up to 20 passengers. Upgrade to a Transit Terminal (L2) for more seats and a fare-deadline extension for connecting passengers.

facilities.name: Transit Terminal
facilities.description: A proper terminal wing with comfortable seating, luggage handling, and staff who actually announce departures. Holds up to 60 connecting passengers, and the smoother layover extends each checked-in passenger's fare deadline by 180 ticks (once per journey — and a later deadline also means a bigger speed bonus left on the onward leg). Upgrade to a Transit Concourse (L3) for capital-hub capacity.

facilities.name: Transition Fabrication
facilities.description: Specialized production facility with expanded dark-matter cell arrays and advanced quantum stabilization to enable controlled handling of exotic materials at higher volumes. Structural frames support the containment infrastructure required for continuous production.

facilities.name: Trauma Clinic
facilities.description: A dedicated casualty clinic with surgical suites, recovery bays, and continuous diagnostic coverage.
facilities.satisfied_description: Surgical teams rotate between stocked theatres while recovery crews return patients to their ships.
facilities.degraded_description: Only one theatre remains supplied, forcing triage staff to defer injuries that should be routine.

facilities.name: Treasure Cache Market
facilities.description: No-questions-asked trading floor. The only place you can sell contraband outside pirate space.
facilities.satisfied_description: The trading floor hums with activity. Nobody is asking where anything came from, and everyone prefers it that way.
facilities.degraded_description: Half the terminals are down, which somehow hasn't slowed business at all. Deals are closing by handshake in the corner.

facilities.name: Tritium Cryo-Extractor
facilities.description: A cryogenic refinery that freezes and liquefies tritium ice into fusion-grade fuel. Heat sinks and plasma injection systems manage the extreme cold required to liquefy the volatile isotope.

facilities.name: Tritium Pearl Enricher
facilities.description: A reactor-grade enricher that draws glacier-drifter tritium pearls down into high-grade power cells.

facilities.name: Tritium Processing Complex
facilities.description: State-of-the-art installation featuring advanced coolant circulation and plasma injection arrays that achieve near-instantaneous liquefaction. Full automation and redundant cryogenic systems enable continuous fusion-fuel production.

facilities.name: Tungsten Core Press
facilities.description: Automated production line that stamps tungsten ore into hardened penetrator tips and loads them into steel casings with precision seating. Control nodes manage pressure and alignment during the hardening and assembly process.

facilities.name: Tungsten Drawing Frame
facilities.description: A specialized refining line that melts and extrudes tungsten ore into dense rods for kinetic weapons. Steel frame and basic heating systems manage the high-temperature draw process.

facilities.name: Tungsten Processing Works
facilities.description: Heavy industrial complex with ore pretreatment, high-temperature casting furnaces, precision boring, and multi-stage case assembly. Targeting computers monitor density and concentricity; weapon housing and barrel components are optimized for maximum penetration.

facilities.name: Tungsten Rod Mill
facilities.description: Industrial-scale facility with plasma-assisted heating and precision coolant loops to rapidly process ore into penetrator-grade rods. Higher throughput and tighter dimensional tolerances than the basic line.

facilities.name: Tungsten Sintering Furnace
facilities.description: Powder-metallurgy furnace that sinters tungsten into the iron melt for a denser, harder plate while stretching each batch of iron further.

facilities.name: Tungsten Slug Caster
facilities.description: A dedicated smelting and casting line that processes tungsten ore into heavy penetrators, then presses and seals them into reinforced cases with steel backing. Designed for the slow, deliberate work of handling dense, refractory materials.

facilities.name: Tungsten Steel Mill
facilities.description: Parallel sintering line with metered tungsten powder feed and fuel cell-driven furnace control. Produces consistent batches of dense alloy steel.

facilities.name: Tungsten Synthesis Hub
facilities.description: State-of-the-art multi-stage extraction and forming system with redundant plasma injection and closed-loop cryogenic cooling. Achieves maximum density and consistency for premium kinetic rounds.

facilities.name: Turret Assembly Line
facilities.description: A dedicated production line that integrates weapon cores, barrel assemblies, and durasteel plating into functional defense emplacements. Control nodes coordinate targeting system initialization before each turret leaves the line.

facilities.name: Turtle Compound Bioreactor
facilities.description: A pharmaceutical line for concentrated defensive compounds.

facilities.name: UF6 Conversion Unit
facilities.description: Scaled-up synthesis facility with enhanced containment and automated feed systems. Multiple reaction chambers and reinforced lead shielding increase throughput while maintaining strict isolation from station atmosphere.

facilities.name: Ultra-Enrichment Complex
facilities.description: State-of-the-art cascade enrichment system with plasma-assisted separation and cryogenic cooling loops, achieving near-instantaneous conversion of low-enriched uranium to highly enriched fissile material.

facilities.name: Ultra-Precision Heavy Weapons System
facilities.description: State-of-the-art fabrication complex with active coolant loops for heat management during exotic-matter handling, quantum control systems for gravitational calibration, and fully automated targeting computer integration. Produces weapons capable of accelerating massive projectiles with devastating precision.

facilities.name: Umbral Stout Brewery
facilities.description: Dark fermenters and aging casks for a light-drinking stout.

facilities.name: Universal Nav Core Complex
facilities.description: State-of-the-art facility with triple-redundant coolant loops and maximum plasma injection capacity, achieving near-instantaneous dark matter conditioning and seamless navigation core assembly.

facilities.name: Unmarked Munitions Line
facilities.description: An armory line that forges ghost rounds with every maker's mark and energy signature deliberately omitted. The weapon housings and barrel assemblies are sourced through channels that don't keep records. Pirate stations only.

facilities.name: Untraceable Arms Plant
facilities.description: Framed assembly bays running parallel barrel and housing lines, all of it feeding rounds that leave forensics with nothing to write down. Quality control is exceptional — these strongholds won't sell ordnance that jams.

facilities.name: Uranium Hexafluoride Containment Vat
facilities.description: Specialized packaging facility for uranium hexafluoride with corrosion-resistant liners and lead-shielded hoppers. Processes gaseous and liquid hexafluoride into sealed hazmat containers with radiation protection.

facilities.name: Uranium Hexafluoride Extraction Unit
facilities.description: A corrosive-resistant extraction system designed to safely separate UF6 gas from its containment. Lead-lined construction and radiation-hardened controls manage the volatile compound with steady output.

facilities.name: Uranium Leach Pad
facilities.description: A lead-shielded acid-leaching vessel designed to dissolve uranium ore and precipitate yellowcake concentrate. Operates with radiation-hardened controls and hazmat containment for safe processing.

facilities.name: Uranium Ore Processor
facilities.description: Heavy-duty refinery with cascading leach stages, solvent recovery, and integrated hazmat systems operating under full radiation protection. Produces yellowcake concentrate at industrial scale with consistent high purity.

facilities.name: Uranium Rod Complex
facilities.description: Fully automated nuclear fuel production facility featuring comprehensive lead radiation barriers, redundant hazmat containment, and advanced coolant loops for thermal management during intensive enrichment cycles. Produces weapons-grade enrichment material with exceptional purity.

facilities.name: Uranium Rod Fabricator
facilities.description: A heavily shielded centrifugal separator using lead-lined containment to process low-enriched uranium into fuel-grade rods. Radiation-hardened controls prevent equipment degradation from sustained neutron exposure.

facilities.name: Uranium Rod Plant
facilities.description: Dedicated uranium processing plant with multi-stage separation chambers and reinforced lead shielding throughout. Structural frames support the weight of protective barriers while radiation-hardened circuitry manages the sensitive enrichment process.

facilities.name: Uranium Rod Refinery
facilities.description: Large-scale enrichment complex with extensive lead shielding, hazmat-rated containment vessels, and precision control systems for consistent fuel-rod output. Achieves higher enrichment levels through optimized centrifugal separation.

facilities.name: Vanadium Alloy Mill
facilities.description: Double-stack smelting line with metered vanadium dosing and fuel cell-driven temperature control. Burns hotter and faster for consistent alloy-steel batches.

facilities.name: Vanadium Forge
facilities.description: Smelter with a vanadium injection lance that micro-alloys the iron pour, stretching each batch into more usable plate.

facilities.name: Vat Protein Loaf Galley
facilities.description: A canteen bakery line turning vatflesh curd into sliceable loaves.

facilities.name: Vatflesh Culture Vat
facilities.description: Sterile culture tanks that set cultured protein into a firm, sliceable vatflesh curd.

facilities.name: Vault Welding Line
facilities.description: Purpose-built welding and assembly line for fabricating reinforced storage vaults from durasteel plates and circuit boards. Produces secure containers at steady industrial pace.

facilities.name: Velocity Enhancement Lab
facilities.description: An expanded facility with enhanced engine core processing and sensor array integration, significantly increasing production speed while refining thrust calibration.

facilities.name: Verdigris Kefir Bar
facilities.description: Culturing crocks that set a tangy copper-blue kefir from verdigris curd.

facilities.name: Verdigris Smeltery
facilities.description: A simple smeltery that bakes veil-ray copper curd into clean piping.

facilities.name: Void Cannon Assembly Line
facilities.description: Purpose-built production line for void crystal integration and weapon housing assembly. Barrel components are fitted and aligned under controlled conditions to channel void energy.

facilities.name: Void Cannon Foundry
facilities.description: Heavy-duty production facility featuring quantum control cores for precision void energy calibration and multiple targeting computers for synchronized assembly. Reinforced frames support the intense electromagnetic fields.

facilities.name: Void Capacitor Assembly Line
facilities.description: Specialized production line for processing null matter and bonding superconductors to shield emitters. Hull plating and reinforced bulkheads form the structural shell for dimensional energy storage.

facilities.name: Void Compression Cell
facilities.description: A specialized refining line that subjects void condensate to controlled plasma injection and precision cooling to form stable void crystals. Multiple heat sinks and plasma injectors work in sequence to stabilize the exotic matter.

facilities.name: Void Containment Lab
facilities.description: Expanded facility with larger structural frames and additional barrel assembly stations, enabling parallel void crystal processing and faster housing assembly cycles.

facilities.name: Void Crystal Breacher
facilities.description: A specialized facility with cryogenic stabilization and exotic-matter containment chambers, carefully synthesizing void crystals and stabilized exotics into packable energy cores. Heavy coolant circulation maintains the extreme thermal and energetic isolation required.

facilities.name: Void Crystallization Plant
facilities.description: Heavy-duty mass-production facility featuring extensive coolant loops and multiplied plasma injection points for sustained high-volume output. The massive heat sink array enables near-continuous operation with minimal thermal stress.

facilities.name: Void Distillery
facilities.description: A specialized refining line equipped with plasma injectors and heat sinks to safely compress void essence into stable condensate through controlled energy injection.

facilities.name: Void Dust Synthesis Complex
facilities.description: An industrial hallucinogen plant with parallel sealed chambers, exhaustive air reclamation, and quantum-controlled reactions monitored down to the particle. Produces void dust at a scale that keeps the outer systems perpetually drifting. No windows, for a reason.

facilities.name: Void Energy Dispenser
facilities.description: Fuel dispensed through dimensional taps that pull energy directly into your tanks. The process feels wrong but the readings are perfect.
facilities.satisfied_description: Sympathetic resonance flows smoothly, fuel cells charging through dimensional alignment. Your instruments confirm perfect energy states despite the wrongness.
facilities.degraded_description: In theory. Dimensional taps stutter and misfire, fuel cells charging erratically. The wrongness intensifies into dread as readings fluctuate wildly.
facilities.lore: The dispensers bypass conventional fuel transfer entirely, inducing energy states in your existing fuel cells through what the Voidborn call 'sympathetic resonance.' Instrument readings confirm full charge. Ship AIs confirm full charge. Pilots confirm a persistent feeling that something is watching them through their fuel gauge.

facilities.name: Void Espresso Bar
facilities.description: An espresso station dosing gloomcap coffee with void-charged ichor.

facilities.name: Void-Ichor Consomme Galley
facilities.description: A darkened clarification station for a broth that glows on its own.

facilities.name: Void-Ichor Liqueur Bar
facilities.description: A sealed still and cold room for a liqueur that glows and oxidises if you dawdle.

facilities.name: Void Lance Assembly Line
facilities.description: Specialized production line focusing void condensate through crystalline lattice arrays and into weapon housings. Barrel assemblies are precision-aligned to channel destructive void beams.

facilities.name: Void Lance I Forge
facilities.description: Heavy-duty production incorporating quantum control cores for void energy focusing and targeting computers for beam calibration. Reinforced frames support the intense energy channeling infrastructure.

facilities.name: Void Lance I Foundry
facilities.description: Fully automated state-of-the-art facility with extensive coolant loops managing quantum control and targeting systems, achieving rapid sequential void lance production through parallel condensate conditioning.

facilities.name: Void Lance I Workshop
facilities.description: Expanded facility with structural frames supporting larger crystalline lattice arrays and multiple parallel barrel assembly stations. Increased weapon housing throughput enables faster beam weapon production.

facilities.name: Void Lattice Foundry
facilities.description: State-of-the-art facility combining dark-matter cells, gravity generators, and shield emitters in a unified synthesis framework. Active coolant loops and quantum-grade controls enable rapid exotic-crystal formation while safely containing extreme quantum phenomena.

facilities.name: Void Matter Manufacturing Complex
facilities.description: A fully automated cutting-edge facility with advanced coolant networks and containment systems of unknown specification. Produces its classified product at maximum efficiency through methods the Collective declines to elaborate upon.

facilities.name: Void Mine Assembly Line
facilities.description: Heavy-duty production line for void crystal handling and warhead integration into dimensional-rift mines. Weapon housing and barrel components provide containment for the volatile void essence used in each unit.

facilities.name: Void Mine Complex
facilities.description: Fully automated facility for void crystal processing, quantum-stabilized essence integration, and multi-stage warhead assembly. Extensive coolant circulation and precision targeting systems produce void mines with maximum dimensional-breach reliability.

facilities.name: Void Mine Launcher Assembly
facilities.description: A compact production line dedicated to assembling rift-mine deployment systems. Tracking systems and void crystal matrices are integrated into weapon housings under controlled atmospheric conditions to prevent dimensional instability.

facilities.name: Void Mine Launcher Forge
facilities.description: Industrial-scale production with parallel assembly lines and automated charge-loading systems. Targeting computers are factory-calibrated to each launcher's dimensional signature before shipment, ensuring consistent rift-mine deployment accuracy.

facilities.name: Void Mine Launcher Foundry
facilities.description: Fully automated facility with active coolant circulation maintaining cryogenic conditions around antimatter charges. Quantum control cores direct robotic assembly of each launcher with microsecond timing precision, preventing dimensional cascade failures.

facilities.name: Void Mine Launcher Workshop
facilities.description: A larger plant with separate machining and assembly zones. Barrel assemblies are pre-fabricated, then integrated with tracking systems and contained antimatter charges in isolated containment bays before final housing assembly.

facilities.name: Void Mine Plant
facilities.description: Specialized facility with dedicated void crystal processing, essence containment protocols, and warhead assembly integration. Larger-scale operation reduces per-unit cycle time while maintaining structural integrity of the rift-triggering munitions.

facilities.name: Void Mine Works
facilities.description: Industrial ordnance factory with parallel void crystal preparation, quantum-controlled essence containment, and precision warhead integration. Targeting computers and barrel assemblies enable accurate deployment of dimensional-rift weapons.

facilities.name: Void Nanite Array
facilities.description: An expanded facility with enhanced coolant systems supporting processes that remain classified. Improved efficiency suggests significant technical advancement over baseline production capacity.

facilities.name: Void Nanite Synthesizer
facilities.description: An industrial facility of undisclosed operational parameters producing a suspension of equally undisclosed composition. Standard equipment configurations mask its true function.

facilities.name: Void Nexus Exchange
facilities.description: The Voidborn's probability-field trading network, interfaced for organic users via Haven trade ciphers.
facilities.satisfied_description: Probability fields shimmer with perfect coherence, matching trades through patterns that feel inevitable in hindsight. The ciphers translate flawlessly.
facilities.degraded_description: Not today. Probability calculations stutter and mismatch, trades completing with unsettling delays. The ciphers flicker with corrupted symbols that hurt to read.
facilities.lore: Trade at the Nexus operates through probability fields rather than conventional order books. Buyers and sellers are matched through patterns only the Voidborn claim to understand. The ciphers imported from Haven provide the one concession to organic logic: verifiable transaction records.

facilities.name: Void Ordnance Assembly
facilities.description: Industrial-scale facility with array of containment reactors, advanced cryogenic management, and high-volume coolant loops maintaining precise temperature and pressure gradients. Automated staging and quality verification accelerate synthesis cycles.

facilities.name: Void Reactor Containment Lab
facilities.description: A remote-operated containment line for assembling singularity-powered ship reactors.

facilities.name: Void Refinery Station
facilities.description: Heavy-duty industrial equipment with extensive heat management through multiple heat sinks and coolant loops, alongside enhanced plasma injectors for sustained high-volume void condensation.

facilities.name: Void Resonance Fabricator
facilities.description: Cutting-edge manufacturing center with maximal coolant circulation, quantum control infrastructure, and multiplied emitter capacity. Produces the most advanced adaptive quantum shields at peak throughput and reliability.

facilities.name: Void Shaper Facility
facilities.description: Fully autonomous production achieving sub-20-second cycle times through quantum control optimization and redundant cooling arrays maintaining cryogenic conditions throughout assembly.

facilities.name: Void Shield Matrix Complex
facilities.description: Cutting-edge facility with redundant quantum control cores, extensive shield-emitter arrays, and cryogenic stabilization loops enabling rapid synthesis of void-defensive matrices at maximum throughput.

facilities.name: Void Shield Weaving Forge
facilities.description: Specialized facility for binding null matter, fury alloy, and crystal lattice into shield matrices. Equipped with shielded containment chambers and matrix emitters for dimensional-grade defensive components.

facilities.name: Void Shield Weaving Plant
facilities.description: Larger production facility with multiple containment bays and redundant shield-emitter arrays, capable of handling higher volumes of exotic matter fusion and matrix crystallization.

facilities.name: Void Shield Weaving Works
facilities.description: Large-scale operation combining quantum control systems with advanced shield-emitter networks and precision coolant circulation to stabilize null-matter weaving at production speeds.

facilities.name: Void Strike Ordnance Plant
facilities.description: Industrial-scale production with parallel assembly tracks and automated phase-coherence verification at each stage. Targeting computers are integrated and factory-calibrated to each launcher's void-crystal configuration before completion.

facilities.name: Void-Tuned EM Line
facilities.description: A shielded calibration line for void-harmonic EM charges.

facilities.name: Volumetric Optimization Nexus
facilities.description: State-of-the-art high-speed facility with robotic material handling, inline bonding verification, and continuous curing. Optimized logistics and minimal downtime enable maximum throughput per cycle.

facilities.name: War Market
facilities.description: The Crimson Fleet's military exchange and arms bazaar, armored in titanium alloy and secured by Haven ciphers.
facilities.satisfied_description: Armored terminals flash with real-time prices, traders barking orders across the alloy-plated floor. Every deal closes fast — the Fleet doesn't tolerate inefficiency.
facilities.degraded_description: Not today. Half the terminals display error codes, and cipher verification crawls. Traders resort to handshake deals in the corridors, which the Fleet pretends not to notice.
facilities.lore: In the Crimson Fleet, commerce is war by other means. The War Market runs on intimidation as much as credits — but the prices are fair, because the Fleet needs suppliers alive. The trading terminals are reinforced with alloy plating, and every transaction is cipher-verified.

facilities.name: Warbird Assembly Line
facilities.description: An expanded facility with dedicated assembly stations for chassis integration, weapon core mounting, and AI core initialization. Structural frames and additional drone chassis inventory enable higher production throughput and more reliable assembly.

facilities.name: Warehouse
facilities.description: Industrial-scale storage with automated retrieval and cataloging systems.
facilities.satisfied_description: Robotic retrievers glide along racks under inert atmosphere. Cataloging systems index every item to the gram.
facilities.degraded_description: When properly supplied. Retrievers stall on corroded rails, the inert atmosphere has thinned, and some reactive materials need manual handling.

facilities.name: Warhead Assembly Line
facilities.description: Specialized production facility for explosive payload assembly, combining steel, circuitry, and polymer materials into stable warhead units. Automated handling ensures consistent quality and safe processing.

facilities.name: Warhead Assembly Plant
facilities.description: Expanded production complex with dedicated guidance-system testing and barrel-assembly fabrication lines. Output increased to one launcher per 5 minutes.

facilities.name: Warhead Fabrication Complex
facilities.description: State-of-the-art warhead production system with cryogenic coolant loops managing thermal stress during assembly. Produces complete warheads in seconds via fully integrated automated workflows.

facilities.name: Warhead Fabrication Plant
facilities.description: Dedicated warhead fabrication complex with segregated assembly zones and enhanced material flow. Output rate jumps substantially through optimized tooling and batch processing.

facilities.name: Warhead Fabrication Works
facilities.description: Heavy-duty manufacturing facility running quantum-controlled precision assembly for warhead cores. Targeting computers and advanced automation enable rapid, repeatable warhead production.

facilities.name: Warhead Slug Assembly Plant
facilities.description: Integrated facility with weapon housing and barrel assembly components feeding into the shaping process. Production coordination ensures warhead alignment and explosive charge consistency across each slug batch.

facilities.name: Warp Beacon Foundry
facilities.description: Heavy-duty production plant with reinforced structural support for scaled-up coolant circulation and control systems. Simultaneous calibration of multiple beacon units reduces per-unit time to under a minute.

facilities.name: Warp Coil Assembly
facilities.description: A purpose-built facility for refining exotic crystals and quantum matrices into jump drive cores. Includes dark matter cell storage and basic quantum stabilization infrastructure.

facilities.name: Warp Core Assembly Line
facilities.description: A specialized production facility with dark-matter containment and cryogenic systems for assembling faster-than-light cores. Quantum stabilizers and control nodes work in tandem to manage exotic materials and jump-coil integration.

facilities.name: Warp Core Manufacturing Plant
facilities.description: An expanded industrial facility with reinforced structural frames and increased dark-matter storage. Enhanced quantum control capabilities and gravity-field infrastructure boost output significantly.

facilities.name: Warp Core Production Megafactory
facilities.description: State-of-the-art fully automated facility with extensive shield emitter arrays and distributed coolant systems managing extreme operational demands. Produces warp cores at maximum throughput with continuous dimensional and exotic-matter verification.

facilities.name: Warp Core Stabilizer Assembly Facility
facilities.description: Industrial-scale production with integrated gravity generators and coolant circulation for managing thermal loads. High-volume assembly of complex sensor arrays and superconductor circuits drives increased output.

facilities.name: Warp Core Stabilizer Production Lab
facilities.description: An enlarged facility with reinforced structural frames and expanded dark-matter handling capacity. Quantum control cores and gravity-field generators enable faster assembly of sensor and power-distribution subsystems.

facilities.name: Warp Core Stabilizer Technology Nexus
facilities.description: Fully automated cutting-edge plant with distributed shield emitters and extensive coolant infrastructure. Produces warp disruptors at maximum efficiency through simultaneous multi-stage assembly and continuous sensor validation.

facilities.name: Warp Core Stabilizer Workshop
facilities.description: A focused production line equipped with dark-matter cells and quantum stabilization for assembling warp-stabilization modules. Sensor array integration and power-cell handling are managed through precision control nodes.

facilities.name: Warp Disruptor Assembly Facility
facilities.description: Industrial-scale production with integrated gravity generators and coolant circulation for managing thermal loads. High-volume assembly of complex sensor arrays and superconductor circuits drives increased output.

facilities.name: Warp Disruptor Production Lab
facilities.description: An enlarged facility with reinforced structural frames and expanded dark-matter handling capacity. Quantum control cores and gravity-field generators enable faster assembly of sensor and power-distribution subsystems.

facilities.name: Warp Disruptor Technology Nexus
facilities.description: Fully automated cutting-edge plant with distributed shield emitters and extensive coolant infrastructure. Produces warp disruptors at maximum efficiency through simultaneous multi-stage assembly and continuous sensor validation.

facilities.name: Warp Disruptor Workshop
facilities.description: A focused production line equipped with dark-matter cells and quantum stabilization for assembling warp-prevention modules. Sensor array integration and power-cell handling are managed through precision control nodes.

facilities.name: Warp Scrambler Assembly Facility
facilities.description: Heavy-duty industrial production with integrated gravity-field stabilization and coolant systems. High-volume assembly of dual sensor arrays and advanced circuit boards achieves significant throughput gains.

facilities.name: Warp Scrambler Production Lab
facilities.description: An expanded facility with reinforced frames and increased dark-matter storage, improving assembly speed. Multiple quantum control cores and gravity generators support faster integration of complex sensor and circuit subsystems.

facilities.name: Warp Scrambler Technology Nexus
facilities.description: Fully automated production megafacility with shield emitter arrays and extensive coolant distribution. Produces warp scramblers at peak efficiency through simultaneous multi-stage assembly and real-time functional verification.

facilities.name: Warp Scrambler Workshop
facilities.description: A specialized production line with dark-matter cells and quantum control nodes for assembling jump-prevention systems. Dual sensor arrays and superconductor circuits are integrated through precision containment protocols.

facilities.name: Warp Stabilizer Line
facilities.description: A field-tuning line for disposable disruption immunity packs.

facilities.name: Water Reclamation Workshop
facilities.description: A mid-scale facility assembling water-cracking modules in parallel, with structural frames supporting expanded heat-sink handling. Copper piping channels coolant while processing cores tune each unit's electrolysis circuit.

facilities.name: Water Recycler Facility
facilities.description: Industrial-scale production with advanced processing cores and precision optics for contamination detection. Reinforced structural support and quantum control integration drive high-volume recycler assembly.

facilities.name: Water Recycler Hub
facilities.description: Fully automated precision plant with distributed sensor arrays and extensive precision optics. Produces purification systems at maximum efficiency with continuous quality validation and real-time contamination monitoring.

facilities.name: Water Recycler Plant
facilities.description: An expanded facility with processing cores and sensor arrays for quality control. Structural frames and precision assembly enable faster throughput of purification systems.

facilities.name: Water Recycler Workshop
facilities.description: A compact production line for assembling closed-loop purification units. Flex polymer molding and steel integration are handled through standard control automation.

facilities.name: Water Treatment Complex
facilities.description: A full municipal treatment stack: ice intake conveyors, chlorine contact basins, and clean-water reservoirs sized for a station district. Downstream taps never know the difference.

facilities.name: Weapon Assembly Line
facilities.description: A specialized production line that forges fury alloy and darksteel into weapon cores, then assembles barrel and housing components. Heat sinks are mounted and tested to ensure proper thermal management during operation.

facilities.name: Weapon Battery Assembly Line
facilities.description: A specialized production line that assembles weapon housings, cores, and targeting systems into integrated battery platforms. Copper piping and steel framework provide the structural foundation for multi-unit weapon mounts.

facilities.name: Weapon Battery Manufacturing Complex
facilities.description: Industrial-scale production with parallel assembly and precision alignment systems for multi-mechanism coordination. Heavy investment in reinforced frames and docking rings enables rapid sequential battery output.

facilities.name: Weapon Battery Production Foundry
facilities.description: State-of-the-art facility with fully automated assembly, targeting calibration, and hardening processes operating in continuous flow. Massive material throughput and redundant control systems achieve sub-30-second cycle times.

facilities.name: Weapon Bay Assembly Line
facilities.description: Dedicated production facility that integrates weapon cores with ammunition fabricators and fury-alloy reinforcement into ordnance deployment systems. Barrel assembly and targeting integration occur across a 7-minute production cycle.

facilities.name: Weapon Boost Station
facilities.description: An efficient production facility with integrated coolant loops to manage thermal output during power cell charging and plasma-core bonding. Structural frames provide rigidity for high-voltage electrical pathways.

facilities.name: Weapon Core Assembly Station
facilities.description: A focused production line integrating tungsten rods, steel plates, and power batteries into unified control units. Basic copper piping and control nodes manage power distribution and signal routing.

facilities.name: Weapon Core Production Facility
facilities.description: Advanced production facility featuring quantum-control calibration equipment and precision optic alignment systems. Specialized handling ensures quantum components remain stable throughout assembly.

facilities.name: Weapon Housing Fabrication Line
facilities.description: A precision metalworking line that bonds titanium alloy and copper wiring into weapon-grade housings with integrated power conduits and structural reinforcement.

facilities.name: Weapon Integrator Line
facilities.description: A compact assembly line that mounts targeting systems and firing mechanisms onto drone frames. Steel structure and copper wiring carry power and control signals to each assembly station.

facilities.name: Weapons Assembly
facilities.description: An expanded production facility with multiple forming stations, sensor arrays, and processing cores that rapidly assemble and test weapon housings for power integrity and structural consistency.

facilities.name: Weapons Assembly Plant
facilities.description: Dedicated facility with plutonium handling systems, precision durasteel machining, and circuit integration stations. Weapon housing components provide radiation shielding and structural containment during assembly and storage.

facilities.name: Weapons-Grade Centrifuge Bank
facilities.description: Advanced multi-stage cascade of precision centrifuges with integrated hazmat handling and improved rotor dynamics. Significantly faster isotope separation with enhanced safety protocols.

facilities.name: Weapons Grade Plutonium Containment Vat
facilities.description: Purpose-built shielded assembly line for sealing weapons-grade plutonium into hazmat casks. Lead-lined work stations and automated clamping systems ensure safe handling and consistent seal integrity.

facilities.name: Weapons Grade Plutonium Extraction Unit
facilities.description: A precision extraction system for separating weapons-grade plutonium from its containment matrix. Heavy steel and copper shielding with hardened controls ensures safe, controlled output.

facilities.name: Weapons-Grade Processing Unit
facilities.description: Reinforced plant with extensive lead shielding and radiation-hardened electronics, incorporating hazmat containment and improved isotope separation. Substantially faster and safer than baseline.

facilities.name: Weapons Salvage Bench
facilities.description: A cutting and welding station that turns scrap metal into crude weapon mounting frames. The tolerances are loose. The pirates don't mind.

facilities.name: Whale-Blubber Confit Galley
facilities.description: Slow confit baths and sealing benches for preserved grazer meat.

facilities.name: Whale-Oil Grog Bar
facilities.description: A mulling kettle for hot grog with a controversial whale-oil float.

facilities.name: White Metal Foundry Complex
facilities.description: An industrial foundry complex with paired induction furnaces and coolant networks rated for platinum's brutal melting point, casting fin arrays at volume without losing a pour to thermal drift.

facilities.name: Wildlife Corral
facilities.description: A ring of drift-fencing, a feed trough, and a two-person pressure shack. The animals come for the feed and stay because nothing out here shoots at them — which is more than they can say for the rest of the belt.
facilities.satisfied_description: The trough is full, the hands are on shift, and the herd grazes in a slow orbit of the feed line. Calm, fed, multiplying.
facilities.degraded_description: The trough is empty and the shack's air scrubber is running on fumes. The herd is thinning — every cycle unfed, a few more drift back out into the wild.

facilities.name: Wire Spinner
facilities.description: A dedicated production line that processes raw copper ore into bundled wiring through controlled heating and extrusion. Steady output suitable for modest station demand.

facilities.name: Wiring Harness Facility
facilities.description: Precision facility with quantum-controlled tensioning and real-time optical inspection of every bundle. Handles complex multi-gauge harnesses with integrated signal lines and shielding.

facilities.name: Wiring Harness Hub
facilities.description: Fully automated high-speed line with simultaneous multi-harness production and instantaneous defect detection. Precision optics and quantum controls achieve four-second cycle times across all bundle configurations.

facilities.name: Wiring Harness Plant
facilities.description: A larger facility with automated winding and multi-stage quality inspection for consistent bundle geometry. Processing cores and sensor arrays verify conductor continuity and insulation integrity.

facilities.name: Wiring Harness Workshop
facilities.description: A straightforward production line that spools, bundles, and terminates copper wiring with flex polymer insulation. Basic control systems manage cutting, stripping, and crimp operations.

facilities.name: Workshop Fabricator
facilities.description: A personal fabrication rig wired into this station's workshop: precision jigs, powered assembly arms, and a full materials library. The fastest your own two hands will ever build.
facilities.satisfied_description: Assembly arms calibrated, materials staged, the line never waits on you. Hand-crafting here is as fast as it gets.
facilities.degraded_description: The seals are compromised and the arms drift between calibrations. Still a long way ahead of a bare bench.

facilities.name: Workshop Power Tools
facilities.description: A set of personal power tools, jigs, and a materials rack bolted into your bay at this station's workshop. Heavier kit, faster work — your hand-crafting here is quicker still.
facilities.satisfied_description: Powered jigs and a tuned lathe make short work of every build. You feel the speed.
facilities.degraded_description: The power feeds brown out at peak hours and the lathe needs calibrating. Still beats hand tools.

facilities.name: Workshop Toolkit
facilities.description: Your own roll-away toolkit installed at this station's workshop — sharper tools laid out the way you like them. Everything you hand-craft at this station's Station Workshop comes together faster. Only helps where it's installed.
facilities.satisfied_description: Tools are sharp, the bench is yours, and every job starts a beat sooner. Hand-crafting here is quicker.
facilities.degraded_description: Scattered parts and dull blades. The soldering iron takes ten minutes to heat — barely better than the bare bench.

facilities.name: Xeno Smokehouse
facilities.description: A cure-and-smoke rig with a fermentation locker for aging. Slow work — but it turns prime cuts into a smoked delicacy fit for a tasting menu.

facilities.name: Xenobiology Lab
facilities.description: Expanded facility with multiple cultivation chambers, advanced environmental controls, and air recycling systems to maintain optimal conditions for rapid culture growth and compound recovery.

facilities.name: Xenon Cell Factory
facilities.description: A large-scale operation featuring quantum control cores and precision optics for exact xenon gas metering and circuit board integration. Sensor arrays and processing cores work in concert to ensure consistent cell performance and capacity.

facilities.name: Xenon Cell Lab
facilities.description: A precision electronics facility that integrates purified xenon gas, circuit boards, and copper wiring into functional energy storage cells. Basic sensor arrays verify component alignment during assembly.

facilities.name: Xenon Compression Plant
facilities.description: An expanded facility with integrated processing cores and sensor arrays for real-time quality verification of xenon containment and electrical circuits. Improved component precision and throughput via automated calibration systems.

facilities.name: Xenon Concentration Nexus
facilities.description: State-of-the-art automated gas processing complex with distributed chemical-lined systems and comprehensive hazmat containment. Multiple purification stages and cooling circuits achieve near-complete separation and concentration of xenon at maximum throughput.

facilities.name: Xenon Ionization Plant
facilities.description: Expanded production facility with structural-frame reinforcement, increased processing-core capacity, and parallel sensor-array staging to double output throughput.

facilities.name: Xenon Processing Complex
facilities.description: Industrial-scale facility with reinforced frames supporting extensive chemical-lined piping and hazmat infrastructure. Coolant loops manage thermal loads from compression stages while multiple purification columns run in parallel.

facilities.name: Xenon Purification Line
facilities.description: An industrial gas processing facility that concentrates and purifies xenon from raw gas inputs. Chemical-lined vessels and hazmat containers safely handle the noble gas while control nodes regulate pressure and flow.

facilities.name: Xenon Purification Unit
facilities.description: Larger-scale gas refinery with chemical liners throughout the circulation system and multiple hazmat containment vessels. Separation columns work in series to achieve higher purity xenon output.

facilities.name: Xenon Synthesis Complex
facilities.description: A state-of-the-art facility with quantum control systems, advanced sensor networks, and precision optic alignment for xenon containment at maximum efficiency. Produces power cells with superior energy density through automated multi-stage integration and verification.

facilities.name: Yellowcake Plant
facilities.description: Larger multi-stage leaching facility with dual extraction chambers, extensive lead shielding, and radiation-hardened instrumentation. Accelerates concentrate production through parallel processing and solvent recycling.

facilities.name: Zero-Defect Drawing Plant
facilities.description: State-of-the-art facility featuring redundant plasma injectors, extensive heat-sink arrays, and closed-loop cryogenic cooling. Achieves maximum throughput via parallel processing streams and real-time thermal regulation.

facilities.name: Zero-G Lounge & Bar
facilities.description: A rotating-null-gravity bar deck where drinks pour in slow motion and the crowd drifts as much as it mingles. A favorite stop for business-class travelers with a layover to kill.
facilities.satisfied_description: The gravity rig's running smooth, the bar's fully stocked, and the crowd's thick enough that finding a spot to drift takes a minute.
facilities.degraded_description: The gravity rig's stuttering and the bar's rationing pours. Still open, but the novelty's wearing thin without the polish.

facilities.name: Zero-Resistance Manufactory
facilities.description: Cutting-edge facility with precision plasma-injection arrays, quantum-grade process control, and extensive coolant infrastructure for uninterrupted zero-resistance conductor synthesis. Reinforced framing supports maximum throughput at industrial scale.

facilities.name: Zero-Resistance Manufacturing Hub
facilities.description: Cutting-edge facility with precision plasma-injection arrays, quantum-grade process control, and extensive coolant infrastructure for uninterrupted zero-resistance conductor synthesis. Reinforced framing supports maximum throughput at industrial scale.

facilities.name: Zerothermal Ceramic Plant
facilities.description: State-of-the-art manufacturing system featuring redundant plasma injection, cryogenic coolant loops, and real-time composition monitoring. Achieves near-instantaneous glass-ceramic formation with zero tolerance for defects.

facilities.name: Zinc-Oxygen Cell Line
facilities.description: A controlled-atmosphere line that rolls zinc electrodes and installs magnetic regulators into oxygen-fed power cells.

facilities.name: Zinc Smelter
facilities.description: A compact roasting furnace with vapor capture and casting molds for clean zinc ingots.
